description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Organization's Summary Statement:
  
The A. James Clark School of Engineering at the University of Maryland serves as the catalyst for high-quality research, innovation, and learning, delivering on a promise that all graduates will leave ready to impact the Grand Challenges (e.g., energy, environment, security, and human health) of the 21st century. The Clark School is dedicated to leading and transforming the engineering discipline and profession, to accelerating entrepreneurship, and to transforming research and learning activities into new innovations that benefit millions.
  
  
About the CATT Lab
  
The Center for Advanced Transportation Technology (CATT) Laboratory is the industry leader for transportation information analysis, visualization, and user interface design. We provide cutting-edge analytics products and an integrated suite of situational awareness tools for transportation practitioners. These products and services are rapidly changing the way governments operate and make decisions. You can learn more about our products at https://ritis.org/.
  
  
We receive hundreds of gigabytes of transportation data daily, making our petabytes of archived data likely the largest collection of traffic data in the world. Our clients use our software to monitor real-time operations and analyze historical data to generate valuable insights. Our work saves taxpayers money, improves the environment, and saves lives!
  
  
We’re as passionate about transportation as we are about building great software. We care about building usable, stable, and secure software to analyze massive amounts of data. We use cutting-edge tech to build and maintain our software. We have a mature development process and use industry best practices to build the best software possible. Our team is composed of application developers, analysts, UX designers, data scientists, IT, quality assurance specialists, and customer support operating in an Agile environment.
  
  
Our office is in College Park near the University of Maryland, easily accessible by DC Metro, MARC train, bus, car, and bike. Local employees are welcome to work in our office, or other locations, with a flexible schedule around our core hours. We also have many employees who are fully remote and work from different states. UMD requires all employees to live in the US, and we periodically bring remote employees to work with colleagues on-site.
  
  
We believe varied perspectives build better products, are proud to have a diverse team, and encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.
  
  
When you join our team, you will work to define, document, and test a wide variety of transportation data analytics and operations applications. You will learn new skills and stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies.
  
  
Data Engineer Position Summary:
  
The CATT Lab is seeking a mid-career or senior Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team. This individual will work to design, develop, and support over 40 relational database instances and distributed Cassandra and Hadoop instances. They will design geospatial data processing solutions for critical infrastructure planning and operations managers, applying their knowledge, skills, and experience to create stable, secure, and reliable data platforms supporting custom data analytics applications. If you’re looking for complex data problems in the GIS domain to collaboratively solve with a brilliant research and development team, please apply!
  
  
Essential duties and responsibilities:
  
Design, develop, deploy, and manage data storage and processing solutions
  
Develop data models and schemas for new data sources for both relational and non-relational distributed platforms
  
Write and maintain data pipelines to ingest large datasets from APIs and cloud storage to local storage instances
  
Write data retrieval, statistical calculation, and geospatial analysis queries and stored procedures
  
Assist with analysis and discovery of new datasets for integration into existing internal platforms
  
Collaborate with the data platform team to optimize data processing pipeline performance.
  
Work with application developers to debug and tune queries for performance
  
Estimate effort for work tasks and report on work progress to technical team lead
  
Participate in our Tier II Support team rotation
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
Education:
  
B.S. Degree in Computer Science or related field
  
  
Experience:
  
2+ years relevant professional experience with design, development, and administration of data platform solutions
  
Experience deploying, configuring, maintaining, and upgrading production-level database servers and services
  
Experience leading or supporting the implementation of complex, high demand and volume data platform solutions.
  
Experience in a technical team individual contributor role, responsible for deliverables on multiple projects.
  
Experience writing ETL scripts, APIs and standalone applications in both Python and Java with advanced knowledge of SQL.
  
  
Preferences:
  
Experience administering PostgreSQL servers, performance tuning, streaming replication, and PgBouncer failover configuration
  
Experience with non-relational data storage and processing solutions like Cassandra, Hadoop, Spark, Iceberg, Sedona etc.
  
Experience working with geospatial datasets, using geospatial extensions (such as PostGIS) and querying features.
  
Experience with Linux (RHEL), including writing robust Bash scripts.
  
Experience architecting and implementing backup and recovery strategies.
  
Experience with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket.
  
Experience with cloud platforms including AWS and GCP.
  
Experience as a technical lead, overseeing the work product of others and mentoring more junior developers.

title: DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Overview:

Founded in 1921, the Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is a leading nonprofit membership organization, research center, and publisher, with headquarters in New York, an office in Washington, DC, and programs nationwide. It is dedicated to increasing America's understanding of the world and contributing ideas to U.S. foreign policy. CFR’s 5,000+ members are leaders in international affairs and foreign policy. CFR also publishes Foreign Affairs, the preeminent magazine on global issues, and provides up-to-date information about the world and U.S. foreign policy on its award-winning website, CFR.org.

Position Summary:

The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is seeking an experienced DevOps engineer / Site Reliability Engineer. This role is responsible for maintaining the secure and reliable functioning of our digital properties including CFR.org, ForeignAffairs.com, Think Global Health, The China Open Source Observatory, and other associated web and mobile sites. The portfolio spans a managed WordPress VIP publishing platform, Pantheon publishing platform, and custom AWS applications.

This role owns the reliability, resilience, security, and observability of those properties, the delivery pipeline that ships to them, and a growing set of AI and agentic services built on top of them. Your goal is to prevent outages; when incidents happen, you lead the response and make sure we learn from them. You will work closely with the software engineering team and report to the associate vice president of product, design, and engineering.

This full-time position is based in CFR’s New York City or Washington D.C. office on a hybrid basis. CFR currently defines hybrid status as working at least four days a week onsite, with Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays considered institutional anchor days where all staff are required to be onsite.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities:

* Define and track SLOs and error budgets for each property. Own on-call, incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems.
* Run observability, logging, and alerting systems (Datadog, Dash0) to track service health, improve resilience, and prevent downtime, and raise issues before visitors or stakeholders ever see a problem.
* Own infrastructure, backup, and disaster recovery documentation and execution.
* Maintain the CI/CD pipelines for CFR.org and our applications, including WordPress VIP and Pantheon deploys as well as custom AWS apps; debug failed runs and keep configurations current.
* Provision and manage AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform, with policy checks and drift detection in the pipeline.
* Identify opportunities to use automation, testing, and deployments.
* Build security into every stage of delivery: manage Okta-based role-based access, own secrets, key management and rotation.
* Own infrastructure, backup, and disaster recovery documentation and execution.
* Own AWS security posture and edge/WAF configuration.
* Lead incident response, determine root cause on production issues, mitigate, and provide technical support to the engineering team as needed.
* Assist DevSecOps contractors, vendors, and cross-functional technical contributors to deliver against the platform roadmap

Minimum Qualifications:

**Experience**

* 3-7 years experience in DevOps, SRE, platform or security engineering.
* Proven experience with AWS and infrastructure as code with Terraform.
* Experience with managed platforms such as WordPress VIP, Pantheon, Acquia, or similar.
* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and multi-environment deployments. Familiarity with supply-chain security tooling.
* Hands-on experience applying zero-trust principles. SSO/MFA through an identity provider (Okta), least-privilege IAM, short-lived credentials, and secrets management (1password, AWS Secrets Manager or similar).
* Scripting in Bash and Python. Working familiarity with PHP and Node.js/TypeScript. Working knowledge of WAF/CDN services such as Cloudflare, Cloudfront, or, Fastly.
* Strong communication and problem solving skills, serving as a collaborative bridge across engineering, operations, IT, and vendors.

Required Application Materials:

Please submit a résumé and cover letter stating your interest in the position.

Compensation and Benefits:

* The full-time annual compensation range for this position is $150,000 – $175,000, depending on experience.
* In addition to competitive salaries, the Council on Foreign Relations offers a benefits package that is among the best offered by nonprofit institutions today, including an award-winning health and wellness program, an on-site fitness center, and generous leave policies and health insurance programs.

About CFR:

The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is committed to fostering a foreign policy community in the United States that is more representative of American society, recognizing that diverse backgrounds and perspectives contribute to broader, more informed participation in the foreign policy debate and lead to an enhanced understanding of the world and the United States’ role therein. To that end, CFR is dedicated to continuing to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout its work and workplace by building a more diverse membership and staff, producing and dispensing thoughtful analysis on a broad range of foreign policy issues, and developing relevant, wide-reaching programming that also serves to expand the foreign policy talent pipeline to underrepresented populations.

description:
**Company Description**

Ent Credit Union and Wings Credit Union joined forces in January 2026. This merger means more opportunities, expanded resources, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional member service. Together, we become more - empowering members, communities, and teams through a bold, unified future. Both organizations bring a strong legacy of member satisfaction, operational excellence, financial stability, and community impact.  **Job Description**

Ent is looking for a DevOps Engineer II to join our cross functional platform team. This position would be responsible for handling the pipeline work to get our software safely and securely deployed to our cloud environment, allowing the development staff to concentrate on developing the next great feature to delight our members. This person needs to be comfortable working on a cross functional team made up of Network Operations, Application Security, Security Operations, and other developers. This person will be solving problems to keep our systems highly available, performant, and facilitate the safe deployment of new code and cloud infrastructure. This person will be solving challenging problems, collaborating across teams, and passionate about having an impact on a growing team and organization.  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Tactical Cloud Support / Maintenance Activities:
  + Provision, configure, administrate, automate, monitor, and support enterprise Cloud services.
  + Through automation, enforce continuous compliance to operation and security standards.
  + Perform operational Architecting for activities which include platform upgrades, server patching, monitoring, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  + Provide periodic off-hours on-call support for production and development environments.
  + Manage security logging, monitoring, and alert triage and participate in security incident response and investigation.
* Strategic Cloud / Automation & Guidance:
  + Key player in enterprise datacenter modernization initiative by researching, designing, recommending, and implementing an Azure cloud infrastructure which supports global business applications and operations.
  + Assist in the development of processes and practices as it relates to the migration of workloads to Azure.
  + Design state-of-the-art technical solutions on Azure that are scalable, reliable, secure, and meet performance requirements.
  + Support architectural design and new cloud service implementations utilizing industry best practices.
  + Assist with the planning and migration of legacy applications to the Azure Cloud.
  + May assist other team members with questions related to cloud services as a subject matter expert.
* Enable Development / Automation:
  + Developing pipelines (currently in Azure DevOps) to build and deploy code and infrastructure into our Azure cloud environment.
  + Training of developer staff on how to release code, utilize the pipelines, and local Kubernetes development.
  + Mentoring and training other DevOps engineers.
  + Researching enabling technology based on the future needs of the development staff and their feature roadmaps.
* Bank Secrecy Act: Remains cognizant of and adheres to Wings policies and procedures, and regulations pertaining to the Bank Secrecy Act.

  
**Qualifications**

**Minimum Formal Qualifications for this Position:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Architecting, or related technical field, *preferred*
* 2+ years' combined technical IT related experience *required* to include at least:
  + 1+ years' experience in a DevOps role, *required*

**Technical or Specialized Knowledge/Skills:**

* Azure experience, in particular with Azure Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings
* Understanding of cloud security
* Understanding of Azure platform and network security.
* Understanding of Azure identity and access management.
* Strong scripting and programming skills (e.g. PowerShell, Python, etc.)
* Able to maintain custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks.
* Strong interpersonal skills used in developing strong working relationships and effective listening skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent decision-making, problem solving and conflict resolution capabilities.
* Experience with utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in a cloud environment
* Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) tools, preferably Azure DevOps and/or GitHub
* Knowledge of Git source control
* Experience on a Scrum/Kanban team
* Team play that fully embraces the DevOps culture, eliminating barriers and bridging moats
* (preferred) Network skills.
* (preferred) Experience with tools such as HELM, Ansible, Terraform
* (preferred) Kubernetes/Docker expertise

**Certifications Required:**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Developer Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert, *preferred*

  
**Additional Information**

**PAY RANGE: $**119,000 to $139,000 Annually (I16) plus a 15% annual target bonus  
  
*Final compensation for this position will be determined by various factors such as relevant work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, certifications, location and internal pay equity.*  
  
  
**BENEFITS:**

* 401k Discretionary Profit Sharing

* Dental Insurance

* Life Insurance

* Health Savings Account with company contribution

* Paid Vacation, Sick, Floating Holidays and Volunteer Time Off

title: Senior Cloud Engineer - Governance
description:
**About Delinea:**  
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

**Summary:**

We are seeking a skilled Cloud Engineer with a focus on Cloud Governance to join our team. This role is critical in ensuring that our cloud infrastructure is managed effectively, securely, and in compliance with industry standards and company policies.

**What You'll Do:**

* Develop, implement, monitor, and enforce cloud governance frameworks and policies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices; We automate everything for efficiency
* Ensure cloud infrastructure adheres to security best practices and compliance

standards

* Conduct regular security assessments and audits
* Implement and manage identity and access management (IAM) policies
* Manage and implement hardware security keys (e.g., YubiKeys)
* Monitor cloud usage, costs, and implement strategies to optimize spending
* Provide regular reports and insights on cloud costs and usage trends to senior leadership and Finance
* Develop automated, seamless, and simple solutions to minimize repetitive manual operations
* Work closely with development and security teams to minimize restrictions that inhibit progress as well as ensuring cloud governance policies are integrated into workflows
* Provide communication, training, and guidance to development teams on new policies, procedures, and best practices for cloud resource management
* Develop CI/CD pipelines for deploying policies and other CSP management
* Respond to and resolve cloud governance-related incidents and issues; Provide

root cause analysis when necessary

**What You'll Bring:**

* Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud
* Deep understanding and proven ability to effectively manage an Enterprise-scale **Entra** environment
* Implementation of **Zero Trust** security strategies and proven ability to protect identities, endpoints, data, applications, and infrastructure
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, and/or CloudFormation Templates (CFT)
* Experience with large scale CSP (Cloud Service Provider) account and vendor relationship management
* Proven ability to align cloud environments with compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC2, **FedRAMP**, **NIST**)
* Expert in Identity and Access Management (IAM)
* Strong understanding and experience with SAML and OIDC for authentication
* Strong understanding and experience with JIT (Just-In-Time) privilege elevation
* Experience with cloud cost management tools and strategies and ability to analyze and report on cloud cost data
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively
* Relevant cloud certifications (e.g. Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect)
* Previous experience in a similar role focusing on cloud governance

For this Job, Delinea is not considering candidates that need any type of US work authorization now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J1, etc.

**Why work at Delinea?**

* We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.
* We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.
* What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

* Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do
* Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments
* Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

* Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

description:

**Job Summary**

Responsible to the assigned supervisor for performing entry level engineering work activities and projects requiring the application of engineering knowledge in a safe, effective, efficient and economic accomplishment of assigned objectives.

**Job Description**

**What You’ll Do:**  
This position is for the role of a Tools & Analytics Engineer within the Transmission System Operations Engineering (TSOE) organization. The role entails supporting and enhancing the tools, applications, data systems, analytics, and automation processes used to manage Transmission Facility Ratings, Configuration Management, transmission modeling, and regulatory compliance activities across the transmission system.

Expected activities include, but are not limited to:

* Providing technical support for TSOE-owned applications, databases, reports, dashboards, and automation solutions used by Transmission Engineering, Operations, Ratings & Configuration, and Configuration Management organizations.
* Developing, maintaining, and enhancing software applications, scripts, APIs, reports, and integrations used to support transmission modeling, facility ratings, engineering workflows, and business processes.
* Creating and supporting SQL, Oracle, and other database queries to analyze engineering, operational, and compliance-related data and provide actionable information to engineering and leadership teams.
* Designing, developing, and maintaining Power BI dashboards, performance metrics, and reporting solutions that improve visibility into Transmission operations, Configuration Management activities, FAC-008 compliance, and engineering performance.
* Supporting Transmission Planning System (TPS), ODMS, facility ratings processes, and related transmission modeling tools by validating data quality, identifying discrepancies, and coordinating corrective actions.
* Reviewing outage requests, asset changes, engineering records, and system data to identify potential impacts to transmission models, facility ratings, and systems of record.
* Performing root cause analysis of data quality issues, model discrepancies, reporting inaccuracies, and process failures to identify improvement opportunities and enhance data integrity.
* Collaborating with engineering, operations, IT, vendors, and external stakeholders to define requirements, implement enhancements, and support modernization of TSOE applications and data systems.
* Providing subject matter expertise related to transmission system modeling, facility ratings, MLSEs, electrical asset data, Configuration Management, and applicable NERC and industry standards.
* Identifying and implementing opportunities to automate manual processes, improve engineering efficiency, reduce compliance risk, and increase the accuracy and accessibility of transmission system data.

**What we’re looking for:**

This is an engineer role which requires an engineer degree and experience.

  

Note: This position is posted at multiple grade levels and offers a range of opportunities for advancement. The minimum qualifications outlined below apply to the Associate level, with increased educational, skill or experience requirements for higher level roles.

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (non-ABET) plus a Master's degree or PhD in engineering from a university with an ABET accredited Bachelor's program.

*In addition:*

* Electrical engineer is preferred.
* Transmission system modeling (TPS, ODMS, PSSE, bus/branch concepts)
* Facility Ratings and FAC-008 knowledge
* NERC compliance understanding
* SQL and Oracle database experience
* Power BI development
* Python, .NET, PowerShell, or other programming experience
* API and system integration experience
* Data analytics and business intelligence
* Understanding of transmission assets, stations, transmission lines, relays, and ratings methodology

*This role requires schedule flexibility. Candidates should expect to work outside of standard business hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. The ability to work non-traditional hours and adapt to changing schedules is essential for success in this position.*

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Description**
Leidos Civil IT division is focused on innovation and solving complex technical problems spanning infrastructure operations, cybersecurity analytics, and application modernization. We rely on a team of skilled staff capable of operating across technical domains, embracing challenges, and being adaptable to new technologies and new ideas.
  
  
**This position is Telework / Remote.**
***Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.***
**About The Role**
The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer supports the operation, maintenance, automation, and continued modernization of AWS and hybrid-cloud infrastructure supporting federal systems. The engineer will work alongside senior infrastructure and security engineers to implement cloud changes, troubleshoot issues, maintain infrastructure-as-code, remediate vulnerabilities, monitor system health, and improve operational processes.
  
  
This is a developmental engineering position intended for an individual with strong technical fundamentals who wants to build deeper expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure, automation, networking, and security. The engineer is not expected to arrive as an expert across the AWS platform but should demonstrate technical curiosity, ownership, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies.
  
  
**About The Candidate**
We are specifically looking for someone who can:
  
  

* Support AWS infrastructure, including EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, load balancing, DNS, and related services.
* Implement infrastructure changes using established architecture, procedures, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Maintain and modify Terraform and/or CloudFormation configurations under guidance from senior engineers.
* Monitor cloud resources and investigate availability, performance, configuration, and security issues.
* Troubleshoot networking, operating system, application connectivity, permissions, DNS, and cloud-service issues.
* Support vulnerability remediation, patching, configuration compliance, and security-hardening activities.
* Assist with cloud migrations, modernization efforts, disaster recovery, and infrastructure lifecycle activities.
* Develop scripts and automation to reduce repetitive administrative work.
* Maintain technical documentation, diagrams, procedures, and change records.
* Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Work with senior engineers to learn cloud architecture, security, networking, automation, and operational best practices.
* Gradually assume ownership of cloud services and technical workstreams as experience develops.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems or a relevant field and 1-3 years of practical experience in the field.
* Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.
* Ability to independently manage assigned work, document technical activities, communicate issues, and seek assistance when appropriate.
* Demonstrated self-initiative to build enterprise-like AWS systems and resources that align with well-architected frameworks.
* Understanding of fundamental networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, subnets, and firewalls/security groups, with the ability to apply systematic troubleshooting methods.
* Basic understanding of infrastructure security concepts such as least privilege, vulnerability remediation, system hardening, and security baselines.
* Hands-on experience building solutions with CloudFormation, Terraform, Python, or other tools.

**Beneficial Qualifications**

* Cloud-related certifications (Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, etc.).
* Exposure to CIS Benchmarks, STIGs, or similar security and compliance frameworks.

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. We need to reliably produce well-understood, easy-to-use datasets that can answer existing and future analytical questions. You will focus on core tools, frameworks, and patterns that will enable the whole team to meet our data quality and monitoring goals. OCI is seeking a highly motivated individual with expertise in data engineering and analytics, strong communication skills, and a passion for solving complex business problems. Responsibilities include building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, integrating disparate data sources, and developing trusted datasets, dashboards, and actionable insights across OCI’s strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical expertise with business acumen to translate complex data into clear recommendations that advance OCI’s strategic and financial objectives.

Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

title: Data Engineer, Market Data
description:
MIO Partners Inc. (MIO) is a global, world-class investment and advisory institution with a decades-long track record of performance for our clients through multiple market cycles. Our team of approximately 250 people provides asset management and advisory services to current and former McKinsey employees. We manage more than $20 billion in assets across public and private markets. We are headquartered in New York City, with offices in Atlanta, Georgia; West Palm Beach, Florida; Germany; Hong Kong; Singapore; Spain; and the UK.

We provide objective advice on long-term wealth building and create distinctive investment products that deliver value relative to market-based benchmarks. We operate two core lines of business: (i) our advisory team provides advice, wealth planning, and retirement services to approximately 2500 individual clients, and (ii) our investments business consists of alpha-seeking alternative investment strategies across public and private markets.

A defining characteristic of our business is our perfect alignment with our clients. Our extraordinary mandate as a boutique investment and advisory firm, grounded in a core set of principles, enables us to create unique products and services while keeping our clients’ interests front and center.

Much of our success can be attributed to our insatiable intellectual curiosity. We seek to hire individuals who are passionate about our mission and values, and who always strive toward excellence. We care about fostering a culture of continual improvement, as individuals and as an organization, and are excited to work with individuals who have a similar growth mindset. We are proud to have a culture that promotes the highest ethical standards and investor-focused values, alongside a commitment to diversity and inclusivity and a highly collaborative work environment.

MIO (and related entities) is an independent, indirect, and wholly owned subsidiary of McKinsey & Company.

***Position***

MIO is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Research & Investment Technology team and help build and scale our market data platform. This is an opportunity for an early- to mid-level professional to deepen their expertise at the intersection of data engineering and financial markets.

In this role, you will work alongside experienced engineers and architects to ingest, transform, and ensure the quality of market data from leading providers such as Bloomberg, LSEG, and ICE. You will gain hands-on experience with modern data pipelines, cloud-based infrastructure, and the complexities of financial datasets, while building a strong foundation in scalable data systems that support research and trading workflows.

***Primary responsibilities***

* **Data Pipeline Development**
  + Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for market and reference data
  + Support data ingestion, transformation, and loading across systems
  + Monitor pipeline performance and troubleshoot issues under guidance
* **Data Modeling:** Analyze vendor datasets across asset classes and map them to the MIO canonical data model
* **Vendor Integration:** Integrate data from providers such as Bloomberg and Refinitiv; normalize and standardize datasets for firmwide use
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Partner with Portfolio Managers and Analysts to deliver reliable, bespoke data solutions for research and trading
* **System Architecture:** Contribute to the design and evolution of scalable data architectures using modern frameworks and cloud services
* **Infrastructure Management:** Manage and optimize data infrastructure, including Aurora SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Redshift); support the evolution of scalable storage solutions
* **Data Management and Operations**: Monitor platform health, manage alerts, and resolve production issues within defined SLAs
* **Data Quality and Governance:** Implement data quality checks and controls to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across datasets
* **Cost Review and Optimization:** Review our data usage, infrastructure, and vendor spend; identify opportunities to improve efficiency and align with budget

***Required skills & qualifications***

* Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 5+ years of experience working with financial datasets, preferably in buy-side (hedge fund) or capital markets environments, including renowned data providers such as Bloomberg, ICE, or LSEG
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines working with orchestration tools is preferred
* Hands-on experience with AWS, including services such as S3, Aurora, Athena, Redshift, and Lambda
* Experience with CI/CD practices and AWS-native tooling
* Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and data quality frameworks
* Solid understanding of financial data concepts, including market data, security masters, time-series data, and reference data across asset classes (e.g., commodities, fixed income, FX, digital asset, etc.)

***Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employer-sponsored work authorization, now or in the future.***

*MIO has adopted a flexible, hybrid model that supports a blend of in-office and remote work. Our office is in New York City.*

*Certain US states require MIO Partners, Inc. to include a reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to an individual’s assigned office location, experience, and expertise. Certain roles are also eligible for bonuses, subject to MIO’s discretion and based on factors such as individual and/or organizational performance. Additionally, MIO offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision coverage, telemedicine services, life, accident and disability insurance, parental leave and family planning benefits, caregiving resources, a generous retirement program, financial guidance, and paid time off.*

Base salary range

$160,000 - $160,000 USD

*MIO Partners, Inc. (MIO) is an equal opportunity employer. MIO will consider all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.*

*We are committed to protecting your privacy. Please review our* *Applicant Privacy Policy* *for a detailed explanation of how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.*

title: Founding Data Engineer
description:
Our client, a growing AI and Data organization, is hiring a **Founding Data Engineer** to join the team. The successful candidate will help transform enterprise data into actionable intelligence by building the backend systems, data pipelines, connector frameworks and graph-based knowledge models that power their Agentic AI applications.

**Responsibilities**

* Build reliable, scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines across structured, semi-structured and unstructured data sources.
* Develop and maintain connector frameworks that integrate enterprise systems, including ERPs, PLMs, CRMs, legacy platforms, email, Excel, documents and web APIs.
* Design and enhance the Data Fabric layer, including knowledge graphs enriched with ontologies, metadata and relationships.
* Prepare, enrich, normalize and vectorize enterprise data for AI and LLM applications, including RAG, summarization and intelligent alerting.
* Establish and maintain data contracts, access layers, lineage, governance and data quality processes.
* Develop secure APIs that enable services, AI agents and users to access and query enriched semantic data.
* Partner with ML and LLM teams to provide high-quality enterprise data for model training, tuning and AI applications.
* Build robust systems that support schema evolution, observability, scalability and reliable production operations.

**Skillset**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience designing, building and operating large-scale data infrastructure in production environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with data ingestion frameworks such as Kafka, Airbyte, Meltano or Fivetran, alongside orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster or Prefect.
* Proven experience working with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, including PDFs, Excel, emails, logs, CSVs and web APIs.
* Experience with columnar data stores, object storage and modern lakehouse technologies such as Iceberg, Delta or Parquet.
* Strong understanding of knowledge graphs and semantic modelling, with experience using platforms such as Neo4j, RDF, Gremlin or PuppyGraph.
* Experience designing and developing GraphQL and REST APIs, as well as scalable and developer-friendly data access layers.
* Strong knowledge of data governance principles, including RBAC, ABAC, data contracts, lineage and data quality.
* Experience with vector databases and embedding pipelines, including technologies, such as Weaviate, Qdrant or Pinecone, is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with enterprise connector ecosystems, ontology versioning, graph diffing and semantic schema alignment is an advantage.
* Exposure to RAG pipelines, LLM fine-tuning, Linked Data, W3C standards or modern data fabric architectures is a plus.

**Benefits**

* Salary: $150k – $200k.
* Equity.

title: Sr. DevOps / Cloud Engineer
description:
**Req ID:** 397350
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Sr. DevOps / Cloud Engineer to join our team in either Plano, TX or Nashville, TN. Please note that this role will be on-site 5 days/week.
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Position Summary / Day-to-Day Responsibilities
  
  
We are seeking an experienced DevOps / Cloud Engineer to support cloud-based data platforms and automation initiatives, with a strong focus on Terraform, Kubernetes, Java/Python, and deployment automation. The engineer will design and maintain scalable infrastructure-as-code solutions using Terraform and will be expected to quickly upskill in OpenTofu as the platform evolves. This role will work closely with data engineering and application teams to support automated deployments, containerized workloads, and cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who combines strong Terraform and Kubernetes expertise with Java OR Python development capabilities and an understanding of modern cloud and data engineering practices. Day-to-day responsibilities will include developing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code, supporting CI/CD and deployment automation, troubleshooting platform and infrastructure issues, and collaborating with technical and business stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  

* 5+ years of overall experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 3+ years of hands-on Terraform experience, including Infrastructure as Code (IaC), infrastructure provisioning, and deployment automation.
* 3+ years of hands-on Kubernetes experience supporting containerized applications or cloud-based platforms.
* 3+ years of Java or Python programming experience, with the ability to develop, modify, and troubleshoot code supporting platform and automation capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience with OpenTofu, or the ability to quickly transition existing Terraform expertise to OpenTofu.
* Experience with AWS and cloud-based data engineering platforms, including knowledge of AWS security practices.
* Experience with Apache NiFi and modern data engineering practices and tooling.
* Experience with Docker, Prometheus, GitHub, and Jenkins Core.
* Familiarity with Open Table Format (OTF) or modern data lakehouse architectures.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently, communicate effectively, and explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for U.S.-based positions. The starting pay range for this role will depend on the location of the successful candidate.
  
  
For candidates in both Plano, TX and Nashville, TN, the starting pay range is $104,240-$130,300. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.
  
  
This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance.
  
  
This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and ADD insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefit

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, and operates Allegro's cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines with security built in from the start. This role turns platform standards into working, repeatable code: Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, and automated security checks that let development teams ship quickly and safely. The engineer works across GCP and Azure environments and is a hands-on contributor to Allegro's secure software development lifecycle.

The role partners closely with Platform Architecture, Global Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and application development teams, and executes within established patterns and standards.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### ***Software composition analysis (SCA)***

* Deploy, configure, and maintain SCA tooling across source repositories and build pipelines.
* Onboard application teams and repositories to SCA scanning, and integrate scans as pipeline gates with agreed severity thresholds.
* Triage dependency vulnerability and license findings, work with developers on remediation, and track findings to closure.
* Generate and maintain software bills of materials (SBOMs) for in-scope applications.

### ***CI/CD pipelines***

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (for example GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build) for application and infrastructure code.
* Implement pipeline security controls: secrets management, signed artifacts, least-privilege service identities, and protected branches.
* Improve build reliability and speed, and troubleshoot pipeline failures across teams.

### ***Infrastructure as code and cloud CLI***

* Write and maintain Terraform to provision cloud resources consistently.
* Use cloud CLIs and SDKs plus scripting to automate operational tasks.
* Manage Terraform state, module versioning, and drift detection, and follow code review and change management practices.

### ***Platform architecture***

* Implement cloud landing zone components to approved designs: networking, identity and access, logging, and policy guardrails.
* Contribute to architecture discussions and document the components the engineer builds and supports.
* Apply security baselines (CIS benchmarks, organization policies, Azure Policy) to cloud resources and workloads.

### ***Secure SDLC***

* Integrate security testing into the development lifecycle: SCA, static analysis (SAST), secrets scanning, container and IaC scanning.
* Support developers in fixing findings and following secure coding and dependency management practices.
* Help produce evidence of SDLC controls for internal audit, SOX, ITGC, and CMMC requirements.

### ***Operations and collaboration***

* Monitor cloud environments for availability, cost, and security posture, and respond to incidents as part of an on-call rotation.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, Global Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, and application teams.
* Keep runbooks, diagrams, and standards documentation current.

**What You Will Need**
----------------------

  

* 3+ years in DevOps, cloud engineering, or systems engineering, with at least 2 years hands-on in a major cloud platform (GCP, Azure, or AWS).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or equivalent experience.
* Working proficiency with Terraform and at least one cloud CLI.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Scripting ability in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Understanding of cloud networking, IAM, and core security concepts.
* Familiarity with Git workflows and code review.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience deploying or operating SCA or other application security tooling.
* Exposure to containers and Kubernetes (GKE, AKS, or EKS).
* Cloud certification such as Google Professional Cloud Engineer, Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or AWS Solutions Architect Associate.
* Experience in a regulated environment (SOX, CMMC, NIST 800-171).

**Why Allegro?**

Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

We foster a culture of **Real Innovation**, empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.  
Your work will create a **Real Impact** by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.  
You’ll experience **Real Connection**, collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.  
**Join us—and help build what’s next.**

description:
Information and Transform

At **Duly Health and Care**, you are supported to do your best work and make a meaningful impact every day. You will be part of a collaborative, physician-led team that works as one and puts patients at the center of everything we do.  
  
With a connected network of providers, care teams, and services across primary and specialty care, surgery centers, imaging, lab, and therapy, you are part of a system designed to deliver high-quality, coordinated care. Together, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and help improve the experience and outcomes for every patient we serve.

* Access to a mental health benefit at no cost.

* $5,250 Tuition Reimbursement per year.

**Primary Purpose**

The Data Engineer I is an early-career role within the Data & Analytics team, responsible for helping build, operate, and improve the data pipelines that feed analytics, reporting, and AI across the enterprise. Working alongside senior engineers and architects, this position contributes to the organization's cloud data platform, including data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and pipeline monitoring. This role is a strong fit for someone with solid SQL and programming fundamentals who wants to grow into a data engineering career in a healthcare setting. No prior healthcare or Epic experience is required; we will train you.

**Major Responsibilities**

***Pipeline development and data integration (50%)***

* Build, test, and maintain batch and incremental data pipelines that ingest data from source systems, databases, APIs, and files into the enterprise lakehouse
* Develop transformations in SQL and Python to move data through layered (e.g., bronze/silver/gold) structures
* Support orchestration and scheduling of pipelines using the organization's data platform tools
* Apply version control, code review, and testing practices to all pipeline code
* Optimize queries and pipeline performance for reliability, reusability, and cost

***Data quality, monitoring, and platform support (30%)***

* Monitor pipeline runs, troubleshoot failures, and help resolve data issues in a timely manner
* Implement data quality rules, validation checks, and alerting within pipelines
* Follow organizational standards for data privacy and the protection of PHI/PII, including support for access control and security practices
* Assist in evaluating the impact of source system changes on downstream pipelines, models, and reports
* Document pipelines, data flows, runbooks, and release notes as required by our project delivery methodology

***Collaboration and continuous improvement (20%)***

* Partner with architects, analysts, BI developers, and data scientists to understand data needs and deliver trusted, well-structured data sets
* Work with business stakeholders to understand data definitions and requirements
* Learn from senior engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and mentoring
* Identify opportunities to improve data engineering standards, automation, and documentation
* All other duties as assigned

**Minimum Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data science, engineering, or a related field; or 2 years of related experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 0-2 years of experience working with relational databases, data engineering, or software development (internships, co-ops, and academic projects count)
* Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and transformation
* Experience with Python or another scripting language beneficial
* Experience with Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Azure Data Factory, or other cloud data platforms (Azure preferred) beneficial
* Experience with Git and CI/CD practices beneficial
* Healthcare or Epic Clarity experience not required; training provided

**Minimum Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA)**

* Understanding of relational database concepts, data modeling, and ETL/ELT patterns
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, and window functions
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences
* Attention to detail and a commitment to documentation and testing
* Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented environment
* Curiosity and a desire to learn modern data engineering practices
* Familiarity with data governance, data security, or privacy concepts helpful

If you are committed to putting our patients first and helping shape the future of care, you belong at Duly*.*

Additional compensation may be available through shift differentials, bonuses, and other incentives. Base pay is only a portion of the total rewards package.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Opiniion is a resident experience tool that partners with property management to create better living experiences for their residents. Our platform has helped thousands of property managers collect and act on real-time feedback, improve resident experiences, and enhance their online reputation. Opiniion is committed to exceptional service and innovation, earning recognition as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Driven by a forward-thinking team, we’re shaping the future of resident engagement. Our continued growth and commitment to innovation make this an exciting time to be part of our team!**
****LOCATION****
: Lehi, UT — Hybrid (Monday–Wednesday in office)
  
  
****EMPLOYMENT****
****TYPE****
: Full-time
  
  
**Position Overview**
Opiniion is a SaaS, AI-first company reshaping how businesses understand and act on customer feedback. We're looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to own the reliability, scalability, and security of our AWS infrastructure. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, automates everything that shouldn't be manual, and can move fast without breaking trust in the platform.
  
  
We're building a new platform alongside our current one, so this role requires balance: owning and operating what's live today while partnering with our Staff Software Architect and Staff Data Architect to stand up the infrastructure for what's next.
  
  
You'll set the technical bar for how we build, deploy, and operate our infrastructure, and be a key partner to engineering as we scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure on AWS.
* Balance ownership of existing production infrastructure with building new infrastructure for our next generation platform.
* Partner with the Staff Software Architect and Staff Data Architect to design the infrastructure foundation for the new platform, while ensuring a clean path to carry over what still needs to run from the current one.
* Own and evolve the CI/CD pipeline infrastructure and tooling that automation and quality gates run within.
* Drive infrastructure as code practices across the organization using Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Manage and optimize core AWS services (EC2, VPC, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch).
* Build and improve observability, monitoring, and alerting so issues are caught before they become incidents.
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis for production systems.
* Drive cost optimization and capacity planning across our cloud footprint.
* Embed security best practices into every stage of the deployment pipeline.
* Mentor engineers on DevOps and cloud infrastructure best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Proven track record leading complex DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure initiatives in a senior or staff-level role.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS, including EC2, VPC, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch.
* Strong experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* Proven track record building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Solid experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar).
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar).
* Working knowledge of networking, security groups, and AWS security best practices.
* Experience supporting SOC 2 or similar compliance frameworks.
* Comfort operating in a dual-track environment: maintaining a live production system while helping architect what replaces it.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* A strong bias for action and a mindset of continuous improvement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional or AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
* Experience with multi-country compliance requirements (data residency, privacy regulations, cross-border data handling).
* Experience supporting AI/ML workloads or MLOps pipelines on AWS.
* Background in high-growth SaaS environments or post-acquisition infrastructure consolidation.

**Opiniion’s Culture**
At Opiniion, we take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously! We work hard together, and we have a lot of fun doing it. We are a team that believes in real autonomy: you own your area, solve problems, and move fast enough to actually see the change you make. The people here are invested in each other just as much as they’re invested in the work, and that combination is what makes this place different. We believe in collaboration, innovation, and building a team that truly cares—about our clients, their residents, and each other.
  
  
**Benefits Snapshot**

* Comprehensive healthcare plans, encompassing medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with group life coverage. Opiniion covers 40-90% of the premium cost for employees and all dependents.
* 401(k) retirement plan with a 100% corporate match on the first 1% and 50% match on the next 5%.
* Pre-tax Health Savings Accounts (HSA).
* Paid Parental Leave for all new parents (including adoption or foster care).
* Unlimited Time Off policies.
* 10 Paid Holidays annually.
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement benefit.

\*Note that the above benefits are available only to full-time employees of Opiniion\*
  
  
**Opiniion is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.**

title: Platform Engineer (Azure)
description:
Platform Engineer (Azure), Boulder, CO (Hybrid or Remote)
  
  
Ascend's Azure platform runs the hosted environments behind Market Intelligence (MI), PowerVAL (PV), PowerSIMM (PS), SmartBidder (SB), Ascend Power Procurement (APP), and Ascend Energy Exchange (AEX). As Platform Engineer, you'll design, build, and operate that platform alongside our Senior Platform Engineer, working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and identity and security administration. You'll partner with Development, Model Support, and client-facing teams to deliver reliable environments, move clients from on-premises hosting into Azure, and help maintain our security and compliance posture.
  
  
You'll do well here if you have strong hands-on Azure skills, automate and document what you build, and can explain technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  
  
Our Mission @ Ascend
  
  
At Ascend Analytics, our mission centers on creating sustainable economic value for energy buyers and producers to transform the power industry. Our team combines advanced analytics, cloud-based technology, and deep market expertise to help our clients solve complex challenges across grid reliability, power market volatility, renewable integration, infrastructure development, and energy investment strategy. As a high-growth, private equity–backed company, Ascend continues to expand its market leadership while investing in innovation, talent, and scalable solutions for an increasingly dynamic energy market.
  
  
Your Impact @ Ascend
  
  
Real influence. Real outcomes. At every level.
  
  

* High-impact work. Shape the tools and decisions that drive the clean energy transition.
* Direct exposure. Work alongside executive leadership and key utility and corporate clients.
* Room to grow. A rapidly scaling SaaS business with real advancement opportunities.
* Collaborative culture. A team that values creative thought, inclusion, and work-life balance.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Azure infrastructure and networking
  
  

* Design, deploy, and maintain Azure resources, including virtual machines, App Services, container apps, batch accounts, storage accounts, file shares, and key vaults.
* Build and maintain Azure networking: VNets and subnets, site-to-site and point-to-site VPN, private endpoints, NAT gateways for static IP requirements, and Front Door routing.
* Configure and manage Azure Virtual Desktop host pools, images, scale plans, and published applications for analyst and developer workstations.
* Maintain backup, monitoring, and alerting coverage across development and production environments.

Automation and DevOps
  
  

* Develop and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform, delivered through Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for application build, versioned deployment, and environment promotion, including service connections, self-hosted agents, and federated identity credentials.
* Help development teams move build and test workloads from legacy on-premises environments into Azure.

Identity, security, and compliance
  
  

* Administer Entra ID: user and group provisioning, conditional access, MFA, SSO integrations, and app registrations, with automated monitoring of expiring secrets and certificates.
* Manage Privileged Identity Management role eligibility, access reviews, and approval of elevation requests.
* Administer role-based access for client-facing platforms and resolve customer authentication and MFA issues escalated through the IT case queue.
* Deploy and maintain endpoint security tooling, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Provide evidence, control descriptions, and technical input for SOC 2 Type II audits and customer security assessments, and advise on audit scope for newly production-hosted systems.

Client support and documentation
  
  

* Support client onboarding and migrations, including storage access, VPN connectivity, and third-party integrations.
* Serve as an escalation point for platform incidents affecting internal users and hosted clients.
* Maintain network diagrams and hosting documentation as environments change, and lead internal cross-training sessions on Azure architecture.
* Provide weekly status updates on priorities, progress, and blockers.

**Required**
Key Qualifications
  
  

* 4+ years in cloud platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* AZ-104 or a similar intermediate-level Azure certification.
* Strong working knowledge of Azure IaaS and PaaS: VMs, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Container Apps, and Azure Batch.
* Strong working knowledge of Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Azure networking experience: VNet design, VPN gateways, private endpoints, NAT, DNS, and firewall rules.
* Hands-on Entra ID administration: conditional access, MFA, SSO, app registrations, and PIM.
* Proficiency with PowerShell and KQL for automation and reporting.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.
* Clear technical writing and the ability to communicate with non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a SOC 2 Type II audit cycle.
* Azure Virtual Desktop administration at scale.
* Bicep infrastructure-as-code experience.
* Power BI Embedded capacity management.
* Oracle Database or Autonomous Database on Azure.
* Background supporting SaaS products in energy, utilities, or another regulated industry.
* Advanced certifications: AZ-305, AZ-400, or SC-300.

If you don't meet every qualification but this role excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.
  
  
Our Values @ Ascend
  
  
Ascend promotes a culture of teamwork, inclusion, and work-life balance. We operate by five core pillars:
  
  

* Integrity: We act with honesty and uphold the highest ethical standards, doing the right thing even when it's difficult.
* Purpose Driven: We are united by a shared purpose — to deliver meaningful impact for our customers, our industry, and the energy transition to a low-carbon future.
* Belonging: We foster a respectful, inclusive environment where everyone is valued, diverse perspectives are embraced, and equitable opportunities are provided for all.
* Innovation: We anticipate and address new challenges, embracing change and continuous improvement.
* One Team Mindset: We collaborate across teams and functions, supporting one another and prioritizing shared success over individual wins.

Your Value @ Ascend
  
  
Join a team that values your work, supports your growth, and invests in your future.
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Life and disability insurance
* Paid parental leave
* FSA, HSA, and dependent care accounts
* 401(k) with 3% non-elective contribution
* Flexible PTO and work hours

Salary range: $85,000-$115,000 USD annually, calibrated to your experience and structured to grow with you.
  
  
Compensation is flexible and tailored to your qualifications, relevant experience, and location of hire.
  
  
We thrive on collaboration, whether in our Boulder office or across a screen.
  
  
That's why our Boulder, CO office runs on a hybrid schedule (3 days in-office, 2 days remote). We prefer candidates who can work from Boulder HQ, but it isn't a requirement: we're open to strong remote candidates, and we make it easy to collaborate across both.
  
  
Need accommodations? Contact us at recruiting@ascendanalytics.com.
  
  
Ascend Analytics is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, veteran status, disability, or genetic information.

title: Engineer, Platform Engineering
description:
**CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD**

Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

The Engineer – Platform Engineering (Cloud Engineer) is responsible for building and managing Chipotle’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure, with a focus on automation and scalability. You will implement and maintain core platform services (such as cloud resources, servers, and CI/CD pipelines) that power our restaurants and enterprise systems. By utilizing Infrastructure-as-Code and robust monitoring, you’ll drive improvements in reliability, performance, and security. This role plays a key part in Chipotle’s modernization initiatives, contributing to cloud adoption and platform innovation in line with our Infrastructure Strategy.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Configure, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS) and on-prem servers, ensuring systems are set up following best practices for security and performance.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code templates and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Terraform scripts, Azure DevOps tasks) to automate provisioning and configuration of resources.
* AI & Automation: Comfortable leveraging leading LLMs and hybrid AI models to accelerate engineering work, including generating and validating Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripts, automation, and troubleshooting workflows.
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for platform components to quickly detect issues and optimize system performance
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues (network, OS, or cloud service problems), working with cross-functional teams to restore service and identify root causes.
* Research and introduce new technologies or tools (containers, configuration management, AIOps platforms) that can improve infrastructure efficiency, scalability, or cost-effectiveness.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE**

* Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) from 4-year college or university.
* 3-5 year’s experience
* Solid hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS), virtualization, and containerization, along with a strong grasp of core infrastructure components (servers, storage, networks, security).
* Proficiency in scripting/automation (e.g. Terraform, PowerShell, CI/CD pipelines) to build and manage infrastructure as code, driving consistency and efficiency.
* Hands-on experience with leading LLMs and AI coding tools, including using AI to generate, review, and validate Infrastructure as Code and automation, plus an understanding of hybrid AI architectures.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities for infrastructure issues – able to dissect complex problems under pressure and implement reliable solutions.
* Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally (e.g. with developers, support teams) and clearly document technical processes.
* A security-minded and detail-oriented approach – you follow best practices for cloud governance, identity/access management, and compliance in everything you build.

**PAY TRANSPARENCY**

A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $87,000.00–$120,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. Visit https://jobs.chipotle.com/benefits for more details.

**WHO WE ARE**

Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE: CMG) is cultivating a better world by serving responsibly sourced, classically cooked, real food with wholesome ingredients without artificial colors, flavors or preservatives. Chipotle has restaurants in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France and Germany and is the only restaurant company of its size that owns and operates all its restaurants in North America and Europe. With employees passionate about providing a great guest experience, Chipotle is a longtime leader and innovator in the food industry. Chipotle is committed to making its food more accessible to everyone while continuing to be a brand with a demonstrated purpose as it leads the way in digital, technology and sustainable business practices. For more information or to place an order online, visit
WWW.CHIPOTLE.COM(opens in new window)

*Chipotle Mexican Grill is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. As a people-first company rooted in values, our purpose extends beyond serving nutritious food using real ingredients. It means hiring world-class individuals and fostering a culture that champions diversity, ensures equity, and celebrates inclusion. All qualified applicants, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.*
