description:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Delivery Management Engineer II on the Deloitte AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for...
  
  

* Deploy, configure, integrate, and maintain mission-critical toolchains.
* Collaborate with enterprise software engineering and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) teams on multidisciplinary engineering efforts.
* Deliver robust, cloud-hosted engineering applications that meet project requirements.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and application delivery through infrastructure as code and continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the reliability, security, and performance of engineering platforms.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

**The team**
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.
  
  
Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of experience in a cloud environment
* Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC), including Terraform or AWS CloudFormation, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline development using Jenkins, GitLab, or GitHub Actions
* Experience with application programming interface (API) integrations
* Active Secret security clearance required
* You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* Experience with Python or Java
* Experience working on a Digital Engineering team

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $97,700 to $162,800.
  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

title: DevOps Engineer (Hybrid) - 30762
description:
Enlighten, honored as a Top Workplace from USA Today, is a leader in big data solution development and deployment, with expertise in cloud-based services, software and systems engineering, cyber capabilities, and data science. Enlighten provides continued innovation and proactivity in meeting our customers’ greatest challenges.
  
  
We recognize that the most effective environment for your projects doesn’t always look the same. Our hybrid work approach ensures that you can make lasting relationships with your team and collaborate in-person to get the job done—while having the flexibility to work from home when needed to achieve focused results.
  
  
Why Enlighten?
  
  
**Benefits**
At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:
  
  

* 100% paid employee premium for healthcare, vision and dental plans.
* 10% 401k benefit.
* Generous PTO + 10 paid holidays.
* Education/training allowances.

Anticipated Salary Range: $100,173.00 - $130,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, Enlighten takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function, internal equity and a candidate's education or training, work experience, certifications and key skills. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.
  
  
**Job Description**
Enlighten is seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced development team. The ideal candidate will have strong working knowledge in Kubernetes and Container Orchestration, Configuration Management, CI/CD, Automation, AWS, Linux systems administration, Scripting in Bash and Programming in Python, and a background in Big Data solutions. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment (on average 2-3 days a week) with a great team.
  
  
If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
#Mid-Senior Level
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
* Automate deployment processes and implement CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliability and rapid scaling of services.
* Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
* Collaborate closely with development teams to seamlessly integrate their applications into the operational infrastructure.
* Monitor production systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and resolve them rapidly to maintain high availability.
* Continuously improve processes and tools to optimize system performance.
* Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, constantly exploring innovative ways to improve our infrastructure.
* Additional duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Secret U.S. Government Security Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI; U.S. Citizenship required.
* 5+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge with one or more of the following:

+ Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
+ AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
+ Configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
+ Application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.

* Ability to develop in Python, Bash, or Go.
* Familiarity with Git, Flux, and other development and deployment tools.
* Comfortable operating in a terminal-based environment.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Must have or be able to obtain DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e., Security+) within 30 days of hire.
* Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, spending an average of 2-3 days per week at our San Antonio, TX office or on customer site as needed. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed. Onsite frequency and locations may vary based on customer/company support requirements and contract needs.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Currently holds an active Top Secret security clearance and is willing/able to obtain an SCI read-in.
* Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Git, Flux, Helm, and other development and deployment tools.
* Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
* Experience with K9s, AWS CLI, AWS SNS, AWS SQS, and AWS Diode.
* Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**About The Company**
Passage Health is a fast-growing Series A startup on a mission to improve the quality and accessibility of autism care through technology. Autism diagnosis rates have surged over the past decade to 1 in 31 children, yet families still face waitlists of up to a year for care as providers—hampered by antiquated technology and manual workflows—struggle to meet surging demand.
  
  
We’re building the platform that modernizes how autism care providers work—from clinical documentation to operations to billing—transforming how care is delivered and scaling access across a $460B market.
  
  
Over the past year, Passage has grown more than 3x, driven by strong customer demand and expanding partnerships across the autism care ecosystem. As we scale, we’re focused on building durable foundations—the systems, processes, and decision-making needed to support long-term growth.
  
  
**What You**
’
**ll Be Doing**
As a Senior Platform Engineer, you’ll own the foundational infrastructure the rest of engineering builds on. This is a largely greenfield role: you’ll define the platform and tooling needed to support our AI efforts—including the environments and test harnesses that let AI agents (“bots”) safely exercise and validate how our systems behave. Reporting directly to our founder and CTO, you’ll make high-leverage decisions about our infrastructure, CI/CD, and developer experience, and set the standards the rest of the team follows.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Infrastructure as Code: Design and manage our cloud infrastructure as code with Terraform on AWS, keeping it reproducible, reviewable, and ready to scale.
* End-to-End Ownership: Own our infrastructure end to end—making the greenfield decisions that shape our platform and the tooling the rest of engineering builds on.
* CI/CD & Developer Experience: Own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines in GitHub so engineers can ship quickly, safely, and often.
* Reliability & Scale: Keep the platform secure, observable, and dependable as the product and team grow.
* Technical Leadership: Set infrastructure standards and partner across engineering, bringing strong product knowledge of what we’re building and why.

**What You**
’
**ll Bring**

* Experience: Proven experience in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps/SRE engineering, including building and running production systems at scale.
* Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on expertise with Terraform and AWS, and a code-first approach to managing infrastructure.
* CI/CD & GitHub: Deep experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and working day to day in GitHub.
* Node.js & TypeScript: Experience building and running production services in Node.js and TypeScript.
* Language-Agnostic: Comfortable working across languages and picking up new tools as needed—TypeScript is our primary language, but you’re not tied to it.
* Product Mindset: Strong product sense—you understand how infrastructure decisions shape the product and the people who use it.
* Ownership: Thrives with autonomy and greenfield ambiguity, taking end-to-end ownership of decisions in a fast-moving environment.

**Tools & Technology**

* Terraform (infrastructure as code)
* AWS
* GitHub and CI/CD
* Node.js and TypeScript
* Aptible

**Why Passage Health?**

* Opportunity to make a tremendous impact on an early-stage company and team.
* A chance to use your skills to help children with autism.
* A fast-paced environment that offers new challenges and opportunities for growth.
* Competitive salary and equity compensation.
* Healthcare, dental, and vision benefits.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
*Passage Health is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all applicants from every background and life experience, without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*
Compensation Range: $170K - $200K

Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.
  
  
**Job Description**
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! When it comes to what you want in your career, if you can imagine it, you can do it at Parsons. Join an amazing collaborative team that analyzes, designs, and develops computer software to support marquee customers in Defense and Intelligence. We are seeking a DevOps Engineer (CNO) to develop and maintain the CI/CD pipelines and containerized platforms that power our CNO development environment, working independently on well-defined platform components.

* Develop and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for the CNO development environment.
* Build and maintain containerized environments using Docker and Docker Compose.
* Implement automation scripts (e.g., Python, shell) for build, test, and environment provisioning.
* Manage build artifacts and dependencies in Artifactory (or equivalent).
* Support environment automation and troubleshoot pipeline and container issues.
* Collaborate with software engineers to integrate their code into the CI/CD workflow.
* Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 5+ years of relevant experience; additional experience and/or niche capabilities may be considered in lieu of degree requirement.
* Scripting proficiency (e.g., Python, shell)

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

* Master's degree
* Artifactory (or equivalent) artifact repository usage
* Linux administration
* Infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible)
* Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and secure development workflows
* Valued certifications include AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect Professional, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, CKA/CKAD. None required.

Travel Required: Up to 10% for remote roles

None
  
  
This position is part of our Federal Solutions team.
  
  
The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now.

We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle!

Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status.

title: Systems: Cloud Engineer (F3DAFCE)
description:
Referment is working with an established investment management firm to find a Cloud Engineer for a systems team responsible for production compute infrastructure. The role focuses on hybrid grid computing, extending on-premise capacity into major public-cloud platforms and improving how engineering teams consume cloud services.
  
  
You will combine hands-on platform engineering with operational ownership. Alongside building automation and improving Linux compute reliability, you will work directly with technologists to identify suitable cloud use cases, move ideas from experimentation into production and support services through their lifecycle.
  
  
**The Role**

* Design, build and operate hybrid grid-computing infrastructure that can burst workloads into AWS, GCP and Azure.
* Improve the reliability and performance of Linux-based compute platforms and their networking.
* Develop tooling and automation that make cloud capabilities consistent and straightforward for engineering teams.
* Own cloud-platform observability and participate in an operational escalation rotation, taking incidents from triage through remediation.
* Partner with technologists to identify valuable cloud opportunities and guide adoption.
* Apply secure-by-default principles throughout platform design and delivery.

**What We're Looking For**

* Five to seven years of infrastructure or software engineering experience supporting production systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP or Azure.
* Strong Linux skills in a hybrid environment, including debugging network traffic across public and private links.
* Experience with modern development and infrastructure-as-code practices such as Terraform.
* A solid grounding in cloud security fundamentals.
* The communication, organisation and judgement to carry technical initiatives forward.

**Desirable Experience**
Programming in Go, Python or Rust would be valuable, as would experience supporting compute-intensive platforms or distributed workloads.
  
  
This could suit a cloud platform engineer, infrastructure engineer, site reliability engineer or systems engineer who enjoys combining deep Linux and networking work with automation and production ownership.
  
  
#Referment

title: Azure Cloud Engineer (6908)
description:
As an
**Azure Cloud Engineer**
, you’ll play a key role in operating, modernizing, and automating the Microsoft Azure environment supporting a mission-critical federal program in downtown Washington, DC. You will design, develop, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform, build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and deploy and support Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments that enable reliable and secure mission operations. Working as part of a small, experienced technical team, you will collaborate directly with federal stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement, implement scalable cloud solutions, and strengthen platform performance, security, and reliability. This position requires working onsite at the customer’s location in Washington, DC, four days per week, providing opportunities for direct customer engagement and collaboration. This is a hands-on role where your technical expertise, initiative, and ability to deliver practical solutions will have a direct impact on mission success.

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are
**obsessed**
with
our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!

**What you’ll do:**

* You will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and modernization of Microsoft Azure infrastructure supporting a mission-critical federal program.
* You will design, deploy, and manage cloud resources, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity services, and platform services, while developing and maintaining Terraform infrastructure as code and GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate provisioning, configuration, and deployments.
* You will administer and optimize Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments, including host pools, session hosts, FSLogix profiles, and Microsoft 365 integrations, ensuring reliable performance and availability for mission users.
* Your daily responsibilities will include troubleshooting infrastructure and connectivity issues, monitoring system health using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, implementing automation through PowerShell and Bash scripting, and maintaining secure cloud operations aligned with NIST, RMF, FedRAMP, and agency-specific requirements.
* Working directly with engineering, cybersecurity, and program stakeholders, you will identify opportunities for improvement, resolve technical challenges, and deliver secure, scalable, and reliable cloud solutions that improve operational efficiency and support evolving mission requirements.

**What you’ll need to succeed:**

* Active Secret clearance with the ability to obtain an Interim Top Secret clearance.
* 3+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or systems engineering, with substantial hands-on Azure work.
* Demonstrated depth with Microsoft Azure core services and architecture — you've implemented and run real environments, not just studied for the cert.
* Strong familiarization with Terraform. This is the one we weight most heavily.
* PowerShell scripting ability for automation and system configuration.
* Working experience troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines in GitLab.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Virtual Desktop in a production environment — host pools, session hosts, and FSLogix.
* Experience supporting Azure networking: VNets, routing, NSGs, and VPN/ExpressRoute.
* Familiarity with federal cloud security frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST, and RMF.
* Have troubleshooting instincts and the communication skills to explain your reasoning to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* Ability to work onsite in downtown Washington, DC four days per week.

SALARY RANGE: $110,000 - $140,000

The salary range for this position is determined based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. The final salary offered will be determined based on several factors including:

* The candidate's professional background and relevant work experience
* The specific responsibilities of the role and organizational needs
* Internal equity and alignment with current team compensation
* This role is also eligible for additional compensation, subject to the terms and policies of MetroStar, which may include:

+ Performance-based bonuses
+ Company-paid training and/or certifications
+ Referral bonuses

**Application Deadline:**
Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled; candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible for full consideration.

**Additional Compensation**
: This role may also be eligible for bonuses and/or additional incentives based on individual and company performance.

**Benefits**
: All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits programs:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
* Parental Leave and dependent care
* Flexible work arrangements
* Professional development opportunities
* Employee assistance and wellness programs

Like we said,
**we are**
big fans of our people. That’s why
**we offer**
a generous benefits package, professional growth, and valuable time to recharge. Learn more about our company culture code and benefits. Plus, check out our accolades.

description:

Our team supports a mission-critical management system enabling several Airborne ISR missions that are actively used today in global operations by the U.S. Navy, Border Patrol, Coast Guard, and other federal partners. * Six years of software development or engineering experience on programs or contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity.
* At least four years of experience developing software for systems using cloud-related technologies.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, cloud migration, cloud integration, distributed systems, or large-scale data processing environments.
* Familiarity with Agile development processes and the ability to collaborate effectively on a software development team.
* Ability to interface directly with development teams, system stakeholders, and end users.
* Experience testing infrastructure components, validating design requirements, and documenting results.
* Active TS/SCI clearance and Full Scope Polygraph is required for the program.

title: MS - AWS Cloud Engineer
description:
**About The Position**
**AWS Cloud Engineer**
**Location: US / Canada (Eastern Time) - Home based**
**Job Type: Full-time, Permanent**
**About AllCloud**
AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.
  
  
AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.
  
  
AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io
  
  
**﻿**
**Job Summary**
AllCloud is seeking an AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, and deploy highly scalable, reliable, and secure cloud environments for our customers. In this role, you will focus on delivering complex cloud projects, including large-scale migrations from on-premises data centers to AWS, containerized application deployment (including Amazon EKS), building new landing zones, and implementing infrastructure-as-code using modern automation frameworks. You will be responsible for setting up, maintaining, and evolving AWS architectures; developing automation to streamline delivery; ensuring robust monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting practices; and leveraging cutting-edge AWS services to help customers achieve their business goals. This position is hands-on, customer-facing, and integral to driving successful AWS delivery engagements.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Summary of Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, deploy, and maintain scalable, highly available, and secure AWS infrastructure for project needs (e.g., compute, storage, networking, database).
* Lead or participate in cloud migrations: lifting and shifting on-premises workloads, re-architecting to cloud-native services.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines (for example via AWS CodePipeline / AWS CodeBuild / Jenkins / GitLab CI) to automate deployment workflows.
* Implement serverless solutions using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and integrate event-driven architectures where appropriate.
* Containerize applications (Docker) and orchestrate microservices using AWS container platform services, with a strong focus on Amazon EKS, ECS, and Fargate.
* Ensure monitoring, logging, alerting, tracing of AWS resources and applications using tools like CloudWatch, X-Ray, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack.
* Apply best practices around security: IAM policies, least privilege, encryption (at rest/in transit), network segmentation (VPCs, subnets), Web Application Firewall (WAF), GuardDuty, AWS Shield, etc.
* Implement backup, disaster recovery and high availability strategies; manage data redundancies, snapshots, multi-AZ / multi-region architectures.
* Optimize cost & performance: right-sizing resources, identifying waste, designing for efficiency.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues in cloud infrastructure and services; conduct root cause analyses.
* Maintain documentation for architectures, configurations, standard operating procedures, runbooks.
* Engage with cross-functional teams: developers, QA, operations, security/compliance, and project managers to ensure successful delivery.
* Communicate proactively and effectively with clients to understand technical needs, provide progress updates, and articulate complex solutions clearly.
* Apply critical thinking and strategic problem-solving to evaluate trade-offs, identify root causes, and design robust cloud architectures.
* Stay up to date on the latest AWS services, features, industry best practices; evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements.
* Perform deep OS-level troubleshooting and system administration across both Linux and Windows environments operating in the cloud.

**Summary Of Requirements & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or relevant field (or equivalent work experience).
* 3-5+ years of hands-on experience working with AWS in an engineering or infrastructure role (seniority adjustable).
* Strong knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, S3, VPC, RDS / Aurora, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools: Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
* Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker, Kubernetes / Amazon EKS, ECS, and Fargate.
* Proven ability to debug and troubleshoot complex container workload issues in Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and AWS ECS environments.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions.
* Solid scripting skills (Python, Bash, NodeJS, PowerShell, or similar) for automating tasks.
* Working familiarity with monitoring, logging, tracing tools (e.g. CloudWatch, X-Ray, ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, and compliance (VPCs, subnets, security groups, network ACLs, encryption, identity management).
* Experience in project delivery: working in agile or scrum environments, estimating work, delivering against milestones.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Good communication skills—able to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Deep technical knowledge and hands-on experience with OS-level administration, configuration, and advanced troubleshooting for both Linux and Windows Server platforms.
* Strong client-facing communication skills with a proven track record of building trust and managing technical discussions with stakeholders.
* Exceptional critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and decisive problem-solving capabilities under complex or ambiguous scenario conditions.

**Why work for us?**
Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.

title: SQL Server ETL Developer (SSIS)
description:
RSNA is seeking a
**SQL Server ETL Developer**
to build and support the data solutions that power reporting, analytics, and decision-making across the organization.
  
  
Working primarily with
**SQL Server, T-SQL, and SSIS**
, you’ll design reliable data pipelines, integrate data from multiple systems, and help ensure our data is accurate, accessible, and ready for analysis.
  
  
You’ll have ownership of your work from requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. You’ll also partner directly with analysts and business teams to turn their needs into scalable data solutions they can trust.
  
  
This is a SQL Server-centric role. ETL is built in T-SQL and SSIS, not Python or cloud-based drag-and-drop tools.
  
  
**Why Join RSNA?**
At RSNA, You’ll Combine Meaningful, Mission-driven Work With a Supportive Environment That Values Collaboration And Work-life Balance. You Can Expect
  
  

* Work that supports an organization dedicated to advancing radiology and ultimately improving patient care.
* A collaborative, experienced team that values knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Opportunities to solve a variety of real-world data and business challenges.
* A hybrid or remote work environment with generally predictable hours and limited evening or weekend work.
* Professional development and opportunities to expand your technical skills.
* Competitive benefits, generous paid time off, paid parental leave, long-term savings benefits, and a week-long Winter Break.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain ETL/data pipelines using SSIS, APIs, scripts, and other integration tools.
* Develop and optimize T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions supporting reporting and analytics.
* Build efficient incremental data-load processes using techniques such as Change Data Capture (CDC), watermarking, and MERGE/upsert patterns.
* Design and maintain dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Optimize SQL Server and ETL performance using execution plans, indexing, Query Store, and SSIS tuning.
* Build data validation, logging, error handling, reconciliation, and alerting into ETL processes to maintain data quality.
* Monitor and troubleshoot SQL Agent jobs, SSIS packages, and production data processes.
* Manage code in Git and participate in code review, testing, and deployment practices.
* Partner with analysts and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
* Document solutions and contribute to consistent development and data management practices.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing ETL solutions using Microsoft SSIS.
* Strong T-SQL skills, including stored procedures, window functions, CTEs, and complex joins.
* Experience troubleshooting and improving SQL Server performance using execution plans, indexing, and query optimization.
* Understanding of relational database design and data warehousing concepts, including star schemas and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience monitoring and troubleshooting SQL Agent jobs and production ETL processes.
* Familiarity with Git and structured development, testing, and deployment practices.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and non-technical partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to Have**
Experience in any of the following would be a plus:
  
  

* SQL Server 2022/2025
* Power BI or DAX
* .NET, Python, or PowerShell
* Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Azure Data Factory or AWS data services
* dbt or SQLMesh

You don’t need to check every box. If you have strong SQL Server and ETL experience and enjoy building reliable data solutions, we encourage you to apply.

title: Data Migration ETL Engineer
description:
Overview:

The Data Migration ETL Engineer implements repeatable, auditable migration pipelines from BOSS-E, MBMS and related VA legacy sources into VA-EISS. Critically review AI-generated ETL scripts and data transformations, verifying that every conversion preserves required business meaning and record integrity in support of VA-EISS modernization.

Responsibilities:

* Build SQL/Python/ETL pipelines, staging schemas, data cleansing rules, transformation jobs and automated reconciliation reports.
* Review AI-generated extraction, migration and rollback scripts for accuracy, performance, idempotency, security and repeatability.
* Execute migration rehearsals, measure throughput and data quality, diagnose exceptions and support final cutover plans.
* Implement automated row-level and business-rule reconciliation across source/target systems with appropriate evidence and audit logs.
* Coordinate with Data Analyst, Data Architect, QA Lead and VA stakeholders to resolve schema mismatches and mapping defects.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in computer science or IT related degree with 3-6 years’ experience. Additional years of experience can substitute for a degree for the right candidate.
* Hands-on SQL and data engineering experience with ETL/ELT, relational data modeling and large-volume database migration.
* Ability to code and debug Python/SQL scripts and review AI-generated transformation logic critically.
* Practical understanding of source-to-target reconciliation, exception management and migration testing.
* Experience building repeatable, version-controlled pipelines and supporting cutovers.
* Public Trust

**Preferred:**

  

* SQL Server, Oracle, Salesforce extracts, AWS GovCloud/VAEC services and DevSecOps automation.
* Federal benefits or cemetery systems, auditability/PII protections, historical conversion and GIS data migration.

title: DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer — WePro**

Houston, TX · On-site · Full-time

**About WePro**

WePro is AI-first SaaS for the home service industry. We build the tools home service businesses use to run every part of their operation: CRM, dispatch management, call answering, marketing campaigns and billing. Every part is customizable, with AI and automations built into each step.

In this industry, a missed call is a lost job and a slow dispatch is a lost customer. Our tools help our customers avoid both. Most software in this space treats AI as an add-on. We built WePro AI-first, and every part of the platform is customizable. We're bootstrapped and profitable, so we answer to our customers, not investors. We're a small team moving fast to change what home service software can be, and we're looking for a DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer to help us do it.

**Why this role**

* **Work directly with the CTO.** Your ideas go straight to the person who decides, and decisions happen in days, not quarters.
* **Own the infrastructure, not a slice of it.** You'll be responsible for reliability, performance, security and cost across both our current production platform (V1) and the next-generation cloud architecture we're building (V2).
* **Hard, interesting problems.** Real-time voice infrastructure that has to stay up. Moving live monoliths onto Kubernetes without disrupting customers. Finding the slow query behind a latency spike before a customer notices it.
* **AI-assisted engineering.** We expect you to use AI tools to investigate, fix and document faster, and to help us find where they work best.

**Who we're looking for**

Someone who treats production like they own it. You'll be the first responder when something degrades: you gather the evidence, find the root cause, fix what you can and hand developers clear, specific tasks for what you can't. You don't wait to be told something is broken. You find infrastructure risks, billing anomalies and failing builds before they slow anyone down, and you write things down so the team never depends on one person to keep things running, including you.

**What you'll ownObservability, monitoring and SLOs**

* Design and maintain Datadog dashboards, APM tracing, Database Monitoring (DBM), Real User Monitoring (RUM) and synthetic monitors.
* Define and track SLOs for latency, uptime (99.99%+) and error rates across critical services and integrations.
* Expand log and metric ingestion across our application frameworks (CodeIgniter, PHP-FPM, Node on Kubernetes) and capture structured exceptions.

**Incident management and root cause analysis**

* Act as the primary responder for system degradation, gathering telemetry before pulling in backend developers or database leads.
* Lead investigations into outages, CPU and memory exhaustion, database lock contention and network bottlenecks.
* Write post-mortems and runbooks and publish them to the engineering repository.

**Application performance and databases**

* Audit slow endpoints through Datadog APM, spec the code or indexing fix, and track it through the deployment pipeline.
* Analyze slow queries in MariaDB/MySQL, recommend and execute indexing changes, and remove blocking query patterns.
* Move application session storage to distributed Redis clusters.

**Cloud platform, CI/CD and migration**

* Manage Kubernetes clusters with GitOps (ArgoCD) and enforce consistent configuration across environments.
* Build, secure and maintain self-hosted GitHub Actions runner pools, balancing build time, runner availability and cost.
* Plan and execute the migration from EC2-based monoliths to containerized Kubernetes (EKS and DOKS).
* Maintain internal developer portals and build operations tooling that makes deployments and releases visible.

**Telephony and third-party integrations**

* Operate our voice infrastructure on FreeSWITCH and OpenSIPS: high availability, SIP trunk connectivity, and WebRTC/SIP dialer routing.
* Monitor third-party webhooks (such as Twilio) for failure modes, SSL compliance and delivery errors.

**Security and access control**

* Administer zero-trust network access (Tailscale) for SSH, database connections and internal tools.
* Implement Kubernetes NetworkPolicies, secure cloud storage and CDN configuration (CloudFront, S3), and manage edge caching.
* Run centralized secrets management (Phase, OpenBao) across Kubernetes and standalone workloads, including key rotation.

**Cost and infrastructure lifecycle**

* Track spend across AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean and third-party AI APIs, and put cost-saving policies in place.
* Decommission legacy environments safely with Terraform, with verified backups and snapshot retention before anything is torn down.

**Daily operations reporting**

* Publish an end-of-day operations summary covering 500 error rates, telephony and carrier errors, endpoint latency spikes and SLO compliance.
* Spot operational bottlenecks and hand developers clear, actionable tasks to resolve backend and database performance issues.

**Our stack**

**Domain**

**Tools**

**What you'll do with them**

Observability

APM, RUM, DBM, synthetic monitors, latency dashboards

Provisioning, environment teardown, state management

**You might be a fit if**

You have:

* 4+ years of hands-on DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering, including running production infrastructure on AWS (EKS, EC2, S3 and CloudFront).
* Strong Kubernetes experience, including GitOps with ArgoCD, NetworkPolicies and ingress.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform, including safe teardown of environments.
* Deep experience with Datadog or a comparable observability platform: APM, logs, dashboards and monitors.
* A track record of leading incident response and writing post-mortems that change how the team works.
* Comfort with relational databases (MariaDB/MySQL): reading query plans, indexing and finding lock contention.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
* Working knowledge of network security, access control and secrets management in cloud environments.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day engineering work.
* Strong written and spoken English; someone who wasn't there can follow your runbooks and post-mortems.
* An owner's mindset: you find risks before they become incidents, fix broken processes and bring your own ideas about how the platform should evolve.

Bonus points:

* FreeSWITCH, OpenSIPS, SIP trunking or WebRTC experience.
* DigitalOcean (DOKS, Droplets) or GCP in production.
* Redis and MongoDB in production.
* PHP application stacks (CodeIgniter, PHP-FPM).
* Migrating legacy monoliths to containers.
* Time at an early-stage startup.

**Is this you?**

This role isn't for you if you want a large platform team, a narrow lane, or an on-call rotation someone else owns. It is for you if you'd rather find and fix the root cause yourself than file a ticket about it.

We're a small team, so every hire matters, and we're picky. We'd rather take our time and find the right person.

**Location**

On-site in Houston, TX, working side by side with the CTO.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a short note about an incident you led or a piece of infrastructure you built: what the problem was, how you found the cause, and what you changed so it wouldn

Over the last decade, we have achieved 100% client retention and earned more than 20 notable industry recognition. This reflects our reliability in delivering what we promise and the quality we bring to every engagement.  
  
Join our growth-driven culture and help us lead, innovate, and simplify. We are looking for a team members who embody our values:

* Empathetic - we listen, we understand, and are considerate of everyone
* Persevering - we dont give up on challenges or people and go all the way
* Inclusive - we value everyone and their perspectives
* Reliable - we deliver what we promise, and more
* Innovative - we make things better than they were yesterday

**The Role :**

Design and deliver the semantic layer and Power BI reporting capability for governed data platform engagements at regulated financial institutions. Own the semantic model over the analytical tier, configure Power BI connectivity and workspaces, deliver the agreed set of reports business users depend on, and contribute engineering capacity to client-owned data engineering and ETL work alongside client teams. Author and execute the test cases that prove your work.

**You Will :**

* Design and implement the semantic layer over client Athena analytical tiers — the model Power BI and other analytical consumers read against, structured for the reporting patterns the business needs.
* Configure Power BI connectivity to the semantic layer, validate end-to-end query patterns, and configure user workspaces in the client Power BI environment.
* Deliver the agreed set of use case reports — production-quality Power BI reports built for the confirmed business audiences, validated with the client business partner during delivery.
* Refine visualization requirements with client business stakeholders during delivery, within the agreed report scope, without allowing scope to drift into custom UI territory.
* Contribute to client-owned data engineering and ETL work as a co-developer alongside the client technical lead — data ingestion, transformation, gap handling — without taking the outcome ownership the client retains.
* Author test specifications for the semantic layer, Power BI reports, and your ETL contributions. Author and maintain automated tests that run as part of the deployment pipeline provided by the client. Investigate and remediate defects on your components.
* Work as an embedded member of an integrated delivery team: participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and joint reviews with client technical leads, data analysts, and business partners.

**Who You Are :**

* You have designed and shipped semantic layers over analytical tiers (Athena, BigQuery, Snowflake, or comparable) — not just as a modeling exercise, but as the layer downstream consumers depend on in production.
* You have hands-on Power BI experience at report-build depth: DAX, connectivity to cloud analytical stores, workspace configuration, and Row Level Security patterns. You have shipped Power BI reports business users actually use.
* You know dimensional modeling and can apply it pragmatically — you have opinions on when to normalize, when to denormalize, and what makes a semantic layer usable versus theoretically pure.
* You are comfortable in the AWS data stack: S3, Athena, Iceberg or comparable formats, Aurora PostgreSQL. You can trace a query through the stack when performance is off.
* You treat testing as part of your engineering craft — you write test cases as you build, you understand how to test data pipelines and semantic models (not just application code), and you can distinguish between a unit test, an integration test, and a data quality check.
* You have contributed to ETL and data engineering work without treating ownership as a status question — you can co-develop and hand back cleanly.
* You can walk a business partner through a report and iterate on it in the same session, without needing a UX designer for basic layout and interaction decisions.
* You are comfortable working inside a client team, participating in their cadence, and delivering ownership outcomes without behaving like a vendor visitor.

**What to expect**  
  
Besides Competitive Salary and working for one of Canadas Best Managed and Top 50 Technology Companies, you should expect:

* Purposeful Work: autonomy, resources, and time you need to do what matters for our clients and most importantly - you
* Positive Environment: recognition coupled with a flexible environment that celebrates diversity, inclusivity and encourages everyone to achieve their best
* Growth & Development: opportunities to grow professionally and personally through mentorship, training, and development programs
* Transparency & Trust: direction, purpose, mission, and expectations are never a secret; you will always know where you stand as well as where you are going
* Exclusive Perks: discounts on shopping, the gym, insurance, mobile phone plans, not to mention an office smoothie bar and enough coffee to make you vibrate
* Meaningful Benefits: life happens. You will get health, dental, vision, disability, travel insurance, and much more all covered by us
* Unforgettable Events: team bonding, BBQs, office lunches (pizza, always pizza), gala dinners, and any other excuse to have fun

  
**Inclusion and equal opportunity employment**  
  
ML arteka is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans status, Aboriginal/Native American status, or any other legally-protected factors. Disability-related accommodation during the application process is available upon request.  
  
**Are you ready to join the award-winning team and help us accelerate digital transformation?**

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Radix**
  
Radix is revolutionizing how the multifamily world makes decisions. From investment to divestment, and everything in between, Radix brings data transparency, market intelligence, and acquisition modeling into a seamless ecosystem that turns the industry's best insights into confident decisions.

**What You Will Be Part Of**

We’re looking for a highly capable, hands-on Data Engineer to help build the foundation for Radix’s next generation of data and AI products.

This is a strong individual contributor role for someone who wants to solve hard data problems, build reliable systems, and raise the bar for how data moves, models, and powers decision-making across the business. You will work closely with the Head of Data Engineering and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and AI Systems to improve the quality, reliability, and usability of Radix’s data platform.

You’ll be stepping into an environment with multi-product system complexity, modest technical debt, and real stakes. The right person will be able to diagnose where trust breaks down, improve pipeline reliability, strengthen data modeling practices, and build production-grade systems that support both analytics and AI-enabled product experiences.

Beyond traditional data engineering, this role will help shape the semantic layer that powers Radix’s AI products. That means designing data systems with LLM consumption in mind: clean metric definitions, reliable context surfaces, governed access patterns, and data infrastructure that agents can actually trust.

**What You Will Achieve**

* Build and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines that move data from MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and third-party APIs into clean, analytics-ready models.
* Support the Databricks data warehouse, including cluster configuration, job orchestration, cost optimization, and governance.
* Build data contracts so downstream consumers can trust the data products they use.
* Own data quality in your pipelines and models, from detection and alerting to root cause analysis and resolution.
* Build and maintain reliable, tested, well-documented dbt models that are easy for analytics consumers to understand.
* Help establish pragmatic dbt conventions that keep the data model clear, consistent, and scalable.
* Implement dbt-native tests, documentation, schema contracts, source freshness checks, and model expectations for critical data assets.
* Treat the data model as a product, with a focus on clarity, trust, and usability.
* Help build the governed, LLM-consumable semantic layer that powers Radix’s AI products, with consistent metrics, dimensions, and measures used across BI, product, and AI surfaces.
* Design models, metrics, and entity definitions that support conversational SQL and natural language queries.
* Contribute to the Model Context Protocol data exposure layer, including which data surfaces are exposed, how they are accessed, and what guardrails are needed.
* Partner with the Head of Data Engineering and the Infrastructure and AI Systems team on the data context and retrieval surfaces agents rely on.
* Evaluate semantic and AI data tools such as Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, MetricFlow, and LookML-style metric registries.
* Build and maintain infrastructure as code for Databricks, pipeline compute, and supporting AWS services, with Terraform as the default.
* Improve CI/CD for data pipelines, including automated testing, deployment gates, rollback mechanisms, and safer releases.
* Instrument data workflows with production-grade observability, including metrics, alerting, lineage, anomaly detection, and data quality monitoring, so issues surface before they reach the business or customers.
* Improve the developer experience, including local development, testing patterns, environment parity, and deployment confidence.
* Create documentation, runbooks, and operational playbooks that make the platform easier to understand, support, and scale.

**What Makes You a Strong Fit**

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field, including operating data systems in production.
* Deep fluency with Databricks or a comparable data warehouse, including cluster management, Spark tuning, job orchestration, and Unity Catalog or equivalent governance.
* Strong dbt expertise, including project architecture, advanced modeling patterns, testing, documentation, and semantic layer or MetricFlow concepts.
* Hands-on experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL as pipeline sources, including their data models, change patterns, and failure modes.
* Proficiency with columnar and open table formats such as Parquet, Delta Lake, and/or Apache Iceberg.
* Strong Python skills for pipeline development, transformation logic, automation, and tooling.
* AWS fluency across data infrastructure services, including S3, Glue, Lambda, IAM, VPC, and supporting compute.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, with Terraform preferred.
* Experience building CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including testing, deployment gates, and safe release workflows.
* Hands-on experience with data observability, including pipeline monitoring, data quality alerting, and lineage, using tools such as Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with orchestration frameworks beyond dbt, such as Airflow, Dagster, or equivalent.
* Awareness of streaming patterns such as Kafka or Kinesis, even if your primary experience is batch.
* Ability to trace a data issue from source system to downstream BI, product, or AI consumer and identify where trust breaks down.
* Focus on data contracts and interface stability before shipping models others depend on.
* Skill at spotting anti-patterns early in modeling, pipeline design, reliability, and development workflows.
* Commitment to operational readiness, with observability, testing, and supportability part of your definition of done.
* Comfort working through ambiguity and turning messy systems into reliable, understandable ones.
* Active use of AI tools in your own development workflow, with curiosity about how they improve engineering quality and speed.
* Understanding of how to design data systems for LLM consumption, including clean ontologies, predictable schemas, well-scoped context surfaces, and trustworthy metric definitions.
* Informed opinions on how semantic layers should support natural language querying and where natural language to SQL breaks down.
* Interest in the AI data infrastructure space, with the ability to separate practical value from hype.
* Excitement about building data systems that serve humans, applications, and AI agents.
* Hands-on, builder-oriented approach: when something is broken or missing, you help fix it.
* Experience in complex environments with inconsistent standards, technical debt, or low-trust data, and a track record of improving quality without stopping delivery.
* Leadership through technical credibility, clear communication, and strong judgment rather than authority.
* High ownership and transparent communication.
* Success in small teams where your decisions have direct impact and your contributions are visible.
* Care for building systems that are reliable, understandable, and useful to the people and products that depend on them.

**Why You Will Love Working Here**

* Comprehensive Benefits

  + Medical, dental and vision coverage designed to support your wellbeing.
* Uncapped Paid Time Off

  + We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and do your best work.
* Pre-IPO Equity

  + Meaningful ownership with the potential to grow right alongside Radix.
* Performance Bonus

  + Rewarded for the impact you drive, not just tasks completed.
* Learn From the Best

  + Work shoulder-to-shoulder with industry experts, innovative operators, and leaders shaping the future of multifamily.
* Build Category-Defining Products

  + Join us during a high-velocity, post–Series A growth stage whe

description:

Ibotta is seeking an **Analytics Engineer** to join our innovative team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. In this role, you will transform raw data into a strategic asset, designing and building the production pipelines, curated datasets, and automation that power our Decision Science, Business Intelligence, and Client & Publisher Analytics teams. You will lead by example as an individual contributor, setting the standard for data quality and engineering best practices while turning complex data into actionable insights for our clients and the business.

This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States.

**Not based in Denver? We will offer a relocation bonus to help make your move to the Mile High City a smooth one.**

**What you will be doing:**

* Design, build, and orchestrate production data pipelines and dashboards using Databricks and Airflow to automate analytical processes
* Organize and optimize Ibotta’s complex data environment, designing scalable table structures and curated datasets for downstream users in Decision Science and Business Intelligence
* Partner with Decision Scientists to design, aggregate, and normalize robust datasets for advanced modeling, machine learning, and predictive analytics
* Architect and document event-based data structures in the data lake to answer critical, high-impact business questions
* Own data quality, reliability, and governance, including automated testing, validation, anomaly detection, and change management standards for analytics workflows
* Stand up CI/CD (GitHub Actions) and automated testing for analytics code and pipelines
* Build and maintain automation tools and self-service patterns that democratize data access and foster data literacy across the organization
* Integrate AI into engineering workflows, building Claude skills and plugins that automate, standardize, and accelerate the team’s day-to-day work
* Lead large, complex analytical projects end to end, delivering high-quality work, providing milestone updates, and prioritizing efficiently
* Monitor, maintain, and modernize existing data services
* Represent data best practices across Engineering and Decision Science, and mentor associate engineers to foster a culture of technical excellence
* Embrace and uphold Ibotta’s Core Values: *Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, & A good idea can come from anywhere*

**What we are looking for:**

* 3–5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a highly technical analytics/BI role
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field required
* Expert-level SQL and proficient Python, with hands-on experience building production grade pipelines and automation
* Experience with Databricks (including DABs) and Spark, including cluster configuration and optimizing large-scale data processing
* Understanding of ETL/ELT patterns and modern data stack tools such as Airflow, dbt, and cloud data warehouses
* A “test-driven” approach to data development, with demonstrated practice in automated testing, CI/CD (GitHub Enterprise/Actions), data validation, and anomaly detection
* Proficiency with Looker/LookML and AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Databricks Genie)
* A proven track record of translating ambiguous business problems into technical data solutions, acting as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders
* Proven ability to establish self-service patterns, set standards, and manage cross-functional priorities in an Agile environment
* A growth mindset grounded in clear communication, continuous learning, iterative product delivery, and healthy technical debate
* Independent self-starter who can successfully manage your own time and multitask

**About Ibotta ("I bought a...")**

Ibotta (NYSE: IBTA) is a leading performance marketing platform allowing brands to deliver digital promotions to over 200 million consumers through a network of publishers called the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN). The IPN allows marketers to influence what people buy, and where and how often they shop – all while paying only when their campaigns directly result in a sale. American shoppers have earned over $2.6 billion through the IPN since 2012. The largest tech IPO in history to come out of Colorado, Ibotta is headquartered in Denver, and is continually listed as a top place to work by The Denver Post and Inc. Magazine.

To learn more about what our Tech teams are doing day to day, visit Building Ibotta on Medium.com

**Additional Details:**

* This position is located in Denver, CO and includes competitive pay, flexible time off, benefits package (including medical, dental, vision), Employee Stock Purchase Program, and 401k match. **Denver office perks include paid parking, snacks, and occasional meals.**
* Base compensation range: $113,000 - $132,000. Equity is included in overall compensation package. This compensation range is specific to the United States labor market and may be adjusted based on actual experience.
* Ibotta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ibotta’s employment decisions are made without regard of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status.
* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.
* Applicants are accepted until the position is filled.
* For the security of our employees and the business, all employees are responsible for the secure handling of data in accordance with our security policies, identifying and reporting phishing attempts, as well as reporting security incidents to the proper channels.

**Recruiting Agency Notice**
  
Ibotta does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to any Ibotta employees.

Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.

Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.

Bechtel Manufacturing and Technology (M&T) is an exciting and growing business that serves the increasing demand of EPC services for customers in the semiconductor (manufacturing facilities and supply chain); data center, electric vehicle (batteries, charging infrastructure, and production); and life sciences markets.

Headquartered in the U.S. with employees in various states, M&T also has colleagues in the United Kingdom, India, and other locations while we actively pursue exciting opportunities in other parts of the world. We are looking for talented people to join our team that are passionate about making a difference and contributing to historical projects that will have a lasting impact on society.

The PIIM Data Engineer supports Bechtel's data-centric delivery model by designing, building, and maintaining the project's analytics data environment. This role is responsible for developing scalable data pipelines, integrating data across project systems, and creating trusted datasets that enable reporting, analytics, automation, and emerging AI capabilities. The position serves as a key technical resource supporting project execution through data-driven solutions and advanced analytics.

* Manage data ingestion and exchange across tools, ensuring reliable, timely, and accurate movement of data between systems.
* Serve as the project subject matter expert for the analytics data lake environment, including data architecture, access patterns, performance optimization, and advanced analytics support.
* Collaborate with project teams and system owners to define data requirements, onboard new data sources, and support system integrations.
* Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes and optimize SQL data models.
* Develop curated datasets to support reporting, dashboards, analytics, and downstream applications.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and completeness across project systems.
* Support reporting platforms by delivering performant datasets for Power BI and other analytics tools.
* Support the development and deployment of AI, machine learning, and agent-based solutions by preparing data and operationalizing outputs into project workflows.
* Enable automation and data-driven solutions that improve project execution, productivity, and decision making.
* Support governance, security, and lifecycle management of project data assets.

* Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 5-8 years of relevant experience or 9-12 years of relevant work experience

Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Strong SQL and data modeling experience in relational databases.
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT solutions.
* Experience developing and supporting data pipelines and workflows.
* Programming experience in Python for data transformation, preparation, and pipeline development.
* Understanding of data lake architectures and modern analytics platforms.
* Experience with Power BI datasets, reporting architectures, and analytics solutions.
* Knowledge of data quality management, validation, and governance principles.
* Experience integrating data across multiple systems using APIs and data exchange frameworks.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Azure Databricks and Delta Lake.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and how data pipelines support advanced analytics solutions.

Functional Skills
  
  

* Ability to translate business and project requirements into scalable data solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement and requirements-gathering skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting cross-functional project teams.
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced project environment.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and innovation.

Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Working with diverse internal and external data sources, you will design scalable solutions, strengthen data quality, and improve pipeline performance. You will also play an important role in troubleshooting production incidents, coordinating data architecture decisions, and maintaining robust engineering practices. In addition to your technical contributions, you will mentor junior engineers and collaborate closely with data operations leadership. This remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute your expertise within a mission-driven nonprofit organization focused on making data more accessible and impactful.
  
  
Accountabilities

title: Senior Data Engineer (dbt)
description:
**About SpotOn**
We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh\*t about helping restaurants succeed.
  
  

* Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2 (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users
* Rated the top-rated point-of-sale (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users
* Awarded Great Places to Work and Built In’s Best Workplaces for multiple years running

We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.
  
  
Senior Platform Engineer - Data (Analytics)
  
  
Location: Remote but available to come into the Chicago office occasionally.
  
  
The Role
  
  
SpotOn's analytics platform is how the company understands its business: how many merchants are live and growing, how much payment volume flows through our platform, how merchants use our products, and how we turn that into revenue. As an Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will own that platform end to end. From ingesting data out of our production systems and third-party tools, through monitoring and job health, to the core dbt models that serve as the source of truth for analysts, finance, product, and power users across the company.
  
  
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll treat data as a product: you know who uses it, you know when it's wrong before they do, and you design models that make the right answer the easy answer. You'll work across a business that spans multiple POS platforms, payments, and SaaS products, so unifying messy, similar-but-not-identical sources into one consistent view is core to the job.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Ingestion & Pipelines
  
  

* Build and operate reliable pipelines that land data from production databases (CDC), SaaS tools, and third-party APIs into Snowflake.
* Orchestrate batch and incremental workloads in Airflow, choosing the right load pattern (full, incremental, CDC) for each source.
* Onboard new sources quickly and repeatably, with clear contracts for schema, freshness, and ownership.

Modeling & Serving
  
  

* Design and own the core dbt models (merchants, orders, payments, revenue, and product usage) that downstream teams build on.
* Unify data across platforms and product lines (e.g., legacy and next-generation POS) into consistent, well-documented models so users never have to reason about where the data came from.
* Build curated, analysis-ready marts for finance and product analytics, and enable self-serve for power users through clean semantics and documentation.
* Write reusable macros and conventions that keep a growing dbt project consistent and maintainable.

Data Quality, Monitoring & Job Health
  
  

* Define and enforce data tests (uniqueness, nulls, referential integrity, metric reconciliation) as a first-class part of every model.
* Own monitoring and alerting for pipeline health, freshness, and volume anomalies; respond to incidents, run root-cause analysis, and fix the underlying problem.
* Reconcile financial data (processing volume, fees, revenue, billing) against source systems so finance can trust the numbers.

Performance & Cost
  
  

* Tune Snowflake and dbt workloads, incremental strategies, clustering, materialization choices, and warehouse sizing to keep models fast and costs predictable.
* Monitor platform spend and usage and recommend changes that pay for themselves.

Partnership & Leadership
  
  

* Partner with analysts, finance, product, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous business questions into durable data products.
* Raise the bar on SQL, modeling, and testing practices through code review, documentation, and mentorship.
* Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to move faster, while reviewing their output with the same rigor you'd apply to anyone else's code.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* First 90 days: You own a slice of the pipeline end to end, have shipped improvements to core models, and are a trusted responder when jobs fail.
* First 6-12 months: Core models are better tested and faster, data incidents are caught before stakeholders notice, and Finance and Product teams self-serve on models you designed.

**Required**
Skills & Experience
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role.
* Expert SQL: complex joins, window functions, incremental logic, and query performance tuning.
* Strong Python for pipeline development, automation, and tooling.
* Deep hands-on experience with dbt (models, tests, macros, incremental materializations, documentation) and Snowflake (or a comparable cloud warehouse).
* Strong data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, grain, slowly changing dimensions, and designing models for many downstream consumers.
* Experience building and operating production pipelines with orchestration (Airflow or similar), including monitoring, alerting, and on-call ownership.
* A testing mindset: you build data quality checks in from the start and know when a number is right and when it needs a second look.
* Experience supporting product analytics (event data, funnels, adoption, retention) and/or financial analytics (revenue, payments, reconciliation).
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in payments, fintech, POS, or SaaS businesses.
* CDC and streaming ingestion (e.g., Debezium, Kafka, Streamkap) or modern ingestion frameworks (e.g., dlt, Fivetran).
* Unifying data across platform migrations or multiple product backends.
* Snowflake administration: RBAC, cost governance, warehouse management.
* Data observability tools, CI/CD for dbt, and infrastructure as code.
* Experience enabling BI and semantic layers (e.g., Metabase, Looker, dbt Semantic Layer) or AI/agent access to warehouse data.

Offers will be reflective of the candidate’s location and experience.

technology solutions, but we stand out because of the hard-working humans behind the tech.
  
  
We can’t take care of our clients without taking care of our employees first, and that’s why we
  
  
invest in you with a competitive benefits package which includes:

* Proven experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and supporting production data workflows.

* Experience building transformations using notebooks, including Python and Pandas (and/or Spark-based transformations as needed).
* Strong understanding of:
* modern data warehousing
* dimensional modeling (facts/dimensions, SCDs, conformed dimensions)
* performance fundamentals (indexes, partitioning concepts, query tuning as applicable)

* SSIS experience (nice-to-have, not required).
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric components (Lakehouse, Warehouse, pipelines, notebooks, shortcuts, etc.).
* Familiarity with semantic modeling platforms and patterns (e.g., Power BI semantic models/tabular concepts).
