* Create and maintain pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and/or Fabric-native orchestration patterns as appropriate.
* Build transformation logic using notebooks and modern approaches (Python, Pandas, Spark where applicable).
* Apply best practices for:
* data quality checks & validations
* reproducibility (parameterization, modular notebooks, version control)
* performance optimization (partitioning, pushdown, caching strategies where relevant)
* Design and maintain enterprise data warehouse models
* Understand how to prepare data for semantic models and analytics consumption:
* Collaborate with report developers/analysts by ensuring data models align with real BI usage patterns.
* Work closely with stakeholders (analysts, app teams, data owners) to translate requirements into scalable pipelines and models.
* Participate in code reviews, documentation, and operational handoffs.
* Help establish standards for naming, versioning, environments, and deployment patterns.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 3+ years of professional experience in BI, data engineering, or data warehouse development in an enterprise environment.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with T‑SQL, including:
* complex joins, window functions, CTEs
* query optimization and performance tuning
* building and maintaining transformation logic in SQL
* 2+ years of experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines.
* 1+ years of experience building data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) or a comparable orchestration tool.
* 3+ years of experience with modern data warehousing principles, including:
* layered architectures (raw, curated, consumption)
* ELT patterns batch and incremental loading strategies
* 3+ years of hands-on dimensional data modeling experience, including:
* star and snowflake schemas
* fact and dimension table design
* surrogate keys and SCD (Type 1/2) patterns
* 1+ years of experience developing data transformations using notebooks.
* Working knowledge of reporting and analytics tools concepts (e.g., how analysts and business users consume data), even if not responsible for building reports directly.
* Professional communications skills, both verbal and written. Good team player.
* Manage personal workload and work under tight timeframes.
* Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

title: Data Analytics Engineer (Consultant)
description:

What You Bring

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
**Senior Data Engineer - Job Description**
Scenthound is the first membership-based franchise providing affordable and accessible wellness-focused dog care, committed to providing every dog with the care necessary to help maintain their health and keep them clean and happy. Franchising since 2019 and on pace to have over 200 locations open by the end of 2026, Scenthound is establishing itself as the preeminent solution for routine and preventive dog care.
  
  
Our values…
  
  

* Dog First. We advocate for the health and well-being of every dog in our care.
* One Pack. We are one company, one team, with one mission.
* Bring Love. We bring good energy to our work and do our jobs with loving intention.
* Seek Growth. We believe. We learn. We grow.
* Make a Difference. We work with purpose. We are driven by a desire to make a positive impact.

**Role Overview**
Great growth starts with data people can trust. As our
**Senior Data Engineer,**
you will build the foundation that shows us how customers find us, what drives growth, and where to invest next.
  
  
The pipelines, models, and architecture you design will shape how the entire organization uses data for years to come, and your work will show up in measurable business results.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Build Data pipelines**

* Build and maintain ingestion from Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Tag Manager/GA4, among many other data and web sources into Snowflake
* Choose the right approach for each source: managed connectors where they fit, custom Python/Airflow where they don’t
* Monitor pipeline health, catch schema and API changes early, and fix issues before the business notices

**Data architecture and modeling**

* Design and evolve our Snowflake architecture, including layering, naming, and modeling standards
* Build trusted, documented models that support a Customer 360 view
* Make build-vs-buy and tooling recommendations to the CTO, with trade-offs stated

**Marketing activation (reverse ETL / CDP)**

* Push modeled audiences and customer data from Snowflake back to marketing and operational tools
* Partner with marketing to turn data into usable segments and campaigns

**Governance, security, and access**

* Manage Snowflake roles, access controls, and handling of sensitive and personal data
* Support privacy and compliance requirements, flagging risks early

**BI and analytics support**

* Provide clean, well-defined datasets for dashboards and analysts
* Help troubleshoot metric definitions and data discrepancies

**Cost and performance**

* Monitor Snowflake spend, tune warehouses and queries, and set guardrails to keep costs predictable

**What you bring**

* 6+ years of data engineering experience, with deep hands-on Snowflake expertise (modeling, performance, security, cost control)
* Strong SQL and Python; experience building production pipelines with Airflow or a similar orchestrator
* Experience with dbt and with managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, or Stitch
* Proven experience ingesting marketing and advertising data (Google Ads, Meta Ads, GTM/GA4 or similar) via APIs or connectors
* Working knowledge of Customer 360 concepts, identity resolution, and reverse ETL or CDP activation
* Experience with data governance: role-based access, PII handling, and auditability
* Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders
* Comfort being the only or primary data engineer, owning work end to end

**Nice to have**

* Snowflake certification (SnowPro Core or Advanced)
* Experience with a reverse ETL platform, or a CDP
* Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
* Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure as code for data workloads
* Background in a multi-location, franchise, or consumer services business
* Experience with privacy regulations that affect marketing data (CCPA, consent management)

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Compensation commensurate with experience
* Health/Dental/Vision insurance
* Paid time off
* Company Paid Life and AD&D Insurance
* Short Term Disability
* 401k with company match
* Free Scenthound membership for your dog — because of course
* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Employment Sponsorship will not be offered.

This is a remote position.

title: Data Analytics Engineer, Kiewit Water Facilities South 1
description:

183092

Mid Level

Kiewit Water Facilities South

Full Time
  
  
**Position Overview**
Do you have a passion for analyzing data and using it to solve problems? At Kiewit, we believe in the power of analytics to create exceptional results and we are adding an
**intermediate to mid-level**
**Data Analytics Engineer**
to our KWFS district. We are looking for someone with a passion for performing data analysis, data mining, and eventually data science in a professional setting. As a Data Analytics Engineer, you will work with business users to understand challenges and build analytics solutions to overcome those challenges. You will also gather, extract, restructure, analyze and interpret data, and communicate findings and recommendations to the business.
  
  
**District Overview**
Kiewit Water Facilities South specializes in constructing water treatment facilities, wastewater treatment facilities, and desalination plants across North America. Because our people receive continuous and extensive training, hands-on experience, and challenging responsibilities from day one, they quickly develop the expertise that has earned our district its reputation as the premier contractor in the southeast United States.
  
  
**Location**
This position is based in
**Westlake, TX**
, with potential for remote work depending on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and proximity to major Kiewit hub offices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Best-in-class solutions – Your primary role will be delivering analytical solutions to the business. You will need to bring a strong business acumen and work to understand the business challenges facing your stakeholders. From there, you will need to leverage your technical skills and deep knowledge of data to recommend and build solutions for these stakeholders.
* Data Modeling – You will have access to many data sources to provide solutions to your stakeholders. But often this data may not be modeled or structured in an optimal manner to meet your needs. We will have resources to offer support, but ultimately you will be expected to be highly self-sufficient and have the technical skills (SQL/python) to restructure and clean this data as needed.
* Data Visualization – Your output will embody data visualization best practices. Our team is committed to building high quality, performant, insightful solutions that meet specific business needs. The solutions you produce will meet our quality and performance standards.
* Data Analysis – You will be expected to, with limited direction, leverage data to make strategic recommendations to the business. This may include formulating and testing hypotheses, performing correlation analysis, and other forms of data mining. You will also be expected to understand and articulate the business impact of any recommendations.
* Communication and Presentation – On the front end, you will be expected to guide requirement gathering conversations with stakeholders, asking insightful questions to see the business from their perspective. On the back end of solution development/analysis, you will be expected to explain results of analysis to team members, train stakeholders on how to use decision support tools, and succinctly convey how solutions meet specific business needs.
* Data Collection – You will be expected to develop a deep understanding of the core applications we leverage to collect data. You will work with stakeholders and key members of our product team to understand which data we capture today, as well as participate in the development/procurement of future solutions to help capture other necessary data we may not be currently collecting.
* Analytical Advancement – We are intent on delivering a world class employee experience to our Kiewit employees and believe in the power of analytics to aid us in this mission. You will be expected to embrace this mission and work closely with your team members to advance our analytical capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Management, or related field
* Strong interest in data driven problem solving and enjoy using data to uncover insights and tackle complex business challenges.
* 2-5 years of hands-on programming experience with languages such as C++, Python or Java. Proficiency in writing SQL queries is required; experience with SQL Server and Snowflake is highly preferred.
* 2+ years of recent U.S.-based experience in data analytics, including data mining, statistical analysis, and exploratory data analysis. Solid understanding of data science principles, including data visualization and working with APIs for data integration.
* Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI and Streamlit, is highly preferred.
* Ability to travel as business necessitates.
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

**ADDITIONAL Requirements**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* A deep desire to add significant business value
* Curious and naturally inquisitive
* Strong critical thinking
* High business acumen
* Passion for learning and development
* Effective time management and organizational skills
* Ability to work independently and as a team to meet deadlines, goals and objectives

Other Requirements:
  
  

* Regular, reliable attendance
* Work productively and meet deadlines timely
* Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment
* Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies.
* Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required.

Base Compensation: $75,000/yr - $95,000/yr
  
  
**(Actual compensation is subject to variation due to such factors as education, experience, skillset, and/or location)**
We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

title: AI Data Engineer
description:
**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------

Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------

In the position of AI Data Engineer, you will engineer the data that Monster's artificial intelligence (AI) agents and copilots depend on, owning AI data readiness from source to answer. Assess and remediate data for specific AI use cases; build the retrieval pipelines, embeddings, and search indexes that ground Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agentforce, and custom OpenAI and Claude-based agents; and maintain the semantic layer that links related records across systems (for example, a Salesforce account to its SAP financials and Power BI reporting). Working in Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Databricks with the AI Architect, Sr. AI Solution Engineer, and AI Engineer, make enterprise data AI-ready, measurable, and trustworthy, so every AI answer can be traced to its source.

**The Impact You'll Make:**
---------------------------

* Retrieval (RAG) Data Pipelines — Build and operate ingestion, parsing, chunking, enrichment, embedding, and vector / hybrid indexing pipelines (e.g., Azure AI Search, Databricks Vector Search) that ground Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agentforce, and custom agents; enforce permission-aware retrieval that respects source-system security.
* Semantic Layer & Grounding Context — Design and maintain Power BI / Fabric semantic models, business glossary, and entity relationships (e.g., customer, product, and distributor across Salesforce, SAP, and BI) that give AI agents and Fabric data agents a shared, accurate understanding of the business.
* AI Data Readiness Assessment & Remediation — Assess source data for each AI use case (coverage, quality, freshness, sensitivity, and bias); score AI readiness; and drive remediation with source owners before AI build begins.
* AI Data Access via MCP & APIs — Expose curated, zero-copy data in Microsoft Fabric / OneLake and Databricks to AI agents through governed interfaces (e.g., MCP servers, SQL endpoints, APIs) with least-privilege access.
* Retrieval Quality, Observability & Feedback — Monitor index freshness, data drift, and retrieval quality (relevance, groundedness, citation accuracy); feed agent logs and user feedback back into data fixes; publish AI-readiness key performance indicators (KPIs) in Power BI.
* Metadata, Lineage & AI Data Governance — Register AI data assets in Microsoft Purview or Collibra; apply sensitivity labels; maintain lineage from source to index, agent, and answer; partner with Legal, Privacy, and Security on personal data, retention, EMEA data residency, and AI regulatory requirements.
* Evaluation & Ground-Truth Datasets — Curate golden question-and-answer sets, labeled ground truth, and test data that measure AI accuracy; prepare data for fine-tuning or model customization when needed, including LLM-generated synthetic data with appropriate controls.
* LLM-Assisted Data Engineering & Standards — Use OpenAI and Claude models and AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor) to automate metadata enrichment, entity matching, documentation, and pipeline code; contribute AI data standards, templates, and playbooks.

**Who You Are:**
----------------

* Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Statistics, or related.
* 3-5 years of experience in data engineering (pipelines, data modeling, SQL, Spark), including work on Microsoft Azure / Fabric or Databricks
* 1-3 years of experience in building data pipelines specifically for AI or generative AI use cases (RAG, embeddings, vector search, semantic models, evaluation datasets)
* Computer Skills Desired: Languages / query: SQL (advanced), Python (data tooling, PySpark), Spark (intermediate)
* Platforms: Microsoft Fabric / OneLake (Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse, data agents), Azure data services, Databricks, or equivalent
* AI data tooling: Azure AI Search and vector / hybrid search, OpenAI embedding models via Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, LangChain or similar for ingestion, MCP servers for data access
* Models: OpenAI GPT-5.6 / GPT-6 and Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 for enrichment, classification, and evaluation
* Metadata / catalog: Microsoft Purview, Collibra (or similar); Git for versioning
* Modeling / orchestration: dbt, Azure Data Factory / Fabric pipelines, or Airflow
* Dashboards for AI-readiness KPIs: Power BI
* AI-assisted development: Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot
* Preferred Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700), which replaces the retired Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Generative AI Engineer Associate
* Microsoft AI-103: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure (desirable)
* Collibra or Microsoft Purview practitioner training / certification
* Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Strong collaboration with the AI Architect, Sr. AI Solution Engineer, AI Engineer, data engineering, governance, and security teams; ability to turn business concepts into semantic models, entity relationships, and retrieval-ready data; treats retrieval quality and data trust as measurable outcomes

We are seeking a ***Data Engineer I*** who will assist with the creation and maintenance of complex data pipelines from raw acquisition of data to visualization. The Data Engineer I will support the design, production, and maintenance of software infrastructure to automatically extract, transform, and load data from diverse sources. The Data Engineer I will help input/output data from databases and realize complex queries. The Data Engineer I will support the creation of scripts for data manipulation, cleaning, filtering, and preparation of data outputs to be used for data visualization or web display. This will also include creating parts of systems to monitor and guarantee data quality, perform daily data quality assurance tasks, maintain, and troubleshoot the infrastructure, and audit data sources. The Data Engineer I will help explore and analyze data to answer policy-related questions as needed.

  
  

The Data Engineer I will lead the development of mathematical and statistical models of infectious disease transmission including a focus on the analysis of epidemiological and molecular data sets about infection dynamics. The Data Engineer I will develop statistical tools to analyze infectious disease dynamics. This project will focus on the use of various data sets (human behavior, genomics, serological status, and epidemiological information) to predict the spatial and temporal dynamics of vector-borne (malaria, dengue) and vaccine-preventable (SARS-CoV-2, measles, rubella) diseases. The position will require the development, evaluation, and investigation of statistical frameworks to understand disease transmission and ultimately inform public health policy.

  
  

**Specific Duties & Responsibilities**

* Assist with the design, production, and maintenance of data pipelines for data acquisition, management, and transformation, and back-end code development to power data web applications and convert raw data into usable information.
* Contribute to writing and maintenance of ETL/ELTs that operate on a variety of structured and unstructured sources.
* Assist with the development and maintenance of web data scraping systems for automatic data acquisition.
* Assist design data architecture and provide ongoing support.
* Assist with input/output data from databases and perform queries.
* Assist in the creation of scripts to clean, transform, and analyze data.
* Contribute to production data pipelines using data warehousing systems.
* Create and implement production software to monitor data quality and detect data anomalies.
* Perform daily manual data quality assurance tasks.
* Support, maintain, and troubleshoot the software infrastructure.
* Source data, conduct analyses, visualize data, and generate insights to support ongoing research projects and other requests across the organization.
* Assist developers, analysts, data scientists, researchers, policy experts, and other partners.
* Communicate with division leadership, and others on the team.
* Collaborate with external partners, contractors, and vendors.
* Other duties as assigned.
  

  

*In addition to the duties described above*

* Develop infectious disease models.
* Integrate molecular and epidemiological data into computational frameworks.
* Create reproducible analyses and code.
  

  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
  

* Bachelor’s Degree.
* Three years of related experience.
* Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Experience in infectious disease modeling is essential, particularly those related to vaccine-preventable, vector-borne diseases, and/or general infectious disease epidemiology.
* Experience in advanced biostatistical and mathematical methods.
* Experience with coding in R and management of ‘big data’.
* Experience working on spatial transmission models and working on the epidemiology of vaccine-preventable diseases.

title: Associate Data Engineer
description:
Associate Data Engineer

**Department:** Data and Analytics

**Reports to:** Data & Analytics Lead

**Position Summary**
====================

Pogue Construction is seeking an Associate Data Engineer to help build and maintain the data pipelines, API integrations, and dashboards our teams use to make business decisions. As the third member of our data team, this role will work closely with the Data & Analytics Lead and our existing technical team member to keep data accurate, available, and useful across the company.

The Associate Data Engineer will support the data lifecycle from source onboarding and ingestion through transformation, reporting, monitoring, and retirement. The primary focus is hands-on data engineering and API management, with ongoing Power BI dashboard support. This is an opportunity to develop engineering skills while learning how project, financial, and operational information moves through a construction business.

The role will take day-to-day responsibility for assigned integrations and support tasks under established standards and technical guidance. The Data & Analytics Lead will set priorities and retain responsibility for architecture, governance, and production approval, working with IT, Information Security, and department data owners.

**Experience**
==============

* 0-2 years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics, software development, or technical application support. Internships, co-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects will be considered.
* Practical experience using SQL and a scripting language to retrieve, transform, validate, or troubleshoot data.

**Education**
=============

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical training and experience.

**Primary Responsibilities**
============================

**Data Engineering and Ingestion**
----------------------------------

* Build and maintain assigned data pipelines using approved patterns to bring information from APIs, databases, and files into Pogue's data platform.
* Support new source onboarding by profiling data, documenting field mappings and refresh requirements, and validating initial loads with the team and source owners.
* Develop and maintain SQL transformations, notebooks, and dataflows that prepare source data for Silver and Gold tables and downstream reporting.
* Support incremental loads, scheduling, dependencies, retries, and controlled reruns or backfills. Investigate missing records, duplicate data, schema changes, and pipeline failures.

**API Management and Integration Support**
------------------------------------------

* Develop, test, and maintain API connections for business systems such as CMiC, Procore, and scheduling platforms as assigned.
* Handle authentication, pagination, rate limits, payload mapping, and error responses using established integration and security practices.
* Maintain an API inventory documenting endpoints, system owners, permissions, dependencies, refresh schedules, and support contacts. Track credential expiration and coordinate approved rotation with IT and system owners.
* Monitor integration health and vendor API changes. Test version changes, troubleshoot failed requests, and support approved internal APIs that provide curated data to other applications.

**Dashboard and Reporting Support**
-----------------------------------

* Maintain and enhance Power BI reports using approved semantic models, KPI definitions, report standards, and Pogue branding.
* Investigate refresh failures, incorrect results, filter behavior, and access issues. Trace problems through the report, model, pipeline, and source system, and escalate issues outside the assigned scope.
* Gather and document user requests, deliver small report improvements, support user acceptance testing, and create practical guidance that helps employees use reports correctly.

**Data Quality and Lifecycle Support**
--------------------------------------

* Implement and maintain checks for completeness, freshness, duplicate keys, and reconciliation to source totals. Work with department data owners to investigate discrepancies.
* Keep mappings, lineage, dependencies, runbooks, and change records current so another team member can support assigned assets.
* Use version control, peer review, testing, and established release procedures. Document deployment and recovery steps, communicate service interruptions, and help resolve recurring problems.
* Follow approved access, classification, and retention practices. Support archiving and retirement of unused datasets, integrations, and reports after checking dependencies and obtaining the required approval.

**Required Skills**
===================

* Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and troubleshooting query results.
* Foundational Python or comparable scripting skills for data processing and automation.
* Understanding of relational databases, data transformation, and the purpose of ETL or ELT pipelines.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP requests, JSON, and authentication concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, validate results, and document work clearly.
* Clear communication with technical colleagues and business users, sound handling of confidential information, and willingness to learn through feedback and review.

**Preferred Skills**
====================

* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, including pipelines, notebooks, lakehouses, warehouses, or dataflows.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, semantic models, and refresh troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, automated testing, monitoring, or deployment workflows.
* Exposure to OAuth, service principals, secure credential storage, or API testing tools such as Postman.
* Familiarity with CMiC, Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or construction accounting and project operations.

title: Data Engineer Advisor
description:
The Data Engineer Lead plays a pivotal role within Dataworks, focused on creating and driving engineering innovation within Dataworks, helping define and build the Dataworks organization and facilitate the delivery of key business initiatives. S/he acts as a “universal translator” between IT, business, software engineers and data scientists, collaborating with these multi-disciplinary teams. The Data Engineer Lead will contribute to the creation of and adherence to technical standards for data engineering, including the selection and refinements of foundational technical components. S/he will work on those aspects of the Dataworks platform that govern the ingestion, transformation, and pipelining of data assets, both to end users within FedEx and into data products and services that may be externally facing. Day-to-day, s/he will be deeply involved in code reviews and large-scale deployments. Under minimal supervision, supports the design, build, test and maintain data pipelines at big data scale. Assists with updating data from multiple data sources. Other functionalities under close supervision is to work on batch processing of collected data and match its format to the stored data, make sure that the data is ready to be processed and analyzed. Assists with keeping the ecosystem and the pipeline optimized and efficient, troubleshooting standard performance, data related problems and provide L3 support. Independently implements parsers, validators, transformers and correlators to reformat, update and enhance the data. Provides recommendations to highly complex problems. Provides guidance to those in less senior positions.

**Essential Functions**

  

* Provide practical, hands-off guidance on GCP data platform and pipeline architecture: recommend patterns for ingestion, storage, modeling, and governance that match the organization’s maturity and goals.
* Review and critique proposed GCP designs and implementation plans for scalability, reliability, security, and cost; surface risks and pragmatic mitigation options.
* Recommend GCP-specific ingestion and processing patterns: Pub/Sub -> Dataflow (Beam) streaming, Dataflow batch/ETL, Dataproc/Spark jobs, Transfer Service/Storage for bulk loads, and Datastream for CDC; suggest tradeoffs between managed services and containerized workloads.
* Advise on BigQuery design and optimization: schema strategies, partitioning/clustering, materialized views, slots/reservations, BI Engine, cost-control patterns, and query performance best practices.
* Recommend storage and stateful service patterns on GCP: Cloud Storage lifecycle/tiering, Bigtable/Firestore use-cases, Cloud SQL/AlloyDB considerations for analytics use, and caching strategies.
* Propose metadata, catalog and lineage approaches using Data Catalog, Pub/Sub/Dataflow instrumentation, and integration with governance tools; define metadata and discovery expectations.
* Advise on data quality and observability for GCP pipelines: validation checkpoints in Dataflow, Great Expectations or similar, Cloud Monitoring/Logging instrumentation, and data-SLO/SLI recommendations.
* Define security and compliance guardrails on GCP at an architecture level: BigQuery IAM/data access models, Authorized Views, VPC Service Controls, Workload Identity, Cloud KMS/CMEK, Secret Manager, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) patterns for PII.
* Recommend CI/CD and deployment patterns for data workloads on GCP: Dataflow templates, Composer/Airflow orchestration, artifact promotion strategies, and IaC (Terraform) governance for data platform resources.
* Provide cost/governance guidance specific to GCP analytics: labeling, budgets, BigQuery cost controls, committed use/flat-rate considerations, and high-level FinOps guardrails.
* Produce concise guidance artifacts for engineering teams: GCP architecture checklists, design-review templates, migration playbooks for GCP services, runbook outlines, and cutover/validation checklists.
* Mentor and upskill engineers on GCP data best practices via reviews, brown-bags, and targeted coaching; enable teams to adopt patterns without owning delivery.
* Support migration and modernization efforts in an advisory capacity for GCP moves: contribute to risk assessments, cutover criteria, performance/RTO-RPO validation approaches, and rollback plans.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* 5+ years in data engineering or related roles with experience advising or influencing technical direction; 2+ years working with GCP data services in a practical or architectural capacity.
* Hands-on or review experience with core GCP data services: BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataproc/Dataproc Serverless, Cloud Composer (Airflow), Datastream/Transfer Service, and Data Catalog.
* Practical knowledge of BigQuery performance and cost patterns (partitioning, clustering, materialized views, reservations/slots) and common anti-patterns.
* Familiarity with GCP security and compliance features relevant to data: IAM for datasets, Authorized Views, VPC Service Controls, Workload Identity, Cloud KMS/CMEK, Secret Manager, and DLP.
* Experience advising on pipeline observability and data-quality approaches on GCP: Cloud Monitoring/Logging, traceability for Dataflow/Dataproc jobs, and data validation frameworks.
* Experience participating in at least one GCP-focused data platform migration or modernization as an advisor, reviewer, or core contributor.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to produce concise, actionable guidance and explain technical tradeoffs to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
* Familiarity with Terraform and CI/CD patterns for GCP resources and data pipelines; conceptual understanding of GitOps for data workloads.
* Certifications such as Google Professional Data Engineer or Google Cloud Architect are a plus but not required.

**Minimum Education**

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics or Engineering and/or equivalent formal training or work experience.

**Minimum Experience**

Five to Seven (5 - 7) years equivalent work experience in measurement and analysis, quantitative business problem solving, simulation development and/or predictive analytics. Extensive knowledge in data engineering and machine learning frameworks including design, development and implementation of highly complex systems and data pipelines. Extensive knowledge in Information Systems including design, development and implementation of large batch or online transaction-based systems. Strong understanding of the transportation industry, competitors, and evolving technologies. Experience providing leadership in a general planning or consulting setting. Experience as a leader or a senior member of multi-function project teams. Strong oral and written communication skills. A related advanced degree may offset the related experience requirements.

**Domicile Information**

This is a hybrid position located in Plano, TX. Candidates must live within 50 miles of the campus location. Employees will be required to work at the FedEx campus location several times per week. We will also consider candidates located in Pittsburgh, PA and Memphis, TN.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**General Summary**

Under limited direction, responsible for design and implementation of core technologies associated with the organizations data analysis and analytics technical infrastructure. As a core member of a high-performance team, ensure data pipelines are consistently and reliably maintained and analytics capabilities are delivered at an optimum level, helping the organization identify insights from a large number of diverse datasets.

This position reports to the Director, Enterprise Data Integration and Solution Architecture.

**Principal Responsibilities and Tasks**

The following statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. These are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all job duties performed by personnel so classified.

1. Ensure analytics infrastructure and associated systems meet business requirements and industry best practices.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
The Data/DataOps Engineer II is a junior-to-mid level position that will provide data pipeline, orchestration, and platform operations expertise to guide the development, deployment, and reliable operation of data products and reporting solutions within the Verisk Claims Solutions division. The successful candidate has experience developing data pipelines using cloud services, designing data structures that support data products and reporting systems, and applying DevOps/CI-CD practices to keep those systems secure, observable, and repeatable to operate. In this hands-on role, he/she will be responsible for collaborating with product owners, tackling technical problems, helping define best practices, and contributing in design/code reviews. In addition, the candidate will help create innovative solutions to satisfy the growing needs of internal and external customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Pipeline Development - Design and develop data pipelines using cloud serverless/container services (e.g., managed functions, batch compute, container orchestration, and workflow/orchestration frameworks) in conjunction with cloud data warehousing platforms.
* Data Table Design – Design, review, and build dimensional/Kimball style data models for data products and business intelligence reporting systems.
* Platform Operations & DevOps – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for data pipelines and infrastructure, following version-controlled, repeatable release practices.
* Access & Governance Operations – Support access provisioning/lifecycle management, role-based permissions, and audit/compliance controls across data platforms in line with security and governance standards.
* Integration – Build and consume REST APIs and integrate with web services/gateways as part of pipeline or platform automation.
* Collaboration – Work closely with product owners to understand and refine new feature requests. Work closely with data engineering team to design, review, and develop new data pipelines.
* Communication - Ability to communicate technical ideas in terms product owners and non-technical users can understand.
* Best Practice - Ensure standard practices are followed for logging, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and data security.
* Data Security – Understand Verisk data security policies and controls and design and implement ways to comply with the policies.

**Qualifications**
**About You and How You Can Excel in This Role**

* BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 2+ years of experience designing and developing cloud data pipelines (ETL/ELT solutions).
* 2+ years of Data Warehousing experience.
* Proficient in writing SQL for aggregating and transforming data as part of a data pipeline.
* Experience using Python for automating processes, working with APIs, and/or transforming data.
* Working knowledge of dimensional/data modeling methods used to support business intelligence tools.
* Experience building data pipelines using a variety of data sources (RDBMs, NoSQL, REST APIs, message queues, and files).
* Experience working with a cloud data warehouse platform (e.g., Snowflake or equivalent).
* Experience with cloud serverless/container technologies (e.g., functions-as-a-service, managed batch compute, container orchestration) and workflow orchestration frameworks.
* Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals and CI/CD practices (build/release pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated deployments).
* Experience with access management, security, and governance/audit operations on a data platform.
* A curious, inquisitive mindset with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and troubleshoot through ambiguous issues.
* Working knowledge of development standards/best practices with the ability to follow established design patterns.
* Proficiency with version control systems (GIT)
* Proficiency with database modeling tools (SqlDBM, etc.)
* Experience with REST APIs, API gateways, or other web application/integration technologies is a plus.
* Experience working with tokenized PII is a plus.
* Insurance industry experience is a plus.

**About Us**
For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster.
  
  
At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed.
  
  
For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.
  
  
We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations.

title: Data and Analytics Engineer
description:
We are an established security manufacturing company with more than 50 years in business, providing quality products and solutions our customers can depend on. As we continue to grow and strengthen our data-driven operations, we are looking for a talented Data and Analytics Engineer to join our team.

  

If you enjoy solving problems, working with data, building meaningful insights, and helping a business make smarter decisions, this could be the opportunity for you!

  

**About the Role**

The Data and Analytics Engineer plays an important role in developing and supporting our company's data and analytics environment. This position works across data engineering, business intelligence, and analytics to manage the full data lifecycle—from collecting and transforming data to developing dashboards, maintaining BI platforms, and helping employees use data effectively.

  

The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem-solver with strong SQL and Python skills, experience with API integrations, and a passion for making data accessible, accurate, and useful throughout the organization.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and automated workflows to extract, ingest, integrate, and process data from multiple sources, including applications, APIs, databases, and external systems.
* Develop and maintain data warehouses, data lakes, and related data platforms to support reliable, efficient, and accessible data storage and analytics.
* Implement data quality tests, document data definitions, optimize SQL queries, and manage dependencies between data models to ensure accuracy, consistency, and performance.
* Monitor pipeline performance, data freshness, and reliability; troubleshoot failures; and manage data security, access controls, and infrastructure costs.
* Monitor and respond to inquiries submitted through the Data Team Help Line, troubleshooting and resolving day-to-day system and data-related issues to support operational efficiency and data accuracy.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs and deliver actionable data products.
* Contribute to internal documentation, playbooks, and knowledge-sharing to strengthen team practices.
* Stay current on tools and methods, recommending improvements to platforms, processes, and governance.
* Transform raw warehouse data into clean, structured, and reusable datasets to design, build, and maintain BI dashboards, reporting, and analytical initiatives that support decision-making.
* Perform predictive analytics and statistical analysis to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and generate actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making.
* Follow and adhere to the DMP Data Classification Standard.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, information systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
* 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, BI development, or a closely related role.
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining data pipelines, models, and BI solutions in production environments.
* Experience working cross-functionally with business teams to translate requirements into data products.
* Proficiency in SQL for data modeling, transformations, and performance optimization.
* Experience working with APIs for data ingestion, integration, and automation.
* Familiarity with medallion/lakehouse architectures and developing transformation pipelines (Bronze ? Silver ? Gold).
* Strong skills in BI and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Domo, Looker, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with version control tools (such as Git) and modern data development practices.
* Experience administering BI platforms, including governance, permissions, and content management.
* Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality practices.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort taking ownership across the full data lifecycle.
* Ability to develop and execute complex research projects with minimal supervision.

  

**Why Join Our Team?**

Be part of an established company with more than five decades of experience in security manufacturing, where your technical skills and ideas can make a meaningful difference. You'll have the opportunity to improve how information is collected, managed, and used across the business while helping build a stronger, more data-driven organization.

  

**Ready to turn data into meaningful results? We'd love to hear from you!**

Apply today and become part of a team that values experience, collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  

EOE/Vet/Disabled

Onsite medical clinic for employee, spouse and family members 18 and under living at home; Medical, Dental, 401k, Life Insurance, Short and Long Term Disability, paid vacation/holidays, plus some not so usual (free security system, free UPS shipping), so you don't have to worry about self or family.

Would you like to implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve the world's most complex technical problems? Do you have a deep passion and desire to engineer and operate the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure to build a better world for future generations?  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to use the latest cloud computing technologies to help U.S. Government agencies implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems.  
  
AWS established a specialized group of service teams responsible for the work we are doing with the U.S. Intelligence Community. We are building some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world, and we need adaptable people to help us implement and operate them.
  
  
The AWS Intelligence team is seeking highly motivated engineers who are focused on operational excellence and troubleshooting complex system operations, have a good understanding of Linux, networking and general knowledge of cloud services. We need engineers who understand how to think big, and simplify solutions to complex problems; all the while ensuring that our customers continue to have the best experience possible.
  
  
In this role, you are able to take a defined set of tasks and execute it on schedule. You identify ineffective processes. You may identify when technical implementations have defects or are not highly available, performant, or maintainable. You understand operational risk and avoid taking unnecessary risks. You identify operational concerns and resolve, mitigate, or escalate the concerns in a timely manner.  
  
This is a shift work position. This team works 24/7 operations, and may require you to work some nights and/or weekends.  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.  
  
A day in the life  
On a typical day, our engineers may dive deep to find the root cause of a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending in the wrong direction, or discuss radical new approaches to automate operational processes. As a member of our team you will join a dedicated group of engineers who provide troubleshooting and operations support, and innovate to automate operational tasks.  
  
About the team  
About AWS
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

------------------------

* High school or equivalent diploma, or A+ or CND (Certified Network Defender) or Network+ or Security+
* 1-3 years of experience with Systems Administration in Linux/Unix (Ubuntu, CentOS, RedHat, Solaris, etc.)
* 1-3 years of experience with Troubleshooting / Support for technical IT issues
* 1-3 years of experience with Networking (TCP/IP, DNS)
* Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret or above with Full Scope Polygraph

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with AWS core services, Command Console, or command line interface

description:
Cleveland Steel Container, an Employee Owned and World Class Steel Pail Manufacturing company, is seeking an enthusiastic, responsible, and customer-oriented individual that has a positive attitude and shares the values of our company culture, which is built around teamwork, family, honest communication and producing desirable results for our **Hudson, OH** corporate office.

NEW EMPLOYEES ARE ELIGIBLE FOR 15 DAYS OF PAID VACATION PER CALENDAR YEAR AND 11 PAID COMPANY HOLIDAYS.**

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team and take ownership of the data infrastructure that powers our internal analytics and reporting capabilities. You'll be the primary technical resource responsible for maintaining and evolving our ELT pipelines and Snowflake data warehouse, working closely with a team of analysts and systems administrators who depend on reliable, well-structured data to do their jobs.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and enhancement of our ELT pipelines and Snowflake data warehouse
* Diagnose and resolve pipeline failures, data quality issues, and performance bottlenecks
* Design, build, and document new data models and transformations as analytical needs evolve
* Ensure data reliability, consistency, and availability for downstream consumers
* Support and extend API integration workflows built on Boomi and Python
* Maintain and contribute to custom Python applications developed by the team
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to scope and deliver new data integration projects
* Contribute to the evaluation of modern data tooling options as we assess potential improvements to our current architecture
* Document systems, processes, and decisions to build institutional knowledge over time

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics or similar subjects is preferred
* 3-5 years of hands-on experience in a data engineering role
* Strong proficiency with SQL and data modelling concepts for analytical workloads
* Practical experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse platform
* Familiarity with ELT/ETL pipeline concepts and tools — you don't need to know our specific stack on day one, but you should be able to learn it quickly
* Experience with WhereScape RED, Matillion, Airbyte, dbt, or comparable ELT automation tools

* Experience with API integrations and working with REST-based data sources

* Experience with GitHub for version control

**Ability to:**

* Support and extend API integration workflows built on Boomi and Python
* Maintain and contribute to custom Python applications developed by the team
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to scope and deliver new data integration projects

**Additional Skills:**

* Exposure to enterprise integration platforms (Boomi or similar iPaaS tools)

* Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration concepts
* Experience working closely with BI or analytics teams as a technical partner

Cleveland Steel Container offers a competitive salary based on commensurate experience and a comprehensive benefits program that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, 401k with company contribution, profit sharing, paid holidays and vacations, life insurance and short & long-term disability coverages along with an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

title: Azure Cloud and DevOps Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
The Azure Cloud & DevOps Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and operational tooling within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. This role will partner closely with development, security, and operations teams to create reliable, repeatable, and secure delivery practices while contributing to the optimization of our Azure environment and DevOps culture.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, including automated builds, releases, and environment provisioning.
* Manage Azure cloud resources, infrastructure-as-code templates (ARM/Bicep/Terraform), networking, identity, storage, and monitoring solutions.
* Implement and maintain configuration management and deployment automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, YAML pipelines, and Git repositories.
* Support .NET, SQL Server, and API-based application deployments into Azure App Services, Kubernetes (AKS), or containerized environments.
* Collaborate with developers to standardize build/release processes and ensure successful, reliable deployments.
* Implement observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and dashboards for proactive system health management.
* Partner with security teams to enforce DevSecOps best practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, Azure Key Vault usage, and compliance alignment.
* Troubleshoot production infrastructure issues, support incident response, and drive root-cause analysis and long-term remediation.

**Qualifications**
**What we expect from you:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (App Services, AKS, ACR, Storage, Networking, IAM, Functions).
* Expertise with Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts).
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Azure CLI, and scripting for automation.
* Experience with Git, YAML-based pipeline development, and version control best practices.
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (AKS/Kubernetes).
* Background in Windows and Linux server administration, CI/CD architecture, and cloud security fundamentals.
* Understanding of monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure core networking (VNets, VNet Peering, Load Balancers, Application Gateways, Azure Firewall, and network routing)
* Strong knowledge of hybrid connectivity, VPN Gateways, ExpressRoute, Network Security Groups (NSGs), and User Defined Routes (UDRs).
* Practical experience implementing Private Endpoints, Private Link, and custom Azure DNS infrastructure.
* Proficiency provisioning and managing network infrastructure as code using ARM, Bicep, or Terraform.
* Experience diagnosing cloud network issues using diagnostic and packet analysis tools (Azure Network Watcher, NSG flow logs, Wireshark)
* Foundational understanding of traditional on-premises networking concepts (VLANs, BGP routing, hardware firewalls, and switching) is a plus.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of DevOps, cloud engineering, or related experience in Microsoft environments.
* Industry certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, or equivalent knowledge are highly preferred.

**Preferred Soft Skills:**

* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting ability, and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to partner across development, infrastructure, and security teams.
* Proactive mindset with a passion for automation and continuous improvement.

**Work Environment:**

* Hybrid work environment with a combination of remote and on-site collaboration, depending on organizational needs.
* Fast-paced, highly collaborative setting that involves cross-functional coordination.
* May require occasional off-hours work during system updates.
* Standard office hours with flexibility as needed to support operations.

Enlighten is seeking a highly motivated and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our fast-paced development team. The DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and ensuring the monitoring, reliability and scalability of our services. Work is performed in a hybrid environment (on average 1-2 days a week) with a great team.
  
  
If you have a passion for DevOps and are interested in working with a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
#Mid-Senior Level
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Support development and deployment of cloud infrastructure in AWS, especially EKS.
* Support development and deployment of non-cloud (Edge) infrastructure of on-premise and portable equipment.
* Automate deployment processes and ensure reliability and scalability of services.
* Manage and maintain Kubernetes containers and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
* Collaborate with development teams to integrate their applications into the infrastructure.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production systems and resolve issues as necessary.
* Continuously improve processes and tools to ensure high availability and performance.
* Stay current with new technologies and industry trends, continuously exploring new ways to improve our infrastructure.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Clearance Requirement: Must currently have and maintain an active Secret U.S. Government Security Clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.
* 5+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering or Software Development and Bachelors in related field; or 3 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
* Strong knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, EBS, S3, Lambda) and their application to deployment and management of infrastructure.
* Proficient in configuration management tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
* Experience with application, container, and OS deployment, scaling, and management.
* Ability to develop in multiple programming languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.
* Familiarity with Git, Flux, and other development and deployment tools.
* Must be comfortable in a terminal-based environment.
* Proficient knowledge of Linux, including system administration and troubleshooting.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and troubleshoot complex issues.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Understanding of AGILE software development methodologies and use of standard software development tool suites.
* Must have a DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications (i.e. Security+) or willing to obtain within 60 days of hire.
* Must be able to work in a hybrid environment, spending an average of 1-2 days per week at our Columbia, MD office. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed. Onsite frequency and locations may vary based on customer/company support requirements and contract needs.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience with big data technologies like: Hadoop, Accumulo, Ceph, Spark, NiFi, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Hive, Drill, Impala, Trino, Presto, etc.
* Experience with K9s, AWS CLI and other AWS services like SNS, SQS and Diode is a plus.

We have many more additional great benefits/perks that you can find on our website at www.enlighten.com.

description:

**Department: Health Equity**
**Location: Dallas, TX**
**Shift: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM**
**Job Type: Remote (Texas)**
**Why Children's Health?**
At Children's Health, our mission is to Make Life Better for Children, and we recognize that their health plays a crucial role in achieving this goal.
  
  
Through our cutting-edge treatments and affiliation with UT Southwestern, we strive to deliver an extraordinary patient and family experience, ensuring that every moment, big or small, contributes to their overall well-being.
  
  
Our dedication to promoting children's health extends beyond our organization and encompasses the broader community. Together, we can make a significant difference in the lives of children and contribute to a brighter and healthier future for all.
  
  
**Summary**
Under the direction of Data & Analytics Engineering leadership, the Analytics Engineer II will own and operationalize analytics products that advance health equity operational, quality, and research initiatives. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in applying statistical and analytical methods, including regression modeling, hypothesis testing, survival analysis, risk adjustment, and other epidemiological techniques, to translate complex clinical, operational, and research questions into actionable insights and measurable outcomes. They will leverage strong SQL, Python, and analytics engineering skills to design and maintain semantic layers, data marts, metrics stores, and self-service analytics solutions while ensuring data quality, governance, and reproducibility. This individual will partner closely with clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to transform EHR, research, financial, and supply chain data into trusted, scalable analytics products that support decision-making, outcomes measurement, disparities analysis, and performance improvement efforts. The ideal candidate combines rigorous scientific and research-oriented thinking with modern engineering practices such as version control, CI/CD, automated testing, metadata management, and environment promotion, while serving as an effective communicator who can translate technical concepts for diverse audiences and mentor junior team members. Candidates who have demonstrated success in research activities, publications, presentations, health services research, or population health programs, along with the ability to connect analytics solutions to tangible healthcare impact, will be particularly well-suited for this role. The strongest candidates will demonstrate both advanced healthcare analytics expertise and the ability to operationalize analytics at scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and model analytically ready datasets; implement and maintain semantic layers, metrics stores or data marts; apply data engineering best practices to analytics (version control, CI/CD, environment management); collaborate with BI analysts, data scientists and domain stakeholders to operationalize analytics products; ensure alignment with governance and data quality requirements

**Level Specific Requirements**

* Design and implement semantic layer components (metrics store objects, analytical models, data marts) to support domain KPIs and BI consumption
* Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and deployment promotion for analytics products; own environment management for domain artifacts
* Lead data quality monitoring for analytics products and collaborate with data stewards to remediate issues; maintain metadata and lineage in the catalog
* Optimize query and semantic performance for BI tools; implement best practices to reduce dashboard sprawl and inconsistent metrics
* Collaborate with clinical and operational stakeholders to translate clinical workflows and EHR/ERP data into repeatable analytics products (e.g., procedure-level cost and outcomes dashboards, inventory visibility reports)
* Domain collaboration (e.g. clinical, financial, or supply chain), stakeholder facilitation and problem-solving skills
* Ability to translate business KPIs into reproducible metrics-as-code and communicate technical concepts to a wide range of stakeholders
* Ability to mentor junior engineers

**Healthcare Domain Considerations**

* Work with EHR/clinical data and supply‑chain/ERP data sources, follow interoperability expectations (FHIR/HL7 awareness for clinical integrations), support clinical analytics use cases (procedural analytics, outcomes measurement, preference card analytics) and supply‑chain analytics (spend, contract, inventory visibility) when relevant

**Engineering Practices To Measure And Apply**

* Version control of analytics content, separate dev/test/prod environments, workflow orchestration, metadata/cataloging and performance testing to improve model uptime, adoption, code quality and defect resolution

**Governance & Risk**

* Adhere to organizational data governance, privacy and security requirements (e.g., HIPAA-relevant controls), and collaborate with governance or ARB where analytics/AI artifacts will be used in clinical or high-risk contexts

**Work Experience**
**How You’ll Be Successful:**

* At least 3 years In analytics/data roles with demonstrated delivery of analytics artifacts, experience with dbt or other analytics engineering tools, and hands-on CI/CD and orchestration tool usage. Required
* At least 3 years Advanced SQL, dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks, familiarity with metrics store concepts and knowledge-graph/ontology basics for semantic enrichment where applicable Required
* At least 3 years Ability to implement CI/CD for analytics, automated testing, environment promotion and metadata/catalog integration Required
* At least 3 years Proficiency with at least one cloud data platform (Snowflake, Databricks, MS Fabric) and BI tool optimizations (Power BI/Tableau performance tuning) Required
* At least 1 year Exposure to machine learning, data science, or artificial intelligence concepts Preferred
* At least 1 year Experience working in healthcare or other regulated industry Preferred

**EDUCATION**

* Four-year Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or related field Required

**LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS**

* Analytics related certifications (e.g. Dbt Analytics Engineering, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Snowflake SnowPro, Databricks, Epic Cogito) or a learning plan requirement to be provided with offer includes missing relevant certifications needed to perform role, and certifications must be obtained within 180 days of starting first class Required

**A Place Where You Belong**
We put our people first. We welcome, value, and respect the beliefs, identities and experiences of our patients and colleagues. We are committed to delivering culturally effective care, creating meaningful partnerships in the communities we serve, and equipping and developing our team members to make Children’s Health a place where everyone can contribute.

Seeking an experienced Spark, HDFS, and Kafka Administrator/Engineer to manage, support, and optimize enterprise-grade big data platforms. Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, HDFS, and Kafka is required and will be the primary focus of this role. Experience administering these technologies within a Cloudera environment is preferred but secondary to strong expertise in the core underlying platforms.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Spark Administration:** Deploy, configure, monitor, tune, and troubleshoot Apache Spark environments and workloads. Support Spark job performance, resource management, capacity planning, and production operations.
* **HDFS Administration:** Manage and support HDFS storage, including capacity, performance, availability, permissions, replication, and troubleshooting. Ensure robust integration between distributed compute platforms and storage.
* **Kafka Administration:** Deploy, configure, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot Apache Kafka clusters, topics, producers, and consumers. Support performance, capacity, availability, security, and production operations.
* **Monitoring & Performance Tuning:** Monitor platform connectivity, health, capacity, and performance using tools such as Grafana, Splunk, and related management utilities. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks across Spark, HDFS, and Kafka.
* **Security & Compliance:** Implement and manage security configurations, including Kerberos, SSL/TLS, authorization policies, HDFS ACLs, and enterprise IAM/LDAP integrations.
* **Automation & Scripting:** Develop and maintain automation using Python, Bash, or Perl for routine administration, configuration management, monitoring, and operational support.
* **Troubleshooting & Support:** Provide expert-level troubleshooting and technical support across the big data tech stack, including participation in an on-call rotation.
* **Platform Lifecycle:** Support installations, patching, upgrades, migrations, and maintenance activities while minimizing downtime. Support Cloudera Hadoop/CDP administration as needed.

title: Embedded DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Hark**

Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory.

We're pairing that intelligence with next-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world.

To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next-generation AI hardware together - designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems.

The Embedded Software team is responsible for the software running on Hark’s next generation of AI hardware, and we are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our team. You will be working cross functionally with the Firmware, Device Software, QA, Manufacturing and Operations team. * 5+ years of practical experience in DevOps for Embedded Systems and/or consumer electronics products

* Proficiency in shell scripting and Python, along with advanced debugging skills
* Experience with embedded system software build system for bare metal, RTOSes, and/or Linux/Android based systems
* Proficient with Git and collaborative version control practices.
* Experience with modern OTA systems including A/B image management, compression and delta update
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are needed to work effectively within a cross-functional team

**Bonus Qualifications**

* Advanced-level skills in Linux system administration
* Proficiency in GitLab CI

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

* Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
* Extraordinary co-workers

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

------------------------------

  

The Component, Science, Engineering, and Production (CSEP) Information Systems and Operational Technology Solutions department (Org 7577) is seeking an IT/Computer Science professional to work on full-stack application development (custom and COTS), DevOps Engineering (CI/CD pipeline automation), or Smart factory Engineering, or a combination of these, for Sandia's discrete manufacturing and lot-based production centers. This role is ideal for a collaborative, versatile, and self-motivated individual who thrives on solving diverse, high-impact technical challenges. The successful candidate will design, implement, integrate, upgrade, and optimize solutions to enable Sandia to make continued progress towards digital transformation.

On any given day, you may:

Perform full-stack application development work

* Customize and extend COTS Oracle Manufacturing and/or Solumina MES COTS applications
* Integrate/interface data between COTS applications and/or Custom systems
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines that package, validate, and deploy both custom applications and COTS solutions.
* Demonstrated cyber security awareness by writing secure code and deploying through CI/CD pipelines that automatically run security scans, testing scripts, etc..
* Research and implement OpenShift-based deployment strategies for the departments COTS and custom application portfolio.
* Research, explore, and apply AI-enabled methods to enhance productivity, increase workflow efficiency, and support modernization strategies.

* Support efforts to develop strategies for developing OT information retention.
* Develop and maintain standardized on-boarding patterns (reference architectures, reusable templates, configuration baselines) to accelerate repeatable equipment integrations.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts to enhance standardization, scalability, and security of OT on-boarding processes, incorporating lessons learned from deployments.
* Advance digital engineering, digital thread, and industry 4.0 smart factory initiatives.
Build and sustain effective relationships with manufacturing/engineering partners, CIO collaborators, and stakeholders across Sandia* -ensuring strong communication, alignment, and customer support.

While some remote work is possible, due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite.

$102,400 - $199,700

* Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

-----------------------------

* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
* Active DOE Q-level security clearance

**Qualifications We Desire**
----------------------------

  

The ideal R&D Computer Science candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

* Demonstrated software development skills and familiarity with modern software development practices and tools (e.g., Agile).

* Demonstrated proficiency using AI

The Component, Science, Engineering, and Production (CSEP) department, org. 7577, provides IT, OT, and cyber security assurance support and services to our engineering partners across Sandia's Neutron Generator and Advanced Manufacturing Enterprise, Explosives Technologies, and Power Sources technologies centers. title: DevOps Engineer - Hybrid
description:
