Tenet3® is a digital knowledge management company based in Dayton, Ohio. We have deep roots in cybersecurity, system trustworthiness, and software/hardware assurance. We develop software products involving advanced machine learning and property graph representations to enhance human cognition. Tenet3 is a recognized leader in creating novel solutions for managing knowledge about complex systems. Our capabilities put data in context so that teams can generate meaningful insights. We leverage our knowledge management platform, MeTRA®, and sophisticated AI/ML tooling to rapidly build digital knowledge graphs using open data standards that make them accessible and usable across the lifecycle. Tenet3 is growing by applying our knowledge management platform to systems assurance, cybersecurity, and engineering change analyses.

**Why Work Here**

At Tenet3, our employee's contributions are highly visible, valued, and rewarded. Be part of a team that supports both your personal and professional growth. Our team thrives in a collaborative, growth-oriented environment where we're continuously pushing the boundaries of what's possible. If you're looking to work in a place that combines cutting-edge technology with a strong sense of culture and team spirit, and amazing benefits, then we are the place for you!

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with a strong background in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation to serve as a technical advocate supporting our client's cloud initiatives. This role involves collaborating with development and security teams to build resilient CI/CD pipelines, optimize core cloud network topologies, and maintain proactive observability and alerting tools. You will have the opportunity to leverage your expertise in cloud orchestration, scripting, and access management, working closely with our team to deliver high-impact, secure, and repeatable cloud deployments.

The ideal candidate would be an automation-driven systems thinker who understands that infrastructure is only as reliable as the code that provisions it. This position will bridge the gap between application development and IT operations, ensuring our client's mission-critical systems are secure, scalable, and highly available.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize infrastructure-as-code (IaC) for repeatable and secure cloud deployments
* Build, maintain, and refactor CI/CD pipelines to accelerate feature delivery, minimize risk, and reduce technical debt
* Configure and manage observability tools, dashboards, and proactive alerting to detect and resolve issues
* Respond to production issues, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to incident postmortems
* Collaborate with development teams to align infrastructure design with application requirements
* Document technical designs, runbooks, and standard operating procedures to ensure team alignment
* Participate in sprint planning and advocate for automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency
* Utilize Cloud & DevOps Skills to:
* + Design, provision, and maintain core cloud network topologies and troubleshoot connectivity across multi-environment setups
  + Enhance secrets management, access controls, and audit IAM roles/policies for least-privilege access in collaboration with security engineers
  + Improve visibility into cloud resource utilization and cost to support budget-aware engineering decisions

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Core Technical Experience:** 3-5 years of professional engineering experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering, with a track record of identifying automation gaps, recommending IaC improvements, and troubleshooting multi-environment or hybrid setups.
* **Cloud Infrastructure & IaC:** Proficiency in modern IaC and orchestration tools (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes, Ansible, CloudFormation), with experience managing core cloud network topologies.
* **CI/CD & Automation Proficiency:** Solid experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD) and strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating routine tasks and reducing manual toil.

* **Security & Compliance:** Experience managing secrets and access using tools like AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, or SSM, with a strong understanding of cloud IAM roles and least-privilege enforcement.
* **Technical Communication & Collaboration:** Clear communication of infrastructure requirements, risks, and opportunities, with a proven ability to partner effectively with developers and IT to support secure, reliable delivery pipelines.

*Education*

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

**Benefits**

At Tenet3, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your personal and professional well-being:

* **Generous Paid Time Off**: Including PTO, sick days, and floating holidays to help you recharge.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: 100% paid medical, vision, and dental insurance for you and your family.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

Our mission is to accelerate the future of intelligence and make it ubiquitously accessible by delivering full stack custom AI servers optimized for large-scale inference and training. Backed by top-tier investors and led by industry veterans, we’re scaling rapidly. We seek forward-thinking engineers and operators who thrive in a collaborative environment and excel at solving complex challenges from first principles. If you want to build infrastructure that fundamentally changes what the world can accomplish with AI, come join us!

**About the position**

As a Senior DevOps Engineer reporting to the DevOps Manager, you will own the infrastructure our engineers use to build, test and run Majestic Labs’ AI servers. The environment is hybrid: on-prem bare-metal clusters in our labs alongside public cloud. You will design the orchestration, automation, CI/CD and observability foundations that let our hardware, firmware, software and ML teams move fast and ship reliably.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Design, build and operate hybrid infrastructure spanning on-prem bare-metal clusters and public cloud
* Own cluster orchestration with Kubernetes, including scheduling, quotas and resource management for development, testing and AI workloads
* Build and scale CI/CD and build systems for software, firmware and hardware validation flows, including lab and hardware-in-the-loop testing
* Codify infrastructure with IaC and automation for provisioning, configuration and the full bare-metal server lifecycle
* Establish monitoring, logging, alerting and SLOs; lead incident response and blameless postmortems
* Apply security best practices across the stack: secrets management, access control and network segmentation
* Partner with hardware, firmware, software and ML teams to understand their needs and continuously improve developer experience
* Set DevOps standards and mentor engineers as the team grows

  
Requirements:  
  
  

* 6+ years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering, with strong Linux skills and ownership of production systems
* Hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production across on-prem and public cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure)
* Strong Infrastructure as Code and automation skills (Terraform, Ansible, Helm or similar) and scripting in Python, Bash or Go
* Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and build systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar)
* Experience building monitoring, logging and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki or similar) and leading incident response

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Familiarity with high-performance networking (InfiniBand, RoCE)
* Bare-metal provisioning and management (PXE, MAAS, Ironic, Foreman, BMC/Redfish)

title: Data Engineer
description:
Education Analytics is a non-profit organization that strives to deliver sophisticated, research-informed analytics to educators and school administrators to support their work in improving student outcomes. Data Engineers at EA enable this mission by ensuring that the data educators receive is accurate, up to date, secure, and easily accessible.
  
  
We are seeking a full-time Data Engineer or Analytics Engineer to join our Engineering team focused on Data & Partners. Candidates for this role may be hired at a Data Engineer II or Senior Data Engineer level depending on skills and experience. The person in this role will design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines and analytic systems for our partner education agencies. This will involve working directly on partner education agency projects to build data systems using EA’s tools, and use the experience of building real systems to advise and contribute to core product development.
  
  
An ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, experience with data warehousing concepts, and familiarity with complex data integration work. Data engineers are responsible for extract/load processes, data warehouse design, data transformations, and data modeling. While we want our team members to have familiarity with all aspects of ELT, we welcome specialists who may be more experienced on either the data engineering or analytics engineering side. Our typical stack uses an ELT approach via Apache Airflow and dbt to create data warehouses in Snowflake and Databricks.
  
  
Our team is working to change the education sector by building frameworks to enable collaboration across school systems. To do this, we use open data standards and open-source tools so that solutions we create can be used and re-used in different education agencies across the country. We build and maintain the Enable Data Union project and open-source projects like Earthmover. Our team’s work includes building tools and creating and managing data systems using those tools.
  
  
This sampling of posts from the Education Analytics blog provides some insight into the role:
  
  

* What we’ve learned building AI on top of Education Data
* A day in the life of a Data Engineer with Ryan Aguilar
* A day in the life of a Data Engineer with Angelica Lastra
* Building Shared Data Infrastructure for Public Education

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years experience designing data pipelines, systems, and warehouses
* Knowledge of best design practices in cloud-based data warehouses
* Knowledge of software engineering practices, particularly in team-based development using Git
* Fluency in SQL and experience working with real world data
* Experience with Python
* Experience with Linux
* Experience with database administration, security, and management

**Skills and experience that make you a particularly good fit:**

* Experience with cloud-based columnar data warehouses and other cloud data technologies (Snowflake, RedShift, Databricks, Fabric, BigQuery)
* Experience working in environments with strict data security requirements
* Experience with dbt
* Experience with Apache Airflow
* Familiarity with AWS tooling and best practices
* Experience with education data, and the Ed-Fi data standard in particular
* Experience and interest in using AI code tools as part of development and automation workflows

**Hiring Process**

As a Data Engineer at NSA/CSS, you will transform and deliver high-priority datasets to enable exploitation and analysis for critical intelligence and cybersecurity missions. Design and Build Scalable Data Infrastructure - Design and architect systems that collect, transform, and manage data at scale using cloud, open source, and custom solutions - Create data models, schemas, databases, and optimized pipelines that process large, complex datasets - Implement ETL (extract, transform, load) processes and automated data validation methods Data Engineering and Analysis - Derive structured data from unstructured sources and combine multiple datasets to create a complete picture - Address conflicting, missing, or inconsistent data through cleaning and curation - Conduct exploratory data analysis using mathematical and statistical methods - Identify data features required to solve mission challenges Collaboration and Communication - Partner with collectors, data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts to design integrated solutions - Elicit customer needs and translate them into technical implementations - Document processes, analyses, and results for technical and non-technical audiences - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to team members
  
  
**Job Summary**
At the National Security Agency (NSA) and Central Security Service (CSS), Data Engineers play a vital role in tackling key national security issues. Applicants will design, build, and maintain systems that handle data to support our mission goals, from intelligence gathering to cybersecurity. In this role, applicants will create and improve data pipelines and databases, helping our teams quickly access and search through both structured and unstructured data transforming raw information into standardized, usable formats that power our operations and protect the nation. Drawing on skills in data design, computer science, and specific knowledge of our field, applicants will turn mission needs into practical technical solutions. This includes building data structures, connecting different data sources, and ensuring data moves smoothly between systems. Applicants will also communicate the capabilities and limitations of data systems to subject matter experts and key decision-makers. Using cutting-edge tools, applicants will have opportunities to solve real-world problems in collecting, organizing, storing, and processing data. We're looking for talent at all levels, from those just starting out to seasoned experts, ready to make a real difference in national security.

Degree must be in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Information Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, or Physical Sciences. Experience must also include formal or informal leadership.

title: Analytics Engineer, Finance
description:
**About The Company**
Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.
  
  
**Our Ethos**
We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Rain is building payments and stablecoin infrastructure. Every transaction generates data across our system.
  
  
We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer, Finance to own the data layer Finance runs on: model it, reconcile it against source systems, test it, automate it, and make it self-serve. You’ll partner with Finance and Accounting and the data team to make sure every number we report ties back to its source.
  
  
We’re looking for someone with high agency and urgency who owns problems end to end, digs into discrepancies until the numbers tie out, and communicates clearly when something is uncertain. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built.
  
  
At Rain, we’re builders who use AI to automate repetitive work. That changes what data roles look like: where a data scientist used to only analyze and an analyst used to only build dashboards, here everyone models data, writes production-quality code, and automates their own workflows. You own the result, including checking what the AI produces. For this role, that means building trusted models and automating the reconciliations and reporting Finance depends on.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build and own models for Finance: ledger, settlements, card transactions, invoicing, fees, and collateral, with clear grain and consistent definitions.
* Build and run reconciliations between internal systems and external sources (card networks, processors, banks, partners); investigate breaks and fix the root cause.
* Support month-end close and audit readiness with validated, documented outputs Finance can trust.
* Automate recurring Finance reporting and deliveries (scheduled reports, exports, and alerts) so close and partner reporting run without manual work.
* Add data quality tests and alerts so issues are caught before Finance sees them.
* Partner with Finance to define metrics such as revenue, costs, volume, and contribution profit, and make them reusable across teams.
* Build self-serve reporting so Finance can answer recurring questions independently.
* Work with data and platform engineers on ingestion and source changes, following Rain’s data standards and access policies.

**What You’ll Need**

* At least 3 years of experience in analytics engineering, software engineering, or analytics with a strong data modeling focus.
* Proficiency using AI tools to learn new skills, navigate unfamiliar domains, and accelerate your work, while taking responsibility for checking the output.
* Strong SQL in a modern data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift, including complex joins, window functions, and incremental logic.
* Hands-on dbt experience: data modeling, testing, documentation, version control, and code review.
* Experience reconciling data across systems and explaining differences down to the row.
* Familiarity with financial metrics and processes, such as revenue and costs, financial statements, reconciliation, or monthly close.
* Strong attention to detail: you validate results against source systems and explain assumptions, tradeoffs, and uncertainty.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-moving startup, communicating clearly with technical and nontechnical partners.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in payments, card issuing, fintech, or stablecoins, such as settlement files, ledgers, or interchange.
* Experience with BI as code, such as Lightdash, Looker, or Omni.
* Python or another scripting language for automation and data checks.
* Experience working directly with Finance or Accounting teams.
* Experience with orchestration and ingestion tools such as Dagster, Airflow, Meltano, Fivetran, or Datastream.

**Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:**
**Flexible time off**
🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.
  
  
**Flexible working**
☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.
  
  
**Easy to access benefits**
🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.
  
  
**Retirement goals**
💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.
  
  
**Equity plan**
📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.
  
  
**Health and Wellness**
📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!
  
  
**In-office meals**
🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.
  
  
**Team summits**
✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

title: Senior Client Platform Engineer, Endpoint Platform & Automation
description:
Role Description 

 As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will lead the migration to FleetDM and build the shared platform capabilities that support dependable endpoint operations. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical planning, partnering with Windows, macOS, and Linux engineers to introduce changes safely across a distributed environment.
You will develop automation, integrations, and configuration-as-code workflows, validate platform capabilities, and guide phased adoption. Beyond migration, you will improve platform reliability, visibility, and maintainability, helping the team reduce manual work and operate the service with shared ownership.
You will partner with Security, IAM, CorpInfra, and support teams to resolve dependencies and make practical trade-offs. This is an individual-contributor position with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities.

 Responsibilities 

- Lead the FleetDM migration. Define scope, requirements, architecture, dependencies, and a phased delivery plan with OS specialists and partner teams. 

- Engineer and operate the shared platform. Maintain configuration, agent workflows, policies, queries, integrations, and operational automation. 

- Make deployment safe and repeatable. Build version-controlled configuration with automated checks, peer review, controlled rollout, drift detection, and recovery. 

- Validate capabilities and coexistence. Identify gaps, clarify management authority, and establish which responsibilities should migrate or remain with existing tools. 

- Make platform health actionable. Establish trustworthy device populations, data freshness, enrollment and agent health, and owned remediation workflows. 

- Protect service continuity. Use representative pilots, acceptance gates, employee-impact checks, and clear pause and recovery decisions. 

- Strengthen team capability. Create reusable patterns, documentation, and shared support coverage through pairing, mentoring, and operational handoffs. 

- Improve efficiency and cost. Reduce recurring manual work and recommend tooling consolidation where evidence supports it. 

 Requirements 

- Significant hands-on experience engineering enterprise endpoint platforms, including deep expertise in at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux and experience working across OS boundaries. 

- Personal ownership of a multi-phase platform migration or comparable change, including discovery, pilots, rollout, recovery, and operational handover. 

- Strong practical programming or scripting skills, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or shell, with production automation and API integration experience.

title: Data Engineer / Data Analytics Specialist
description:
**About Company:**

**Position overview**
---------------------

JC Automation (JCA) is seeking a Data Engineer / Data Analytics Specialist to join its team supporting global pharmaceutical manufacturing clients. This position implements Rockwell PharmaSuite MES at new manufacturing sites and replaces the legacy MES platform at existing ones. The Data Analytics work-stream delivers the analytical layer that turns MES data into reports, dashboards, and data products for manufacturing, quality, and operations users across multiple global sites.

A Data Engineer on the PharmaSuite MES program designs, develops, and maintains the data solutions that make PharmaSuite data available, reliable, and consumable for analysis and business operations. This person works with site stakeholders, MES teams, and data architects to translate manufacturing requirements into validated SQL views, reports, and dashboards in a GxP-regulated environment.

* Design and develop analytical SQL views and data models on PharmaSuite MES data, following established corporate SQL and programming standards.
* Build and maintain Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and dashboards for manufacturing and quality reporting (e.g., yield, defects, IPC, order status).
* Gather, analyze, and document site requirements, and manage them through the change and validation lifecycle (ALM, ServiceNow Change Requests).
* Produce GxP/GMP-compliant documentation: requirements, risk and impact analyses, implementation guides, test evidence, and source code reviews.
* Support deployments and site replication across environments (DEV, TEST, PROD) with strict environment verification.
* Troubleshoot data discrepancies, resolve RITMs and incidents, and perform root cause analysis.
* Optimize query performance and ensure data quality, integrity, and security.
* Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams across time zones and cultures, in English.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience working in a regulated pharmaceutical or life sciences environment (GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11).
* Strong SQL proficiency (T-SQL / SQL Server) and relational data modeling.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modeling).
* 3+ years of experience in data analytics or reporting, ideally in pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device manufacturing.
* Knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11 and data integrity (ALCOA+) principles.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with MES platforms, ideally Rockwell PharmaSuite, or with batch records, EBR, and manufacturing execution data.
* Experience with computer system validation (CSV) and documentation under a formal validation plan.
* Python for data analysis and automation; familiarity with HTML/CSS/JS for lightweight web tools.
* Cloud experience (Azure preferred), including Azure SQL, Azure Web Apps, and Azure AD authentication.
* Familiarity with SQL Server high availability (Always On Availability Groups) and with Denodo or other data virtualization layers.
* Experience with Agile practices, GitHub, and workflow automation (Power Automate).

* Knowledge of Data Governance, Master Data Management, and Business Intelligence concepts.

* Attention to detail and a strong quality mindset in a regulated setting.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership: able to manage multiple deliverables, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Curiosity and willingness to challenge assumptions with data.
* Clear communicator with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-directed and organized; able to manage several site deliverables at once.
* Comfortable working remotely with teams across time zones.

description:

If we've described you and your dream workplace, please apply and share in the many benefits and opportunities we offer.***

**Data Engineer – Scientific Document and Data Pipelines**

Responsible for designing, developing, and implementing automated scientific data extraction and standardization solutions supporting the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) CHIPS METIS initiative. Develops advanced Python-based pipelines to extract figures, charts, and tables from scientific documents and transform non-standard research data into structured, machine-readable formats. Implements Optical Character Recognition (OCR), document layout analysis, data normalization, and schema validation capabilities. Integrates data processing tools and microservices into existing web applications and research data repositories. Works closely with government scientists and technical stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and interoperability. Develops technical documentation, maintains source code repositories, and supports the delivery of reliable, reusable software solutions.

**Responsibilities / Tasks**

* Design and implement automated OCR and document layout analysis pipelines to extract scientific figures, charts, and tables from PDF and Microsoft Word documents.
* Develop algorithms to identify and extract figure captions, axis labels, measurement units, and associated scientific metadata.
* Implement table extraction capabilities that preserve row and column structures, headers, and data relationships.
* Integrate extracted metadata with established controlled vocabularies and ontologies within the Controlled Vocabulary Curation System (CVCS).
* Develop and enhance user interfaces that enable scientific domain experts to validate extracted content and correct OCR errors.
* Develop Python-based parser libraries to convert proprietary instrument outputs, legacy spreadsheets, and non-standard text files into standardized CSV formats.
* Implement automated data normalization, schema validation, and quality assurance procedures to ensure compliance with METIS data schemas.
* Develop heuristic data-cleaning capabilities to address missing values, merged cells, inconsistent headers, and extraneous metadata.
* Integrate extraction and standardization tools as microservices or software modules within the existing CVCS web application architecture.
* Develop data export capabilities to support integration with the METIS Discovery Portal.
* Prepare design documentation, implementation guides, API specifications, and deployment procedures.
* Develop, test, and maintain documented source code within GitHub repositories, including code intended for public release.
* Prepare and deliver technical demonstrations of extraction workflows, data conversion capabilities, and system enhancements.
* Monitor and report technical performance metrics, including document processing volumes, OCR accuracy, data conversion success rates, and system integration status.
* Collaborate with government scientists, developers, and technical stakeholders to identify requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and improve system functionality.

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree (four-year) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
* Four (4) years of advanced Python programming experience, specifically with Pandas and OCR libraries.
* Four (4) years of experience with OCR pipelines and table extraction logic.
* Four (4) years of experience with data format normalization and schema validation.
* Four (4) years of experience integrating microservices into web applications.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated data processing and transformation pipelines.
* Knowledge of OCR and document processing technologies such as Tesseract, PaddleOCR, pdfplumber, Camelot, LayoutParser, or comparable tools.
* Familiarity with JSON Schema, XML/XSD, controlled vocabularies, and ontology-based metadata tagging.
* Experience with REST APIs, GitHub, and software development and deployment practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills.
* Must be able to successfully complete a federal background investigation appropriate for an IT-Low Risk position and meet applicable HSPD-12/PIV credentialing requirements.
* Must be able to work on-site at the NIST campus in Gaithersburg, Maryland.
* This position is contingent upon contract award.

description:
**About the Role**

Vamonos IT is seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain enterprise applications and infrastructure within Microsoft Windows Server and Azure environments.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Windows Server administration, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, PowerShell, and SQL Server, with experience supporting application deployments, infrastructure maintenance, and operational security. This position requires a hands-on technical professional who can collaborate with developers, infrastructure engineers, and project teams to maintain reliable application environments and support modern deployment technologies.

The successful candidate must demonstrate strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, a solid understanding of infrastructure operations and automation, and the ability to support secure, compliant, and reliable enterprise systems with minimal day-to-day supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, administer, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise applications hosted within Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Support application deployments, configuration changes, software updates, and ongoing operational maintenance.
* Administer and maintain Windows Server operating systems, including system configuration, patching, troubleshooting, and performance monitoring.
* Support Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments, including identity management, authentication, and access control.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations and authentication services.
* Develop, maintain, and execute PowerShell scripts to automate system administration, application deployment, monitoring, and maintenance activities.
* Support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including application connectivity, database configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Assist with the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of applications and infrastructure hosted in Microsoft Azure.
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance, identify operational issues, and implement corrective actions.
* Perform application and operating system patching, updates, and vulnerability remediation in accordance with established security requirements.
* Assist with deploying, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to support application integration, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Support deployment automation and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes.
* Implement and maintain system configurations consistent with organizational security policies and applicable compliance requirements.
* Troubleshoot application failures, authentication issues, system performance problems, and infrastructure connectivity issues.
* Participate in technical planning, deployment coordination, and operational troubleshooting activities.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, deployment procedures, maintenance activities, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Evaluate existing infrastructure and application deployment processes and recommend improvements to reliability, security, automation, and operational efficiency.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience supporting enterprise applications, Windows Server environments, infrastructure operations, or DevOps engineering activities.
* Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting applications in Microsoft Windows environments.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Experience administering or supporting Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting identity management, authentication, and Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions.
* Proficiency with PowerShell scripting for system administration, automation, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, including application integration, connectivity, and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting application or infrastructure deployments within Microsoft Azure environments.
* Experience performing operating system and application patching, updates, and routine maintenance.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Understanding of application deployment processes, infrastructure monitoring, and operational support.
* Knowledge of enterprise security practices, access controls, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues involving applications, Windows infrastructure, identity services, and system integrations.
* Experience collaborating with developers, infrastructure engineers, and technical project teams.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical issues and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple technical priorities, and support reliable application and infrastructure operations.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft certification related to Azure, Windows Server, or associated Microsoft infrastructure technologies.
* Experience supporting enterprise Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated application deployment and infrastructure management solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes container orchestration and management.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Git, or other CI/CD and source control technologies.
* Experience supporting enterprise identity and access management solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID and SSO integrations.
* Experience implementing infrastructure automation using PowerShell or infrastructure as code methodologies.
* Familiarity with enterprise monitoring, logging, and application performance management tools.
* Experience supporting security compliance, system hardening, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Experience supporting federal government customers or large enterprise IT environments.

  

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and certification.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Exposure to cutting-edge Microsoft technologies.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Overview:

CPI Card Group is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a DevSecOps focus and hands-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS Security Services, infrastructure automation, to join the Infrastructure Cloud Engineering team. This role implements, automates, and operates secure, resilient infrastructure capabilities across a hybrid environment that includes on-premises environments, AWS Infrastructure as a Service, and relevant SaaS integrations.

The position strengthens the Cloud Engineering organization with a focus on AWS Cloud Security, and associated security services, infrastructure delivery pipelines, threat-detection integration, vulnerability and configuration remediation, data-protection controls, incident response, and compliance-control implementation. The engineer contributes to reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, guardrails, and automated controls that integrate security throughout the platform
  
engineering and CloudOps lifecycle.

Working closely with Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and other technology teams, this role translates security and compliance requirements into implementable infrastructure capabilities. This role is accountable for incorporating AWS Cloud Security controls within the scope of Infrastructure Cloud Engineering and associated infrastructure cloud platforms. Enterprise cybersecurity architecture, security policy, and cyber-risk governance remain with Cybersecurity.

Responsibilities:

* **AWS infrastructure security:** Engineer and operate security capabilities supporting multi-account AWS environments, including logging, configuration compliance, threat detection, vulnerability visibility, network protection, encryption, and data protection. This work leverages AWS-native services such as AWS CloudTrail, AWS Config, Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, AWS Shield Advanced, and AWS KMS.
* **Infrastructure as Code and automated controls:** Develop and maintain Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, scripts, modules, policies, and automated workflows that provision secure infrastructures and platforms while continuously validating required security controls.
* **Secure delivery pipelines:** Implement and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines, including security testing, policy checks, approval controls, separation-of-duties requirements, artifact integrity, and controlled promotion across environments.
* **Secure infrastructure patterns and standards:** Implement and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure patterns across AWS and hybrid integrations using approved architectures, standards, and guardrails.
* **Threat, vulnerability, and risk reduction:** Automate the identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities, insecure configurations, and control gaps. Provide technical evidence and remediation support for risk-management
    
  activities.
* **Hybrid infrastructure protection:** Integrate security controls across on-premises environments, AWS infrastructure, and relevant SaaS services. Support network
    
  segmentation, security groups, firewall integration, DDoS-resilient designs, secure connectivity, and infrastructure protection patterns.
* Security monitoring and response: Improve infrastructure telemetry, alerting, and operational response through AWS and enterprise monitoring platforms. Participate in security and infrastructure incidents, root-cause analysis, containment, recovery, and
    
  corrective-action automation.
* **Compliance implementation and evidence:** Partner with Cybersecurity to translate PCI DSS and other applicable control requirements into technical controls, validation methods, documentation, and repeatable audit evidence. CloudOps and platform operations: Monitor infrastructure health, security posture, reliability, and control effectiveness. Participate in lifecycle management, change management, problem management, operational readiness, and the team's 7x24 on-call
    
  rotation.
* **Collaboration and documentation:** Contribute to design reviews, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing. Communicate options, risks, tradeoffs, and
    
  recommendations to technical, non-technical, and leadership audiences.
* **Continuous improvement:** Evaluate relevant AWS services and industry practices, pilot improvements within approved guardrails, and reduce manual work through safe, measurable automation.

  
Qualifications:

* **Builds for operations:** Designs infrastructure with day-two operations in mind. Monitoring, alerting, patching, backup, and recovery are part of "done," not added later.
* **Builds security in:** Treats security controls as engineering requirements that are coded, tested, and validated in the pipeline, not as reviews applied after deployment.
* Automates first: Prefers code over console changes. Spots repeated manual work and turns it into automation that is versioned, reviewed, and repeatable.
* **Troubleshoots across layers:** Diagnoses issues that span AWS, networking, identity, on-premises systems, and SaaS integrations. Uses logs, metrics, and security findings to find the root cause, not just the symptom.
* **Works with operational discipline:** Follows change management and approved standards. Leaves systems and runbooks in a state another engineer can support during an on-call event.
* **Respects ownership boundaries:** Understands what Cloud Engineering owns and what belongs to Cybersecurity and Technology Governance, Risk and Compliance, and knows how to engage those teams effectively.
* **Exercises risk-aware judgment:** Recognizes when a design, request, or shortcut creates unacceptable risk. Raises it with evidence and a recommended option, explained in plain terms for engineers, auditors, and leaders.
* **Keeps learning:** Keeps AWS, security, and automation skills current and applies what they learn to improve team patterns and practices.

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or comparable professional experience.
* Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud security engineering, or comparable technical roles.
* Hands-on experience deploying, securing, and operating AWS infrastructure in production or regulated hybrid environments.
* Experience implementing or improving security controls within production cloud or hybrid infrastructure.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, with experience developing reusable modules, automated testing, policy validation, and controlled deployment practices.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms and source control, such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS-native delivery services.
* Strong scripting or software automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or a comparable language.
* Experience with multi-account AWS environments, identity and access controls, logging and monitoring, configuration compliance, vulnerability management, encryption, data protection, and network security.
* Experience participating in infrastructure or security incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action implementation.
* Working knowledge of regulated-industry security and compliance practices. Experience with PCI DSS is preferred.

**Preferred Certification and Qualification Paths:**

Candidates may demonstrate readiness through one or more of the following paths. AWS certifications are preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered:
  
**Preferred path:** An equivalent combination of AWS architecture, operations, security, automation, and production engineering experience aligned to the following certifications:
  
AWS Certified Security – Specialty
  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Data Platform
description:
**Location:** Remote (US) · **Type:** Full-time · **Reports to:** Head of Engineering · **Comp:** $150k-165k

### **About Harness**

Harness Giving (goharness.com) is a fundraising platform for nonprofits. Thousands of organizations have used us as a donor CRM and to take donations, sell event tickets, manage donors and run email and SMS campaigns. Hundreds of millions of dollars have flowed through the Harness platform.

We're continuing to build out our CRM, but also building out Harness Intelligence. It's a set of AI agents and deterministic rules that analyze a nonprofit's fundraising data, identify opportunities to raise more money, recommend actions, and then execute those actions with the fundraising team's approval.

### **What you'll do**

* Build and run NestJS services and APIs: the CRM, communications and the endpoints the product and agents call. PostgreSQL schemas, gRPC contracts, SQS/SNS messaging.
* Build on the Snowflake data layer with our data engineer: Airbyte ingestion from Postgres, MySQL and Stripe, curated views, data quality, freshness and cost.
* Build a normalization layer that ingests data from third-party systems through their APIs and custom-built connectors, runs the ETL, and maps different source schemas into one clean data layer.
* Shape where the data platform goes next. We run Snowflake today and may move toward a data lake or lakehouse. You'll help make that call and lead the work if we do.
* Make production boring. Remove single points of failure. Add monitoring and alerting on services, syncs and data freshness. Share on-call.
* Own multi-tenant data security: per-organization isolation, least-privilege service roles, secrets management and PII handling.
* Build and harden the APIs and data our AI agents depend on, including the gateway that handles auth, tenant scoping, permissions, approvals and audit.
* Build the tools agents call: reliable queries over structured data, structured outputs, and evals that check answers against real numbers. Work across model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini).

### **What we're looking for**

* You drive a collaborative culture. You pair with teammates, review generously, document what you build and share ownership instead of holding it close. You make the people around you better.
* 8+ years in backend engineering, including real time running data systems in production.
* Strong TypeScript / Node.js. NestJS preferred. Python for data work.
* PostgreSQL and MySQL in depth: schema design, query tuning, replication and change data capture.
* Expert SQL. You can tell when a query is right by checking it, not by trusting it.
* Production experience with a cloud data warehouse, including access controls, query performance, data modeling and cost management.
* Data lakes and lakehouses: object storage (S3), Parquet, Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake, catalogs and query engines. You know the trade-offs against a managed warehouse. Hands-on BigQuery or Databricks is a plus.
* ELT tooling (Airbyte, Fivetran, dbt or similar). You've debugged a broken sync under pressure.
* AWS (ECS, RDS, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager) and Terraform.
* Multi-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, PII and audit trails.
* You've built and shipped AI systems in production: LLM features with tool calling, retrieval or text-to-SQL over structured data, structured outputs and evals. You don't need to be an AI specialist, but you know how these systems fail and how to test them.

### **How you'll use AI to build**

We expect AI in your daily workflow. Not as a novelty. It's how the work gets done here.

* You use agentic coding tools daily (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) and can show us your setup.
* You use AI to accelerate development, but you remain accountable for the architecture, implementation, quality and security of everything you ship.
* You use AI to write and explain SQL, profile unfamiliar datasets, map external CRM fields onto our schema, generate test fixtures and draft evals.
* **You validate before you build.** Every query, AI-written or not, gets run and checked against real numbers before it ships.
* You know where these tools fail on data work: invented column names, wrong grain, silent double counting, joins that look right and aren't.

In the interview we'll hand you a real dataset and a question. You'll answer it with your own tools while we watch.

### **Nice to have**

* Nonprofit CRM data experience.
* Snowflake experience: roles and grants, secure views, row access policies, warehouse sizing and cost, streams and tasks.
* The Stripe data model: charges, payment intents, subscriptions, refunds, payouts.
* Deeper AI work: agents with tool calling, evals, guardrails, MCP.
* Semantic layers: Snowflake semantic views, dbt metrics or Cube.
* Analyst tooling: Metabase, Jupyter.

### **What success looks like**

* **30 days:** You know the services and the warehouse cold: every source, every view, every role and grant. You've shipped a fix to production.
* **60 days:** You own pipeline monitoring and alerting. The first external CRM import is running in production.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
SiloSmashers is hiring for a Senior Data Engineer to support a government customer. This position will be responsible for architecting, developing, optimizing, and maintaining high‑performance data ingestion, transformation, streaming, and analytical pipelines within Databricks‑enabled Lakehouse environments.

The selected candidate will serve as a senior technical expert for Databricks Lakehouse engineering, advanced Delta Lake optimization, governed data design (Unity Catalog), medallion‑architecture enforcement, structured streaming, and platform‑integrated cloud data engineering across enterprise platforms. This role is expected to collaborate closely with the Project Manager / Contractor Lead, federal technical teams, and cross‑task platform, SRE, governance, privacy, and development personnel.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the principal technical authority for Databricks data engineering, pipeline optimization, streaming, and Lakehouse standards across programs.
* Lead design reviews, technical roadmaps, and architectural decisions in partnership with federal SMEs and platform/security teams.
* Build and optimize batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines, Delta Lake, Auto Loader, and Workflows with robust error handling, retries, alerting, and monitoring.
* Lead and enforce medallion‑architecture ingestion and refinement patterns, data lifecycle management, and governed data storage tiering.
* Implement advanced performance tuning and cost‑efficiency strategies, including cluster/sizing optimization, serverless compute adoption, workload health monitoring, and resource governance.
* Provide root cause analysis, disruption/outage reporting, and production support for Databricks jobs, pipelines, applications, and platform features.
* Coordinate with Privacy & Governance teams to enforce Unity Catalog RBAC/ABAC, row/column‑level security, governed tags, lineage, and compliance controls.
* Mentor mid‑level/junior engineers, perform code reviews, and uphold high engineering quality through testing strategies, quality gates, reproducible builds, and DevSecOps best practices.

**Required Skills**

* Demonstrated expertise designing and implementing Databricks Lakehouse solutions, including:
  + Delta Lake table design, schema evolution, expectations, and medallion‑architecture (bronze/silver/gold).
  + Databricks Workflows, Jobs, Auto Loader, COPY INTO, Structured Streaming, Databricks SQL Warehouses, and Unity Catalog governance models.
  + Performance and cost optimization (Photon, file sizing, Z‑ORDER, clustering/partitioning, caching, AQE, shuffle/skew mitigation).
* Hands‑on experience building distributed data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and cloud‑native services across AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.
* Demonstrated experience administering and optimizing relational and NoSQL data systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, Aurora, DynamoDB) and designing efficient, secure schemas.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Git‑based workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), Databricks Repos, Asset/Bundles, Terraform/IaC, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience supporting federal environments and compliance‑aligned development.
* Experience applying agile development methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, and iterative delivery.
* Experience in AI/ML DevSecOps or agentic‑AI engineering, including Databricks Model Serving, Genie, Agent Bricks, or integration with AWS Kiro or other government‑approved platforms.

**Mandatory** **Qualifications & Requirements**

* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
* Eight (8) or more years of experience (7 of which must be within the last 10 years) in data engineering, ETL/ELT pipeline development, or distributed data processing within enterprise cloud environments.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or related field; or twelve (12) total years of equivalent experience in lieu of a degree.
* Databricks Data Engineer Professional Certification
* At least one cloud-focused certification (e.g. AWS Developer Associate, Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, or equivalent).
* Preferred but not required: Databricks Lakehouse Architect, Generative AI Associate/Professional, or related ML/AI certifications.
* This position may require regular, physical attendance at customer sites.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

Are you interested in leading the transformation of cancer care through putting world-leading scientific data and knowledge in the hands of doctors and other members of the medical team? Do you have a passion for solutions that empower patients to take charge of their care and bring world-class solutions to winning the cancer battle? If so, join our growing team at VieCure, the company that promises to revolutionize the way cancer care is delivered.

At VieCure, we are redefining the delivery of precision oncology through advanced clinical intelligence and innovative software platforms. Our cloud-based system leverages AI and real-time clinical data to support oncologists in delivering personalized, evidence-based care. As we continue to scale, our engineering team plays a critical role in building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers our platform.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer, Product and Technology. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence of VieCure’s multi-tenant healthcare SaaS platform. This position combines cloud infrastructure engineering, CI/CD automation, infrastructure-as-code management, platform operations, security, compliance, and release management to support the continuous delivery of software solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* CI/CD Pipeline Management: Own CI/CD in Azure DevOps, consolidating duplicated pipelines into reusable, configuration-driven YAML templates with change detection. Implement build-once, promote-many deployment strategies, approval gates, rollback mechanisms, immutable tagging standards, and concurrency controls.
* Infrastructure as Code: Design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure using Terraform including module development, remote state management, pull request reviews, drift detection, and CI-driven deployment processes.
* Container Platform Management: Administer Azure Container Registry and support Azure Container Apps, AKS, and App Service deployment platforms.
* Multi-Tenant Platform Provisioning: Develop and maintain automated tenant onboarding, provisioning, configuration, feature flag, database, and resource management processes.
* Identity, Security, and Compliance: Implement secure cloud architectures utilizing Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity, Key Vault, VNets, private endpoints, and least-privilege principles while supporting HIPAA and SOC 2 requirements.
* Monitoring and Observability: Build monitoring, logging, telemetry, dashboards, service-level objectives, and alerting solutions using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.
* Reliability and Disaster Recovery: Define RTOs and RPOs and develop backup, restore, business continuity, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Release and Change Management: Own release governance, change control, deployment validation, and production readiness activities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Development, QA, Security, Operations, and Client Services teams.
* Code Review and Engineering Standards: Promote infrastructure, automation, security, and DevOps best practices.
* Documentation and Operational Readiness: Maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, disaster recovery documentation, and engineering standards.

**Requirements**

* Minimum of six years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Minimum of three years supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure.
* Deep experience with Azure DevOps Pipelines including YAML templates, environments, and deployment automation.
* Strong experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
* Experience supporting Azure Container Registry, Azure Container Apps, AKS, and App Service.
* Experience managing Azure SQL, geo-replication, storage services, and database deployment methodologies.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity, Azure Key Vault, VNets, and private endpoints.
* Experience designing monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and observability frameworks.
* Experience supporting HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, or similar regulated environments.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms preferred.
* Familiarity with .NET and Angular deployment pipelines preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Expert knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services and architecture.
* Advanced proficiency with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipeline architecture.
* Strong Terraform expertise including modules, governance, and state management.
* Experience with Azure Container Registry, AKS, Azure Container Apps, and App Service.
* Strong understanding of Azure SQL, Elastic Pools, Geo-Replication, and Azure Storage.
* Experience with Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and telemetry platforms.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, identity management, encryption, and network isolation.
* Knowledge of disaster recovery, business continuity, and resilience engineering.
* Understanding of HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, audit controls, and PHI handling requirements.

Education / Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-305, or AZ-400 are advantageous.
* Additional cloud, automation, or security certifications are a plus.

* Mission-driven work in the healthcare space with real impact on patient outcomes
* Collaborative, forward-thinking engineering culture
* Competitive salary and benefits

title: Analytics Engineer, Finance
description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.
  
  
We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.
  
  
As an Analytics Engineer on the Finance Team you will build and maintain data models, transformation pipelines, and reporting which will be leveraged by the Finance team. You will have ownership around the accuracy and consistency of data and dictionaries for reporting and analytics within the Finance domain.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Enable the Finance team by providing documented, auditable, trusted tables that analysts and AI-assisted workflows can use without engineering support
* Design and build the Finance warehouse on Google Cloud (BigQuery), including environments, access controls, cost management, and documentation
* Own PHI identification and removal by inventorying source columns, classifying them, and building the scrubbing layer (e.g., field-level removal, tokenization, and free-text redaction)
* Define data specifications and partner cross-functionally with Analytics to ingest and incorporate necessary data feeds
* Define and operate controls in partnership with Legal and Security to set the de-identification standard and automate checks for PHI leakage
* Build finance data models in dbt, including recognized revenue, billings, cash collections, CARR bridge, and credit consumption
* Reconcile and validate warehouse outputs against Salesforce, Stripe, and the general ledger
* Transition existing finance workstreams and models from shared warehouse datasets to the new Finance-owned environment

**What We Look For**

* 5+ years of data engineering, including at least one data warehouse built from scratch, ideally in finance at a pre-IPO company
* Experience supporting finance, accounting, or revenue operations teams
* Strong SQL, hands-on data modeling, and dbt experience, with familiarity with medallion architecture
* Hands-on experience with BigQuery or comparable cloud data warehouse, including IAM, security controls, and policy tags
* Experience de-identifying or restricting access to sensitive data (PHI, PII, financial data) and working knowledge of HIPAA de-identification methods
* Experience building tested, documented dbt models that enable analyst self-sufficiency
* Comfort partnering with Legal, Security, and Finance stakeholders to explain technical tradeoffs
* Ability to work independently with no existing playbook; innate curiosity and root-cause analysis skills
* Proficiency with software engineering best practices, including Git version control

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of AI-generated output
* Experience building, shipping, evaluating, and monitoring LLM or agent systems in production
* Google Cloud Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) or similar redaction tooling
* Familiarity with Salesforce data models, Stripe billing data, or an ERP such as NetSuite
* Experience with Metabase or similar BI tools
* Python experience
* Background in legal tech, healthcare, or another regulated industry

**SUCCESS METRICS**

* First 90 days: Complete the source and PHI inventory, agree the de-identification standard with Legal and Security, and finalize the warehouse architecture and project plan
* First 6 months: Core finance sources landing in the warehouse with automated PHI checks passing, and a first set of validated finance model
* First 12 months: Finance reporting runs from the Finance-owned warehouse, recognized revenue and cash models reconcile to the ledger, and the Finance team queries the data without engineering support

**Benefits & Perks:**
As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:
  
  

* Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
* Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.

* A home office stipend.
* 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.

* A local in-person meet-up program.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
**About The Brandit Agency**

The Brandit Agency is a promotional products distributor, technology platform, and fulfillment company based in Vero Beach, Florida. We help brands get their logo into people’s hands: we run branded merchandise programs, custom online ordering portals, and in-house fulfillment for companies across the country. Data drives everything we do, from client reporting and order operations to how we grow the business.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Junior Data Engineer who loves working with data and wants to grow their career in data engineering. You’ll work primarily for The Brandit Agency, inside the Marketfuel platform, the technology that powers our ordering portals and client programs.

You’ll spend your days writing SQL, building reports and dashboards in Metabase, and helping keep our data accurate and reliable. You’ll be based in our Vero Beach office and work closely with our sales, operations, fulfillment, and finance teams. You’ll also work alongside the Marketfuel platform team on data that touches the platform itself.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands-on experience across the whole data stack. You’ll pick up new skills quickly and take on more ownership as you grow.

**What You’ll Do**

* Write and maintain SQL queries, views, and reports that answer business questions
* Build and maintain dashboards, questions, and models in Metabase for internal teams and clients
* Help build and maintain data pipelines that bring data from the Marketfuel platform, our business systems, and third-party tools into our reporting environment
* Create client-facing reports for our portal and program clients: order activity, spend, inventory, and fulfillment
* Work with our sales, operations, fulfillment, and finance teams to understand what they need and turn it into clear, reliable reports
* Check data for accuracy, track down discrepancies, and help fix the source of the problem
* Document data sources, table definitions, and report logic so others can understand and trust the data
* Learn our data stack and take on more responsibility over time, including Metabase administration and pipeline ownership

By joining our team, you’ll be part of our life-changing mission and vision. You’ll contribute to an innovative, multifaceted culture that is second to none — one that embraces collaboration, excellence, discovery and compassion. You’ll play a role in something that’s never been done before as we integrate science and clinical care to help patients achieve better, faster outcomes — as we Advance Human Ability, together.

**Job Description Summary**

General Summary  
The Data Engineer is a member of the Data Platform Engineering team, working in a dynamic cross-functional environment to assist in developing the strategic direction and the meaningful use of data within the organization for our next generation data platform to provide a full and self-service environment for clinicians, researchers, administrators and executives. Assists with development or selection of data models to be implemented in support of clinical, quality improvement, and research objectives. Creates ETL pipelines for data to and from various cloud and local sources consistent with existing data models. Adapts database systems and architecture as necessary to meet the operational, analytical, and reporting needs of the organization.  
  
The Data Engineer will consistently demonstrate support of the Shirley Ryan AbilityLab statement of Vision, Mission and Core Values by striving for excellence, contributing to the team efforts and showing respect and compassion for patients and their families, fellow employees, and all others with whom there is contact at or in the interest of the institute.  
  
The Data Engineer will demonstrate Shirley Ryan AbilityLab Core Attributes: Communication, Accountability, Flexibility/Adaptability, Judgment/Problem Solving, Customer Service and Core Values (Hope, Compassion, Discovery, Collaboration, & Commitment to Excellence) while fulfilling job duties.

**Job Description**

**The Data Engineer will:**

* Collaborate within the Data Platform Engineering team, Data Analytics and Data Governance teams, other Information Services (IS) teams, executive leadership, external consultants, and stakeholders from various departments within the hospital to:
* Primarily utilizing existing resources, assist in developing secure, stable, scalable long-term plans for the flow of the hospital’s data.
* Assist in the development of scalable data infrastructure and platforms to collect and process large amounts of data, including structured and unstructured data for analysis by clinical, research, and business resources. Data sources may be internally (locally) or externally (cloud) sourced, both data owned by the organization and external to the organization from partners and vendors.
* Establish methods and procedures for tracking data quality, completeness, redundancy, compliance and improvement along with related system operational performance.
* Create strategies and plans for data capacity planning, data security, life cycle data management, scalability, backup and archiving.
* Create the mapping of data sources, data movement, interfaces, and analytics, with the goal of ensuring data quality and accurate downstream delivery and reporting.
* Define standards for engineering and architecture including naming, describing, managing, modeling, cleaning, enriching, transforming, transferring, storing, searching, and delivering data securely within the hospital.

* Acquire and maintain data from primary or secondary data sources.

* Monitor, update, and ensure consistent uptime, availability and access of the data platform and other data systems for performance and reliability.
* Develop processes to support the deployment of high quality, flexible, and secure data management solutions
* Leverage available tools to drive Automation of key data management processes
* Create instrumentation and metrics to ensure ecosystem health & ensure continuous improvement of KPI’s

**Reporting Relationships**

* Reports directly to the Director Data Platform Architecture

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or computer engineering, or in a related area (data science, mathematics, statistics, economics, etc.) with demonstrated proficiency in the skills below.
* Expertise in SQL (5 years professional) with experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL and their derivatives in building complex queries, tuning, and optimization
* Expertise in Python and/or Java (5 years professional) with a focus on data manipulation, database interaction, ETL automation, big data technologies, and performance optimization
* Knowledge and understanding of HIPAA and ability to implement data security standards in line with those requirements including inter-operability with HL7 and FHIR.
* At least 2-5 years of professional experience establishing ETL/ELT processes for securely transporting data between cloud and local databases. Experience doing so between Snowflake, AWS RDS (Aurora), OCI, Microsoft Power Apps, and using Informatica is a plus.
* Experience with other AWS data utilities (API gateway, S3, etc.) is a plus.
* Demonstrated experience in handling large data sets and relational databases, data warehousing, scalability, reliability, access and provisioning.
* Experience evaluating and leveraging AI utilities in data warehouse and data governance tools for model and pipeline development while ensuring quality data for the analytics layer and self-services.
* Strong communication skills, particularly those relevant to translating highly technical information for non-technical audiences in terms of documentation and diagrams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and see through long-term projects.
* Proactive work habits such as proposing and developing new projects and initiatives or advocating and promoting incremental adoption of new technologies.
* Candidates familiar with Oracle-Cerner EHR systems, particularly the Millennium data model and CCL, will receive strong consideration.
* Candidates familiar with research CDMs like OMOP, i2b2, and PCORnet will be strongly considered.
