Recurring review findings have become deterministic checks, and at least one detection harness combines deterministic rules with agentic analysis in production. Product teams and Security rely on you as an escalation point.
* Within 1 year: You are accelerating the definition and understanding of the standards we hold our application environments, developer environments, and tools to. You demonstrate that direction continuously and clearly to the infrastructure team, to engineering teams, and to leadership, so everyone understands the current standard, what changes next, and why.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute cloud strategies for AWS and Azure. Co-own the architecture of our cloud organization, including account structure, guardrails, and network topology, and review designs with product teams early to provide reusable patterns.
* Own our container and serverless platforms, and optimize resource utilization and cost management in cloud environments, with cost attribution by team and product across cloud and AI spend.
* Automate infrastructure management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Pulumi in TypeScript), keep reviewed code as the only path to production, and detect and correct drift.
* Own our GitHub organization and source control practices, including repository lifecycle, access, and privilege best practices.
* Own the CI/CD pipelines every team ships through, including runners, deployment identities, software supply-chain controls, and release controls such as progressive rollout, health-gated promotion, and automated rollback.
* Own infrastructure change control as pipeline policy, with approvals, separation of duties, risk assessment, and emergency-change handling enforced in CI and the harness, and every change traceable.
* Co-own identity and access patterns across our cloud organization, with least-privilege access defined in code.
* Standardize processes and procedures across platforms. Define, document, and continuously raise the standards for application environments, developer environments, and tooling, including which AI tools, models, and platforms we adopt and retire.
* Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation for incident response, lead infrastructure response during security and availability incidents, and run postmortems that eliminate root causes.
* Analyze network traffic and manage firewall settings and route tables, including WAF rules, security groups, cardholder data environment (CDE) segmentation, and zero-trust network access.
* Deeply understand and ensure adherence to cloud security best practices and provide Security and Compliance with automated evidence that PCI DSS and SOC 2 controls are operating.
* Define and maintain the engineering harness our team works through, codifying our standards into the work our agents do so agent output meets the same expectations we hold human engineers to. Encode standards as rules, skills, permission tiers, and deterministic checks, manage prompts, skills, tools, and evaluation criteria as production code with review and tests, and turn recurring review findings into new checks.
* Build and operate detection harnesses for CI, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors that combine deterministic controls, such as WAF rules and policy as code, with agentic analysis and feed automated blocking and SIEM correlation.
* Apply DevOps standards to production AI workloads in the cloud, including model and agent hosting, agent identity and secrets, network isolation, observability, cost controls, release gates, and rollback.
* Build self-service tooling for engineers and agents, including infrastructure capabilities exposed to agents as scoped, audited tools such as MCP servers.
* Communicate infrastructure direction, changes, and progress to the infrastructure team, engineering teams, and leadership. Plan changes with the teams they affect, publish standards and changes where engineers can find them, and report progress against agreed metrics in the Weekly Business Review.
* Mentor DevOps engineers through code review, pairing, and documentation.

**Preferred Skills**

* Track record of taking infrastructure projects from design through rollout, verification, documentation, and decommissioning of the systems they replace.
* Track record of creating engineering standards or paved-path tooling that other teams adopted because it made their work easier.
* Composure and sound judgment during incidents.
* Commitment to secure-by-design principles, with experience in high compliance environments like banks, payments, or healthcare, including producing evidence for PCI DSS or SOC 2 assessors.
* Extensive daily experience with coding agents and agent harnesses, including building harnesses that codify engineering standards so agent work meets the same expectations as human engineers' work, and sound judgment about where a standard needs a deterministic check or a human decision.
* Experience deploying AI workloads in production with the identity, isolation, observability, release, and cost controls expected of any production service.
* Ability to form and communicate a clear point of view on where infrastructure needs to go, its largest risks, and the order of work to get there.
* Strong written communication, including design documents and RFCs that define the problem and its value first and explain dependencies and effects on other teams.
* Ability to lead without direct authority across engineering teams and to raise team-level issues early.
* (5+ years) Expertise in AWS, including multi-account organizations (Organizations or Control Tower, SCPs, IAM Identity Center) and VPC networking. Experience owning an entire AWS footprint, including account creation and organization-level guardrails.
* (3+ years) Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Pulumi or Terraform as the primary way infrastructure is built and changed, including importing hand-built resources and detecting drift. Pulumi with TypeScript is preferred.
* Experience with CI/CD in GitHub Actions, including OIDC federation to AWS, protected environments, reusable workflows, self-hosted runners, supply-chain controls such as SHA pinning, and progressive delivery with automated rollback. Proficiency in packaging and deploying solutions in a containerized environment.
* Strong coding skills in TypeScript and Python, with tested, reviewed code for infrastructure, tooling, and agents.
* (2+ years) Hands-on experience building with coding agents and LLM tooling, such as Claude Code or Codex, MCP servers, agent skills, and agent permission models, including encoding team standards into agent rules and skills and integrating agent workflows into CI and code review.
* Experience deploying and operating AI workloads in the cloud, such as Amazon Bedrock or model APIs behind a gateway and agents on ECS or Lambda, with scoped identities, secrets management, network isolation, logging, and cost controls.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud-based application monitoring, creating relevant metrics, dashboards, and alarms, including SLOs and error budge

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Fortress Affinity Management (FAM)**
is Higginbotham's standalone affinity insurance platform, purpose-built to turn group relationships into scalable, recurring insurance programs. FAM provides the complete infrastructure needed to support these programs, including digital intake systems, member portals, and dedicated service teams, all aimed at reducing friction and improving results for both producers and their clients. Because those member-facing systems run continuously for live client groups, the platform depends on reliable cloud infrastructure and disciplined release practices — which is where this role sits.
  
  
**Position Summary:**
The Sr. DevOps Engineer is the dedicated, full-time owner of uptime and infrastructure for the company's web services, Blazor applications, and supporting tools across Azure, AWS, and Cloudflare. Day to day, this role owns CI/CD pipelines, environment provisioning, the team's shared development environment, and incident response for live client environments. As the application portfolio grows, this role keeps infrastructure, pipelines, and reliability practices scaling alongside it.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities:**
None
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Infrastructure & Cloud Operations**

* Own and operate Azure infrastructure supporting the company's web services and Blazor applications, including App Service, Key Vault, Managed Identity, and Entra ID, and maintain backup, failover, and resiliency across those environments
* Administer AWS resources supporting the company's AI/automation tooling (e.g., Bedrock) and related services
* Manage Cloudflare configuration for CDN, WAF, and bot protection across public-facing applications
* Maintain and support the team's shared Linux development environment used for AI-assisted development tooling

**CI/CD & Release Engineering**

* Own and extend Azure DevOps Pipelines across the company's web services, Blazor applications, and supporting tools
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or Terraform) for repeatable, auditable environment provisioning
* Support database migration deployment and environment promotion practices across dev, test, and production
* Partner with developers to keep build, test, and deployment pipelines fast and reliable as the project portfolio grows

**Reliability & Incident Response**

* Serve as the primary on-call owner for platform uptime across live client environments, including after-hours response to production incidents — not only deployment windows
* Monitor logging and telemetry sources to catch and respond to issues proactively
* Lead incident response and post-incident review for platform outages or degraded service
* Maintain and continuously improve infrastructure documentation and runbooks
* Manage secrets, certificates, and identity-based access across environments — including Key Vault, Managed Identity, and AWS IAM — and keep infrastructure patched and configurations hardened

**Core Competencies**

* Ability to Analyze and Solve Problems: Skill in diagnosing production issues under time pressure, evaluating options with incomplete information, and implementing effective solutions quickly during and after active incidents
* Attention to Detail: A strong focus on completing tasks and projects accurately and thoroughly
* Communication Skills: Capable of expressing ideas clearly in both verbal and written forms and engaging with various audiences
* Timely Task Completion: Ability to finish tasks and projects efficiently, managing resources and priorities effectively
* Team Collaboration: Willingness to work together with others, promoting teamwork and supporting shared goals
* Client Focus: Dedication to understanding and addressing the needs of clients and stakeholders to ensure their satisfaction
* Dependability: Consistent availability and follow-through, including reliable on-call responsiveness and clear communication during and after incidents
* Creative Thinking: Openness to suggesting new ideas and methods to improve processes and outcome
* Organizational Skills: Capability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Adaptability: Willingness to adjust to changing situations and priorities, showing resilience in a dynamic work environment

**Experience & Education**

* 5+ years of experience in a DevOps, site reliability, or infrastructure engineering role required
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Pipelines (CI/CD) required — must be able to own and extend existing pipelines
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or Terraform) required
* Linux administration experience (shell scripting, terminal multiplexers) required
* AWS administration experience required (IAM, S3; exposure to Bedrock or comparable AI services a plus)
* Cloudflare experience required (WAF, DNS, bot protection) for protecting public-facing applications
* Experience with structured logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (e.g., Serilog, Seq, or comparable) required
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and work experience will be considered

**Licensing & Credentials**

* Azure certification (AZ-400 or AZ-104) a plus

**Systems & Technical Skills**

* Microsoft Azure (App Service, Key Vault, Managed Identity, Entra ID)
* Azure DevOps Pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code (Bicep or Terraform)
* Linux administration, shell scripting
* AWS (Bedrock, IAM, S3)
* Cloudflare (WAF, DNS, bot protection)
* Structured logging/monitoring tools (e.g., Serilog, Seq, or comparable)

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift 25 pounds
* Repeated use of sight to read documents and computer screens
* Repeated use of hearing and speech to communicate on telephone and in person
* Repetitive hand movements, such as keyboarding, writing, 10-key
* Walking, bending, sitting, reaching and stretching in all directions

**Benefits & Compensation:**

* Higginbotham offers medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, 401K, equity incentive plan as well as multiple supplemental benefits for physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing.
* Employee Wellness Program
* Company paid holidays, plus PTO

**Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies:**
To protect the interests of all parties, Higginbotham Insurance Agency, Inc., and our partners, will not accept unsolicited potential placements from any source other than directly from the candidate or a vendor partner under MSA with Higginbotham. Please do not contact or send unsolicited potential placements to our team members.
  
  

* Applications will be accepted until the position is filled

title: Senior Build & Release Software Engineer
description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

**Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies**

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person,
**forge the future with Voyager.**

The Senior Software Build & Release Engineer for Voyager Lunar Systems owns the automation of software builds, versioning, deployment, and delivery for our lunar lander program.

The position reports to the Software & Controls Manager and is part of the Software & Controls Department based in Pittsburgh, PA. This role is onsite based in Pittsburgh, PA.

**In this role, the essential functions are:**

* **Own release engineering end to end**
  for flight and ground software, from pipeline architecture through final software package generation.
* **Design and evolve the branching and release strategy.**
  This includes a GitFlow-based model with release branches, automated semantic versioning, and promotion gates that define what qualifies as an alpha build, release candidate, or release.
* **Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines**
  that compile, test, version, publish, and deploy software. You'll triage and resolve infrastructure-related failures and regressions.
* **Integrate automated and manual test campaigns**
  into the release process so every build has a clear, auditable test record.
* **Deploy and operate on-premises infrastructure**
  for critical engineering services, including GitLab and GitLab Runners, Slurm HPC clusters, Jira, Confluence, Harbor, and MinIO.
* **Own Linux-based spacecraft flat-sat platforms.**
  You'll work with test engineers to build Python tooling and custom Docker containers for automated deployment and testing.
* **Set engineering standards**
  for build, test, and release practices across software teams.

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now,
Join Our Talent Community
and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of DevOps, build, or release engineering experience supporting robotics, spacecraft, embedded, or other mission-critical systems.
* Hands-on ownership of GitLab CI/CD, including pipelines, runners, package registry, and releases.
* Strong Python skills for pipeline automation, release tooling, scripting, and pytest-based test frameworks.
* Experience with Bazel, particularly for multi-language (C++/Python) builds, remote caching, or migrating existing projects from Make/CMake.
* Experience with Docker and with Make/CMake build systems.
* A track record of designing or significantly shaping branching and release strategies, such as GitFlow, release branches, semantic versioning, and promotion gates.
* Solid Linux administration experience, including deploying and maintaining self-hosted engineering services.
* Comfort as the primary or sole owner of infrastructure, responsible for both architecture and hands-on implementation.
* Must be a U.S. person as defined by ITAR.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Working proficiency in C++, particularly around build, test, and packaging.
* Experience running simulation or compute workloads on HPC clusters (Slurm).
* Experience with container registries and object storage (Harbor, MinIO).
* Prior work in ITAR/CUI-controlled environments.
* Informal technical leadership experience, such as mentoring engineers or driving cross-team adoption of tooling and process.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

* Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees
* Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll
* 401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security
* Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being
* Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources
* The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

Voyager is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120–130) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) (15 CFR Parts 730–774), applicants for this position must be a U.S. Person: a US Citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3). Applicants must be eligible to obtain any required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or the U.S. Department of Commerce.

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:

Esri is a global leader in geographic information system (GIS) technology, dedicated to helping organizations unlock the power of spatial data to make informed decisions. With a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, Esri fosters a workplace that values varied perspectives and backgrounds, driving innovation and positive global change. The company’s ArcGIS Online platform offers a secure, cloud-based mapping and spatial analysis software as a service (SaaS) that enables customers worldwide to collect, manage, analyze, and share geospatial data efficiently. Esri continuously invests in its employees’ growth and provides a supportive environment where diverse talents can thrive and contribute to meaningful projects.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to join the ArcGIS Online (AWS) team, focusing on designing and operating robust cloud-based mapping analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) and fellow DevOps professionals to maintain and enhance SaaS capabilities across multiple cloud providers. This role involves improving deployment workflows, maintaining CI/CD pipelines, configuring containerized microservices, and leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code to ensure high availability and scalability of services. The position offers an excellent opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in a dynamic, collaborative environment and to contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud-native applications.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in software coding, problem-solving, and debugging
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Go, Python, PowerShell, or Bash
* Experience with configuration management tools like Puppet, Chef, or PowerShell DSC
* Strong understanding of version control systems and build processes
* Hands-on experience with continuous integration and deployment tools such as Jenkins
* Proficient in provisioning cloud infrastructure using APIs and tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates
* Solid knowledge of public cloud services, particularly AWS components such as IAM, EC2, EKS, ELB, ALB, CloudFront, Autoscaling, and Networking; familiarity with AKS is a plus
* Extensive experience working with containers and orchestration tools including Docker, Kubernetes, and ECS
* Familiarity with databases and data stores such as Redis, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB, or RedShift
* Comprehensive understanding of web technologies, HTTP, networking, security, scaling, and cloud-native architecture principles
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline
* Recommended: Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum), monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana, Git version control, and AWS certification

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with SRE and DevOps teams to operate and enhance SaaS offerings across multiple cloud platforms
* Improve build, test, and deployment workflows to increase efficiency and reliability
* Maintain and optimize CI/CD pipelines for development, QA, and production environments
* Configure and deploy containerized microservices ensuring scalability and resilience
* Design, document, implement, and maintain operational components within applications
* Implement automation and infrastructure-as-code practices to streamline operations
* Develop and maintain data pipelines to gather operational insights on deployed services and applications
* Promote best practices, share knowledge with team members, and demonstrate agility in adopting new technologies and methods

* Comprehensive health and welfare benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Basic and supplemental life insurance for employees and their families
* 401(k) retirement plan with profit-sharing programs
* Minimum accrual of 80 hours of vacation leave annually
* Twelve paid holidays each calendar year
* Opportunities for personal and professional growth within a supportive environment
* Competitive base salary range estimated between $101,192 and $167,336 USD, reflecting skills, experience, and certifications

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can contribute their best work. title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
Forge Forward is searching for a Senior Cloud Engineer.
**This position will be on-site and support a client in Charleston, SC. Position requires US citizenship with a Secret clearance. Those not meeting these requirements cannot be considered.**
Minimum seven (7) years of experience supporting enterprise IT or C4I systems, with substantial hands-on cloud architecture and engineering experience is required. The Senior Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, securing, and sustaining mission-critical cloud and hybrid-cloud infrastructure in regulated DoD and Navy environments.
  
  
The preferred candidate brings deep Microsoft Azure experience, particularly Azure Government. Impact Level 5 (IL5) experience is strongly desired, and IL6 experience is ideal. The role requires the ability to design within mission, security, connectivity, and platform constraints while integrating on-premises services with cloud capabilities.
  
  
This engineer will serve as a technical authority across Azure architecture, external and internal networking, identity and access management, security services, virtual desktop, virtual machines, containers, and Infrastructure as Code automation. AWS or commercial-cloud experience is relevant, but Azure Government experience is preferred.
  
  
**Functional Responsibilities And Skills**

* Design, deploy, secure, and sustain Microsoft Azure architectures, with preference for Azure Government over commercial cloud and Azure over AWS.
* Apply experience in DoD Impact Level environments; IL5 experience is strongly desired, and IL6 experience is ideal.
* Design hybrid-cloud solutions that run complementary services on premises and in Azure, including integration and management through Azure Arc.
* Engineer external connectivity and direct-connect solutions, including Azure ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, routing, and connectivity to on-premises networks.
* Design and manage internal networking, including virtual networks, subnets, network security groups, VLANs, routing, and network segmentation.
* Implement cloud security using Microsoft Defender, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, secure baselines, least-privilege access, and Zero Trust principles.
* Design and administer Azure identity, role-based access control, privileged access, and service identities, including integration with program-provided NIS tools.
* Architect and support Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows and Linux virtual machines, and containerized workloads.
* Evaluate technical, cybersecurity, mission, and cost constraints and develop resilient Azure solution architectures and implementation plans.
* Develop repeatable infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Azure Automation integrated with Terraform; PowerShell, Bash, Python, and CI/CD experience is valuable.
* Troubleshoot complex cloud, network, identity, security, compute, and hybrid-integration issues across lab and production environments.
* Produce architecture diagrams, implementation plans, test artifacts, operating procedures, and RMF/ATO compliance evidence; participate in technical reviews and change management.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field desired. Relevant technical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree, subject to contract labor category requirements.
* CompTIA Security+ or equivalent certification meeting DoD Cybersecurity Workforce IAT Level II requirements.
* US citizen with a Secret clearance and current SSBI/T5 investigation. TS/SCI desired.

**Desired Skills And Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert; Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104); Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate; and HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.
* Experience supporting Navy C4I or comparable DoD mission environments.
* Azure Government and classified-cloud engineering experience at IL6.
* Advanced Azure architecture experience with Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure Arc, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, Microsoft Defender, VPN Gateway, virtual machines, containers, and role-based access control.
* Hybrid-cloud architecture spanning on-premises infrastructure and Azure services.
* Terraform integrated with Azure Automation, Git-based version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service or other Kubernetes/container platforms.
* Familiarity with DISA STIGs, ACAS/SCAP remediation, RMF controls, POA&Ms, and continuous monitoring.
* Strong communication, technical documentation, collaboration, and leadership skills in a multi-disciplinary Agile environment.

title: Sr Cloud Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
Build a cloud and AI platform that application teams, data scientists and business lines can use without having to reinvent security, deployment or governance each time. The Senior Cloud Engineer is a hands-on builder who works across the whole stack: the cloud infrastructure, the services and interfaces that run on it, and the AI capabilities that increasingly sit inside them.
  
  
Role Positioning
  
  
This role suits an engineer who is equally comfortable writing infrastructure as code, building a production API and front end, and wiring a large language model into a governed workflow. You will deliver working platform capabilities, set technical standards for the engineers around you, and help turn early AI experiments into services the client can run, audit and trust. You will partner closely with security, data, model risk and the application teams who are your customers.
  
  
location: Richardson, Texas
  
  
job type: Permanent
  
  
salary: $110,000 - 130,000 per year
  
  
work hours: 8am to 5pm
  
  
education: Bachelors
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Cloud platform engineering.**
Design, build and operate cloud services on AWS: account structure, networking, identity and access, container and serverless runtimes, data stores and shared services. Define infrastructure with Terraform or CloudFormation, apply security and compliance guardrails as code, and keep environments reproducible, observable and cost aware.
  
  
**Full stack delivery.**
Build and ship production services end to end: back-end APIs and event-driven services in languages such as Python, Java or TypeScript, front ends in a modern framework such as React, and the data layer behind them. Raise the bar on testing, code review and design, and contribute reference implementations that other teams adopt.
  
  
**AI platform engineering.**
Build the shared platform that lets teams use generative AI safely. That includes model access through Amazon Bedrock and a common model gateway, retrieval-augmented generation with vector stores and knowledge bases, orchestration with frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, and agent runtimes including OpenClaw where they are approved. Provide reusable patterns for prompts, tools, memory and evaluation so product teams build on a tested foundation.
  
  
**Governed and secure agents.**
Treat autonomous and tool-using agents as privileged software. Apply least-privilege identity and permissions to every tool and data source, sandbox execution, require human approval for consequential actions, and keep complete audit logs of prompts, tool calls and outputs. Work with security and model risk on threat modeling for prompt injection, data leakage and excessive agent autonomy before capabilities reach production.
  
  
**Evaluation, observability and cost.**
Build automated evaluation for quality, accuracy, safety and drift, with regression tests that run in the delivery pipeline. Instrument latency, token consumption, error rates and cost by team and use case, and use that data to select models, tune retrieval and control spend.
  
  
**Delivery automation and reliability.**
Contribute to the paved-road CI/CD pipelines, change traceability and service level objectives that the wider organization relies on. Take part in an on-call rotation, lead incident response for the services you build, and follow through on corrective actions.
  
  
**Technical leadership.**
Mentor engineers, review designs, write clear architecture decision records and represent the platform in design reviews and with auditors. Help evaluate new tools and frameworks with a skeptical, evidence-based eye, and say plainly when something is not ready for a regulated environment.

* Strong full stack skills: back-end services in Python, Java or TypeScript, plus a modern front-end framework and relational and NoSQL data stores.
* Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, containers and Kubernetes or serverless, CI/CD and cloud observability.
* Hands-on experience building generative AI applications on a managed platform such as Amazon Bedrock, including retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, guardrails and prompt management.
* Working experience with orchestration and agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or OpenClaw, and an understanding of their security and operational limits.
* Solid grasp of cloud security fundamentals, including IAM, network isolation, secrets management and data protection.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, including work with auditors, model risk or compliance teams.
* Experience with model evaluation tooling, fine-tuning or hosting open-weight models, and cost optimization of inference workloads.
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol, agent identity patterns and multi-agent designs.
* AWS professional or specialty certifications, for example Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer or Machine Learning.
* Master's degree in a technical discipline.

title: Backend Engineer — Data Platform
description:
**About Us**
Savant is transforming how healthcare and life sciences organizations unlock the value trapped in unstructured medical data. Our platform combines cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) with domain-specific quality controls to convert free-text clinical records into structured, analysis-ready data — efficiently, accurately, and at scale. We work with leading institutions across healthcare, life sciences, and research, supporting faster studies, sharper insights, and better care. Backed by Roivant (NASDAQ: ROIV), Savant is built for organizations that see structured data not just as an output, but as a foundation for innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re hiring a Backend Engineer to help mature and scale the data platform underlying Savant’s clinical data products. You’ll help design and implement the systems that move large, complex datasets through ingestion, processing, quality control, and delivery.
  
  
This is a backend engineering role with a strong data engineering and infrastructure orientation.
  
  
You’ll work across Python and Rust services, SQL-based data systems (DuckDB, Postgresql, and Ducklake), Dagster pipelines, and Kubernetes workloads. You’ll help establish the architectural patterns that allow Savant to process sensitive healthcare data efficiently while maintaining reproducibility, traceability, and quality.
  
  
Savant is based in NYC, and this role is remote-eligible. Preference will be given to candidates able to come to work in NYC.
  
  
**Some Things You Might Work On**

* Design and build production pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating, and delivering healthcare datasets
* Develop backend services and APIs that support Savant’s clinical data products
* Build reliable Dagster workflows with strong patterns for partitioning, retries, idempotency, backfills, and observability
* Design data models and contracts that support schema evolution, lineage, reproducibility, and downstream analysis
* Operate and improve containerized workloads running on Kubernetes
* Build systems for monitoring pipeline health, data quality, performance, and infrastructure cost
* Diagnose production issues across application, data, and infrastructure layers
* Improve the performance of Python and SQL workloads operating over large datasets
* Establish testing and deployment practices that make data systems safer and easier to change
* Collaborate with AI engineers to productionize new model workflows and scale them across customer datasets
* Help shape technical architecture as Savant’s platform, customer base, and processing volume grow

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience building production backend or data-intensive software systems
* Excellent Python and SQL skills
* Experience with AWS and Kubernetes
* Sound technical judgment, taste, and the ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions
* Experience designing and operating data pipelines at scale using Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or a comparable orchestration framework
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative mindset

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience processing clinical, claims, laboratory, registry, or other healthcare data
* Experience with Dagster
* Experience with distributed batch processing or compute-intensive data pipelines
* Familiarity with HIPAA, de-identification, auditability, or other information security requirements for sensitive data
* Experience supporting machine-learning or LLM inference pipelines
* Experience in an early-stage startup or small, fast-moving technical team

**Why Join Us**

* Foundational Ownership: Build the systems on which Savant’s products and AI workflows depend
* Meaningful Scale: Solve real data-engineering and operational challenges involving large, complex clinical datasets
* Broad Technical Scope: Work across backend services, data architecture, orchestration, and infrastructure
* Tight Collaboration: Work directly with AI, product, clinical, and engineering partners

title: Site Reliability Engineer (US - Pacific time)
description:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for people (in the US/Canada - GMT -8 to GMT -6)  that like deep ownership of production systems, people that are not afraid of working with stateful infrastructure and love working in AWS, VMs, automation, and making messy systems reliable.

In general we seek SRE’s who are:

 - Enthusiastic drivers. We need proactive people that can fully own projects and get them done, and know to get help when needed. "Are we there yet?" is the wrong question.

 - Optimistic problem solvers. Things get hard here sometimes, whether it's scaling, shipping complex products, handling a stream of support requests, or trying to ship something that touches multiple teams. We need people who won't get disheartened, and will collaborate, iterate, and ship their way out of anything.

 - Grown ups. We’re an international bunch of weirdos, but one thing unites us: everyone is kind, considerate, and professional towards each other. This isn't about age or experience https://posthog.com/handbook/company/grown-ups, it's about being low-ego, flexible, and respectful.

 - Genuine builders. PostHog is full of people who just love building stuff, people who would still be building software even if there wasn't a paycheck at the end. If this sounds like you, we should talk.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

You won’t be in a typical  “keep the lights on” SRE role. The work is about turning a fast-growing, stateful system into a predictable, well-automated platform. (provisioning, scaling, rebalancing, recovery)
That means reducing operational stress, designing safe automation for traffic-heavy workloads, and building the tooling and patterns that let the system scale without scaling human effort. 

You'll work on the kind of problems that only show up at large scale (petabytes of data, thousands of cores, constant ingestion) across a multi-region, multi-account AWS platform running many services on Kubernetes.

 - Operating EKS clusters across several environments with Karpenter autoscaling, Cilium networking, and ArgoCD-driven GitOps deployments

 - Managing and evolving a multi AWS account organization,  provisioning, networking, access control, and cross-account connectivity

 - Maintaining the Terraform/Terragrunt IaC platform - modules, automated plan-on-PR / apply-on-merge pipelines, and safe patterns for shared infrastructure

 - Improving operational tooling around deploys, schema changes, backups, restores, and incident response

 - Reducing operational load by identifying repeat pain points and eliminating them through code and self-healing automation

 - Optimizing cloud spend as you go

 - Participating in on-call and incident response, with a strong focus on making incidents rarer over time

You'll have room to design and automate, not just respond to alerts. You should join this team if you like deep ownership of production systems and enjoy building the platform layer that everything else runs on.



REQUIREMENTS

 - Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production (EKS preferred). You've debugged node pressure, networking issues, and deployment failures at scale (thousands of nodes)

 - Strong experience operating production infrastructure on AWS. Not just one account, but understanding organizational boundaries, IAM, and networking between many

 - Experience automating infrastructure using Terraform or Terragrunt at scale, including module design and state management

 - Solid understanding of Linux systems (disk, memory, networking, failure modes)

 - Experience supporting stateful systems (databases, queues, storage systems, etc.)

 - Ability to debug and reason about performance and reliability issues in production

 - You're comfortable owning systems end-to-end, including on-call responsibilities

You don't need to be an expert in every system we run on day one. But you do need to enjoy owning complex infrastructure and learning how the pieces fit together.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with GitOps workflows (ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)

 - Experience with building AI agent-enabled base-level infra services for teams that move fast

 - Familiarity with multi-region infrastructure and the consistency/availability tradeoffs that come with it

We are committed to ensuring a fair and accessible interview process. If you need any accommodations or adjustments, please let us know.

title: Senior Data Engineer – Google Cloud
description:
ABOUT ONTRAC SOLUTIONS

Ontrac Solutions is a leading technology consulting firm, specializing in cutting-edge solutions that drive business transformation. We partner with organizations to modernize their infrastructure, streamline processes, and deliver tangible results. By creating value beyond the hype, we help businesses modernize technology and build new strategies that fuel growth. Our team is committed to innovation, collaboration, and excellence, empowering our clients to succeed in an evolving digital landscape.

OVERVIEW

Ontrac is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with deep, hands-on Google Cloud experience to support our client in delivering Google Cloud data platform engagements for enterprise customers. This is a consulting-delivery role: you will design and build production data pipelines on GCP, migrate legacy warehouses and Hadoop estates into BigQuery, and work directly with customer engineering and analytics teams from discovery through hand-off. The ideal candidate has spent several years shipping GCP data platforms for multiple customers, not maintaining a single internal stack.

ENGAGEMENT

* Duration: 6 months, with possible extension
* Location: United States or Canada, fully remote.
* We are not able to provide sponsorship for this role.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 6+ years in data engineering, including 3+ years delivering production workloads on Google Cloud Platform
* Deep hands-on BigQuery experience: data modeling, partitioning and clustering, cost and performance tuning, and ELT in SQL
* Built and operated batch and streaming pipelines with Dataflow (Apache Beam) and/or Dataproc (Spark / PySpark), with Pub/Sub as a streaming source
* Orchestrated production workflows with Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow), including dependency management, retries, and alerting
* Strong Python and advanced SQL
* Provisioned GCP data infrastructure with Terraform and deployed through Git-based CI/CD
* Delivered at least one migration into BigQuery from an on-prem or legacy platform (Hadoop/Hive, Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, or another cloud warehouse), including data validation and cut-over
* Client-facing experience: running requirements sessions, presenting designs, and handing off documented solutions to customer teams

USEFUL QUALIFICATIONS

* Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification (or a current Associate Cloud Engineer / Professional Cloud Architect)
* Databricks certification or production Databricks-on-GCP experience
* Looker / LookML modeling, or Looker Studio dashboard delivery
* Serverless integration work on Cloud Run or Cloud Functions (API ingestion, event handlers)
* Data governance on GCP: Dataplex, Data Catalog, IAM and column-level security, DLP
* Feeding GenAI use cases from the warehouse: BigQuery ML, Vertex AI, embeddings or RAG data preparation
* BigQuery Migration Service / SQL translation, Datastream, or Database Migration Service used on a real migration
* Prior experience at a Google Cloud partner or in Google Cloud Professional Services

SCOPE AND DELIVERY EXPECTATIONS

The following covers the scope of work we anticipate the contractor supporting throughout the engagement.

* Assess the customer's current data estate and produce a target-state GCP data architecture and migration plan
* Build ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines (batch and streaming) into BigQuery, deployed entirely through Terraform and CI/CD

title: Data Engineer
description:
We're looking for a full-time Data Engineer to build the data platform behind the ION Factory OS: the system next-generation hardware builders use to run their factory floors. Every part, work order, inspection, and nonconformance in ION is data that our customers rely on to make production decisions, and increasingly, data that powers ION's AI.

You'll join the First Resonance team full-time in Los Angeles, CA (HQ in El Segundo) as a foundational member of our engineering team.

**WHY THIS ROLE?**
------------------

Our customers build rockets, satellites, eVTOLs, nuclear reactors, and robots. Their factories generate rich, highly structured data, and they want it out of the shop floor and into their analytics, their ERPs, and their decisions, fast and correct.

You'll own the pipelines and APIs that make that happen: the ION Data Connector that delivers customer data on a measured freshness schedule, the Data API that developers and partners build on, and the data foundation for ION Intelligence, our AI layer. This is core to our company objective of building an infinitely scalable intelligence fabric for the factory floor.

**OUR STACK**
-------------

* **Application:** Python backend (SQLAlchemy, asynchronous background jobs), GraphQL API, and a Next.js / React / TypeScript frontend
* **Data:** PostgreSQL as the system of record; Airflow-orchestrated pipelines; the ION Data Connector and Data API for customer data delivery
* **Infrastructure:** AWS, including dedicated, isolated customer environments in AWS GovCloud; infrastructure as code
* **Delivery:** CI/CD with automated testing (Pytest)
* **How we build:** AI-native. Our engineers use Claude and other coding assistants every day to ship faster and with higher quality

**RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES**
-----------------------------

* **Own the Data Pipelines:** Design, build, and operate the Airflow pipelines that move ION data to customers and internal consumers, with clear freshness targets, monitoring, and alerting when they slip.
* **Build the ION Data Connector and Data API:** Deliver reliable, well-documented, secure ways for customers to get their manufacturing data into their warehouses, BI tools, and ERPs.
* **Model Manufacturing Data:** Turn parts, bills of materials, work orders, procedures, inventory, quality, and nonconformance records into clean, versioned data models and snapshots that stay consistent as the product evolves.
* **Power ION Intelligence:** Build the data foundation and context pipelines that feed ION's AI features, so models and agents work from accurate, current, permissioned data.
* **Make Data Trustworthy:** Put validation, reconciliation, lineage, backfill, and access controls in place so customers can depend on what we deliver, including in isolated GovCloud environments.
* **Scale with the Platform:** Partner with Platform and Product engineers on Postgres performance, schema changes, and event-driven designs so data scales cleanly with our customers.
* **Feed Back to Product:** Work with our Forward-Deployed Engineers to turn repeated customer data needs into reusable, productized pipelines.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**
---------------------------

* 4+ years building and operating production data systems as a data engineer, software engineer, or analytics engineer
* Strong Python and SQL, with software-engineering discipline: testing, version control, code review, CI/CD
* Production experience with Airflow (or Dagster / Prefect) orchestrating pipelines with real reliability expectations
* Deep PostgreSQL experience: data modeling, query performance, change data capture or incremental extraction
* Experience designing and shipping data APIs or data products that external users depend on
* Sound judgment about data failure modes: idempotency, late or out-of-order data, schema evolution, reconciliation, and backfills
* AWS experience (S3, RDS / Aurora, IAM, and related services)
* AI-native workflow: you use coding assistants to move faster and raise quality
* Clear written communication; you can explain a data model or a data incident to an engineer and to a customer

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

* Experience preparing data for LLM / AI applications (retrieval, embeddings, context pipelines, evaluation data)
* Familiarity with dbt, event streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar), and cloud warehouses or lakehouses
* Experience with GraphQL APIs and Python ORMs (SQLAlchemy)
* Experience in AWS GovCloud or other compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ITAR)
* Background in manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, PLM, MES, or quality data

**BENEFITS & PERKS**
--------------------

* Health Insurance; medical, vision, dental, & life insurance.
* Paid Parental Leave.
* Employee Stock Option Plan.
* Team outings, group lunches, open office, happy hours.
* Paid holidays, sick days.
* Flexible Friday and PTO.
* 401K.

First Resonance participates in E-Verify. As part of our onboarding process, a new hire's Form I-9 information will be shared with the federal government to confirm they are authorized to work in the U.S.

Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location.

First Resonance accelerates the speed and reliability of hardware development for companies manufacturing the next generation of hardware products. title: Founding backend engineer, data platform and fleet infrastructure
description:
**About Sentis**  
Sentis is capturing the most accurate state of the human body. We bring all the data a hospital has on a patient into one place. Health AI is only as good as the data it learns from, and most of that data is never captured today. We build at the intersection of physical AI and healthcare. We’re live in US ICUs and scaling from single units to full hospitals.

**The role**  
You own the backend: the platform that takes in data from every node, stores it and makes it usable for training, and the infrastructure that keeps a fleet of devices inside hospitals updated and under control.  
The tech exists and runs today, so you don’t start from zero. Your job is to challenge all of it with the team and make it as smart and as scalable as it can be, from first principles. We have no ego about what’s there. If you want to change something, change it. It’s yours.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and run backend services in Go on Postgres, from architecture to on-call.
* Own our AWS infrastructure in Terraform, serverless where it fits.
* Build ingestion for per-second clinical data from every node, with no loss when a hospital network drops.
* Store terabytes of time-series data cheaply and make it easy to export for model training.
* Run the fleet: provisioning, device identity, staged OTA updates with automatic rollback, and remote access.
* Build logging, tracing and alerting across cloud and devices.
* Build in the controls for HIPAA and SOC 2: encryption, audit trails, access control, and deletion per hospital and patient stay.

**How we build**  
Agentic development is a requirement for this role. It only works if you understand backend and infrastructure principles very deeply, and can read, write and judge code yourself.

* You write the specs, repo instructions and tests that let agents ship good code.
* You run several agents in parallel and review what they produce.
* You read every line that touches patient data or device updates yourself.
* You decide the architecture. The agents don’t.

**You might be a fit if**

* You’ve built something hard and can show it: a product from nothing, a system others said couldn’t ship on that timeline, or open-source work.
* You work like a founder. You’ve been a technical founder or first engineer, or you’ve owned a system the same way.
* You have 3+ years shipping production backend software, with on-call for your own system.
* You write production Go, or Rust, Java or Kotlin and you’ll switch fast.
* You understand distributed systems deeply and have run them under real load.
* You know AWS and Terraform in depth, including serverless infrastructure.
* You’ve built data pipelines where losing or duplicating data wasn’t an option.
* You’ve worked with IoT or connected devices before.
* Agentic development is how you work every day.
* Bonus: you’ve run a device fleet in production, with OTA updates and remote management.
* Bonus: clinical data, HIPAA or SOC 2.
* You’re based in the US and can work here without visa sponsorship.
* You'reopen to traveling with us to clients in the US and if needed, globally

**How we work**  
This role is in person in San Francisco. We’re high pace, high agency and low ego.  
We hire very good people and then get out of their way. You work freely, you make your own calls, and you get whatever tools you need to do your best work.

**Next steps**  
An intro call, a technical deep dive on a real Sentis problem, and a conversation with both founders. Send us the hardest thing you’ve built and what made it hard. A link or five sentences is enough.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**The Team**

The Data Platform Engineering team (Part of Upstart's Decisioning & Data) provides developer tools, frameworks, and scalable data infrastructure as shared services across Upstart. The team's primary objective is to provide Data Analysts, ML scientists, and Software Engineers access to high-quality data and developer tools to create business metrics and training data for respective product verticals.

You will join the Data Production Experience (PX) team, which owns Upstart’s Lakehouse (Databricks) infrastructure. This is the platform that Machine Learning, Analytics, and Software Engineering teams use to build the training data and metrics behind our lending, fraud, and pricing models—enabling growth and reducing risk across our business verticals.

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer joining this team, you will focus on:

* **Lakehouse Infrastructure and Security**: Own the Databricks platform across multiple environments, including a newly launched regulated environment (Upstart Bank). Responsibilities include expanding infrastructure as code for new Lakehouse features, enforcing a no-click-ops policy, establishing disaster recovery, implementing least-privilege and attribute-based access controls (e.g., based on data classification), ensuring environment isolation, and resolving other known security risks.

* **Compliance**: Close control gaps and automate evidence gathering for OCC, SOX and SOC audits across access management, change management, and data quality.

* **Cost and usage efficiency**: Reduce Databricks and AWS spend through accurate cost attribution, waste detection, and platform-level optimizations (e.g., compute rightsizing, improving pruning, migrating to Graviton and spot instances, Delta Lake Archival).

**How you’ll make an impact**

* Evaluate and adopt new technologies, including open-source lakehouse alternatives, to expand platform capabilities.
* Improve developer efficiency and infrastructure reliability by working with cross-functional stakeholders like Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Analytics, Compliance, and Security.
* Improve Lakehouse security, usage efficiency, and observability by collaborating closely with the Data Engineering and Security teams.
* Evangelize good coding and engineering best practices while uplifting fellow engineers and mentoring junior team members.
* Help break down complex projects and requirements into quarterly commitments and sprints.
* Own Lakehouse infrastructure components end to end, from technical requirements and design through rollout and production support.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or data platform engineering.
* Hands-on experience operating a lakehouse or big data platform (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg).
* Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g., IAM, S3, EC2, EKS), Python, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK), CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing security and compliance controls in audited environments (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, GDPR, GLBA, OCC), including access management, encryption, and change management.
* Experience reducing cloud or data platform costs through usage analysis, cost attribution, and infrastructure optimization (e.g., Graviton or spot instances, storage tiering).
* Ability to reason from first principles and work effectively through ambiguity on complex, cross-functional problems.
* Proficient in DevOps engineering, leveraging Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) tools such as Kubernetes, Jenkins, CDK, APM, Terraform, and more. Experienced in automation, alerting, monitoring, security, and declarative infrastructure.
* Solid understanding of cloud networking fundamentals.
* Skilled at explaining complex concepts in simple, accessible terms and thriving in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Experience using AI coding assistants or agents to accelerate infrastructure development and operations.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, data architecture design, and big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Lakehouse, Databricks)

**Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a **Data Engineer to support our office based in Seattle, Washington.**

**About the Role**

Weyerhaeuser’s Data & Analytics team is looking for a Data Engineer to build and operate the data platform that powers reporting, analytics, and AI across the enterprise. This hands-on role focuses on building scalable, reliable, well-governed pipelines that move data. We invest heavily in template- and metadata-driven patterns, so onboarding a new source is a configuration exercise, not a net-new build. We expect engineers to use AI as a force multiplier — both in how we build the platform (LLM-assisted development, testing, and documentation) and in what we deliver from it (AI-ready data products grounded in well-modeled sources). This role partners closely with source-system owners, analytics engineers, data scientists, and data analysts. It’s well suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has strong opinions about data quality and pipeline reliability, and is energized by building scalable foundations rather than one-off integrations. Responsibilities Ingestion & Integration  

* Design and maintain ingestion pipelines that move data from SAP, relational databases, flat files, REST APIs, message queues, and SaaS applications into our data lake/Snowflake.
* Extend our metadata-driven and template-driven ADF pipeline frameworks so onboarding a new source is a configuration exercise — schema mapping, validation, and config, not handwritten pipelines.
* Develop Python-based Azure Functions for custom ingestion logic, REST API integrations, paging/retry handling, and schema reconciliation.
* Implement reliable full and incremental data load patterns — watermarking, CDC, late-arriving data, and replayable backfills.
* Design, develop, and support our geospatial ETL tool data pipelines that ingest, transform, and complex location-based data from enterprise, operational, and third-party sources for analytics and reporting. Modeling & Transformation
* Land and preserve history of raw data in the Azure data lake or Snowflake (bronze), then build dbt models that conform, deduplicate, standardize, and enrich it into clean silver datasets.
* Partner with analytics engineers and data analysts to build dimensional models and semantic views that enable AI-ready datasets. Orchestration & Reliability
* Orchestrate end-to-end workflows in Azure Data Factory — dependencies, parameterization, retries, dynamic parallelism, and error handling for complex multi-source pipelines.
* Build monitoring, alerting, and own incident response — triage, root-cause analysis, and backfills, including occasional off-hours coverage for critical loads.
* Tune pipelines and Snowflake workloads for performance and cost Data Quality, Security & Governance
* Implement data quality rules — schema validation, completeness, freshness, business-rule checks, and anomaly detection — wired into pipelines.
* Apply security and compliance best practices and contribute to lineage, metadata, and catalog efforts. Platform & Engineering Practices
* Partner with Data Platform Engineers on Terraform-managed cloud resources, and CICD pipelines.
* Drive engineering best practices — version control, testing, documentation, observability, and document pipelines, schemas, contracts, and runbooks so the platform is supportable by the broader team.
* Mentor junior engineers, contribute to design reviews, and help evaluate new tools and patterns. Contribute to code reviews. AI Enablement
* Skilled in the use of AI assistants and LLM-powered tools to accelerate development, generate and improve tests, and produce or maintain documentation. Collaboration
* Partner with analytics engineers, data analysts, and data scientists to translate requirements into reliable raw data pipelines they can model into downstream products.
* Communicate technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  
**Qualifications**  
  

* What You’ll Have Required
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or equivalent experience
* 4+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building and operating production data pipelines from internal and external sources
* Strong proficiency in Python (readable, maintainable) ad SQL.
* Production experience with a cloud-based ingestion and orchestration platform — Azure Data Factory and Azure Functions preferred, though comparable tools (Fabric Pipelines, AWS Glue/Step Functions, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, etc.) are acceptable — including parameterized, dynamic, and metadata-driven pipeline patterns.
* Production experience with dbt or a comparable transformation framework, including building and choosing across materialization patterns (views, tables, incremental, ephemeral, snapshots), test coverage, documentation, and history preservation.
* Production experience with Snowflake or similar data platform: loading patterns, role-based access, performance tuning, and cost-aware design.
* Demonstrated experience ingesting from a variety of sources: relational databases, SAP, flat files, REST APIs (JSON/XML), and SaaS applications.
* Experience implementing incremental/delta load patterns and managing watermarking, CDC, schema evolution, and backfills.
* Working knowledge of Terraform for provisioning Azure and/or Snowflake resources.
* Solid understanding of data quality, monitoring, alerting, and operational support practices.
* Working proficiency with Git, pull-request workflows, and CI/CD pipelines for data — code review, automated testing, and promotion across environments are part of how you ship.
* AI in your engineering workflow — demonstrated use of AI assistants and LLM-powered tools to accelerate development, generate and improve tests, and produce or maintain documentation.
* Track record of owning reliability — not just shipping features, but keeping data flowing cleanly over time.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and business teams.

  

**Preferred**  

* Exposure or familiarly working with geo-spatial datasets and using geo-spatial functions
* Exposure or familiarity with Iceberg table structures and operations
* Experience designing reusable, config-driven ingestion frameworks at scale.
* Exposure to streaming or near-real-time ingestion (Event Hubs, Kafka, or similar).
* Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and catalog tooling.
* Experience with BI tools such as Power BI in a downstream/consumer context.
* Experience working with manufacturing, supply chain, or forestry/natural-resources data domains. Location: This role will be based out of our corporate office in Seattle, WA.

  
**What We Offer**  
  
**Compensation:** This role is eligible for our annual merit-increase program, and we are targeting a salary range of $98,811-$148,217 based on your level ofskills, qualifications and experience. You will also be eligible for our Annual Incentive Program, which offers a cash bonus targeting 10% of base pay. Potential plan funding may range from zero to two times that target.  
  
**Benefits:** When you join our team, you and your dependents will be offered coverage under our comprehensive employee benefits plan, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. We offer a pre-tax Health Savings Account option which includes a company contribution. Other benefit options are also available such as voluntary Long-Term Care and Employee Assistance Programs. We also support personal volunteerism, sponsor a host of diversity networks, promote mentoring, and provide training and development opportunities to help you chart your path to a fulfilling career.  
  
**Retirement:** Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, which includes a paid company match in addition to our annual contribution equal to5% of your base salary.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com.

As a Senior Data Engineer at AeroVect, you will design, build, and scale the data infrastructure powering our autonomous ground support equipment (AGSE) operations. As our fleet expands across airports, you'll be responsible for ensuring that large volumes of vehicle telemetry, sensor data, and operational data are reliably ingested, processed, stored, and made accessible to engineering and operational teams.

You'll work at the intersection of autonomous systems, cloud infrastructure, and data engineering, building robust pipelines that transform real-world vehicle data into actionable insights. From processing data generated by autonomous tractors to enabling fleet performance monitoring and engineering analysis, your work will directly impact how we operate, improve, and scale our autonomous fleet.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a fast-paced environment where you'll have significant ownership over data architecture, pipeline reliability, and infrastructure scalability. You'll collaborate closely with software, infrastructure, autonomy, and operations teams to build systems that support vehicles operating in live airport environments.

**You Will**
------------

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store large volumes of autonomous vehicle telemetry, sensor, and operational data.
* Develop and operate reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, supporting both near-real-time monitoring and historical analysis.
* Build and optimize cloud-based data infrastructure using AWS and modern distributed data processing technologies.
* Develop systems to move data reliably from edge devices and on-premise infrastructure into cloud-based storage and processing environments.
* Design and maintain data models, schemas, and storage architectures that enable efficient querying, analytics, and downstream engineering workflows.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, availability, and observability across production pipelines.
* Optimize data processing performance, storage efficiency, and infrastructure costs as fleet size and data volumes increase.
* Collaborate with autonomy, software, and infrastructure engineers to support debugging, performance analysis, and continuous improvement of autonomous vehicle systems.
* Build tools and infrastructure that make data easily accessible to engineering, product, and fleet operations teams.
* Take end-to-end ownership of data infrastructure, from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

**You have**
------------

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or distributed systems, with a strong focus on building production-grade data infrastructure.

* Hands-on experience designing and operating large-scale batch and streaming data pipelines.
* Strong experience with AWS services such as S3, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Redshift, or similar cloud-native data infrastructure.

* Experience deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting data pipelines in production environments.

* Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and take ownership of complex technical problems.
