title: Senior Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer (Python)
description:
**About Entrupy**

Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods.

Entrupy's solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy's solutions in market:

* Entrupy Apparel Authentication

* Entrupy Bags & Leather Goods Authentication

* Entrupy Sneaker Authentication

* Entrupy Fingerprinting

**As we continue to build...**

We're seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you're invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we'd love to have you apply.

**About the Role**

Entrupy is seeking a Senior Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team. You will work alongside other infrastructure engineers, under our Platform Lead, to keep our AWS platform secure, compliant and reliable. Nearly all of our platform and data services are written in Python, and this role sits right where that code meets the infrastructure under it. You will be a strong Python engineer who prefers to spend their time on infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and production operations.

The team has two main goals. The first is security and compliance across our AWS environment, including our SOC 2 program: keeping our infrastructure secure by default, meeting our controls continuously, and having audit evidence ready at all times. The second is a major infrastructure modernization. We are moving our services off AWS Elastic Beanstalk onto Amazon ECS, defining our infrastructure in Terraform / OpenTofu, and making every service build and deploy through automated CI/CD pipelines. Together, we make sure security and compliance are built into that new platform from day one, not bolted on afterwards.

Some of the systems you will work with:

* Multi-account AWS infrastructure: networking, IAM, ECS, backups, audit logging and compliance controls
* CI/CD, deploy tooling, secrets management, logging, monitoring and alerting
* Python backend APIs for our mobile apps, SDKs and dashboards
* Public-facing APIs and webhooks used by partners and enterprise customers
* Data pipelines and ingestors that feed analytics, search and reporting
* Databases, caches, search and object stores (PostgreSQL/RDS, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, S3)

The Platform team works closely with the backend, mobile, machine learning and BI teams, and builds the secure, paved road those teams use to ship and run their services.  
**Employment Type:** Remote  
**Reports to:** Platform Lead
  
**Location:** Fully remote (US), working East Coast hours

**What you'll do:**

#### **Security and compliance**

* Help run the technical side of our SOC 2 program with the rest of the Platform team. Implement and maintain infrastructure controls, collect and automate audit evidence, fix control failures, and support each audit cycle.
* Help enforce least-privilege access across our AWS accounts: IAM roles and policies, AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO), cross-account access, GitHub OIDC for CI, and regular access reviews.
* Help make sure data is encrypted at rest and in transit across RDS, DynamoDB, S3, EBS and Redis, and help manage certificates, KMS keys and secrets (SOPS, Secrets Manager, SSM).
* Contribute to audit logging, threat detection (CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub or similar) and vulnerability management for container images, dependencies and hosts.
* Write security and compliance checks into Terraform / OpenTofu and CI, so that new infrastructure is compliant by default and drift is caught automatically.
Take part in security incident response and postmortems, and help keep runbooks and policies current.  

#### **Infrastructure and CI/CD**

* Work with the team to migrate our Python services off Elastic Beanstalk onto Amazon ECS, managed with Terraform / OpenTofu. Plan and run cutovers with zero or minimal downtime, and decommission the legacy environments.
* Build and maintain reusable Terraform / OpenTofu modules for ECS services, networking, IAM, databases and observability. Contribute to the team's state management, environment separation (dev / staging / prod) and a safe, peer-reviewed plan/apply workflow.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) that test, build, scan, version and deploy every service. Help standardize Docker image builds, ECR storage and promotion between environments.
* Help replace hand-run and script-based deploys with repeatable, automated, auditable workflows

#### **Operations and reliability**

* Share responsibility for production operations and on-call: RDS/PostgreSQL upgrades, Redis and DynamoDB capacity, runtime and OS end-of-life upgrades, backups and restore testing, cost hygiene and incident response.
* Help maintain observability: metrics, logs, dashboards and alerting (CloudWatch, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Make sure alerts are actionable, routed correctly and automatically created for new infrastructure.
* Write and review Python. This covers infrastructure automation, deploy tooling, Lambdas and internal tooling, plus contributions to our backend and data services when needed.
* Review your teammates' infrastructure and code changes, and share knowledge across the team.
* Write clear runbooks and architecture docs, and help other engineering teams provision and deploy services on their own, securely.

**What you bring:**

* 5+ years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, security or platform engineering, with a strong focus on AWS.
* Hands-on experience implementing and maintaining SOC 2 (or ISO 27001, HIPAA or similar) controls in a cloud environment, including producing audit evidence and working with auditors.
* Strong AWS security fundamentals: IAM, SSO, KMS, VPC network security, CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty / Security Hub.
* Strong, production-grade Python. You write maintainable, tested Python services and tooling, not just glue scripts.
* Deep hands-on Terraform or OpenTofu experience: writing and structuring modules, managing remote state, importing existing resources, and running IaC safely across multiple environments and accounts.
* Production experience running containerized services on Amazon ECS (Fargate and/or EC2 launch types) with ECR, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling and service discovery.
* Broad AWS experience: VPC, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, Lambda, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, CloudFront.
* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), including security scanning and OIDC-based deploy credentials.
* Experience migrating production workloads from one platform to another (e.g. PaaS to ECS) without disrupting customers.
* Experience running production systems: on-call, incident response, postmortems and database upgrades.
* A collaborative working style. You are comfortable sharing ownership, reviewing and being reviewed, and splitting work across a team.
* Clear written communication. You document your work and can explain security and infrastructure trade-offs to engineers, auditors and leadership.
* Comfortable working fully remote and asynchronously with a distributed team, during East Coast hours.

#### **Preferred experience**

* Experience moving services off AWS Elastic Beanstalk (or Heroku or a similar PaaS).
* Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, Secureframe).
* Multi-account AWS setups: AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies, centralized logging.
* Policy-as-code and IaC security scanning (e.g., Checkov, tfsec / Trivy, OPA / Conftest).
* PostgreSQL administration, including blue/g

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a full-time DevOps Engineer to own the reliability of the ION Factory OS: the platform that next-generation hardware builders use to run their factory floors. When our customers are building satellites, rockets, and aircraft, downtime isn't an inconvenience. It stops production.

You'll join the First Resonance team full-time in Los Angeles, CA (HQ in El Segundo), working alongside our Principal Platform Engineer as a foundational member of our infrastructure team.

**WHY THIS ROLE?**
------------------

Our customers are asking for enterprise-grade reliability commitments, and we're building to meet them, not negotiating them down. This role exists to make that happen.

For your first six months, you'll have one clear mission: take a dedicated, isolated customer environment on AWS GovCloud to formal availability, latency, and recovery targets, and prove it with real measurements. The work you do there becomes the foundation for every customer on ION and for a premium reliability tier we'll offer across our customer base. It also directly serves our company objective of building an infinitely scalable intelligence fabric for the factory floor.

After that, the role grows. In 2027 you'll move into our Forward-Deployed Engineering team, working directly with Los Angeles-area customers on site and bringing the same reliability mindset to their deployments. You'll learn the product inside and out on Platform before you take it into the field.

**OUR STACK**
-------------

* **Application:** Python backend (SQLAlchemy, asynchronous background jobs), GraphQL API, and a Next.js / React / TypeScript frontend
* **Data:** PostgreSQL as the system of record; Airflow-orchestrated pipelines powering the ION Data Connector and customer analytics
* **Infrastructure:** AWS, running a multi-tenant SaaS platform alongside dedicated, isolated customer environments in AWS GovCloud; Kubernetes; infrastructure as code (Terraform / CDK)
* **Delivery:** CI/CD with automated testing (Pytest, Jest)
* **Security & compliance:** SOC 2 controls, enterprise SSO, and environments built for regulated aerospace and defense customers
* **How we build:** AI-native. Our engineers use Claude and other coding assistants every day to ship faster and with higher quality

**RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES**
-----------------------------

* **Own Availability:** Design, build, and operate infrastructure that meets formal monthly availability commitments (99.9%+), including multi-AZ failover and planned-maintenance processes.
* **Observability from the Outside In:** Stand up synthetic monitoring from multiple regions, SLIs/SLOs, dashboards, and alerting so we know about a problem before the customer does, and can report on it monthly.
* **Disaster Recovery:** Own backup, restore, and failover with tight RPO/RTO targets. Plan and run recovery tests on a regular schedule, not just on paper.
* **Performance Engineering:** Find and fix latency at P50, P95, and P99 across reads, writes, search, background jobs, and bulk exports. A lot of this lives in the database: query tuning, indexing, connection management, and Postgres performance.
* **Kubernetes on AWS GovCloud:** Build and run containerized workloads in isolated, compliance-sensitive environments using infrastructure as code.
* **Data Pipeline Reliability:** Keep the ION Data Connector and our Airflow pipelines flowing and fresh, with measurable freshness targets and alerting when they slip.
* **Application-Aware Operations:** Work with our engineers on the Python / GraphQL services and background job system so performance and reliability are designed in, not bolted on.
* **Incident Response:** Lead on-call, incident response, and blameless postmortems, and turn what you learn into lasting fixes.
* **Field-Ready:** Starting in 2027, work on site with Los Angeles customers as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, bringing platform depth to their deployments.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**
---------------------------

* 5+ years in DevOps, Site Reliability, or infrastructure engineering, running production SaaS with real uptime commitments
* Hands-on experience owning availability targets, SLIs/SLOs, and error budgets
* Deep AWS experience; AWS GovCloud or other compliance-sensitive environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ITAR) strongly preferred
* Production Kubernetes experience: deploying, scaling, and troubleshooting
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines
* Observability tooling: metrics, logs, tracing, synthetic monitoring (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry)
* Database performance: Postgres tuning, query optimization, replication, backup and restore
* You've designed and actually tested disaster recovery, and can speak to the RPO/RTO you achieved
* Strong Python for automation and tooling (Go or Bash a plus), and comfort reading application code to find where latency comes from
* AI-native workflow: you use coding assistants to move faster and raise quality
* Clear written communication; you can explain an incident to an engineer and to a customer

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

* Experience with dedicated or single-tenant customer environments alongside a multi-tenant platform
* Experience operating Airflow or similar data orchestration in production
* Familiarity with GraphQL APIs and Python ORMs (SQLAlchemy) from a performance and scaling perspective
* Experience reporting reliability metrics directly to customers under a contractual SLA
* Customer-facing experience, or interest in moving into a forward-deployed role
* Background in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or other industrial software

**BENEFITS & PERKS**
--------------------

* Health Insurance; medical, vision, dental, & life insurance.
* Paid Parental Leave.
* Employee Stock Option Plan.
* Team outings, group lunches, open office, happy hours.
* Paid holidays, sick days.
* Flexible Friday and PTO.
* 401K.

First Resonance is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce.

First Resonance participates in E-Verify. As part of our onboarding process, a new hire's Form I-9 information will be shared with the federal government to confirm they are authorized to work in the U.S.

Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location.

First Resonance accelerates the speed and reliability of hardware development for companies manufacturing the next generation of hardware products. This includes space exploration, electric airplanes, autonomous vehicles, nuclear reactors, robotics, and more. We are a group of software, hardware, and manufacturing engineers that are bringing the best of modern UX and data science to an industry that has been overly rigid in its innovation. We are removing the barriers preventing radical advancement by providing tools to manufacturing engineers and operators to move information more freely, collaborate with their teams more easily, and use the power of data to predict problems and provide insights that result in better hardware quality and delivery.

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

title: DevOps Engineer (Remote)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

The DevOps Engineer helps build, operate, and improve the automation and delivery systems that enable engineering teams to provision, build, test, deploy, monitor, and support applications and infrastructure. The role applies established DevOps practices to improve delivery consistency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen reliability and security.

This is a career-growth individual-contributor role. The engineer owns well-scoped changes and project components affecting the team or department, resolves routine to moderately complex deployment and infrastructure issues, and contributes to improvements in CI/CD, configuration, monitoring, and release processes. Work is performed with general direction and appropriate review, with risks and blockers raised proactively.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipeline components, deployment configurations, build steps, and release automation using established patterns.
* Automate routine operational and delivery tasks using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Use infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management tools to make reviewed, repeatable changes to cloud and infrastructure environments.
* Support reusable deployment patterns for cloud and containerized workloads, including Docker and Kubernetes-based environments.
* Help maintain infrastructure modules, environment configuration, access patterns, secrets integrations, and policy checks.
* Contribute to secure delivery practices such as secret detection, protected branches, merge-request controls, artifact management, and automated validation.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, dashboards, alerts, and basic service-health signals using established team standards.
* Investigate pipeline failures, deployment issues, configuration drift, monitoring gaps, and routine infrastructure problems using logs, metrics, traces, and documented procedures.
* Resolve root causes of assigned problems when possible and escalate issues when they exceed documented procedures or create material operational risk.
* Participate in change planning, testing, peer review, rollout validation, and rollback activities.
* Document reusable procedures, troubleshooting steps, configuration changes, and operational learnings.
* Collaborate with development, operations, cloud, security, and application teams to gather requirements and communicate status clearly.
* Participate in retrospectives, incident follow-up, and continuous-improvement work.
* Contribute to reusable delivery and infrastructure capabilities while following established platform patterns, standards, and change-management practices.
* Use supported self-service workflows and document deviations from standard patterns for review.
* Escalate complex infrastructure, security, reliability, and architecture decisions to the appropriate senior engineer, platform owner, DevOps lead, or service owner.
* Respect service ownership: delivery teams remain accountable for their applications and service-level operations; this role supports the tooling and infrastructure that enable them.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, software engineering, SRE, or a related discipline; experience is a guideline, not a barrier to entry.
* Working knowledge of source control, software delivery concepts, CI/CD pipelines, and system administration.
* Working knowledge of Python, Bash, or a comparable scripting language.
* Experience using infrastructure-as-code or configuration-management tools such as Terraform or Ansible under review.
* Understanding of containers, cloud platforms, deployment workflows, monitoring, and reliability practices.
* Ability to follow runbooks and established procedures while recognizing when a situation requires clarification or escalation.
* Ability to troubleshoot moderate problems, identify contributing factors, and communicate status, risks, and blockers proactively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem solving.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience with GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or a similar delivery platform.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or cloud-native deployment patterns.
* Familiarity with AWS, GCP, Azure, or another public or hybrid cloud platform.
* Exposure to Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, PagerDuty, or similar tools.
* Exposure to GitOps, DevSecOps, software supply-chain security, or secrets management.
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, or DevOps certifications.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.  
This is a hands-on engineering role with deep technical ownership. The constraints are unusual: everything ships into fully air-gapped, accredited environments, which means offline builds, vendor dependencies, and a pipeline that produces the evidence our accreditations require.

  

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design and build production web applications in React, GO and Rust that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.
* Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.
* Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.
* Own the DevSecOps path to production: containerize and deploy to Kubernetes through GitOps CI/CD pipelines that scan, sign, and produce the evidence our accreditations require.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.
* Professional experience developing backend services in Go.
* Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.
* Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.
* Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.
* Experience communicating clearly in design documents, tradeoff analyses, and decision records a peer can pick up and act on.
* Eligible to obtain and maintain a US Top Secret Clearance with customer's approval. May be required to obtain and maintain a DoD 8140/8570 qualifying certification.

#### **DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure or application and desktop brokering (e.g. Citrix, Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Leostream, Apache Guacamole, Kasm), and with virtualization orchestrated through Kubernetes such as KubeVirt.
* Experience implementing authorization systems (RBAC, ABAC, or relationship-based models), integrating applications against an external policy decision point, and Policy as Code (PaC) tools such as OPA, Oso, Cedar, or Kyverno.
* Experience with S3-compatible object storage APIs, POSIX filesystem semantics, or FUSE.
* Experience building software for air-gapped or network-isolated environments, including dependency vendoring and offline builds.
* Experience with DevSecOps supply-chain security practices including SBOM generation, artifact signing, and provenance attestation.
* Proficiency with core security concepts including encryption, authentication, identity and access management, and Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA), plus an understanding of NIST SP 800-53 controls and their technical implementation.
* Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

**Job Description**

**Work Classification:**

**The Role:**

  

General Motors is seeking a motivated data engineer to join the Vehicle Mechatronic Embedded Control (VMEC) organization. In this role you will help to build and maintain scalable data pipelines, support analytics infrastructure and collaborate with cross functional teams to deliver reliable data solutions.

  

This position supports the development of diagnostics and prognostics related to thermal runaway propagation (TRP) in High Voltage (HV) Battery systems on GM vehicles. As a member of the Lookouts Scrum, you will collaboratively lead and manage analytics projects, collect data, develop cloud solutions, and create impactful visualizations that drive decisions across the organization.

  

The selected candidate will collect, harmonize, analyze and present data to ensure feature/diagnostic functionality and software robustness for TRP-related systems. Close collaboration with controls, software, and test engineers within the scrum is essential to develop solutions and resolve issues.

  

This role is expanding in response to the dramatic growth of hybrid and electric vehicle markets, GM’s broadening Electrification portfolio, and the data science needs to support it. You must have a passion for data-driven results and a desire to become an integral part of GM’s corporate vision: **Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions, and Zero Congestion** .

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
### **Radar Reinvented.**

Echodyne offers the world's first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

**Echodyne is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our fast-growing team.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

Echodyne's Radar Sciences team conducts research and development focused on improving radar performance in real-world operating environments. We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to help design and build a scalable data platform spanning on-premises and cloud infrastructure.

In this role you will make architectural decisions, improve engineering standards, write production code, and provide technical leadership to other engineers. You will work with Radar Algorithm, Machine Learning, Field Test, and Sales Engineers to ensure that data collected from Echodyne software and sensors is ready for model training, analysis and reporting.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Help design and implement a scalable lakehouse architecture spanning on-premises and cloud infrastructure; plan and implement a phased migration from our existing data platform that minimizes operational disruption.
* Develop data-tiering and lifecycle strategies that balance access efficiency and cost.
* Define how data is organized for efficient ingestion and query performance, including schemas, file formats, partitioning, clustering, compaction, and metadata management.
* Evaluate and implement technologies across storage tiers, workflow orchestration, transformation, and query execution.
* Build and optimize data pipelines using Python, SQL, and DuckDB or similar analytical engines.
* Benchmark and monitor reliability, performance, scalability, data movement, and cost to guide continued improvements.
* Partner across engineering, data science, machine learning, and IT teams to establish standards for data quality, schema evolution, lineage, governance, observability, security, retention, backup, and recovery.

### **REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE**

* Strong Python and SQL skills, including data transformation, data modeling, query optimization, testing, and maintainable production development.
* Experience with lakehouse technologies such as DuckLake or Apache Iceberg, analytical engines such as DuckDB, and columnar formats such as Parquet.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud data architectures including storage, compute, and access controls.
* Experience building reliable pipelines for structured and unstructured data using workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect, along with modern engineering practices such as monitoring, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, data-quality controls, security, and cost optimization.
* Demonstrated technical leadership such as project ownership, architectural decision-making, design and code reviews, and mentoring.
* Strong written and verbal communication, technical writing, and data visualization skills, with the ability to understand analysis requirements and clearly communicate designs, findings, and conclusions to technical and non-technical audiences.

### **DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE** **(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)**

* Proficiency in Linux environments.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, and domain concepts.
* Familiarity with sensor systems such as cameras, lidar, radar, or scientific instruments.

### **QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, platform engineering, backend engineering, or a related field including ownership of production data systems.
* BS, MS, or PhD in computer science or engineering, data science, or statistics.
* S. citizen. This role may require handling export-controlled (ITAR, EAR) data.

**Echodyne's technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant's eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations. Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.**

### **WHAT WE OFFER**

### **This is an exempt role.**

**If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that's a great fit for you!**

**We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full-time, US-based employees, including:**

On-site in San Francisco, California, five days a week, with about one week per quarter visiting farms in Washington, Oregon, and California.

title: Data Analytics Engineer - Hardware Test Operations
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Team**

Anduril's Hardware Test Operations team is focused on organizing and reporting on all of Anduril's products through their respective development. The Hardware Test Data Operations team builds the data infrastructure and analytical tools that power Anduril's Hardware Test function — turning telemetry, test records, and incident data into consistent, automated views of how our systems are performing across the fleet. The work spans the full data pipeline: how data is created on the platform, how it's collected and egressed to the cloud, how it's modeled, and how it reaches the engineers, managers, and leaders who act on it.  
  
We're a new team within the Hardware Test organization, and we're looking for someone willing to get their hands dirty and make high-impact, foundational changes to the way we collect, analyze, and leverage our data - work that will directly increase the velocity of the organization. Ideally you are passionate about the next generation of defense technology and are looking to become a technical expert in all of Anduril's products.

### **About the Job**

You'll take defined work-streams end-to-end — ingestion pipelines, data models, dashboards, and the small services that tie them together — so the team can run more of them in parallel. You'll partner closely with product-line Hardware Test teams, software and infra teams, and corporate analytics to ship real, production-grade data products that replace and enhance the tools we rely on today.  
  
Executional autonomy is a foundational pillar of this team. You'll be expected to drive the design, the partnerships, and the delivery. We're looking to encourage you to be a collaborator that feels comfortable proposing alternative solutions and even helping give shape to how the team executes over time.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Own data workstreams end-to-end from ingestion of source data through Foundry transforms and ontology modeling to the dashboards and tools that consume them
* Build and maintain Foundry pipelines, data models, and data quality checks
* Build internal-facing dashboards and analytics products that serve flight test engineers, middle management, and leadership
* Write small production services (Python or Go) when integrations demand it — webhooks, bridges, daemons — and partner with the broader SWE organization when the work belongs with them
* Partner directly with product-line Hardware Test leads, software engineering teams, and infrastructure teams to align on data contracts, ingestion patterns, and shared priorities
* Write clear design docs and RFCs that align stakeholders around technical decisions before code ships

#### **Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of data engineering, platform engineering, or equivalent experience owning data systems end-to-end
* Strong Python and SQL; experience with DataFrame-based transforms (Pandas, PySpark, Polars, or similar)
* Experience owning a data pipeline or integration end-to-end from ingestion through to a downstream consumer (dashboard, service, or model)
* Hands-on experience integrating with REST APIs, webhooks, or third-party data sources
* Experience building internal-facing dashboards or analytics products — owning the full stack from data to UI
* Comfortable working on a small team (1-3 people) where scope is fluid and you're often the only person on your piece of work
* Think like a data product owner — when building a pipeline or model, you can independently reason about what questions it needs to answer downstream, not just what data to move
* Write clear design docs and technical RFCs that align stakeholders, not just serve as documentation after the fact
* Experience with ontology modeling or data modeling for heterogeneous sources
* U.S. Persons status is required as this position needs to access export-controlled data
* Ability to travel as required (up to 15%)

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Palantir Foundry — transforms, ontology, Workshop, Streamlit
* Experience in robotics, aerospace, defense, or hardware-adjacent data environments
* Comfortable reading or contributing to git repos in languages other than Python (e.g. Go, Nix, Terraform, etc.)
* Experience using agentic coding tools as part of your daily workflow
* Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
  + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:

You will join the Security& Trust Organization’s Government Solutions (GSO) team. This role is highly dynamic and cuts across multiple functions inside GSO and Cisco—including software development, platform and SRE, IaaS, SecOps, incident command, compliance, and the Meraki business unit. We are at the cutting edge of cloud-native infrastructure, applying Cisco’s products to various Government Cloud certifications at multiple security levels.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer within the GSO Market Access Program (MAP), you are responsible for the architecture, deployment, and operational stability of the AWS-hosted environment that delivers Cisco Meraki solutions to our US Public Sector customers. You will translate security requirements and compliance obligations into scalable, resilient infrastructure-as-code (IaC).
  
  
**In this role, you will:**  

* Architect& Deploy: Own the technical implementation of our cloud landing zones, ensuring they meet rigorous NIST 800-53 control requirements.
* Manage Pipelines: Work within the CI/CD pipeline to manage the promotion of images from ITE to Production using Apollo, ensuring our DevOps toolchain—including GitLab and Artifactory—is secure and performant.
* Bridge Engineering& Compliance: Build automated guardrails that satisfy continuous monitoring requirements.
* Maintain Stability: Serve on-call for infrastructure-level incidents and drive down technical debt through architectural improvements and automation.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Must be eligible for a US Government TS/SCI Clearance.
* 5+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, SRE, or DevOps roles, specifically building and operating cloud-based SaaS infrastructure.
* Demonstrated proficiency in AWS core services (e.g., VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, CloudWatch, KMS) and architecting highly available, secure AWS environments.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools—specifically Terraform—to manage complex cloud environments at scale.
* Practical understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI) and the full software development lifecycle.
* Deep technical proficiency in Linux (RHEL/CentOS) and container orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS).
* Experience in a regulated environment (e.g., FedRAMP, DoD SRG, or NIST 800-53 implementations) and familiarity with implementing security controls within cloud infrastructure.
* Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee) to work in classified environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience using internal deployment orchestration tools (e.g., Apollo) to promote infrastructure/images from ITE to Production.
* Advanced scripting skills (Python, Go, or Bash) for automation and API integration.
* Strong knowledge of networking and network security (e.g., Transit Gateways, WAF, firewalls, and encrypted traffic).
* Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Helm).
* Experience in high-security, air-gapped, or classified government environments.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**DevOps Engineer – GitGuardian Secret Remediation**

**Client:** Wells Fargo  
**Locations:** Iselin, NJ | Charlotte, NC | Chandler, AZ | Irving, TX  
**Work Model:** Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** 12+ Month Contract  
**Pay Rate:** $45–$50/hour on W-2 | $60/hour on 1099  
**Visa Eligibility:** U.S. Citizens, H-1B, H-4 EAD

**Role Overview**

We are seeking experienced DevOps engineers to support the enterprise-wide rollout of GitGuardian across Wells Fargo. In this role, you will partner directly with application development teams to triage, remediate, and prevent hardcoded secrets—including API keys, credentials, tokens, and certificates—across source code repositories and CI/CD pipelines. This is a hands-on, developer-facing position requiring both deep Git expertise and strong collaboration skills.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Triage & Validation:** Analyze historical and real-time secret alerts in GitGuardian, distinguish true positives from false positives, and assess blast radius and severity.
* **Developer Collaboration:** Partner closely with application teams to communicate security risks, guide remediation efforts, and ensure fixes do not disrupt application functionality.
* **Secret Remediation & Rotation:** Assist teams in revoking exposed credentials, rotating secrets, and migrating hardcoded values into approved secret management solutions (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault).
* **Git History Cleanup:** Safely rewrite Git commit history using tools such as git-filter-repo or BFG Repo-Cleaner when required, coordinating branch synchronization with developers throughout the process.
* **Preventative Controls:** Help engineering teams implement pre-commit hooks (ggshield) and CI/CD pipeline checks to block future secret leaks before code is merged.
* **Tracking & Reporting:** Maintain accurate remediation metrics, track SLA compliance per application team, and escalate high-risk exposures to AppSec leadership.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Git Mastery:** Deep understanding of Git internals, branching strategies, and history-rewriting tools (git-filter-repo, BFG).
* **Secret Management:** Hands-on experience integrating enterprise secret managers (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager, or HashiCorp Vault) into application code.
* **Software Development Background:** Ability to read and understand multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript/Node.js, Go, C#) to locate how secrets are used in code and configuration files.
* **CI/CD & DevOps:** Familiarity with CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
* **Communication & Stakeholder Management:** Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work empathetically and effectively with fast-moving development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience administering or triaging alerts within GitGuardian (or similar secret scanning tools such as TruffleHog or GitHub Secret Scanning).
* Background in Application Security (AppSec), DevSecOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
* Experience working in regulated enterprise environments with strict SLA and compliance tracking.

**Key Requirements at a Glance (5 Must-Haves for DevOps – GitGuardian)**

* Git expertise, including history rewriting (git-filter-repo, BFG)
* Secret manager integration (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or GCP Secret Manager)
* Multi-language code literacy (Python, Java, JavaScript/Node.js, Go, C#)
* CI/CD and DevOps tooling experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps; Docker/Kubernetes)
* Strong developer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills

Pay: $45.00 - $50.00 per hour

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, which was built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!

### **The Role**

We are seeking a hands-on AI Platform Engineer to join Cirrus Logic's centralized AI Core team. You will build, run, and scale the platform that gives every Cirrus R&D engineer one safe, governed way to use AI assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code with Cirrus tools and engineering knowledge.

The platform runs its shared services on AWS and Kubernetes: a governed AI gateway, a registry of approved skills and tools, sign-in and permissions, audit, and model access. Engineering and EDA tools keep running on-site in Cirrus CAD environments. You will own the reliability, security, and day-to-day operation of this hybrid setup and help take it from pilot to deployment across R&D.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys both infrastructure and modern AI tooling, and who wants their work used every day by hardware, software, and firmware engineers.

### **What You'll Own & Create**

* Operate and evolve the AI platform on AWS (EKS), including clusters, networking, Aurora databases, storage, and deployment pipelines.
* Manage infrastructure as code and GitOps workflows (e.g., Ansible, Helm, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) so deployments are reviewed, approved, and repeatable across environments.
* Connect the platform to on-premise VMware and Linux CAD environments so AI workflows can securely run engineering and EDA tools as the requesting engineer.
* Build and maintain MCP servers, tool integrations, and assistant plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and VS Code, and help run the shared skill and tool registry.
* Run model access: LLM gateway routing, Amazon Bedrock and commercial model APIs, and self-hosted open models where appropriate.
* Implement identity, access, and secrets: Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on (OIDC/OAuth), role-based permissions, AWS IAM, API key management, and secrets management.
* Build the observability plane: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts that diagnose agent runs and platform failures, plus audit trails of AI tool use.
* Track and control cost: token and AWS spend, usage quotas, rate limits, and budget reporting.
* Partner with IT and Security on access, networking, patching, vulnerability management, and security reviews, and support governance controls for confidential data and intellectual property.
* Support pilot users as the platform expands across R&D: onboarding, troubleshooting, documentation, and AI office hours.
* Help measure agent and workflow quality with evaluation harnesses and run tracing, and support retrieval (RAG) services used by AI workflows.

*You won't just keep servers running. You will build the foundation that lets Cirrus engineers use AI safely, reliably, and at scale.*

### **Skills You'll Bring to the Team**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, with 3+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or cloud infrastructure.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and Bash, with a focus on maintainable, tested code.
* Hands-on AWS experience (e.g., EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, Aurora, S3).
* Experience running containerized services on Kubernetes, including Docker, Helm, and day-to-day cluster operations.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD experience (e.g., Ansible or AWS CDK; Jenkins or GitHub Actions) with Git-based code review.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or Codex, and working knowledge of LLM APIs, tool calling, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid Linux system administration and networking fundamentals.
* Clear communication and the ability to work with engineers, IT, and Security across global teams.

### **Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Experience**

* **Virtualization and hybrid environments:** VMware vSphere and on-premise/cloud integration.
* **Engineering compute:** CAD/EDA tools, license servers, NFS, Perforce, and LSF or other job schedulers.
* **Identity and access:** Microsoft Entra ID, OIDC/OAuth 2.0, RBAC, and secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).
* **Observability and SRE:** OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, alerting, and incident response.
* **Model hosting and LLM gateways:** Amazon Bedrock, vLLM, GPU workloads, LiteLLM-style routing, quotas, and cost tracking.
* **Agent tooling:** building MCP servers, agent tool gateways, or plugins and extensions for AI coding assistants.
* **AI governance:** guardrails, audit logging, data access controls, and intellectual-property protection for AI tools.
* **Evaluation and retrieval:** agent evaluation harnesses, tracing (e.g., Langfuse), embeddings, and vector databases.
* Cloud cost management (FinOps) and usage reporting.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit candidates who are nationals of certain embargoed countries from working in this position without Cirrus Logic first obtaining an export license. Candidates for this role must be able to access technical data without a requirement for an export license. We are unable to sponsor or obtain export licenses for this role.

Cirrus Logic strives to select the best qualified applicant for any opening. Different approaches, ideas and points of view are both valued and respected. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by applicable law.

title: Data Engineer - Agentic AI
description:
**Role Description**
====================

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Data Engineer to embed with a government team and its technology partners building an emerging AI-powered engineering ecosystem.

This role will focus on making enterprise data usable, discoverable, governed, and accessible to AI models, agents, and mission applications. The engineer will work across data ingestion, transformation, storage, metadata, APIs, search, vector and graph technologies, and the interfaces between the data layer and AI workloads.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineer who can operate across the full data lifecycle and understands that data availability and integration are often the primary blockers to delivering AI capabilities. They should be comfortable entering an evolving architecture, learning unfamiliar systems quickly, working directly with commercial technology partners, and solving difficult problems involving data quality, lineage, access, performance, and security.

This is not a traditional analytics or business intelligence role. The focus is on building the data foundations and repeatable patterns that allow AI and agentic capabilities to access trusted data and move from prototype to production in secure and classified environments.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data for AI models, agents, and mission applications.
* Integrate structured and unstructured data sources into enterprise data services, including relational, document, vector, and graph-oriented technologies.
* Work closely with AI/agent engineers to make data discoverable and usable for RAG, semantic search, model context, and tool-enabled agent workflows.
* Develop repeatable data ingestion and transformation patterns using Python, SQL, APIs, event-driven architectures, and workflow/orchestration technologies.
* Establish data quality, validation, provenance, lineage, and metadata practices so downstream users and AI systems can trust the information they consume.
* Design data access patterns that enforce appropriate identity, authorization, classification, and security boundaries while minimizing unnecessary friction for developers and mission users.
* Collaborate with platform engineers to operationalize data services within Kubernetes/OpenShift environments and integrate them into CI/CD and GitOps workflows.
* Help integrate enterprise data capabilities such as relational stores, JSON/document data, vector search, graph data, advanced analytics, and RAG services into the broader platform architecture.
* Troubleshoot end-to-end data issues spanning source systems, pipelines, storage, APIs, identity, networking, platform services, and AI applications.
* Work directly with government engineers and commercial technology partners to resolve data dependencies and remove blockers to mission delivery.
* Develop documentation, data contracts, schemas, architecture decision records, runbooks, and operational standards that make successful patterns repeatable across environments.
* Identify recurring data engineering challenges that can be standardized, automated, or productized rather than repeatedly solved through manual engineering.
* Operate effectively in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where data sources, architectures, security requirements, and mission priorities will continue to evolve.

* Experience with relational databases and modern data storage patterns for structured and unstructured data.
* Experience integrating data through REST APIs, message/event systems, or other distributed integration patterns.
* Working knowledge of data modeling, schema design, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data governance concepts.
* Experience operating in cloud-native or containerized environments and collaborating with Kubernetes/platform engineering teams.
* Ability to troubleshoot data issues across infrastructure, applications, APIs, storage, networking, and access controls.
* Ability to work independently, rapidly learn new technologies, and translate ambiguous mission needs into working data solutions.
* **GEOINT experience is preferred, not required.**

**Preferred Experience and Qualifications**
===========================================

* Experience supporting AI/ML workloads, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, model context, or agentic applications.
* Experience with vector databases, graph databases, document databases, knowledge graphs, or semantic search technologies.
* Experience with Oracle or comparable enterprise data platforms supporting relational, JSON/document, vector, graph, and analytics workloads.
* Experience designing data products or platforms for high-scale, low-latency, or mission-critical workloads.
* Experience with data orchestration and workflow tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Argo Workflows, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with streaming/event platforms such as Kafka, Redpanda, NATS, or similar technologies.
* Experience deploying data services using Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience supporting data and AI systems in Secret or TS/SCI environments and across multiple security domains.
* Experience with disconnected or air-gapped environments and the challenges of moving data, metadata, and software across security boundaries.
* Familiarity with NIST 800-53, RMF/ATO processes, zero-trust architectures, and data security/compliance practices.

* Familiarity with UDS, Zarf, Pepr, Iron Bank, or similar secure software delivery technologies.
* Experience working on multidisciplinary teams consisting of government engineers, FDEs, OEM professional services teams, and multiple technology vendors.

**Mission Focus**

Make trusted data available where AI needs it, while establishing the repeatable, secure data patterns required to move from experimentation to operational capability.

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

description:

Fully dedicated to this newly created business, this role will work closely with Enterprise Data Intelligence, Commercial and Sales Strategy, analysts, developers, and other business power users while serving as an extension of the Americas Data Chapter. This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who can move comfortably from cloud architecture and data integration to semantic modeling, dashboard delivery, governance, and user enablement. The successful candidate will help establish scalable capabilities for a primarily non-technical business unit, balancing speed and pragmatism with Danone enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data quality, and governance standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As a key member of our team, you will play an important role in building a dependable, governed Medical Nutrition data foundation that supports growth, better decisions, operational visibility, and trusted AI.

* Integrate and harmonize healthcare, commercial, sales, digital, and eCommerce data from internal and third-party sources, including Veeva Vault, ODAIA, clearinghouse data, Shopify, APIs, files, and partner platforms.
* Design robust data models, transformation logic, metadata, lineage, observability, and data-quality controls so business users can trust and understand the information used in reporting and decision-making.
* Partner with Enterprise Data Intelligence, Commercial and Sales Strategy, analysts, developers, and functional leaders to translate business needs into scalable datasets, semantic models, self-service reporting assets, and technical roadmaps.
* Enable analysts and developers to build governed self-service reports by creating certified datasets, reusable measures, documentation, development standards, training, and appropriate role-based access patterns.
* Build and enhance Power BI dashboards and semantic models when direct delivery is needed, applying strong standards for usability, performance, security, refresh reliability, and maintainability.
* Establish practical data governance for a primarily non-technical business unit, including ownership, stewardship, access, classification, quality, retention, lineage, and change-control practices aligned with global and Americas standards.
* Provide trusted, production-ready data foundations for AI, GenAI, and agentic solutions, and contribute hands-on to solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and other approved agent platforms.
* Collaborate with the Americas Data Chapter, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, and platform teams to ensure solutions are secure, compliant, supportable, and reusable across the organization.
* Lead technical problem-solving, vendor and source-system coordination, incident resolution, automation, documentation, and continuous improvement across the Medical Nutrition data landscape.

This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods.
  
  
The employee may be required to travel to Danone corporate offices as needed.

Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. * Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data platform development, or a closely related field.

* Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, medical nutrition, CPG, commercial, sales, or regulated data is strongly preferred.
* Experience collaborating across global, regional, and business-unit teams and working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Practical experience integrating third-party healthcare and commercial platforms or datasets such as Veeva Vault, ODAIA, healthcare clearinghouses, claims or provider data, CRM, and related partner sources.

Job Duties: Communicate business concepts, technical requirements, recommendations, and code clearly and concisely. Build data transformation and pipelines in any capacity. Explore, transform, and analyze data in any type of relational database. Model new data and improve existing data products with quantitative rigor that solves customer problems and ensures correctness and interpretability. Transform and integrate raw data from multiple sources into usable, documented, and high-quality data and intelligence products by applying data modeling and statistical techniques. Work directly with product managers and cross functional stakeholders to design solutions, validation frameworks, and statistical benchmarks. Full-time telecommuting permitted from anywhere within the U.S. Required travel to company's headquarters, in Boston, Massachusetts, on a quarterly basis.

Special Skill Requirements:
  
  

* Data modeling and ingestion: Experience transforming raw data files into well-structured, documented, and modeled data assets within a database or warehouse, including designing schemas and applying sensible models so the resulting tables are reliable and reusable (1 year)

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
**OVERVIEW**

The Cloud Engineer is a full-time position and operates as a member of the Cloud Engineering Team within the IT Systems Infrastructure group. The position's role is to work collaboratively with fellow Cloud Engineering Team resources to complete various tasks throughout the service lifecycle of cloud, on-premises, and hybrid infrastructure components. These tasks include designing, implementing and documenting cloud infrastructure components, migrating on-premises systems to cloud services, maintaining the operational effectiveness of the cloud infrastructure, and optimizing performance and capabilities of the cloud infrastructure utilizing a continual service improvement model. The primary objective of these activities is to deliver value, via highly available IT Services, to the member owners of Northwest Federal Credit Union.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Work collaboratively with other IT teams, and business units to ensure the availability, reliability, and scalability of the cloud systems infrastructure
* Plan, design, and implement IaaS, PaaS and SaaS cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure
* Support project planning by developing implementation plans, milestones, risk assessments, and technical requirements, to deliver projects on-schedule, with minimal impact to both business units and members
* Collaborate with Business units and Development teams to evaluate and identify optimal cloud solutions in support of development and procurement efforts
* Acquire licensing and software in accordance with established procurement processes
* Deploy new applications and enhancements to existing applications, software, and operating systems
* Utilize a Continual Service Improvement model and leading best practices to ensure that proposed and existing cloud systems remain efficient and aligned with organizational goals
* Recommend optimizations and improvements to achieve those goals and leverage systems to their fullest
* Manage hybrid directory and identity services in Microsoft Azure and on-premises ensuring consistent and seamless experiences for users
* Manage backup and recovery solutions to meet established RTOs and RPOs
* Design and conduct business continuity tests for cloud and on-premises systems in accordance with established testing schedules
* Produce automated reports, dashboards, and metrics to aid in the monitoring of cloud systems
* Serve internal and external members by demonstrating technical leadership throughout the organization by delivering IT Solutions in a timely and effective manner
* Increase visibility into project statuses by providing regular updates which highlight incremental advances and overall progress toward meeting established commitments
* Use cloud tools to track cloud expenditures and ensure costs stay within budgetary limits
* Adhere to IT asset management policies and assist Information Security in monthly reconciliation efforts
* Complete Problem Management processes in accordance with Service Level Agreements
* Complete Request Fulfillment processes in accordance with Service Level Agreements
* Remains cognizant of and adheres to NWFCU policies and procedures as well as regulations pertaining to the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

**QUALIFICATIONS**

*Required*

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field; equivalent hands-on experience may be considered in lieu of degree
* Minimum 5 years experience with systems infrastructure planning, security principles, and general IT service management best practices
* Minimum3years' experience designing, implementing, administering, and supporting cloud systems on Microsoft Azure
  + Must have experience with hybrid cloud architectures and connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and Azure environments.
* Working knowledge of VMware virtualization technologies
* Experience installing, configuring, and maintaining Microsoft Windows server environments
* Strong working knowledge of identity management systems, Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control, privileged access, conditional access, MFA, identity lifecycle management, and hybrid identity services
* Strong organization and project management skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to work collaboratively with IT, Information Security, Network Engineering, application teams, vendors, and business stakeholders
* Strong service ownership mindset with the ability to manage incidents, service requests, changes, problems, and project deliverables in accordance with established SLAs and change management processes
* Must be able to work M-F 8-4:30 regularly, but also able to work a rotational/on-call/ad hoc schedule, including extended hours or weekends

*Preferred*

* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Google Cloud
* IT certifications such as, Microsoft Certified Azure Administration, Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent certifications on other Cloud platforms, or other IT related fields.
* Experience deploying, managing, and monitoring Microsoft Azure-based IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS services.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, alerting, dashboards, and operational reporting.
* Experience with infrastructure scripting and automation tools such as PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform, Bash, or Python.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Purview, and Defender services.
* Familiarity with the Okta platform, Microsoft EntraID, and Microsoft Intune.
* Experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow for incident, request, change, problem, asset, and configuration management.
* Experience with Cohesity and Zerto applications or other backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions, including RTO/RPO planning, recovery testing, and documentation.
* Databases and Data Platforms including Microsoft SQL server, MySQL, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos, Azure Data Factory.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or other regulatory/security frameworks.
* Familiarity with Agile project management practices and administering Azure DevOps.
* Experience mentoring team members, developing standards, and contributing to cloud architecture strategy.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Pocket**
----------------

*At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.*

Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it.

We’ve built an AI-powered device that captures real-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices.

Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring our first dedicated Data Engineer to own the data foundation behind Pocket’s product, AI systems, growth, and operations. Our data comes from a lot of places: the app database, app stores, Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, ad platforms, product analytics and finance tools. Your job is to make it all land on time, match across sources, and flag issues fast when something goes wrong. This is a hands-on role, reporting to the Data Lead.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own ingestion. Build and maintain pipelines from our app database, payment and subscription systems, commerce platforms, ad platforms, product analytics and finance tools into our warehouse.
* Own freshness and reliability. Set freshness targets for every source, monitor them, and alert when a load is late, missing or partial. Backfills should be safe and repeatable.
* Reconcile sources. Make revenue, orders, subscriptions and refunds tie out across systems that each tell a slightly different story.
* Instrument the product. Partner with engineering on event taxonomy, instrumentation standards and validation, so new features ship with metrics and monitoring from day one.
* Monitor product and AI quality. Build alerting and anomaly detection for key user journeys, regressions and AI workflows: transcription, summaries, speaker mapping and Ask Pocket.
* Build the data models that power funnel, cohort and experiment analysis.
* Document it. Keep a living data guide covering what each source is, how fresh it is, who owns it and what depends on it.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* Every source has an owner, a freshness target and an alert, and nothing goes stale for weeks unnoticed.
* Dashboard numbers tie out to the source systems, and the business trusts them.
* Every major launch ships with instrumentation and monitoring in place.
* Backfills and new sources are routine work, not fire drills.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Have 5+ years of experience in data engineering or a similar role.
* Have built and run production data pipelines, including retries, idempotent loads, backfills and schema changes.
* Are strong in SQL and Python and comfortable with analytical databases, ideally ClickHouse, Postgres or similar.
* Have pulled data from messy third-party APIs and know how to handle rate limits, pagination, delayed reports and partial data.
* Care about data quality, lineage, naming and clear metric definitions.
* Have set up monitoring and alerting for data, not just for services.
* Understand product analytics: events, funnels, cohorts, retention and experiments.
* Communicate clearly with engineering, finance and leadership, and can turn business questions into concrete metrics.
* Like owning things end-to-end at startup speed.

**Nice-to-haves**
-----------------

* Hands-on time with change-data-capture or replication tools, and with scheduling and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and transformation tools like dbt.
* Familiarity with subscription and commerce data: app stores, RevenueCat, Stripe, Shopify, Amazon.
* A background in AI products, LLM evaluation, or speech and transcription quality measurement.
* Comfortable defining metrics such as activation, retention, revenue and unit economics.
* Some exposure to experiment analysis and A/B testing.
* Forecasting work on usage, subscriptions, support volume or infrastructure load.

Compensation Range: $160K - $210K

**Job Summary:**

The Data Engineer is responsible for building the backbone of how National Gypsum uses data. This role designs and maintains the pipelines and models that move data from SAP, plant systems, and enterprise applications into the Enterprise Data Warehouse, and keeps them fast, reliable, and well governed.

This is a build-heavy role spanning ingestion, modeling, and optimization. The Data Engineer contributes to the semantic layer behind enterprise reporting, delivers the data the AI and data science team depends on, and co-builds the applications that put information in front of users when a dashboard is not enough.

**Job Responsibilities (not all inclusive):**

* **Build the Pipelines:** Design, build, and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines that ingest data from enterprise, operational, and third-party sources, and automate workflows so they run reliably without manual intervention.
* **Integrate Enterprise Sources:** Build and maintain integrations with SAP, Microsoft 365, plant systems, and other enterprise platforms, working through APIs, batch, and streaming patterns as the source requires.
