title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Data Pipeline Engineer to help build and manage the imagery data pipeline behind perception model development for a longstanding Department of War client. The platform and pipeline are new, and much of the design, process, and tooling is still being decided. The engineer will do hands-on pipeline work, provide technical oversight of the integrator and vendors building parts of the system, and act as a technical point of contact between the government team, model developers, and end users.

The program runs much like a startup. We need someone who takes ownership of problems, not someone who completes assigned tasks and stops there. When the engineer spots an issue, such as a recurring data quality problem or a broken handoff between teams, we expect them to bring together the platform’s users, the integrator, and the government team, work out a solution, and see it through with minimal oversight. The right candidate is comfortable with ambiguity and willing to put structure in place where none exists yet.

The engineer will work with a wide range of people: non-technical users, experienced model developers, vendors, government staff, other SETA contractors, and representatives of multiple military services. They need to hold their own in technical discussions with vendors and communicate clearly enough to engage senior leaders when needed.

Prior management experience is not required. This position is meant for a strong engineer who wants to grow into technical leadership. As the platform matures and the engineer earns the client’s trust, the role will shift toward overseeing vendor work, planning pipeline development, and coordinating across programs and with senior stakeholders.

**Position Responsibilities**

* Build, operate, and improve the pipelines that ingest, curate, label, and deliver EO/IR imagery and metadata to perception model developers, primarily on Databricks with supporting custom software.
* Monitor data quality across the pipeline, and trace and fix problems with ingest, formats, labeling, metadata, and lineage.
* Provide technical oversight of integrator and vendor work: review designs, code, and deliverables; push back on weak technical approaches; and give the government team an independent assessment of quality and risk.
* Find problems and gaps in the pipeline or platform without waiting for them to be assigned, and lead the effort with the government team, integrator, users, and model developers to resolve them.
* Turn operational needs from non-technical subject matter experts into data requirements and pipeline changes, and guide junior integrator engineers in implementing them.
* Coordinate with stakeholders across multiple military services, vendors, other SETA contractors, and the model development community.
* Document pipeline architecture, data standards, processes, and runbooks while the platform’s conventions are still being set.
* Write clear technical summaries, status updates, and issue papers for government leads, and over time contribute to material for senior leaders.
* Recommend improvements to tools, processes, and technical approaches as the platform matures and adds new sensor modalities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Active Secret clearance.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, information systems, engineering, or a related technical field.
* **Five or more years** of hands-on experience in data engineering, MLOps, software engineering, or a closely related technical role.
* Working proficiency with a standard data engineering stack: Python, SQL, distributed processing such as Spark, data modeling, data versioning, and pipeline orchestration.
* Experience building or operating data pipelines that support ML model development, including data curation, preparation, and labeling workflows.
* The technical depth to evaluate vendor architectures, code, and deliverables independently and to hold one’s own with experienced engineers.
* A demonstrated record of taking ownership: identifying problems outside one’s assigned scope and driving them to resolution.
* Ability to explain technical issues clearly, in writing and in person, to audiences ranging from non-technical users to senior engineers.
* Comfort working on a new platform where requirements are incomplete and priorities shift.
* Ability to work on-site in Arlington, Virginia, with travel up to 5 percent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Databricks, such as Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Workflows, or MLflow.
* Experience working with EO/IR imagery, full-motion video, or other sensor data. Familiarity with additional modalities such as SAR or LiDAR is a plus.
* Experience with computer vision or perception model development (detection, classification, tracking), and an understanding of what model developers need from training and evaluation data.
* Experience with data labeling and annotation tools and workflows.
* Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS GovCloud.
* Experience supporting Department of War, federal, or other complex multi-stakeholder environments.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery, backlog management, and writing requirements or user stories in tools such as Jira or Confluence.
* Experience overseeing contractor or vendor technical work, or leading a small technical team or effort.
* Experience at a startup or on a team standing up a new platform or capability.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive Salary
* Flexible work schedule
* Time Off: PTO, VTO, Holidays
* Full Competitive Benefits Package
* Medical/Dental/Vision Coverage
* Pre-tax FSA and HSA
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Educational Assistance
* 401K Plan with 4% Non-elective Employer Contribution
* Performance-based profit sharing
* Opportunities to volunteer and give to charities
* Employee and growth-centered culture of teamwork and shared goals

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Description:

**About Protomiq**

At Protomiq, we believe that the auto dealerships that win are the ones that create better experiences for their customers. That's why we build technology that helps dealers connect with shoppers, turn interest into action, and drive measurable business results. Thousands of dealerships across North America rely on Protomiq's solutions to engage customers, improve performance, and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving market. From independent dealerships to some of the largest dealer groups and automotive brands in the industry, Protomiq is trusted by dealerships focused on what comes next. If you're excited by innovation, customer impact, and the opportunity to help shape the future of automotive retail, you'll fit right in.

**Working at Protomiq**

At Protomiq, your work matters. We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who are passionate about helping our customers succeed. Here, you'll be empowered to move quickly, embrace new ideas, and make a visible impact on the business. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a culture built on collaboration, accountability, and growth.

**About the Role**

Location: Atlanta, GA

This role reports to the Director of IT Infrastructure & Security. The primary requirement is ownership of our DevOps process end-to-end — our ticket workflow (Jira) through our CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions) to deployment.

**Cloud Infrastructure and Migrations**

* Provision and configure cloud infrastructure from approved designs.
* Migrate applications, services, and data between hosting environments.
* Work across cloud compute, storage, networking, databases, and access management.
* Configure DNS, certificates, firewalls, and application connectivity.
* Prepare and run migration testing, cutovers, validation, and rollback plans.
* Track resource utilization, performance, and cloud spend.

**DevOps and Automation**

* Own our CI/CD pipeline end-to-end — ticket intake in Jira, build and release automation in GitHub Actions, through deployment.
* Write Bash or Python scripts that remove manual work.
* Make repeatable, reviewed infrastructure changes with Terraform or similar tools.
* Deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes, including workload configuration, scaling, and monitoring.
* Work with developers on build failures, deployment issues, and configuration drift.
* Keep development, staging, and production consistent.
* Document infrastructure, deployment processes, and operational procedures.
* Build and maintain the tooling and guardrails that let AI agents work tickets end-to-end — triaging Jira issues, generating code and tests, and opening GitHub Actions-gated pull requests for human review.

**Security and Reliability**

* Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Investigate infrastructure and application issues, and escalate when needed.
* Handle patching, backups, recovery testing, and routine maintenance.
* Apply least-privilege access, secrets management, and secure configuration practices.
* Help remediate vulnerabilities and support SOC 2 documentation.
* Apply least-privilege, scoped credentials, and audit logging to any AI agents operating in the pipeline, with mandatory human review before merge or deploy.
* Take part in production troubleshooting and follow-up improvements.

Requirements:

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years in DevOps and/or cloud administration.
* Hands-on AWS experience and a solid grasp of cloud fundamentals: compute, storage, networking, and access management.
* Comfort administering and troubleshooting Linux.
* Proven ownership of a DevOps process end-to-end — Git-based workflows, a ticket-driven process in Jira, and CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance in GitHub Actions.
* Scripting in Bash or Python.
* Experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool.
* Working knowledge of Docker and exposure to Kubernetes.
* Networking fundamentals: DNS, IP addressing, HTTP/HTTPS, and firewalls.
* Security basics: access permissions, protecting credentials, and patching.
* You ask questions, take feedback well, document your changes, and keep people informed on progress.
* Comfort using AI coding assistants/agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in real engineering workflows, not just autocomplete.

**Nice to Have**

* Deeper Kubernetes experience, including Helm and deployment configuration.
* Supporting applications on Heroku or administering Linode / Akamai Cloud.
* Working across multiple cloud providers or migrating workloads between them.
* GitLab CI or Jenkins, in addition to GitHub Actions.
* SigNoz, OpenTelemetry, or similar monitoring and logging tools.
* Heroku, Hetzner, Linode, GCP and other cloud provider experience.
* SOC 2 or other security and compliance work.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI developer workflows — ticket triage, code generation, automated test generation, or PR automation.
* Cloud or Kubernetes certifications, or a personal lab that shows your infrastructure and automation skills.

**How You'll Grow**

You'll get hands-on experience building cloud infrastructure, improving deployment automation, and running real migrations end to end. Senior leadership provides architecture, priorities, and technical review, and you'll take on more ownership as your skills develop.

description:

We are looking for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in streamlining development and operations processes. This position focuses on building and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines, automating testing and deployment workflows, and improving system observability and monitoring to ensure high availability and performance.

Responsibilities will include:

* Design, implement, and maintain efficient CI/CD pipelines to support development and operations teams.
* Enable seamless integration and delivery processes to accelerate software release cycles.
* Automate repetitive tasks, including testing, build processes, and deployment workflows.
* Leverage infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices to manage and scale infrastructure.
* Develop and enhance system monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure proactive issue identification and resolution.
* Implement observability tools to provide actionable insights into application and system performance.
* Work closely with IT, development, and operations teams to ensure smooth and secure software deployments.
* Contribute to the adoption of DevOps best practices across the organization.
* Optimize system performance, resource utilization, and application reliability.

* Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions.

* Familiarity with Ansible Playbook for application deployment and user provisioning
* Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with AWS including their managed DevOps tools and IoT Greengrass.
* Familiarity with security practices in DevOps, including vulnerability scanning and patch management.
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Certification in cloud platforms (AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, etc.).

title: Cloud Infrastructure Systems Engineer
description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Systems Engineer to design, deploy, and support enterprise cybersecurity services for cloud environments. In this role, you will deploy and configure cloud security services, integrate logging and monitoring, enforce security policies, support audits and assessments, and resolve issues affecting cloud security posture.

You will work closely with cloud architects, cybersecurity teams, and mission stakeholders to ensure that enterprise cloud platforms meet security, accreditation, and operational requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cloud Security Service Engineering**

* Deploy, configure, and maintain cloud‑native and third‑party security services (e.g., security groups, firewalls, CASB, WAF, cloud security posture management).
* Integrate identity and access management (IAM) controls, key management, and encryption services into cloud solutions.
* Support secure architecture and configuration baselines for IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS environments.

**Logging, Monitoring & Policy Enforcement**

* Integrate cloud logs and telemetry with enterprise SIEM and monitoring platforms.
* Implement and enforce cloud security policies and guardrails (e.g., configuration rules, compliance checks, resource tagging standards).
* Monitor security alerts, misconfigurations, and policy violations and coordinate remediation with application and platform teams.

**Security Posture, Audits & Assessments**

* Support security assessments, audits, and RMF/ATO activities for cloud‑hosted systems.
* Provide technical artifacts (diagrams, control descriptions, configuration evidence) to IA and compliance teams.
* Assist in continuous monitoring of cloud security posture and implementation of required corrective actions.

**Troubleshooting & Mission Support**

* Troubleshoot security‑related cloud issues (access problems, misconfigurations, failed controls, logging gaps).
* Work with developers, admins, and security analysts to resolve issues affecting cloud security and availability.
* Participate in change reviews and impact assessments for cloud security‑relevant changes.

**Documentation & Collaboration**

* Maintain documentation for cloud security architectures, configurations, and operational procedures.
* Contribute to SOPs, run books, and playbooks for cloud security operations and incident handling.
* Collaborate with network, systems, and SOC teams to ensure end‑to‑end visibility and control across hybrid environments.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education & Certification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, or related STEM field; or equivalent experience.
* Relevant cloud or security certification (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP associate/professional, Security+) or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire.

**Experience**

* 3–5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Hands‑on experience configuring and operating services in at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent).
* Experience integrating cloud platforms with enterprise security tooling (SIEM, IAM, logging/monitoring).

**Technical Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of cloud networking, IAM, encryption, and security controls.
* Familiarity with infrastructure‑as‑code or automation tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep) is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of basic cybersecurity principles and how they apply to cloud architectures.
* Awareness of relevant security frameworks and RMF/ATO requirements for cloud environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting DoD or Intelligence Community cloud programs.
* Advanced cloud or security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, AWS/Azure/GCP professional‑level).
* Experience with hybrid cloud/on‑prem integration and security.

**Why Nightwing**

* Contribute directly to mission‑critical cybersecurity operations supporting the Intelligence Community and national security objectives.
* Gain hands‑on experience with leading security monitoring, vulnerability management, and automated validation tools.
* Work alongside experienced cyber operators and engineers who are committed to mentorship, professional growth, and operational excellence.
* Engage in challenging, meaningful work where your analysis and attention to detail directly impact mission resilience and security outcomes.
* Competitive compensation with opportunities for advancement as you develop deeper expertise in detection engineering, threat hunting, and automated security validation.

**Salary & Benefits**

  
The salary associated with this position ($99,000-$206,000) is commensurate with the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, and demonstrated level of expertise. Compensation will be determined based on these factors to ensure alignment with skills, responsibilities, and market standards.

Nightwing offers medical, vision and dental insurance coverage in addition to a 401k plan, PTO, Holidays, and additional insurances.

*Nightwing is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.*

description:

description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**The opportunity**
In EY’s Office of the CTO, the Advanced Forward Engineering (AFE) team is comprised of cells of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) that are embedded with our strategic customers to ensure the best possible customer experience in using EY’s products.
  
  
We are seeking a Data Engineer to join AFE delivery pods, where AI‑native systems are deployed directly into highly regulated client environments such as tax, finance, and risk. This role is responsible for ensuring that data is accessible, governed, and production‑ready so AI solutions can be safely and reliably delivered in real‑world conditions.
  
  
Unlike traditional data engineering roles that focus on centralized platforms, the AFE Data Engineer operates within forward‑deployed pods, working directly with delivery engineers and client stakeholders to integrate enterprise AI systems with legacy data environments. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of data engineering, delivery execution, and regulatory constraints, and who can translate ambiguous data landscapes into dependable, compliant solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the data owner within an AFE delivery pod, ensuring data readiness does not block or delay delivery outcomes.
* Design and implement data ingestion, transformation, and access patterns that integrate AI systems with client and legacy data sources.
* Ensure data pipelines comply with governance, security, lineage, and access control requirements mandated by regulated environments.
* Implement data interfaces and contracts that satisfy DevOps Specification (DS) data requirements for supported deployment templates.
* Partner closely with Forward Deployed Software Engineer roles to enable AI workflows, retrieval, and analytics that are reliable in production.
* Diagnose and resolve data quality, schema drift, and integration issues encountered in real deployment scenarios.
* Contribute reusable data patterns and implementation learnings back to the AFE integration core to improve repeatability across pods.
* Support validation, testing, and deployment activities to ensure data flows behave correctly and consistently across environments (dev, test, pre‑prod, prod).

* Experience working under data governance, security, or compliance constraints.

* Experience supporting AI, ML, or analytics‑driven applications in production.

The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $128,400 to $200,600. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. title: Data Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Data Engineer is responsible for building the backbone of how National Gypsum uses data. This role designs and maintains the pipelines and models that move data from SAP, plant systems, and enterprise applications into the Enterprise Data Warehouse, and keeps them fast, reliable, and well governed.

This is a build-heavy role spanning ingestion, modeling, and optimization. The Data Engineer contributes to the semantic layer behind enterprise reporting, delivers the data the AI and data science team depends on, and co-builds the applications that put information in front of users when a dashboard is not enough.

**Job Responsibilities (not all inclusive):**

* **Build the Pipelines:**
  Design, build, and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines that ingest data from enterprise, operational, and third-party sources, and automate workflows so they run reliably without manual intervention.
* **Integrate Enterprise Sources:**
  Build and maintain integrations with SAP, Microsoft 365, plant systems, and other enterprise platforms, working through APIs, batch, and streaming patterns as the source requires.
* **Model the Data:**
  Develop and maintain layered data models across raw, curated, and presentation zones, applying dimensional modeling, warehousing, and lakehouse design practices along with the team's naming and modeling standards.
* **Build the Semantic Layer:**
  Contribute to the certified datasets, Power BI semantic models, and KPI definitions that reporting depends on, so business users work from a single trusted definition.
* **Deliver AI-Ready Data:**
  Build the feature pipelines, training datasets, and vector and search assets that models and agents consume, in partnership with the AI, Data Science & Analytics team.
* **Co-Build Data Applications:**
  Build alongside the AI team on data applications in Streamlit, React, and other approved frameworks, and stand up the compute, deployment, and data access patterns they run on.
* **Optimize Performance and Cost:**
  Tune SQL, warehouse sizing, partitioning, caching, and compression so the platform stays fast and spend stays predictable as volume grows.
* **Safeguard Data Quality:**
  Build validation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation into ingestion pipelines, and maintain lineage and documentation in partnership with the Data Governance and Application Security team.
* **Keep It Running:**
  Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, drive root-cause analysis, and apply CI/CD and environment promotion practices across dev, test, and production.
* **Partner Across IT and the Business:**
  Work with application owners, plant systems teams, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and turn them into durable models and pipelines rather than one-off extracts.
* Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3 to 6 years of hands-on data engineering experience building and operating production pipelines on a cloud data platform.
* Strong SQL, with hands-on experience in Snowflake or a comparable modern cloud data platform.
* Working proficiency in Python for data transformation, automation, and pipeline development.
* Experience with ETL and ELT tooling and orchestration frameworks such as Azure Data Factory, dbt, or Airflow.
* Solid grounding in data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, and normalization.
* Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of data quality, lineage, and access governance practices.
* Clear communicator able to work with both technical teammates and business stakeholders.
* Preferred: Experience integrating SAP source systems, particularly order-to-cash, master data, or finance and logistics structures.
* Preferred: Databricks experience, including Spark-based transformation or lakehouse patterns, and Snowpark, Snowflake Cortex, or dynamic table experience.
* Preferred: Power BI semantic modeling and DAX experience.
* Preferred: Experience building or deploying data applications in Streamlit, React, or similar frameworks.
* Preferred: Cloud or platform certification such as SnowPro or Azure Data Engineer Associate.
* Preferred: Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial operations data.
* Eligible for hybrid work (the hybrid work schedule is provisional and may be modified, based on business needs)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Title: DevOps Engineer**

**Type: Full-time employee**

**Location: Houston, TX-Hybrid**

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to build and run the pipelines, automation, and environments that our application, integration, and data teams depend on. You will spend your days in Terraform, Azure DevOps, and the Azure portal - provisioning environments, fixing pipelines, chasing down drift, and making deployments boring and repeatable.

This role is for someone who likes being close to the systems. You will take the standards and patterns the team defines and turn them into working code, then improve them based on what actually breaks. You will also be a first point of contact when a deployment fails, an environment misbehaves, or a team needs a new sandbox stood up quickly.

You will work alongside engineers responsible for servers, networking, security, and cloud platforms, and you will regularly coordinate with application teams and delivery partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for application, integration, and infrastructure workloads.
* Write and maintain Terraform code to provision and update cloud resources, and import resources created outside of code so the definition stays accurate.
* Stand up and refresh development, UAT, and production environments from code, including configuration, connections, and environment variables.
* Run and act on drift detection, keeping deployed state and committed code aligned and raising exceptions when they diverge.
* Implement secrets and identity handling correctly - Key Vault references, managed identities, and no hard-coded credentials.
* Support release activity: promotions, approvals, rollback, and post-deployment verification, including participation in an on-call or escalation rotation.
* Add automated testing, validation, and security scanning steps into pipelines and help teams resolve what those steps surface.
* Automate repetitive operational work with PowerShell or Python where a pipeline is not the right tool.
* Document what you build - pipeline usage, module inputs, environment layouts, and runbooks - so the work is supportable by others.
* Provide practical guidance to application teams and partners on how to onboard to the standard pipelines and modules.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years in a DevOps, platform, cloud, or systems engineering role with direct responsibility for build and deployment automation.
* Working Terraform experience: writing modules, managing state, planning and applying changes safely against live environments.
* Hands-on Azure experience across resource groups, networking basics, storage, Key Vault, App Services or Functions, and role assignments.
* Practical Azure DevOps (or GitHub Actions / GitLab CI) skills including YAML pipelines, variable groups, service connections, and release approvals.
* Solid Git fundamentals - branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution, and repository hygiene.
* Scripting proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Comfortable troubleshooting across the stack: is it the code, the pipeline, the identity, the network, or the resource?
* Clear written communication and a habit of documenting as you go.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure integration services (Logic Apps, Function Apps, API Management, Data Factory) deployed from source control.
* Exposure to containers, Kubernetes or OpenShift, and container registries.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling and with wiring alerts into deployment workflows.
* Experience supporting e-commerce or customer-facing production workloads with real release pressure.
* Understanding of change management practice and audit or compliance evidence requirements.
* Certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

title: Junior Python Developer

The teams support development of secure AI-assisted applications and services, including large language model (LLM) integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI workflows, OpenAI-compatible APIs, data transformation services, and user-facing analytic tools. * Familiarity with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, or cloud-native deployment concepts.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Additional desired experience:**

This position requires interaction with government customers, technical staff, and team members with varying levels of technical expertise. This hands-on role connects enterprise systems and translates operational, customer, membership, sales, and financial data into practical insights.
  
  
Working with technology and business partners across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and HR, this role supports both the data foundation and the analysis built on it—from source integration and transformation to dashboards, business questions, and recurring reporting.
  
  
At this level, success is measured by dependable data pipelines, accurate and consistent reporting, fewer manual reporting steps, and insights that business partners can understand and use.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Data Engineering & Integration**

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines that bring together POS, membership, CRM, ERP, HRIS, and other enterprise data sources.
* Develop SQL transformations and reusable data models that support operational, customer, and financial analysis.
* Use APIs, file-based integrations, and ETL/ELT processes to move data reliably between source systems and reporting platforms.
* Monitor pipeline health, investigate failures, and document dependencies, refresh schedules, and recovery procedures.

**Analytics & Business Insights**

* Partner with business teams to clarify questions, define reporting requirements, and translate needs into actionable analysis.
* Analyze site performance, membership trends, customer retention, pricing, and sales to identify patterns and opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports, and self-service datasets with clear metric definitions.
* Explain findings, assumptions, and data limitations in practical terms for nontechnical stakeholders.

**Data Quality, Governance & Documentation**

* Validate source data, reconcile reporting outputs, and investigate discrepancies with system owners and business partners.
* Create automated quality checks for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness.
* Maintain documentation for data models, transformations, source mappings, metric definitions, and reporting logic.
* Follow established access controls, data handling standards, and governance practices when working with sensitive information.

**Automation & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Automate repeatable reporting and data preparation tasks to reduce manual work and improve consistency.
* Support system implementations and acquisition integrations through data mapping, migration validation, and reporting continuity.
* Use version control, testing, and change documentation to make data solutions maintainable and dependable.
* Balance engineering maintenance and analysis requests with technology and business partners, communicating priorities, dependencies, and delivery expectations.

**Where you Lead, Shape & Escalate**
**Lead**
Assigned data pipelines, transformations, data quality checks, dashboards, recurring reporting, technical documentation, and analytical deliverables.
  
  
**Shape**
Metric definitions, reusable data models, reporting requirements, automation opportunities, self-service analytics, and improvements to data reliability and usability.
  
  
**Escalate**
Source-system limitations, unresolved data discrepancies, pipeline failures, sensitive-data access concerns, conflicting metric definitions, and delivery dependencies that could affect reporting accuracy or business decisions.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
**We are looking for a hands-on data professional who can build dependable data solutions and explain what the numbers mean for the business.**

* Practical experience in data analysis, data engineering, business intelligence, or a blended role spanning these disciplines.
* Strong SQL skills, including querying, joining, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting data across multiple sources.
* Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines, relational data models, and datasets in a cloud data warehouse or comparable environment.
* Proficiency with a scripting language such as Python for data preparation, integration, automation, and quality checks.
* Experience developing dashboards and reports in a business intelligence platform and translating business questions into clear visualizations.
* Working knowledge of APIs, data integration patterns, version control, testing, and technical documentation.
* Ability to investigate data issues, reconcile conflicting results, and communicate findings and limitations clearly.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate with technical teams and nontechnical business partners.
* Experience with multi-site, consumer-facing, retail, service, or subscription-based businesses is preferred.
* Familiarity with POS, membership, CRM, ERP, HRIS, or operational data is a plus.

**The best data professionals do more than deliver a dataset or dashboard. They connect trustworthy data with the decisions that move the business forward.**
Base Pay Range
  
  
$90,000.00 - $175,000.00

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Level Access is hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer 

to own the data products that power trusted reporting, business decisions and AI experiences at Level. With an initial focus on GTM and revenue

, y

ou will translate commercial data into reliable models, certified metrics and a governed semantic layer that people and AI agents can use consistently.

 

You will work directly with senior leaders and data champions across the company. Our Senior Data Engineer owns the Databricks platform, ETL pipelines and operations. Your focus is the analytics layer: business modeling in dbt, metric implementation, semantic definitions and business-facing data products. You will partner closely on source requirements and upstream issues.

 

**What you will do**

 

You own the path from raw commercial data to certified metrics and KPIs that a person or an AI agent can act on.

 

* ****Own commercial data models****
  **.**

  Design, build and maintain dbt models on Databricks for go-to-market and revenue data. Start with pipeline, bookings and subscriptions, then expand into other business domains as the company grows.

* ****Turn business definitions into certified metrics.****

  Own the full catalog of go-to-market, revenue and customer metrics, from bookings and retention to pipeline, forecast, customer health and efficiency. Work with business leaders to drive alignment across each definition and its edge cases. Add new metrics as the business asks new questions.

* ****Maintain the semantic layer****
  **.**

  Build and maintain Databricks metric views, the data dictionary and model documentation in Unity Catalog, so every certified metric has one definition used everywhere.

* ****Make commercial data AI-ready.****

  Curate the catalog, descriptions and verified queries the AI agent reads over MCP and maintain a revenue regression question set that measures agent accuracy as models change.

* ****Protect data quality.****

  Apply dbt model contracts and tests to certified models. Define freshness, volume and anomaly checks, maintain model lineage and work with the Senior Data Engineer to resolve upstream issues.

* ****Enable predictive analytics.****

  Supply governed revenue, contract and subscription features to machine learning models, alerts and AI agents.

* ****Deliver business-facing analytics****
  **.**

  O

  wn GTM and revenue forecasting datasets and BI feeds. Translate stakeholder questions into reusable data products and prioritize work with business partners.

* ****Raise engineering standards.****

  Review dbt code, establish modeling conventions and mentor peers. Use AI-assisted tools for SQL, tests, and documentation while holding generated work to production standards.

**What you bring**

 

These are required. We are hiring for depth in modeling and business judgment.

 

* ****Production modeling.****

  5+ years building production data models in analytics or data engineering, ideally with a GTM, RevOps or SaaS revenue focus, including at least 3 years in dbt: incremental models, snapshots, macros, tests, documentation and CI with state-based deferred builds.

* ****Strong SQL****

  . Databricks and Delta experience is preferred; Snowflake or BigQuery experience transfers.

* ****Salesforce fluency.****

  Hands-on knowledge of the Salesforce data model, including accounts, opportunities, opportunity line items, contracts, assets or entitlements, quotes and subscriptions, and field history.

* ****SaaS revenue metrics.****

  Able to define and defend ARR and MRR, bookings, renewals, expansion, churn and downsell, net and gross revenue retention, and how double counting happens.

* ****Metric ownership.****

  Documented business definitions, resolved conflicting numbers across teams, and secured stakeholder approval before publishing metrics.

* ****Data quality discipline****

  .

  Experience with model contracts, reconciliation, testing strategies and freshness or anomaly monitoring for production analytics models

  .

* ****Engineering discipline.****

  Git, code review, pull requests, CI and promotion through environments, and a habit of validating AI-generated code before it ships.

* ****Clear communication.****

  Able to explain modeling decisions and tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders and turn ambiguous questions into agreed requirements.

 

**Nice to have**

 

* ****Unity Catalog governance.****

  Governed tags, attribute-based access control (ABAC) column masks, and lineage.

* ****CI/CD for Databricks.****

  Declarative Automation Bundles and Git-based deployment workflows
  **.**

* ****Semantic layers.****

  dbt Semantic Layer (MetricFlow), Cube, Looker (LookML), or Databricks metric views.

* ****Agent-facing data tools.****

  MCP servers, verified queries, and agent evaluation datasets
  **.**

* ****Feature engineering.****

  Model-ready features for churn or propensity models.

  Power BI or Databricks AI/BI dashboards.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

You'll turn raw game, player, and business data into clean, well-modeled summary tables, write the analysis yourself, and build the Tableau dashboards that teams across the company use to make decisions.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role that sits across data engineering, analytics, and AI. We're looking for someone who uses AI tools as a core part of how they work, building workflows that let one engineer support several projects at once without sacrificing quality. You'll set the standard for how data is modeled, documented, and used.

**Data Modeling & Transformation**

* Design and build the data layer between raw source tables and our analysts, from staging to cleaned to summarized tables.
* Build and maintain dbt models with tests, documentation, and clear naming, so anyone can find and trust the right table.
* Define core business and player metrics once, so every report and dashboard counts the same way.
* Monitor data quality and pipeline health, and fix issues before they reach a decision-maker.

**Analytics & Insights**

* Write SQL to answer business questions end to end, from scoping the question to presenting the findings.
* Partner with product, marketing, live operations, and leadership to turn open-ended requests into clear metrics and deliverables.
* Review other analysts' queries and guide them to the right tables and methods.

**Dashboards & Reporting**

* Build and maintain Tableau dashboards that teams use to run the business day to day.
* Design dashboards for non-technical audiences: clear, fast, and focused on the decisions they support.
* Audit existing reporting, consolidate duplicates, and retire dashboards that are no longer used.

**AI-Enabled Workflows & Scale**

* Use AI tools daily to write, review, and debug SQL, dbt models, and Python faster and with fewer errors.
* Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows, such as auto-generated documentation, data quality checks, and first-draft analyses.
* Identify routine reporting work that AI can take on, and put those solutions into production.
* Set practical guardrails for AI use, including output review and protection of sensitive data, and share what works with the team.

Qualifications

**Required**

* 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, with hands-on experience in both data modeling and analysis.
* Experience in the games industry, especially with player telemetry, live-service, or monetization data.
* Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, performance tuning, and modeling large, messy source data.
* Production experience with dbt: models, tests, sources, macros, and documentation.
* Strong Python for data work, such as pandas, automation, and pulling data from APIs.
* Deep Tableau experience, including data sources, calculated fields, LOD expressions, and dashboards built for non-technical users.
* Solid grounding in dimensional modeling (facts, dimensions, grain).
* A proven track record of using AI tools to speed up real data work, with examples you can walk us through.
* Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs or AI agents, beyond chat-based use.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with MMOs and shooters, as a player or from working on them.
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks.

**Who You Are**

* You're a builder and an analyst. You enjoy designing the table as much as answering the question it was built for.
* You're always looking for leverage. When a task repeats, you automate it, and AI is one of the first tools you reach for.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined question and turn it into a clear plan and a useful answer.
* You care about trust. You'd rather ship one metric everyone believes than five that conflict.
* You're a strong communicator. You can explain a technical tradeoff to an engineer and a business result to an executive.

**Location & Work Environment**

This position is based full-time in Irvine, CA.

title: Senior Data Engineer Tech Foundations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

 Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations 

 The Community You Will Join 

 At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

 Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

 You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

 The Difference You Will Make 

 As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

 You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

 Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will build reusable components that simplify source onboarding and reduce duplicated logic. Through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, you will help strengthen the team’s engineering practices and contribute to Airbnb’s broader data community.

 A Typical Day 

- Design, build, and operate high-impact data pipelines across AI usage and cost, Unit Economics, enterprise applications, and critical financial metrics.

- Partner with stakeholders to clarify how AI adoption, consumption, and spending are measured, and implement consistent data models that support those definitions.

- Evolve Unit Economics datasets to connect revenue and diverse cost drivers, enabling teams to understand product profitability and resource efficiency.

- Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications.

- Translate complex requirements into clear source contracts, reusable fact and dimension models, and practical technical designs.

- Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements.

- Implement automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability.

- Plan and execute safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning.

- Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs.

- Own production reliability for your datasets and pipelines through on-call participation, incident response, and improvements to systems and runbooks.

- Contribute to technical planning and design reviews, mentor fellow engineers, and improve Airbnb’s Data Engineering Paved Path.

 Your Expertise 

- 5+ years of relevant industry experience, with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- A track record of independently delivering complex data engineering projects, from requirements and technical design through implementation and sustained production ownership.

- Strong expertise in SQL and programming skills in Python or Scala, with experience building maintainable, well-tested data systems.

- Hands-on experience with distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark and large-scale analytical storage systems.

- Strong data modeling skills, including fact and dimension design, slowly changing dimensions, incremental processing, and historical data management.

- Experience integrating heterogeneous sources, including APIs, enterprise applications, event data, and transactional systems, while managing schema changes and source reliability.

- Proven ability to build reliable pipelines and execute migrations and backfills while preserving correctness and downstream compatibility.

- Experience implementing data quality controls, observability, lineage, and governance practices, and troubleshooting production data issues.

- The ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and optimize distributed computation, storage, and query execution.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements with business partners, explain technical tradeoffs, and coordinate delivery across teams.

- Experience contributing to design and code reviews, sharing knowledge, and supporting the development of other engineers.

- Curiosity and sound judgment when learning new domains and balancing delivery needs with long-term system health.

 Experience with AI usage or cost measurement, cloud cost attribution, Unit Economics, enterprise application data, or financial and payments datasets is a plus. Familiarity with workflow orchestration, SQL transformation frameworks, and modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg is also valuable.

 Your Location

This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

 A day in the life (Responsibilities)

title: Software Engineer, Big Data Infrastructure
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.






ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling's mission is to unlock the power of biotechnology. The world's most innovative biotech companies use Benchling's R&D Cloud to power the development of breakthrough products and accelerate time to milestone and market. Benchling's customers generate a rich and variety of science data. To keep up our innovation, Benchling need a highly scalable and extensible data platform that can serve both its customers and internal application team.

As one of Benchling’s Data Platform engineers, you’ll join a rapidly growing, premier engineering team and form the foundation of our data pillar, encompassing customer-facing data products, internal analytics, and the customer-facing data warehouse. The Big Data Infrastructure team is responsible for enabling customers access to their Benchling data for analytics & AI. You will build the next generation of Data Platform services that enables ingress and egress data access so that Benchling can seamlessly integrate with customer data lakes. Benchling is growing really quickly, and you’ll be setting the bar for high quality data and a metrics-driven culture as we scale. You’ll serve as a key input and thought leader, and work closely with the product teams to deliver data driven capabilities to our internal and external customers.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build next generation Data Platform with scalable data ingress/egress for internal and external customers

 - Define and design data transformations and pipelines for cross-functional datasets, while ensuring that data integrity and data privacy are first-class concerns regarded proactively, instead of reactively

 - Define the right Service Level Objectives for the batch & streaming pipelines, and optimize their performance

 - Designing and creating CI/CD pipelines for platform provisioning, full lifecycle management. Building the platform control panel to operate the fleet of systems efficiently

 - Work closely with the team across Application and Platform to establish best practices around usage of our data platform

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 

 - 1+ years of professional software engineering experience

 - A prior software engineering internship

 - Strong abilities in problem solving and iterating on feedback.

 - A desire to have ownership over building key pieces of product and/or platform.

 - Build software with a product-first approach. You ship code quickly and care about the real world impact of your code.

 - Strong experience with scripting language (such as Python)

 - Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform, Ansible, or Chef and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS

 - Driven by creating positive impact for our customers and Benchling's business, and ultimately accelerating the pace of research in the Life Sciences

 - Comfortable with complexity in the short term but can build towards simplicity in the long term

 - Strong communicator with both words and data - you understand what it takes to go from raw data to something a human understands

 - Willing to work onsite in our SF office 3 days a week

 - Experience with data analytics and warehouse solutions (e.g. Snowflake, Delta Lake), data processing technologies (e.g. Kafka, Spark), schema design, and SQL are a plus!

 


HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

We are an equal opportunity employer. Benchling is building AI & Data Engineering (AIDE), a small, autonomous team within our Security & IT organization. AIDE owns two things: the internal AI capabilities and adoption so Benchlings can rapidly experiment and discover what works; and the source-of-truth data & analytics infrastructure the company depends on. AIDE’s data and analytics functions grew out of our former Data, Analytics & Science  (DAS) team, and this role carries forward DAS's original charter: building and running the data pipelines, warehouse, and analytics infrastructure that the entire company relies on for trustworthy answers.

This is a data engineering role — we want someone who builds and operates reliable, production-grade data pipelines and warehouse infrastructure, not a data scientist focused on modeling or analysis.

This role exists because AIDE's data function supports the whole company — GTM, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and beyond — not just one team, and the team needs to grow to support these initiatives as we expand the team’s scope and portfolio. You'll own core pipelines end to end (ingestion, transformation, warehouse, and the BI/analytics layer on top), partner with the rest of the data team on the team's data architecture, and help build the trusted data foundation that AIDE's AI-adoption and agentic AI work increasingly depends on.

This is infrastructure the rest of the company builds on, not a one-off project.

 - Build the data foundation for AIDE's AI initiatives: Partner with AIDE's AI engineering side to make governed, trustworthy data available for the agentic AI tooling and internal AI applications the team ships.

 - Own data governance and pipeline health: Maintain Snowflake access controls (RBAC), monitor data quality, uphold PII-handling and data-access policy, and manage warehouse cost and performance as usage grows.

 - Contribute to platform strategy: Weigh in on bigger structural decisions — warehouse architecture, semantic layer/metrics store design— alongside the rest of the data and AI engineering team.

 - Comfort with orchestration tooling (Airflow or similar) for scheduled data jobs.

 - Track record supporting many stakeholders across departments such as Sales, CS, Product, Finance, rather than a single internal customer.

 - Understanding of data privacy, governance, quality, and testing frameworks and best practices.

 - Strong communication skills; comfortable translating ambiguous requests from non-technical stakeholders into a scoped, buildable data solution.

 - Comfortable in a small, fast-moving, still-forming team — AIDE only stood up in its current form in mid-2026 and is actively defining its own processes.

 - Interest in learning more about life science (prior knowledge is not required).



NICE TO HAVE

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Transflo is a leading provider of mobile, telematics, and business process automation software for the transportation and logistics industry. Our solutions help freight carriers, brokers, and shippers automate and streamline their operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. We are on a mission to drive innovation in the industry by providing cutting-edge SaaS and AI solutions that enable seamless communication and collaboration across the supply chain.

**DESCRIPTION:**
================

Transflo is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to build our enterprise data platform — from raw ingestion through curated, analytics-ready data products. You will be a key engineer designing our data warehouse, data pipeline infrastructure, and the bronze-silver-gold medallion architecture that serves internal analytics teams, operational reporting, and our growing Transflo Intelligence Suite.

This role demands both deep technical expertise and a strategic mindset. You will work across a wide range of internal and external data sources including APIs, relational databases, NoSQL stores, file-based feeds, and streaming data. The work will include normalizing and modeling data into reliable, governed, and high-performance analytical assets. You will build and scale systems designed for near real-time data environments supporting high-traffic, mission-critical workloads in the transportation and logistics industry.

**CORE AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:**
=================================

* Architect, build, and evolve a scalable enterprise data warehouse on Amazon Redshift, applying industry-standard concepts including star schemas, snowflake schemas, and normalization.
* Design and implement bronze, silver, and gold data layer architecture (medallion architecture): raw ingestion, cleansed and standardized intermediate layers, and curated analytics products.
* Develop dimensional data models, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions (SCDs), and aggregate structures that support BI tooling, ad-hoc analytics, and other downstream systems.
* Build, own, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines that ingest data from disparate source systems including APIs, flat files, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, Amazon DynamoDB, etc.
* Implement real-time and near real-time data streaming architectures using AWS-native services such as Kinesis Data Streams, Kinesis Firehose, MSK (Managed Kafka), and EventBridge.
* Design pipeline frameworks for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) using tools such as AWS Glue, dbt, Apache Airflow, or equivalent orchestration platforms
* Ensure pipeline reliability, idempotency, fault tolerance, and automated recovery; build alerting and observability into every data workflow from day one

* Own data quality: design and implement automated profiling, cleansing, deduplication, standardization, and validation frameworks that enforce data integrity
* Build and continuously evolve tooling and processes to support data governance including data cataloging, lineage tracking, metadata management, access controls, and data classification
* Define and enforce data contracts between source systems and the warehouse, establishing clear SLAs for freshness, completeness, and accuracy
* Partner with data consumers (*e.g.,* Data scientists, Data analytics engineers, BI developers, and product managers) to understand consumption patterns and ensure data products meet quality and performance expectations
* Contribute to the data platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform), ensuring all data infrastructure is version-controlled, reproducible, and auditable
* Design for scale: apply partitioning strategies, workload management (WLM) tuning, concurrency scaling, and caching patterns to sustain performance under high-traffic workloads
* Champion security and compliance best practices across the data platform: column-level security, row-level access controls, encryption, and audit logging
* Collaborate with software engineers, mobile platform teams, and DevOps to ensure upstream application data is well-structured, well-documented, and reliably delivered to the data platform
* Leverage AI-assisted development practices and tooling to accelerate pipeline development, automate data quality checks, and improve engineering velocity

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:**
========================

* 5+ years of professional data engineering experience with a track record of building and operating production-grade data warehouses and pipeline infrastructure
* Expert-level experience with Amazon Redshift including cluster sizing, WLM configuration, distribution and sort key optimization, vacuuming, and query plan analysis
* Deep proficiency in SQL for complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures, and performance tuning across Redshift and ANSI-compatible engines
* Hands-on experience ingesting data from source systems: APIs, IBM DB2, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, Amazon DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, and file-based sources (CSV, JSON, Parquet, Avro, etc.)
* Proven experience designing and implementing medallion or equivalent layered data architectures
* Strong working knowledge of star schema and snowflake schema design, dimensional modeling theory, slowly changing dimensions, and fact table granularity decisions
* Proficiency with ETL/ELT tools such as AWS Glue, dbt, Apache Airflow, or AWS Step Functions
* Demonstrated experience implementing data governance practices: data catalogs (AWS Glue Data Catalog or equivalent), lineage, metadata tagging, and access control frameworks
* Infrastructure-as-code experience (ideally Terraform) for provisioning and managing infrastructure
* Strong Python skills for pipeline development, data transformation logic, and automation scripting
* Deep understanding of data reliability engineering: idempotency, exactly-once processing, late-arriving data handling, schema evolution, and SLA-driven pipeline design

**ADDITIONAL SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:**
=================================

* Experience building real-time data pipelines using streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka
* Experience in the transportation, logistics, trucking, or fleet management industry
* Knowledge of columnar storage formats (Parquet, ORC) and lakehouse patterns using Amazon S3 as a data lake layer in conjunction with Redshift Spectrum, Amazon Athena, and/or AWS Glue
* Familiarity with BI and analytics consumption tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Amazon QuickSight.
* Experience working in fully remote, distributed engineering teams

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
GM Performance Power Units - Concord, NC
  
Data Platform Engineer - Onsite
  
Job Summary
  
The Data Platform Engineer will develop, maintain and improve GMPPU’s enterprise data capabilities across business and manufacturing operations. The role is focused on hands-on delivery: engineering reliable data pipelines, developing Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, supporting agreed system data exchanges, and turning changing business requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
  
Working with the Business Systems Lead, application owners, software engineering, business analysts and functional stakeholders, the engineer will translate architectural direction into operational capability. This role is intended to provide dedicated engineering capacity so that enterprise architecture, strategic planning and stakeholder governance can remain with the Business Systems Lead.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Develop and operate Microsoft Fabric and OneLake capabilities for business, manufacturing and finance data, including lakehouses, pipelines, notebooks and appropriate data processing services.
* Build, test and maintain ingestion, transformation and publishing pipelines; implement reusable patterns and curated datasets for reporting, analytics and operational use.
* Apply data modelling, orchestration, scheduling, error handling, reconciliation and performance optimisation to production data workflows.
* Implement source control, deployment processes, monitoring, alerting, documentation and appropriate automated tests for platform changes.
* Support secure access, environment configuration, capacity usage and cost awareness in collaboration with platform and security teams.
* Engineer agreed data exchanges across ERP, PLM, MES and component lifecycle systems, including IFS, Teamcenter and RVG, in collaboration with system owners and the relevant integration/software engineering teams.
* Translate interface requirements and source-to-target mappings into robust data extraction, validation and transformation processes, using approved APIs, events, connectors or scheduled transfers as appropriate.
* Diagnose data flow failures, identify root causes and improve resilience, observability and supportability; escalate application-side issues to the accountable owners.
* Support defined data exchange with specialist platforms, including Databricks and AWS, where business requirements justify it; avoid unnecessary duplication of datasets and processing.
* Implement agreed data definitions, quality rules, lineage and reconciliation controls with business data owners and stewards.
* Maintain technical data documentation, including mappings, pipeline specifications, dependencies and interface details, aligned with the enterprise data dictionary and architecture repository.
* Apply enterprise standards for authoritative sources, access, security, change control and reusable engineering patterns.
* Provide technical options, estimates and implementation advice to the Business Systems Lead; contribute to designs without owning overall enterprise architecture or business data policy.
* Work directly with manufacturing, engineering, operations and finance stakeholders to understand emerging data needs and turn prioritised requirements into deliverable solutions.
* Enable reliable data provision for Power BI and other approved consumption tools, working alongside reporting specialists rather than becoming the default report developer.
* Improve existing manual data handling through automation and support testing, release, handover and continuous improvement of delivered solutions.
* Balance new development with platform reliability, documentation and operational support.

Required Qualifications
  

* Hands-on experience engineering data pipelines and operating cloud-based data platforms in a production environment.
* Strong SQL and practical Python skills, with experience in data transformation, modelling and troubleshooting.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure data services or Microsoft Fabric; ability to learn and apply Fabric rapidly where direct experience is limited.
* Understanding of APIs, databases, integration patterns, data quality, access controls and data lifecycle management.
* Experience using version control, testing, monitoring and structured deployment practices.
* Ability to work independently with technical and non-technical stakeholders, explain trade-offs and document maintainable solutions.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Data Factory, lakehouses, notebooks and Power BI semantic model integration.
* ERP, PLM or MES data environments; familiarity with IFS, Siemens Teamcenter, RVG or equivalent enterprise applications.
* Manufacturing data concepts such as part masters, bills of materials, serialization, as-built records, traceability and component lifecycle.
* Dell Boomi or equivalent integration tooling; Databricks and AWS data exchange experience.
* Automotive, motorsport or advanced manufacturing experience in a fast-changing delivery environment.

Success Measures
  

* Become familiar with the existing business/manufacturing systems, current Fabric estate, key datasets and priority data flows.
* Build or improve prioritised production data pipelines and reusable data processing patterns in Fabric.
* Introduce practical monitoring, testing, documentation and support arrangements for the engineer’s delivered services.
* Implement agreed quality and reconciliation controls for priority data elements and interfaces.
* Deliver a small number of agreed business use cases end-to-end with stakeholders, with demonstrable reliability and handover.

Role Boundaries & Collaboration
  
The Business Systems Lead retains accountability for enterprise architecture, strategic platform direction, prioritization and stakeholder governance. Application owners retain accountability for their operational systems and transactional business processes. System-to-system integration ownership will be agreed by interface with the relevant software engineering and integration teams; this role contributes to technical engineering and delivery rather than assuming blanket ownership of all integrations. Business data owners and stewards remain accountable for definitions and data quality expectations.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
Ready to be part of a team that pushes boundaries both on and off the track? At GM Performance Power Units, we are developing a new era of performance for the Formula 1 grid. Joining us means entering a startup racing environment backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, giving you the rare opportunity to help build a world-class program from day one. We believe in rewarding innovation and powering potential. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a competitive and comprehensive package designed to support your performance, well-being, and future, helping you thrive at every level.
  
  
**That includes access to:**  

* Bonus scheme
* Private healthcare
* 401(k) plan including company match
* Employer-paid life insurance and disability coverage
* 32 days annual leave (including holidays)
* Free financial advisor access
* Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
* Subsidized on-site dining
* On-site gym
* Discounted GM vehicle purchase/lease program
* Free on-site EV charging for personal GM vehicles

It’s all part of our commitment to creating a workplace that’s as high-performing and forward-thinking as the people who make it succeed.
  
Join us and help power what’s next.
  
You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and performance of a next-generation Formula 1 power unit. Our culture rewards precision, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of performance.
  
**Please note:** GM Performance Power Units and all affiliated companies are Equal Opportunity employer(s). Minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. For more information regarding the EEOC, please visit https://www.ee

The Data Quality Engineer (DQE) is responsible for the design, implementation and administration of a centralized data quality program that optimizes the health and reliability of data across the organization. The DQE works cross-functionally to uncover and deeply understand data quality challenges and develops frameworks, toolsets, processes, and sustainable best practices to solve those challenges. The DQE plays a vital role in making data fit for use so it can be trusted to drive intelligent decision making and fuel meaningful business innovation.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Defines and administers the data quality standards, processes, workflows, and best practices that ensure data is fit for consumption and meets the needs of data consumers across the organization
* Performs data profiling to develop a deep understanding of the structure, content, and storage of data to identify opportunities to improve the quality of data, data transformation (ETL), data models and metadata
* Identifies data stakeholders across the organization and seeks to understand the input and output requirements of the business processes they support
* Gathers and synthesizes data from disparate systems and sources to identify data quality issues; continuously researches and identifies the root cause of data quality issues and implements remediation and improvement plans to prevent issues from recurring
* Assesses and recommends changes to business and technical processes that impact data quality and develops operational procedures for managing data quality issues when they arise
* Partners closely with technology and database teams to perform data cleansing, using automation whenever possible
* Designs and implements mechanism for continuously monitoring data quality by incorporating statistical process control and measurement processes into the information processing flow
* Develops and reports on data quality KPI’s to measure and monitor the health of data quality across the entire data stack and lifecycle and identify opportunities for improvement
* Maintains data quality issue log to provide visibility to data quality opportunities, impact, root causes and efforts required to remediate the data
* Leverages data quality technology to automate data quality activities to the greatest extent possible

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in quantitative field (Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar discipline)
* 4 or more years of relevant experience in data engineering, data governance, data quality or data management/analytics related practices
* Methodical, detail oriented and highly organized
* Experience with process design and implementation
* Strong business acumen with an affinity for data exploration, analysis and working with databases and large amounts of data
* Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills; employs systems thinking to solve complex problems
* Experience documenting data requirements and data rules (standardization, cleansing, validation)
* Track record of taking ownership of project deliverables and day-to-day work product
