title: Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
**About this opportunity:**

At GoEngineer, data connects nearly every part of the business. We’re looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer who wants to understand those connections, improve them, and make sure the data behind our decisions can be trusted.

Reporting to the Manager, Data & Analytics, you’ll work across systems including HubSpot, Shopify, Streamline, NetSuite, and ChurnZero, helping manage the full lifecycle of data from source applications through the warehouse and into the hands of business users.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining data engineering, analytics, systems thinking, and business problem-solving. You won’t spend your days building massive Spark or Snowflake pipelines. Instead, you’ll dig into how systems connect, troubleshoot where data breaks down, improve reliability, and translate real business questions into practical data solutions.

You’ll share ownership of the data environment with the team and grow into primary ownership of key platforms and processes.

**This role is hybrid in Houston, Texas.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the full data lifecycle, understanding where data originates, how it changes, and how it moves across business applications and the data warehouse.
* Design, build, and maintain data models, transformations, pipelines, and scheduled processes that support reporting, analytics, and AI applications.
* Manage data integrations between NetSuite, the warehouse, and other enterprise systems, including data written back to source applications.
* Ensure data quality and reliability by monitoring pipelines, warehouse performance, and data flows, and resolving issues at their root cause.
* Support warehouse operations, including job scheduling, access management, storage, and performance optimization.
* Apply source control, testing, documentation, and controlled deployment practices to data code and processes.
* Develop and support the data services and integrations behind AI tools and agents.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand their questions, identify available data and gaps, and translate needs into practical data and reporting solutions.
* Look beyond the initial request to determine the underlying business problem and recommend solutions that deliver the right outcome.
* Communicate scope, timelines, and trade-offs clearly, using data to guide recommendations and decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to improve data processes, systems, and workflows, collaborating with teammates to turn ideas into practical solutions.

**What You Bring:**

* 2–4 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role. We’re open to candidates slightly outside that range with the right experience.
* Strong SQL skills, ideally T-SQL with SQL Server or Azure SQL, including stored procedures, query tuning, and working with large datasets.
* Experience with data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including fact and dimension tables, incremental loads, and maintaining historical data through temporal tables or slowly changing dimensions.
* Ability to monitor and troubleshoot warehouse health, including failed jobs, data freshness, and performance issues.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, including building data models and dashboards.
* Ability to understand and troubleshoot data flows across interconnected business applications and a central data warehouse.
* A strong understanding of data quality and how changes in one system can affect downstream data and reporting.
* Ability to translate business questions into data requirements, identify gaps, and constructively challenge assumptions when needed.
* Clear communication with both technical and business stakeholders, including explaining recommendations, setting expectations, and recognizing when more information is needed.
* Self-direction and initiative, with the ability to investigate problems, identify improvements, and collaborate with the team to move solutions forward.

***We are looking for candidates with the below experience and skills, however, even if you do not meet all the listed requirements, very interested candidates should still apply:***

We're also looking for experience in at least 2–3 of the following areas. Comparable tools count; you don't need experience with every tool listed.

* dbt or another SQL transformation framework.
* NetSuite data, or another ERP or CRM such as Salesforce, Dynamics, or SAP.
* Celigo or Stitch, or a similar integration tool such as Fivetran, Azure Data Factory, or Boomi.
* Python, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
* Azure services such as Functions, Key Vault, and app hosting, or AWS or GCP equivalents.
* AI coding assistants or building data access for LLMs.

**Competitive Compensation Includes:**

$90,000 - $105,000 USD

**More about what GoEngineer offers:**

At GoEngineer, we understand that our value comes from our employees, and we celebrate and respect their unique experiences. We are working to build a culture where both our employees and customers are centered in the work we do, and employees feel welcomed as they are from the first day.

**Generous Benefits Include:**

* Participation in GoEngineer’s unlimited PTO program from day one of employment.
* 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 6% company match, 100% vested on day one.
* Comprehensive medical coverage, including PPO and High Deductible plans with FSA/HSA options and employer HSA contributions.
* Paid Family Leave, including paid pregnancy disability leave and paid parental bonding leave.
* Employer paid Life Insurance policy, & Short Term, and Long Term Disability insurance, with optional supplemental coverage.
* Dental and Vision insurance
* Mental health, telemedicine with 24/7 access to medical providers, and wellness programs, including virtual therapy, nutrition counseling, and physical therapy.
* Fertility, adoption, and family building benefits.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering free, confidential counseling and support for mental health, legal, financial, and family needs.
* Optional voluntary benefits, including accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness coverage, identity theft protection, pet insurance, plus student loan repayment and prescription cost savings programs.

*To support a fair and efficient hiring process, we may use AI technology to summarize interviews and help our teams review information consistently. AI does not evaluate candidates or make hiring decisions. All decisions are made by our human hiring team.*

title: Data Engineer II, Data Core
description:
**Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions**
The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose.
  
  
**Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation.**
**Position Summary**
As a Data Engineer on the Data Engineering team, you will focus on data transformation and integration: taking messy, disparate datasets that were never designed to work together and turning them into unified, well-modeled data in Snowflake through scalable and reliable processes. The Data Engineering team serves an important role for all participants in the energy markets, collecting new data and creating derivative, value-added datasets that help our clients solve problems. Your design solutions will be built to ensure the highest level of data completeness, correctness, and timeliness for large, complex time series data.
  
  
This position offers candidates an opportunity to develop greater knowledge of energy markets, cloud-based software products, and SaaS businesses, while applying and developing technical, research, and customer-facing skills with one of the most creative and hard-working staff in the industry. AI is at the center of how we build: we make heavy use of AI-assisted and agentic development, including coding agents and the harnesses that orchestrate them, alongside Snowflake, Spring, Kafka, and Oracle PL/SQL.
  
  
**Position Details**

* Salary range: $90,000 - $136,000
* Full-time
* Hybrid
* Location: Boulder, CO, Dedham, MA, or Chicago, IL
* Reports to: Manager of Data Collections
* Travel requirements: Minimal travel may be required (up to 10 days per year)

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design and build transformation layers in Snowflake that combine data from multiple internal and external sources into unified, well-modeled datasets
* Ingest, profile, clean, normalize, and reconcile messy, disparate data sources with differing schemas, granularity, identifiers, and update cadences
* Build scalable, reliable, well-tested data pipelines with monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks built in from the start
* Design data models, shared keys, and cross-reference mappings that allow datasets from different systems to be joined and trusted
* Ensure the highest possible completeness, timeliness, quality, and integrity of Yes Energy data
* Partner with product management to prototype and validate new use cases, turning ideas into datasets that demonstrate customer value
* Use AI-assisted and agentic development tools and harnesses to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and data validation, and help refine how the team applies them
* Provide off-hours support for the data pipelines you build, including nights & weekends as needed
* Create and maintain runbooks and technical documentation that allow the broader team to support your pipelines
* Ensure Snowflake performance and cost efficiency through proactive review, analysis, and tuning
* Plan and coordinate data migrations and integrations between systems
* Contribute to technical departmental standards in such areas as change control, configuration management, development methodology, and coding standards
* Support customers and internal teams with data-related questions
* Participate in product release testing

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least 3 years of related data engineering experience
* 3+ years of SQL experience
* Hands-on production experience with Snowflake, including data modeling and performance tuning
* Demonstrated experience integrating and transforming messy data from multiple disparate sources into unified, production-grade datasets
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools in day-to-day engineering work

**Knowledge Skills & Abilities**

* Stewardship of data quality problems and solutions; passion for data quality
* Creative problem solving abilities and comfort bringing structure to ambiguous, early-stage problems
* Analytic and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to apply a testing mindset to own code
* Ability to work effectively with AI agents and harnesses: writing clear specifications, critically reviewing AI-generated code, and building tests and guardrails around it
* Ability to embrace a customer service mindset
* Strong communication, interpersonal, influence, collaboration and leadership skills
* Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development; shell scripting
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies
* Experience in a Cloud Environment (AWS preferred w S3 buckets, Lambdas, Kinesis, etc.)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Energy Markets experience is preferred
* Oracle PL/SQL experience
* Experience working with large-scale time series data
* Experience unifying data across multiple systems or business domains
* Experience with data transformation and orchestration frameworks (e.g., dbt, Airflow)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

Texas Windstorm Insurance Associationis seeking a **DevOps Engineer** who is a developer first. You will write code to automate, integrate, and stabilize how we deliver software. This is not a role centered on building cloud infrastructure.

Our core business systems run on Guidewire, a vendor-hosted cloud platform on AWS that we control through REST APIs. We do not manage the underlying cloud infrastructure. We do own the work of automating application configuration, environment provisioning, integrations, and releases through the APIs the vendor provides. You will stitch those APIs together with scripts and pipelines, make our environments consistent and stable, surface problems before customers report them, and move changes reliably from Development to Production.

The role is roughly 70% development and 30% operations. A mix of Dev and Ops skills is welcome, as long as you lean clearly toward the Dev side.

**What You Will Solve**

* Changes that do not move reliably from Development to QA to UAT to Production, such as Auth0 identity tenant changes
* Environments that drift apart, with settings, secrets, and deployments changed by anyone
* Developers spend days setting up backend systems before they can start working
* A hand-built pipeline for each application, so a single new security check takes weeks
* Basic bugs reaching QA, and a QA backlog that stretches for weeks
* Production changes that break a critical customer site without anyone noticing for hours
* Releases that are rare, manual, weekend events with lengthy rollbacks
* Customers finding outages before we do

**What You Bring**

* A developer's mindset: you write and maintain code to solve operational problems
* Scripting in at least one general-purpose language (Groovy, Python, or Java preferred), plus comfort with PowerShell and shell scripting
* Experience building and maintaining Jenkins pipelines, including Groovy and shared pipeline libraries
* Experience calling, chaining, and automating REST APIs to orchestrate work across systems
* Git and release practices: branching strategy, merging, and versioning
* Experience turning manual, multi-step processes into reliable, repeatable automation
* Experience designing monitoring and observability: deciding what to measure, alert on, and log
* Experience managing configuration and secrets across many environments
* A collaborative style: you work alongside developers and QA in sprints and suggest improvements rather than waiting for tickets

**Nice to Have**

* Docker for consistent build and test environments
* General familiarity with AWS (deep networking is not required)
* Exposure to Kubernetes, Helm, or Terraform
* Experience with Guidewire Insurance Suite or other insurance or financial systems
* Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0 or Okta
* Automated testing frameworks and security scanning in pipelines

**What "Lead" Means Here**

"Lead" reflects ownership and long-term accountability for our DevOps ecosystem. It does not require people management or prior formal leadership. We are looking for a capable, development-oriented engineer with sound judgment, initiative, and a willingness to grow into broader ownership of the function.

title: AWS Cloud DevOps Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**

Agilify is a minority woman-owned boutique consultancy in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, delivering strategy, process, technology, and training services. Its mission is to foster inclusion, transparency, and accountability while helping employees and client partners achieve valuable outcomes.

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**

Agilify is hiring a mid-level Cloud DevOps Engineer to build and maintain cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines for enterprise clients in regulated industries. You’ll work across multiple AWS accounts, including AWS GovCloud supporting a nuclear environment, with strict change control and documentation requirements.

You’ll write Terraform scripts, manage pipelines, and resolve security findings before changes can move forward. You’ll partner with client cloud operations, security, networking, and database teams, clearly explaining technical issues and working together to resolve them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Infrastructure as Code and Environments**

* Design, implement and maintain Terraform across AWS commercial and AWS GovCloud accounts, including remote state management and module reuse.

* Build and operate CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline or Harness, carrying changes through Development, Test and Production under client change control.

* Manage containerized workloads on ECS Fargate and Kubernetes, including blue/green and controlled rollouts with health checks and automated rollback.

* Provision and operate the core service set: ECS, RDS, S3, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, CloudFront and Route 53.

**Security, Identity and Compliance**

* Enforce least-privilege IAM using federated access and short-lived credentials. No long-lived keys in any pipeline or environment.

* Implement secure connectivity patterns including VPC endpoints and PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and cross-account or cross-partition routing.

* Manage secrets and certificates in AWS Secrets Manager with scheduled rotation, and integrate with Microsoft Entra ID and Amazon Cognito.

* Tune AWS WAF rules, support image scanning, and clear security findings that block promotion.

**Observability, Cost and Support**

* Establish monitoring, alerting and observability using CloudWatch Logs and Metrics, CloudTrail, and platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus or Splunk.

* Support production systems, participate in incident response, and maintain operational runbooks, cost and tagging governance, and ServiceNow change records.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Three to six years in DevOps, Site Reliability or Cloud Engineering roles.

* Strong hands-on Terraform and infrastructure as code experience, including module design and state management.

* Practical AWS experience across VPC and networking, IAM, ECS, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, CloudTrail and Secrets Manager.

* Docker with Kubernetes or ECS Fargate, and CI/CD pipeline experience including blue/green deployments and controlled rollouts.

* Scripting in Python, Bash or PowerShell, and familiarity with observability tooling.

* Identity and connectivity experience: Microsoft Entra ID or Amazon Cognito, and Transit Gateway, Direct Connect or VPC peering across multiple accounts.

* AI agents and services: familiarity with agentic systems and managed AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, including the infrastructure they depend on: private connectivity, service identity and scoped IAM roles, model and endpoint access controls, and logging of prompts, responses and tool calls for audit.

* AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification or higher, and a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**GOVCLOUD AND REGULATED ENVIRONMENTS**

* Hands-on work in AWS GovCloud (US-West or US-East), including account structure and partition boundaries. IAM principals and many service integrations do not cross partitions.

* Awareness that service availability in GovCloud lags commercial regions, and experience confirming it before committing to a design.

* Familiarity with FedRAMP High, DoD Impact Level, ITAR or similar authorization boundaries and the evidence they require.

* Experience in utilities, nuclear, defense, healthcare or financial services, where promotion gates, change records and audit evidence govern the pace of delivery.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* **AI service infrastructure —** enabling and securing Amazon Bedrock or a comparable managed model service, including private connectivity.

* **Data and reporting platforms —** Power BI or Microsoft Fabric reading from AWS-hosted or Oracle sources.

* **Additional platforms and tooling —** Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud; Harness, Jenkins or GitLab CI; Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus or ELK.

* **Advanced certification —** AWS Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Security Specialty.

Pay: $115,000.00 - $145,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Terraform: 3 years (Required)
* hands-on AWS : 3 years (Required)
* CI/CD pipeline: 2 years (Required)
* AWS GovCloud or regulated cloud: 1 year (Required)
* cloud security, IAM, and networking: 2 years (Required)
* production cloud support and monitoring: 2 years (Required)

**DevOps Engineer**

**What you'll bring**

You have strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms, automation, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, and infrastructure tooling, and you can design and improve operational workflows. A practical understanding of cloud architecture, platform systems, identity and access management, database concepts, and observability in production environments is required. You'll design, develop, and automate infrastructure and delivery workflows aligned with best practices. title: Analytics Engineer (AI & Automation) - Contract
description:
**Analytics Engineer (AI & Automation)**
========================================

**Location:** Remote (hybrid option in Herndon, VA)  
**Type:** Contract, Full Time (6 months)

**About the Role**
------------------

IsI Enterprises is seeking a contract Analytics Engineer to join our AI & Automation team. You will turn the data landing in our Snowflake data platform into trusted models, metrics, and dashboards that leaders across our Managed Services, Managed Security Services, and Finance teams use to run the business. Working alongside the Data Engineer, who owns ingestion and the platform, you will own the modeling and reporting layers and work directly with the business owners who rely on them.  
Because we serve Defense Industrial Base customers, you will treat security and data governance as first-class requirements, not afterthoughts.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Data Modeling and Transformation**  
Model source data from ticketing, compliance, security, and finance systems into conformed, documented Snowflake tables (raw, curated, and consumption layers). Build transformations with automated testing, validation, and documentation so models are consistent and reusable across business units.  
**Semantic Layer and Metrics**  
Build the first version of the semantic layer, with shared metric definitions, tests, and lineage, so that reports agree with each other and with source systems. Agree metric definitions in writing with finance and operations stakeholders and reconcile them to source data.  
**Dashboards and Reporting**  
Build dashboards as code in our internal analytics portal, where each dashboard is version controlled and every query is traceable. Replace recurring manual reports with automated ones, including contract terms, renewals, and billing reporting, and the data views that support security review and audit preparation.  
**Security-First Analytics Engineering**  
Apply secure data practices to every model and dashboard, including role-based access control, masking policies, least-privilege access, data classification, and audit logging. Enforce data segregation and handling requirements for sensitive and controlled information (e.g., CUI). Support CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, and related compliance obligations through documented, auditable data flows.  
**Data Quality, Reliability, and Operations**  
Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and alerting on the models you own. Optimize queries and models for performance and cost efficiency.  
**Collaboration and Process**  
Run short discovery sessions with business owners to understand the decisions they need to make, and demonstrate progress weekly. Contribute through pull requests, code reviews, and agile ceremonies. Write clear technical documentation, including data dictionaries and metric definitions, so the permanent team can own your work after the engagement. Leverage AI tooling to accelerate development and delivery.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* As part of your work at ISI, you will potentially have access to sensitive information from the federal government. Pursuant to applicable regulations, ISI requires that all candidates for this role present proof of U.S. citizenship before hire.
* 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, or data engineering with a modeling focus
* Expert proficiency in SQL and working proficiency in Python
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake, including dimensional data modeling and performance and cost optimization
* Experience with transformation tooling (e.g., dbt), including tests and documentation
* Experience building dashboards and reports under version control and code review
* Experience defining metrics with finance and operations stakeholders and reconciling them to source systems
* Experience using AI tooling such as Claude, Codex, or an equivalent service to develop enterprise software
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with keen attention to detail
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced Agile environment
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with team members at all levels

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, analytics, or a related technical field, or equivalent work or military experience
* Experience with Snowflake RBAC, masking policies, and data governance
* Experience working with data from security, IT service management, or MSP tooling (e.g., SIEM, ticketing, PSA/RMM platforms)
* Experience with SaaS finance metrics such as ARR and retention
* Experience with AWS data services (e.g., S3, DMS) and AWS GovCloud
* Hands-on experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code
* Familiarity with data lineage and cataloging practices
* Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance requirements such as CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, or FedRAMP

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Six-month, full-time contract engagement
* Competitive contract rate, commensurate with experience
* Remote work
* A casual, friendly, and relaxed work environment
* Professional growth encouragement and support

We lead with trust, treat each other with respect, and use candor consistently, kindly, and constructively. We care deeply about our work, and we find genuine satisfaction in doing it well. 6+ years of direct, hands-on experience in:

* Python and/or Golang programming, or other general purpose programming languages
* Automation and IaC, e.g., Terraform

* Experience with DevSecOps/DevOps and CI/CD for the administration and deployment of GPU-enabled servers
* Experience deploying or maintaining CNCF projects

* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native applications and services in DDIL impact environments

You will be remote or hybrid/on site at our customer sites at Joint Base Lewis-McChord In Tacoma, WA. If remote, you must be located in the Pacific or Mountain time zone. You will be expected to travel up to 25% of the time.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:

With eleven offices across the United States, 500+ professionals and 350+ business professionals, Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP is a multidisciplinary, integrated national professional services firm known for quality and an extraordinary commitment to clients. The firm's groundbreaking approach brings together legal services, advocacy and business strategy. This approach differentiates Manatt from its competitors and positions the firm to provide a distinct and compelling value proposition.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Cloud Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineering role focused on deploying, automating, and operating Azure workloads within established firm standards, and keeping those environments scalable, resilient, and secure. The position works closely with IT leadership, Information Security, application teams, support teams, end users, and vendors to turn requirements and approved designs into working, supportable cloud solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, configure, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services across identity, networking, security, storage, data, integration, and application-hosting workloads.
* Deploy and maintain Azure landing zone components, management group and subscription structures, resource organization standards, naming and tagging conventions, policy assignments, and role-based access controls in line with firm standards.
* Build and operate Azure compute and platform services, including virtual machines, scale sets, storage, backup, recovery, Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and related PaaS capabilities.
* Partner with Information Security to implement cloud security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, managed identities, privileged access, Defender for Cloud, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability-remediation practices.
* Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics.
* Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency.
* Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization.
* Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
* Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.
* Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure.
* Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations.
* Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management.
* Proficiency with PowerShell, at least one infrastructure-as-code approach such as Bicep or Terraform, and source control and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or comparable tooling.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, certificates, and hybrid identity technologies.
* Two or more years of experience recommended supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, or OneDrive, where these services integrate with Azure and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cloud configurations, issues, and risk to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations.
* One or more years of experience with Microsoft Purview, including data classification, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery, audit, and information protection capabilities a plus.
* Two or more years of experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment a plus.
* Microsoft certifications a plus; such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert.

**Compensation**
The base annual pay range for this role is between $135,000-$155,000. The base pay to be offered will vary depending on skills and qualifications, experience, and location. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits dependent on the position will also be offered.

Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London, and Singapore.

Akuna Capital is looking for an experienced hands-on engineer to join our growing development team and enhance our global Post Trade system. The Post Trade development team designs and operates the global Middle Office, Compliance, Risk, and Trade Enrichment systems. The team maintains the systems used to reconcile trades, satisfy regulations, manage risk, and monitor trading performance across the firm. The ideal candidate will work closely with our trading and quant research teams and build tools and automated data flows that drive trader insights and ensure the smooth running of our global trading operations. In this role, you will:

* Design applications in a distributed system to implement functionality and improve performance
* Implement trading and risk methodologies to monitor performance and manage risk
* Develop software components that perform intraday trade reconciliation, manage positions, and calculate P&L
* Write clean and maintainable code to build large distributed systems using microservices
* Collaborate with multiple teams to understand business problems, prioritize work, and devise technical solutions

* Experience working with relational databases and SQL

* Experience with web development using React/Redux is a plus

title: Sr Analytics Engineer
description:

Public is the world’s first agentic brokerage, combining a comprehensive multi-asset investing experience with all the advantages of AI Agents.
  
  
Members can invest in stocks, options, bonds, crypto, and event contracts, and manage a variety of accounts including their personal brokerage, margin, retirement accounts, and business accounts—all in the same place.
  
  
Since 2019, Public has raised $400 million. Investors include Accel, Tiger Global, Will Smith's Dreamers VC, The Chainsmokers' Mantis VC, as well as renowned figures in business and culture, like Maria Sharapova, Tony Hawk, and NYU Stern professor Scott Galloway.

Working with stakeholders across product, marketing, finance, CX, and brokerage ops, you'll use SQL and dbt to build reliable pipelines, define the company's core metrics once, and make them usable by people and AI agents alike. Your work will directly shape how Public makes decisions, from daily business reporting to product experiments.
  
  
This role is based in New York City and reports directly to the Director of Data.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain centralized company metrics and data models in dbt and our Omni semantic layer, so every team works from the same definitions
* Partner with product, finance, marketing, CX, and brokerage ops to turn business questions into well-modeled, self-serve data
* Work with frontend and backend engineers to define data contracts and event tracking, and model eventstream data from app, backend, and Braze sources
* Design and build Omni dashboards and reports for key metrics and KPIs
* Make our data AI-ready: curate models, descriptions, and topics so teams can get accurate answers through Claude and other AI agents
* Run analyses that improve product and business metrics, using visualization, experimentation, backtesting, and data science methods
* Participate in code reviews and give feedback to keep our codebase high-quality and maintainable
* Feed data-driven recommendations back to lifecycle marketing and backend systems through automated reverse ETL pipelines (Hightouch, Segment)
* Maintain, optimize, and improve Public's data infrastructure across dbt, Omni, Snowflake, Fivetran, Airflow, and Hightouch

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, or data analytics, preferably in finance, brokerage, or fintech
* Hands-on experience building production data models in dbt
* Familiarity with data modeling techniques such as Kimball dimensional modeling and star schemas
* Strong SQL and the ability to write efficient queries on a cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred; Redshift or BigQuery also relevant)
* Experience with Omni or other modern BI tools with a semantic layer (e.g. LookML)
* Hands-on experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor in your data work, such as writing and refactoring dbt models, debugging pipelines, and speeding up analysis
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Clear communicator who can present data-driven narratives in writing and in person
* Quick learner who can grasp the fundamentals of the business and the key drivers behind company metrics
* Investigative mindset; willing to think outside the box and contribute ideas across business functions

**Bonus Points**

* Interest in personal finance and investing
* Experience in a fast-paced startup, especially in fintech or consumer brands
* Experience with modern ingestion and orchestration tools (Fivetran, Airflow) and reverse ETL (Hightouch, Segment)
* Experience modeling product event data (Segment, Braze, or similar) and defining tracking plans or data contracts
* Experience building AI agents or tools on top of data (e.g. MCP servers, text-to-SQL)
* Demonstrated interest or experience applying machine learning to business problems, including on Snowflake ML
* Proficiency in Python
* Expertise in marketing attribution and performance measurement

**Compensation**
The base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $190,000 plus equity, depending on skills and experience.
  
  

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
* Generous PTO and parental leave policy
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development

title: Software Engineer - Platform Engineering
description:
Who we are  

 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 . 

 Hiring and how we work 

 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
 . 

 See yourself at Twilio 

 Join the team as Twilio's next Software Development Engineer 1 - Platform Engineering.

 About the job 

 This position is needed to help operate, secure, and modernize Twilio's shared Kubernetes platform substrate (OTK, Segment, and ZipWhip EKS fleets) at scale.

 Join our Cloud Native Container Operations team as an entry-level platform engineer. You will help manage over 1,000 Kubernetes clusters, tackling real-world multi-cloud complexity. This high-impact role offers structured mentorship from senior engineers, hands-on experience with modern automation tools, and a direct path to improving platform reliability. It is the perfect environment to launch your career in infrastructure engineering at a massive scale.

 Responsibilities 

 In this role, you'll:

- Assist in lifecycle management of cloud hosted Kubernetes platforms serving all of Twilio.

- Remediate container and kernel-level CVE vulnerabilities to keep the shared substrate secure.

- Write automation scripts in Go and Shell to streamline day-to-day cluster operations.

- Collaborate with senior engineers to deploy infrastructure changes safely using Terraform and GitOps.

- Troubleshoot basic platform issues, applying lessons learned to continuously improve system reliability.

 Qualifications 

 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

 Required:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical training.

- Foundational programming skills in Go (Golang) and scripting with Shell.

- Basic exposure to cloud environments, specifically AWS.

- Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code concepts using Terraform and YAML.

- Academic or internship exposure to containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.

- Practical understanding of version control (Git) and core software development life cycle (SDLC) concepts.

 Desired:

- Familiarity with GitOps workflows and tools like ArgoCD.

- Basic understanding of networking, operating systems, and distributed systems.

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) for coding or debugging.

- Strong problem-solving skills and an eagerness to learn complex infrastructure concepts.

 Location 

 This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

 Travel 

 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

 What We Offer 

 Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

 Compensation 

 *Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above. 

 The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

- Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland (outside of the DC area), Massachusetts, Minnesota, or Vermont: $108,720.00 - $135,900.00.

- Based in New York (outside of the New York City area), New Jersey (outside of the New York City area), Washington State (outside of the Seattle area), Washington D.C., Washington D.C. area, Maryland, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $115,120.00 - $143,900.00.

- Based in California (within the San Francisco Bay area), New York (within the New York City area), New Jersey (within the New York City area), or Washington State (within the Seattle area): $127,920.00 - $159,900.00.

- This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

 Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 11/25/2026, but may change based on business needs.
 . 

 Twilio thinks big. Do you? 

 We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

 So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. 
 . 

 Stay alert to recruitment fraud 

 We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
 . 

 Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Since 1927, the Mariner Finance family of companies has provided customers with creative, flexible, and convenient lending options. Headquartered in Baltimore, Mariner Finance operates coast-to-coast with physical locations in over half the states. With a growing number of employees, superior customer service remains the cornerstone of our business, and we pride ourselves in delivering a variety of loans with an enhanced focus on exceptional service. We work with customers to find options that are beneficial to their specific needs, which is why we are recognized by our customers as one of the community’s consumer finance companies of choice.

**Benefits:**

For information regarding our benefits, please visit: https://www.marinerfinance.com/careers/benefits/

All full time employees are provided with a generous benefits package in addition to their monetary compensation. Learn more about it today.

**In this role, you will...**

Serve as a hands-on Senior Data Engineer and architect, owning the design and delivery of sophisticated data models, pipelines, and applications. Build engineering-grade solutions on modern cloud data platforms and adapt technical approaches to the problem, domain, and technology at hand.

Use AI-assisted development to improve speed, quality, and engineering productivity while partnering with engineers, product owners, analysts, and data scientists to translate business needs into trusted data solutions. Own architecture and technical design for complex data products and influence data engineering standards and practices across domains.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

  

* Design, build, and launch sophisticated data models, including Kimball dimensional, normalized, and Data Vault approaches, supporting multiple use cases across products and business domains.
* Own the end-to-end architecture and technical design of complex, cross-domain data products, from ingestion and storage through transformation, serving, and consumption, using cloud data warehouse and lakehouse platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake.
* Build and maintain production-grade pipelines and applications in Python and SQL, using Spark/PySpark and open table formats such as Delta Lake and Iceberg to process large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
* Solve complex data integration problems using appropriate ETL/ELT patterns across batch, streaming, and API-based sources using orchestration and transformation technologies such as Airflow, dbt, or Matillion.
* Define and evolve reusable standards, frameworks, and reference patterns for ingestion, transformation, modeling, testing, data quality, and observability within assigned domains.
* Advance CI/CD and DataOps practices using Git-based workflows, automated build and deployment, release management, and Infrastructure-as-Code.
* Develop meaningful automated tests, including unit, integration, data quality, and regression testing, and articulate testing strategy and coverage clearly to peers and stakeholders.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to improve coding, testing, documentation, refactoring, and engineering productivity, while reviewing and validating AI-generated output for accuracy, quality, security, and compliance with established standards.
* Define and manage service-level expectations for assigned data products and improve logging, monitoring, and alerting to support reliability.
* Lead root-cause analysis of complex data incidents and implement systemic fixes for recurring failures.
* Tune performance and cost across compute, storage, and query workloads.
* Ensure solutions meet applicable security, privacy, governance, lineage, and auditability requirements within a regulated financial services environment.
* Guide modernization and migration of legacy and on-premises data platforms to cloud data warehouse and lakehouse solutions.
* Partner with Data Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Analytics, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into trusted data and communicate architecture decisions, risks, and tradeoffs.
* Evaluate emerging data and AI technologies and recommend adoption based on business value, scalability, security, reliability, and cost.
* Provide technical guidance, design review, and knowledge sharing to other engineers and technical team members.
* May perform additional functions depending on business needs.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; additional applicable experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, software engineering for data, or related technical disciplines, including ownership of production data pipelines and complex data solutions.
* Strong hands-on software engineering experience for data, including advanced Python and SQL used to build pipelines, frameworks, applications, and reusable technical components.
* Demonstrated experience designing data architecture across warehouse, lakehouse, or data lake environments using Kimball and normalized modeling approaches, with familiarity with Data Vault concepts.
* Advanced hands-on experience building cloud data warehouse and lakehouse solutions on platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable technologies.
* Working knowledge of core cloud services, including storage, compute, security, and identity, within AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
* Strong knowledge of distributed data processing, including Spark/PySpark, open table formats, partitioning, and performance optimization.
* Strong experience with orchestration and transformation technologies such as Airflow, dbt, Matillion, or comparable tools.
* Strong command of CI/CD, Git-based source control, release management, Infrastructure-as-Code, and automated testing practices.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, with the judgment to review, validate, secure, and appropriately apply AI-generated output.
* Strong understanding of production support, observability, security, governance, reliability, and data lifecycle practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical design across teams or domains and influence engineering and architecture standards without formal authority.
* Strong communication, technical documentation, stakeholder-management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Advanced Analytics, or a related field.
* Relevant cloud or data-platform certification, such as AWS Certified Data Engineer, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, or SnowPro Advanced.
* Experience within financial services, consumer lending, or another regulated environment.
* Experience with real-time or streaming architectures, data contracts, data catalog/lineage tooling, or AI/ML data enablement.

**Hours of Work:**

Work hours will depend on the business hours of the time zone serviced. To the extent permitted by law, the Company may, in its sole discretion, change the work schedule to address business needs.

**Physical Demands:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit for extended periods; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to twenty (20) pounds. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities

● Design and build the production ETL pipelines and the dbt transformation layers: tested transformations in the operational PostgreSQL layer and analytical models in the Iceberg/Athena lakehouse.

● Reverse-engineer undocumented business logic out of legacy schemas; encode and test every transformation instead of copying tables.

● Design and own the target PostgreSQL schema for the shared data layer that every Bronson product consumes.

● Build the identity-resolution pipeline: deterministic and probabilistic matching, confidence scoring, a manual-resolution queue, and measured false-merge / false-split rates.

● Build the data-quality and lineage controls across both layers: schema-change detection, freshness monitoring, and traceability from source records to product-facing models.

● Own the parallel run: legacy systems and the new layer stay reconciled, with documented discrepancies, until the old side is switched off.

Technical Environment

Managed PostgreSQL as the transactional core, schema-per-domain with a transactional outbox; the analytics lakehouse on object storage with Iceberg tables, a SQL query engine, and dbt transformations; infrastructure as code (TypeScript) and GitHub Actions CI/CD; Python for data tooling; pipeline observability covering CDC lag, data freshness, transformation failures, reconciliation results, and backfill status, with OpenTelemetry used where applicable for tracing. Legacy sources: the firm's on-prem SQL Server and MySQL. PostgreSQL, dbt, and the lakehouse approach are settled; the final cloud (AWS vs GCP) is being decided now, and the decisions you will own include the replacement change-data-capture architecture (the existing replication path is no longer reliable) and the migration approach. Environments: dev (synthetic data), staging (de-identified), production — the only PHI environment.

Technical Challenges

● The existing replication path is no longer reliable. You will choose the replacement change-data-capture architecture (DMS-class vs Debezium-class), defend the choice, and own it in production.

● A wrong identity merge is a legal problem, not a bug: matching ships with measured false-merge and false-split rates and a manual-resolution queue.

● Every pipeline reconciles against its legacy source with documented discrepancies — reconciliation is part of the pipeline, not an afterthought.

● Backfills and replays must be safe: the same load run twice must never produce different results.

Qualifications

● 5+ years of professional data engineering experience.

● Has built and owned a dbt (or equivalent) transformation layer in production, including tests and CI for transformations, schema changes, and pipeline code.

● Has led a migration from legacy on-prem databases to a modern platform with both systems running in parallel, with complete source-to-target reconciliation and documented, approved exceptions.

● Deep SQL and PostgreSQL; reads other people's schemas fluently.

● Change-data-capture experience (Debezium, DMS, or similar).

● Meticulous and patient: legacy data hides problem after problem — find, verify, rework, verify again.

● Communicates directly with product and business stakeholders: validates undocumented rules, resolves discrepancies, and documents source-of-truth decisions.

Preferred Skills

● Entity resolution / record linkage with measured match quality.

● Lakehouse table formats and query engines (Iceberg / Athena class).

● SQL Server and MySQL internals; experience with regulated data (HIPAA / PHI).

The Data Engineering team serves an important role for all participants in the energy markets, collecting new data and creating derivative, value-added datasets that help our clients solve problems. title: Junior Cloud Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

The Mercatus Center is looking for a Junior Cloud Engineer to support our existing AWS cloud infrastructure and on-site network, to provide on-site security analysis and triage, and to support in SaaS administration.

The Junior Cloud Engineer manages our AWS infrastructure, supports the needs of contractors and scholars with their AWS projects, and ensures that the AWS accounts are following security best practices. This environment consists of many separate, but centrally-managed accounts used by different units within the organization for providing hosted applications or to run projects including data analysis.

Additionally, the role supports the local network infrastructure, manages part of our SaaS portfolio, and works with existing staff to manage security alerts and remediation using our SIEM and existing security playbooks. This will include monitoring and updating network infrastructure and design, managing SaaS permissions, and integrating SSO and identity management for those SAAS apps. On the security side, this role works with our existing security specialist in monitoring and updating the SIEM configuration, responding to security incidents, and updating security response playbooks.

We are a small, dynamic IT team, and are seeking a generalist who is able to quickly pivot between systems, learn enough to achieve the required outcome, and move on. Additional duties will include providing backup for the on-site end user support team and providing on-call support once every four weeks. The ideal candidate will need to be a fast learner with good troubleshooting skills.

Responsibilities will be approximately 20% AWS architecture and management, 10% on site networking, 20% security operations, 30% SaaS administration, 20% triage and remediation.

**Specific Duties:**

* Responds to and resolves security incidents.
* Reviews AWS configurations, especially security configurations.
* Works with contracted AWS developers to resolve security configuration issues.
* Manages a 3rd party contractor overseeing security in the AWS environment.
* Assists scholars and staff with new AWS project design.
* Manages SaaS permissions and services.
* Manages identity and permissions across the enterprise using identity management tools.
* Assists with end user problem resolution.
* Assists in help desk ticket triage and resolution.
* Participates in on-call rotation one out of every four weeks.

**Required Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and work experience.
* Minimum of 1-2 years experience managing cloud based compute and storage solutions like AWS or Azure.
* Minimum of 1-2 years experience with TCP/IP networking, including security and firewalls.
* Familiarity with MDM and SSO tools like Okta and Jumpcloud.
* Experience managing contractors, including scoping work, establishing clear communication protocols, evaluating outcomes, and ensuring alignment with organizational requirements.
* Experience troubleshooting unfamiliar issues and finding and applying appropriate solutions.
* Excellent communication skills relevant to the technical tools and solutions for non-technical users or cross-disciplinary experts.
* Familiarity with triage and response to security incidents.
* Ability to document processes and create playbooks.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Has built solutions using CloudFormation or other orchestration tools.
* Experience with tools like AWS GuardDuty and Security Hub to identify and resolve potential issues with cloud resources.
* Experience using IAM tools to manage permissions and roles for users within a cloud environment.
* Experience using a trouble ticketing system.
* Familiarity with SIEM concepts and usage.

**Required certification:**

* AWS Solutions Architect Associate

**Preferred certifications:**

* Network+
* Security+
* Okta Certified Professional
* Jumpcloud Core Certification

Please submit your cover letter and resume. Your cover letter should indicate your interest in the Mercatus Center's mission.

The Mercatus Center at George Mason University is where top classical liberal scholars solve real-world challenges. Grounded in the tradition of market-oriented thinking and classical liberal ideas, we equip high-agency talent to apply bold ideas that shape institutions, inform policy, and help people flourish.

Salary is competitive and will be commensurate with experience. Under general direction of the Information Technology Manager I, the Information Technology Specialist II (ITS II) Cloud Engineer serves as DHCS’ primary technical expert responsible for designing and modernizing cloud-based architecture for the Capitation Payment Management System (CAPMAN) in support of H.R. 1. **Position Overview**
We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable, secure and highly available cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud (OCI). The role focuses on infrastructure automation, reliability, resiliency, networking, security and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments. You will collaborate with application, security and operations teams to implement best practices for deployment, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery while driving continuous improvement and cost optimization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and manage virtual networks (VCN/VNet), subnets, route tables, DNS, VPNs, FastConnect/ExpressRoute and cross-tenancy routing to support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.
* Implement and operate load balancers, storage solutions, backups, and disaster recovery strategies to ensure resiliency and data protection.
* Manage identity and access (IAM), whitelisting, endpoint configuration and firewall policies to secure cloud environments and enforce least privilege.
* Develop, maintain and run automation using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Bash and REST APIs to provision infrastructure, orchestration and configuration management.
* Create and maintain monitoring, logging and dashboarding (metrics, logs, alerts) to enable rapid detection and incident response; participate in on-call rotations and incident post-mortems.

* Perform capacity planning, cloud optimization and cost control activities, recommending improvements and right-sizing resources.
* Document architecture, operational runbooks, topology diagrams, network configurations and standard operating procedures for teams and audits.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (security, applications, networking, SRE) to deliver secure, compliant and production-ready platforms and to drive continuous improvement.
* Implement server administration tasks, manage IP addressing, and maintain firewalls and routing for complex deployments.
* Design and run tests for disaster recovery and failover, validate backup/restoration procedures and maintain recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).

title: Data Engineer
description:
Goodwill Central Texas is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, and support the data pipelines, integrations, and data models that make trusted information available for reporting, analytics, and operational use. This role will work with business stakeholders, application owners, software developers, and data visualization professionals to connect data from enterprise systems and turn it into reliable, well-documented data products. Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Power BI are important parts of Goodwill's evolving data environment. Candidates may bring experience from those technologies or from comparable cloud, data, integration, software development, or automation platforms. Success in this role requires strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply existing experience to new tools and technologies.
  
  
**Data Pipelines and Integration**

* Design, build, test, and maintain data pipelines that ingest and transform data from enterprise applications, databases, APIs, files, cloud services, and external partners.
* Develop reliable batch, scheduled, incremental, or event-driven data flows using the approach appropriate to each source and business need.
* Integrate structured and semi-structured data, including relational data, JSON, CSV, Excel, and API payloads.
* Work with application owners, developers, and vendors to understand source systems, define mappings, manage dependencies, and resolve integration issues.
* Build reusable components and patterns that improve the consistency, maintainability, and speed of future data integrations.

**Data Platforms and Modeling**

* Build and maintain data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and related technologies as Goodwill's data platform evolves.
* Organize and transform raw data into trusted, reusable structures for reporting, analytics, and operational use.
* Develop and maintain data models, transformation logic, metadata, and documentation that make data understandable and usable across the organization.
* Partner with data visualization professionals to provide reliable datasets and semantic models for Power BI reports, dashboards, and self-service analytics.
* Evaluate appropriate use of lakehouse, warehouse, relational, and other data-storage patterns based on business and technical requirements.

**Automation and Engineering Practices**

* Apply software development and automation practices to data engineering, including source control, code review, testing, deployment, logging, and technical documentation.
* Use code, low-code tools, or a combination of approaches to automate data movement, transformation, validation, monitoring, and operational tasks.
* Build on experience with platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, AWS data services, Snowflake, Power Automate, Logic Apps, or comparable technologies.
* Contribute to shared engineering standards, reusable templates, naming conventions, and deployment practices.
* Participate in technical design reviews and help evaluate tools, services, and implementation options.

**Data Quality, Governance, and Reliability**

* Implement validation, reconciliation, and data-quality controls that identify incomplete, inconsistent, duplicated, stale, or invalid data.
* Monitor pipelines and data processes, troubleshoot failures and performance issues, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.
* Maintain clear data lineage, mappings, schedules, ownership information, operational procedures, and support documentation.
* Apply appropriate security, privacy, access, retention, and governance requirements throughout the data lifecycle.
* Design solutions that are reliable, scalable, supportable, and cost-conscious.

**Business and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with business stakeholders and subject-matter experts to understand processes, reporting needs, business rules, and measures of success.
* Translate business requirements into technical data designs, explaining options, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs in clear language.
* Collaborate with data visualization, software development, infrastructure, security, and application teams to deliver complete solutions.
* Provide clear updates on progress, issues, data-quality concerns, and decisions requiring stakeholder input.
* Support knowledge transfer and help colleagues use data products effectively and responsibly.

**Continuous Improvement and Support**

* Investigate data incidents and reporting discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions.
* Review pipeline performance, platform usage, and support trends to improve reliability, efficiency, and maintainability.
* Stay current with modern data engineering, integration, automation, and Microsoft Fabric capabilities, recommending practical improvements when they provide value.
* Participate in release planning, production support, and post-launch reviews for data solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Three or more years of experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, application integration, automation, business intelligence, or a related technical field.

* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational data and databases.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Remote / Telecommuting (Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates)  
  

The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line-of-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists.
  
  
In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System an Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor. The Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge-transfer progression (shadowing, co-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer.
  
  
1. Scope of Responsibilities
  
Data Ingestion & Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model.
  
Transformation & Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect.
  
Record Linkage & Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross-agency reconciliations.
  
Production Pipeline Operations & Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects.
  
Data Quality & Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes).
  
Performance Optimization & Platform Stewardship: Optimize query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance for cost and latency; identify and tune heavily used models and performance hot spots in Snowflake.
  
Quality Assurance, Code Review & Promotion: Adhere to the unified release process across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans; author and execute test cases, conduct peer code reviews, and maintain release change logs.
  
  
2. Activities Performed
  
  
A. Ingestion & Pipeline Development (client-Led Feeds)
  
  
CDHE Courses Data Ingestion:
  
Ingest and validate annual postsecondary course-level data files from CDHE per data sharing agreements.
  
Build ETL mapping processes from CDHE course files into the SLDS common data model based on design specifications provided by 3rd party implementation partner.
  
Pair with 3 party implementation team during ETL construction, validation, and promotion.
  
  
Postsecondary SES & Disability Data Ingestion (Conditional):
  
Ingest and validate demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability classification codes from postsecondary sources.
  
Apply mandated privacy protections, cell suppression rules, and permissible-use governance requirements.
  
  
PSAT/SAT Assessment Data Ingestion (Conditional):
  
Ingest, validate, and map section/composite assessment scores and grade levels from the College Board or CDE.
  
Execute identity matching to connect assessment records to existing longitudinal student profiles.
  
  
B. Knowledge Transfer & Operational Transition (Jan–April 2027)
  
  
Shadowing & Co-running (Jan–Feb 2027):
  
Shadow 3rd party implementation partner engineers on day-to-day operations of existing data feeds (e.g., NSC, K-3, CDEC, and Phase 1 feeds).
  
Co-run live feed cycles, handle data loading, execute record matching, and troubleshoot exceptions alongside 3rd party implementation partner.
  
  
Readiness Gate Execution (Target: March 2027):
  
Run two consecutive feed cycles completely unaided to achieve formal operational hand-over sign-off.
  
  
Full Production Operations (March 2027 Onward):
  
Execute recurring feed schedules, rebuild downstream objects, reconcile row counts against source files, and triage failed jobs.
  
Address ad-hoc data inquiries and export requests from client leadership and partner agencies.
  
  
C. Data Stabilization & Analytics Layer Upkeep
  
Stabilization Backlog Support: Resolve identified data reliability defects, run variations, and de-duplication issues transitioned from the Phase 1 stabilization backlog.
  
  
Analytics Layer Hardening & Maintenance (April 2027 Onward):
  
Apply object modeling standards, naming conventions, and layout-change detection into the RAW layer.
  
Perform ongoing reconciliation of analytics layer outputs across non-production and production environments.
  
Implement metric and calculation enhancements prioritizing downstream use cases (program participation, completion, equitable access, and wage outcomes).
  
Conduct query profiling and performance tuning on dashboard back-end models.
  
  
D. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Testing
  
Testing & Release Management: Author manual and automated test cases in Azure Test Plans; record execution evidence and resolve defect bugs before promoting code.
  
  
Cross-Role Support:
  
Partner with the Data Architect to review and adapt physical and logical data models and pipeline designs.
  
Support the Data Scientist / Visualization Designer by integrating new data sources to power Tableau dashboard refreshes and preparing source tables for de-identified Institution of Higher Education (IHE) outcome files.
  
Coordinate with Operations Engineers on Snowflake compute management, warehouse auto-shutdown, user role permissions, and CI/CD promotion pipelines.
  
  
3. Deliverables Created
  
  
Technical Code & Pipeline Artifacts
  
Production ETL/ELT Pipelines: Fully developed, scheduled Informatica workflows and Snowflake SQL/transformation pipelines for CDHE Courses and existing operational feeds.
  
Cleansing & Validation Modules: Automated L1, L2, and L3 quality-check rules and Informatica layout-change detection routines in the RAW layer.
  
Identity Matching & Linkage Routines: Documented internal matching scripts linking new partner agency student/workforce records into longitudinal IDs.
  
Analytics Layer Transformation Objects: Production views, tables, and metric models in Snowflake aligned with longitudinal reporting use cases .
  
De-Identified Data Extraction Scripts: Data extraction scripts that generate de-identified, suppressed outcome files for participating IHEs per specification.
  
  
Documentation & Engineering Specifications
  
ETL Pipeline Design Documents: Technical architecture and transformation specifications detailing source-to-target logic, schemas, and dependencies.
  
Mapping & Transformation Specifications: Contribution to enterprise data mapping documents aligning source fields to the SLDS common data model.
  
Lineage Documentation & Dependency Maps: As-built data lineage records and dependency diagrams detailing object-level upstream and downstream flows.
  
Operational Runbooks & Incident Procedures: Standard operating procedures for running feed cycles, handling late or malformed files, performing failover, and reconciling row counts.
