title: Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the world’s largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities. With thousands of locations across the United States and Europe and more than 170 million net rentable square feet, we are also among the largest landlords globally.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute, Public Storage is a member of the S&P 500 and FT Global 500. Our common and preferred stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

As the nation’s leading self-storage provider, we are known for our iconic orange doors and our commitment to delivering simple, reliable storage solutions to millions of customers.

 **Job Description**

Public Storage runs at a scale that makes the work interesting. More than 4,500 locations and growing, a national customer base, prices that move every day, and a footprint expanding across the U.S. and into Canada. Our Data and Analytics team sits with the business partners who own those decisions and works with them on the critical problems: pricing, promotions, marketing, operations, real estate acquisitions, and forecasting supply and demand.

Our platform runs on Google Cloud, including BigQuery, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, GKE, and Terraform, along with dbt Cloud, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Looker, and modern CI/CD. We're a small, senior team that operates like a startup inside an S&P 500 company. Short paths from idea to production, real ownership, and work that shows up in the business instead of in a slide deck.

Join a full-stack data team where a new engineer ships to production in weeks, not quarters. In this role you'll build and maintain the pipelines that support our customer teams and the analysts and data scientists who serve them, working with customer data every day. You'll be mentored on code-first data engineering with Python, SQL, dbt, Airflow, and BigQuery, and on the engineering habits that separate a pipeline that works from a pipeline people trust. If you want a place where you learn quickly, own real surface area, and see your work used the same week you ship it, this is it.  
  
What You'll Do

**Build and Run Pipelines**

* Construct and maintain batch data pipelines from internal systems, third-party APIs, and event streams into BigQuery
* Develop transformations in dbt with tests, documentation, and sensible model layering
* Author and maintain Airflow / Cloud Composer DAGs with retries, alerting, and dependency awareness
* Ensure customer and business data in the lake and warehouse is timely, high-quality, and well documented

**Quality and Craft**

* Write data quality tests and monitor freshness, volume, schema, and distribution
* Follow engineering best practices: version control, code review, CI/CD, query optimization, and clear documentation
* Handle customer data in line with our data governance, privacy, and access standards
* Support MLOps workflows: feature refreshes, scheduled retraining jobs, and model input pipelines
* Investigate and resolve pipeline failures, and write up what broke so it doesn't break the same way twice

**Collaborate**

* Work closely with analysts, data scientists, and customer teams to understand what they need from the data and deliver it
* Partner with business and IT teams to onboard new source systems
* Create and maintain architecture and systems documentation

  
**Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM field
* 3+ years of experience building data pipelines or deploying production code in a cloud environment (1+ year with a Master's degree)
* Proficiency in SQL, including relational data modeling and query tuning
* Working proficiency in Python for data processing
* Familiarity with a cloud analytical warehouse. BigQuery preferred, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks considered
* Clear written and verbal communication

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with dbt and with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster, or Prefect
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, and Pub/Sub
* Exposure to streaming or event-driven data (Pub/Sub, Kafka, Dataflow)
* Exposure to containerization and infrastructure as code, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform
* Familiarity with BI and semantic layer tools, preferably Looker
* Exposure to MLOps or machine learning infrastructure

Skills & Technologies

* Languages: SQL, Python; Git-based workflows and code review
* Data stack: BigQuery, dbt, Airflow / Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage
* Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (AWS or Azure equivalent considered)
* Practices: data modeling, ELT design, data quality testing, data privacy and access controls, documentation

  
**Additional Information**

**Why This Role Will Excite You**

* A modern, code-first stack with no legacy on-premise burden to carry
* Mentorship from senior engineers who review your code and explain the why
* Customer data that drives daily pricing and operating decisions at more than 4,500 locations
* New pipelines to build from scratch as we expand into Canada

**Workplace**

* One of our core values is working as OneTeam. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while recognizing the importance of flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days per week, with the option to use up to three flexible remote-work days each month.

  \*\*Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

title: Data Engineer
description:
### **Why This Role Exists**

A2Z Sync runs the deal for dealership rooftops across the United States: digital retail, desking, F&I, and in-store operations on one platform. Every one of those transactions, and every integration with the DMS, CRM, and lender systems around it, produces data. Today that data runs on AWS, from dealer system integrations through an Athena semantic layer to the reports our teams and partners rely on every day.

Now we are building A2Z 2.0, an AI-driven data and intelligence platform for dealers, on a new lakehouse. The agents and insights it delivers are only as good as the data underneath them: fresh, modeled, governed, and fast. That is the Data Engineer's job. You will architect, build, and operate the analytical data ecosystem that feeds reporting today and the intelligence platform tomorrow, with the reliability that a showroom floor demands.

This is a builder's role on a small team. You will own pipelines end to end, from ingestion to the models analysts and agents query, and you will be in the room when the platform's data decisions get made.

### **Scope & Scale**

* Thousands of dealer tenants on the platform, each with isolated databases and per-tenant configuration.
* Data pipelines spanning 6 integration domains with multi-protocol vendor connectivity (REST, SOAP, event-driven).
* An Athena semantic layer of 40+ views feeding Power BI reports and the A2Z Insights self-serve app, used by Product, Ops, Engineering, IT, Finance, and strategic partners.
* A new dealer lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold on Iceberg) coming online for A2Z 2.0, with Beta this fall and general availability early next year.
* Production AI agents whose tools and context depend on the data you serve.

### **What You'll Own**

* **Data workloads on AWS.** Architect, build, and operationalize pipelines and storage using Glue, Athena, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and, where the workload calls for it, Timestream, Flink, and Kafka.
* **The lakehouse.** Bronze, silver, and gold layers on Iceberg: table design, partitioning, compaction, and the storage-format decisions (Parquet, Iceberg, ORC) that keep queries fast as data grows.
* **Data models and access.** Models that analysts, reports, and agents can trust; secure data access APIs in Java and/or Python; real-time streaming where the use case earns it.
* **Pipeline reliability.** Monitoring, alerting, logging, and freshness and completeness checks, so breaks are caught before the Data and BI Analyst or a dealer sees them.
* **Anomaly detection and data quality.** Statistical and ML-based monitoring of data quality and integration call volumes, so a spike, drop, or silent failure surfaces early.
* **Forecasting and predictive features.** Model development in Python (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy) for forecasting and predictive analytics that feed A2Z 2.0 insights.
* **Governance and security.** SSL/TLS, client authentication, access auditing, and the controls that keep dealer data inside its tenant.
* **Cross-functional delivery.** Working with engineers, product managers, and the Data and BI Analyst to turn data requirements into scalable, secure, high-quality solutions.

### **First 90 Days / First Year**

**First 90 Days:** Learn the platform, the integration domains, and the semantic layer well enough to trace any reported number to its source. Take ownership of the pipelines feeding reporting and add freshness and completeness checks where they are missing. Ship your first production change to the lakehouse. Publish a point of view on the ingestion and modeling patterns A2Z 2.0 should standardize on.

**First Year:** The A2Z 2.0 lakehouse is in production with bronze, silver, and gold layers you built or hardened, serving reports and agents at GA. Pipeline incidents are caught by your monitoring before users report them. At least one forecasting or anomaly-detection model is live and used in the product or in operations. The patterns you set are the ones the next data engineer inherits.

### **Hands-On Expectations**

Roughly 70% building and operating (pipelines, models, APIs, monitoring), 20% design and architecture with the platform and AI teams, and 10% working with analysts and product on requirements and enablement. You write and ship code every week.

### **Tech & Tools**

* **Data platform:** Amazon Athena (Presto/Trino SQL), AWS Glue, S3, Apache Iceberg lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold), DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions.
* **Streaming and time series:** Timestream, Flink, Kafka (where the workload calls for it).
* **Languages and ML:** Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn), Java, SQL.
* **Reliability and governance:** CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, freshness and completeness checks, SSL/TLS, access auditing.
* **Downstream:** Power BI, Amazon Quick (under evaluation), A2Z Insights, AgentCore-based agents.

### **How You'll Use AI**

This is not a "we are AI-curious" company. We use Claude every day, and we expect you to as well. Concrete examples for this role:

* Draft and test pipeline code, SQL, and data-quality checks with Claude, then verify against known-good numbers before anything ships.
* Generate lineage and documentation from the models themselves so the map from source to report to agent stays current.
* Summarize pipeline incidents into root-cause notes and runbook entries the on-call engineer can act on.
* Build the data foundations the A2Z 2.0 agents stand on: the tables, APIs, and context they query, held to the standard that the same question returns the same number.
* Prototype forecasting and anomaly-detection approaches faster, so you spend your time on evaluating them against dealer outcomes.

**You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the Data Engineer who builds the data the AI runs on.**

### **Role Specifics**

* **Department:** Engineering
* **Location:** Denver, CO, hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market)
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time

  
**Requirements**  

### **Must Have**

The Data Engineer will be responsible for implementing and maintaining data pipelines, transformations, and data integration processes within a Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS).

This position focuses on translating data architecture designs into technical solutions using Snowflake and Informatica. The selected candidate will work with data from multiple state agencies and third-party sources, transforming raw data into structured, reliable, and harmonized datasets for analytical and reporting purposes.

The Data Engineer will collaborate with Data Architects, Data Scientists, Visualization Designers, Operations Engineers, and external implementation partners to develop automated ETL/ELT pipelines, implement data quality controls, perform identity matching, and maintain production data operations.

The role will initially involve knowledge transfer and collaboration with an existing implementation partner, followed by progressively assuming responsibility for production operations and ongoing maintenance of the data foundation and analytics layer.

The successful candidate will also support data governance, privacy compliance, performance optimization, testing, documentation, and release management.

**Education Requirement**

No specific educational qualification was provided.

* Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience building, orchestrating, and optimizing complex ETL/ELT data pipelines and transformation logic natively within the Snowflake platform.

* Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including provisioning, configuring, and maintaining cloud infrastructure and resources.
* Demonstrated proficiency implementing automated build, test, and release deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Expert proficiency with Git and version control workflows, including branching strategies, pull requests, automated merge checks, and code reviews.
* Strong experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines and transformation processes.
* Ability to perform data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and quality checks.
* Ability to work with structured data from multiple source systems and integrate it into analytical data platforms.

* Rebuild downstream data objects when required.

**Systems Consultant II**
-------------------------

Are you a systems professional looking to scale mission-critical cloud infrastructure and defend vital public sector networks? Help federal agencies automate their most complex operational workflows.

**Location:** McLean/Tysons, VA | **Work Model:** On-site (4–5 days/week)

### **About the Team**

Appian Customer Success is obsessed with supporting our federal customers' missions by delivering transformative, high-availability cloud automation solutions. Our Federal DevOps Engineering team works hand-in-hand with government agencies, ensuring their automated workflows are resilient, securely scaled, and continuously optimized. Grounded in a culture of in-person collaboration at our McLean HQ, we tackle complex technical challenges to keep public infrastructure running smoothly across the **AI-Powered Process Automation** landscape.

### **The Opportunity**

As a DevOps Engineer within our Federal Customer Success division, you will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure engineering and modern application delivery. This role is vital right now because federal agencies are rapidly scaling their digital footprints across hybrid and secure cloud ecosystems. Under the guidance of senior architects, you will gain deep operational mastery of our software platform, automate underlying infrastructures, and enable agencies to achieve true **Enterprise-Grade Orchestration**.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Scale Cloud Infrastructure:** Participate in the installation, day-to-day operation, and scaling of the Appian platform across federal customer environments.
* **Master Cloud & Systems Administration:** Expand your hands-on systems administration footprint (**Linux**, **Windows**) across major IaaS Solutions such as **AWS**, **Google Compute Engine**, or **Microsoft Azure**.
* **Automate Platform Operations:** Utilize programming and scripting skills (**BASH**, **Java**, **JavaScript**, **Python**, or **Ruby**) to automate patching, configuration management, and deployment workflows.
* **Manage Enterprise Data Tiering:** Administer and optimize relational database platforms (**PostgreSQL**, **MySQL**, **Oracle**, **SQL Server**) with increasing operational independence.
* **Deliver Strategic Technical Support:** Interface directly with federal clients to troubleshoot infrastructure roadblocks, provide exceptional technical guidance, and ensure environment stability.
* **Navigate Public Sector Processes:** Develop a comprehensive understanding of client business processes, supporting both secure cloud and on-premise government installations.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Citizenship & Clearance:** Must be a U.S. Citizen with the absolute ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance.
* **Education:** Minimum of a Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
* **Experience:** 2–4 years of professional experience in IT systems administration, with a proven track record of building, maintaining, scripting, patching, and managing hosts, databases, and interconnected cloud networks.

title: Full-Stack DevOps Engineer
description:
**About us**

www.mustdoadmin.com, owned by NNRoad Inc., is an early-stage startup. We run the back office for startups doing business in California, especially foreign companies and companies from other states that are entering California for the first time: HR, payroll, bookkeeping, and the registrations, filings and deadlines that come with a new California entity. Our clients, their employees and our account managers all work through one web portal.

We are a small team building that portal now, and we are hiring our first engineer to own it end to end.

**The role**

You will be the engineer responsible for the MustDoAdmin portal: you build it, ship it and keep it running. That means writing and maintaining the application, deploying it, and operating the servers, databases and security behind it. You will work directly with the founder and our account managers, who use the portal every day. As our first engineer, you will help decide how the product is built, not just build what is specified.

This is a full-time, on-site role in our downtown San Jose office.

**What you will do**

Development and maintenance

* Build new features across the stack: web front end, back-end services and APIs, from a clickable design to production.

* Maintain and improve the existing code: fix bugs, refactor, write tests and keep dependencies current.

* Build and maintain integrations with the systems our clients use, such as payroll platforms, accounting software and e-signature services.

* Build the portal's AI features, such as checking uploaded documents and pre-filling forms, using cloud or locally hosted models.

Deployment

* Own the release process: version control, code review, automated builds and tests (CI/CD), staging and production environments.

* Ship changes safely and often, with a tested way to roll back.

Operations: servers, databases and security

* Run and monitor the servers and cloud services the portal runs on; plan capacity and keep costs under control.

* Administer the databases: schema changes, backups, restore tests, performance tuning.

* Secure the system and the sensitive data in it (personal details, pay and bank information): access control, multi-factor sign-in, encryption, patching, logging and alerting.

* Respond to incidents, find the root cause and fix it for good.

* Keep clear documentation of how the system is built, deployed and run, so that it does not depend on any one person's memory.

**What we are looking for**

We care more about how you think than how many years you have worked. With today's AI tools, the most valuable skills are knowing exactly what to build and why, and having the judgment to check the result.

* Experience building, deploying and supporting a production web application, at work or on your own projects.

* Hands-on skills in a modern back-end language and framework (such as TypeScript/Node.js or Python) and a front-end framework (such as React).

* Relational database experience (such as PostgreSQL): data modeling, migrations, backups and query tuning.

* Linux server administration, a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud), Docker and CI/CD.

* Experience building with large language models, including running models locally.

* Familiarity with SOC 2 or similar security and compliance frameworks.

* A degree in computer science or a related field.

* Clear thinking. You can take a messy business request, find what actually matters, and describe the problem and the requirement precisely enough that a person or an AI tool can build it correctly.

* Strong logic. You break a problem into parts, spot gaps and contradictions, and test your assumptions.

* Broad working knowledge. You understand how a modern web application fits together end to end: front end, back end, databases, servers, networking and security. You do not need to be an expert in all of it, but you know enough to make sound decisions and find out the rest.

* Curiosity and initiative. You explore new tools and approaches, try things, and propose better ways of doing them without waiting to be asked.

* Effective use of AI. You already use AI coding and research tools in your work, and you review what they produce instead of trusting it blindly.

* Ownership. You are comfortable being the only engineer: you make decisions on your own, explain them in plain English to non-technical colleagues, and write things down.

* Care with sensitive data. You understand that the portal holds people's personal, pay and bank details, and you treat security as part of the job.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with HR, payroll, accounting or other software that handles regulated data.

* Integrations with payroll or accounting APIs (for example Gusto or QuickBooks) or banking APIs.

**Schedule, location and work authorization**

* Full-time, fully on site at our office in downtown San Jose, California, five days a week. This role is not remote or hybrid.

* Working hours, Monday to Friday, Pacific Time:

o Standard time (early November to mid-March): 11:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.

o Daylight saving time (mid-March to early November): 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.

* The schedule includes a meal break. Occasional work outside these hours for planned releases or urgent production issues.

**How to apply**

Send your resume to info@nnroad.com with the subject line "Full-Stack DevOps Engineer". In a few lines, tell us about a system you built and kept running in production: what it did, how you deployed it, and one problem you had to fix under pressure. Links to code or projects are welcome.

**Equal opportunity**

MustDoAdmin is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

* 401(k)

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS DevOps Agent
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Build the AI agent that investigates production incidents for AWS customers. The AWS DevOps Agent reads the same telemetry a human operator would — logs, metrics, traces, topology — reasons about what went wrong, and delivers a written root-cause analysis in minutes. We're hiring an SDE II to work on the investigation agent: the core reasoning engine that turns an alarm into an answer.  
  
This is not wrapper code over an LLM. You'll work on agent orchestration, tool design over MCP (Model Context Protocol), prompt engineering at scale, sandbox isolation for untrusted code execution, and evaluation systems that measure whether the agent actually got the diagnosis right. The system spans Rust, Python, and TypeScript services across a hundred packages, and ships to production across all commercial AWS regions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and build agent reasoning systems that investigate production incidents end-to-end — from alarm to root-cause analysis — using large language models and a tool-calling architecture over MCP.
* Own and evolve the investigation agent's tool surface: the capabilities the agent uses to read CloudWatch, X-Ray, Kubernetes, CloudTrail, and service topology on a customer's behalf.
* Build and improve evaluation systems (offline scenarios with ground-truth grading, online trajectory evaluation of production runs) that measure agent quality and catch regressions before customers do.
* Work across the stack — Python agent runtime on Strands, Rust Data Plane services, TypeScript control plane and CDK infrastructure — in a system where a single investigation crosses half a dozen services.
* Design prompt and skill architectures that shape how the agent reasons without hard-coding investigation logic, balancing model flexibility with reliability.
* Collaborate with security, AppSec, and partner service teams on the trust boundaries that let an AI agent safely read customer telemetry at scale.

  
A day in the life  
You might start the morning reviewing an eval regression — the agent's accuracy on a new scenario class dropped, and you're digging into the journal trace to understand what the model missed. After lunch you're pairing with a teammate on a new MCP tool that gives the agent access to deployment history, deciding what information to surface and what to withhold. By end of day you're reviewing a CR that changes how the agent handles multi-signal incidents where logs, metrics, and traces tell conflicting stories. The problems are ambiguous, the feedback loop is fast (run the agent, read the trace, grade the result), and the work ships to every AWS commercial region.  
  
About the team  
The AWS DevOps Agent team builds an AI agent that investigates incidents, reviews releases, and answers operational questions about running AWS environments. We own the full vertical: the agent runtime, the tool servers, the sandbox, the evaluation pipeline, and the data plane that records what every run did. Our system serves AWS customers across all commercial regions, and the investigation agent is the flagship — the thing that turns "an alarm fired" into "here's what happened and what to do about it." We're a team that cares about whether the agent is actually right, not just whether it sounds right, and we've built the eval infrastructure to tell the difference.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Remote)
description:
TLDR; We build software for vacation rentals to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.

We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it.

We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help them with more of their problems.

Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself!

Hospitable.com is a **remote-only** and **fully distributed** company. We hire based on timezones, not countries.

### **The Role**

We're hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to work alongside our existing infrastructure lead, so the platform is no longer a single point of failure.

Your mission: make our Kubernetes and cloud platform safer, more reliable, and easier for product engineers to operate — and keep it that way as we grow. A large part of the job is keeping production healthy: incidents, upgrades, capacity, cost, and the unglamorous work that stops small problems becoming outages. You will also improve the platform itself, not only react to it.

This is a senior individual-contributor role at our E3–E4 level. You will report to Ivan, who leads infrastructure today.

*"Working at Hospitable is both the most intense and the most rewarding professional experiences of my life. The momentum isn't for everyone, neither is the laser focus on shipping value, but the right person will flourish and grow here more so than just about anywhere else."* - Nik, Principal Product Engineer.

### **The platform**

Our platform runs across several Kubernetes clusters and 30+ managed database clusters.

Our main infrastructure stack includes:

* Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and Terraform
* DigitalOcean, with services in AWS and Cloudflare
* GitLab CI/CD and container registries
* MySQL, Redis, Beanstalk, and queue-heavy applications
* VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Loki, Vector, Alertmanager, and PMM
* Vault, cert-manager, external-dns, NGINX, KEDA, and Falco

We are an AI-forward engineering team. We use tools such as Cursor to work faster, but we expect engineers to understand and carefully review all changes before they reach production. That matters especially in infrastructure: you should be able to explain what a change will do, steer an agent when it goes wrong, and debug a system without relying on AI.

### **What you will be working on**

* Design, operate, and improve our Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.
* Maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform and Helm.
* Improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of production systems.
* Build safer and faster CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure changes.
* Improve monitoring, alerting, service-level objectives, logs, and operational dashboards.
* Help engineering teams deploy and operate services without unnecessary infrastructure knowledge.
* Improve database, queue, network, DNS, certificate, and secrets operations.
* Lead infrastructure work during incidents and turn incident findings into lasting improvements.
* Remove manual processes through clear automation and internal tools.
* Working closely with Ivan, who's favourite fruit is nectarine.
* Plan capacity and reduce single points of failure as the platform grows.
* Write clear documentation and share operational knowledge across the engineering team.

You will spend most of your time on focused, steady execution, and some of it jumping into whatever is on fire. We need both: someone who finishes the work that keeps the lights on, and someone we can trust to step into a messy problem without fuss.

 **Requirements**

**Hospitable is a remote-only and distributed company. For this position, your location is not a requirement. We are looking for someone in the European and US-East timezones.**

Don't tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you're still an amazing fit. In the meantime, here's what we're paying attention to:

* Strong production experience in infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or site reliability engineering. This usually means 5+ years in similar roles.
* Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes.
* Hands-on knowledge of at least one major cloud provider, and ideally more than one.
* Strong experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool.
* Experience building and maintaining Helm charts.
* Good knowledge of Linux, containers, networking, DNS, TLS, and cloud security.
* Experience with CI/CD systems. GitLab CI experience is useful but not required.
* Experience with metrics, logs, alerts, and incident investigation.
* Ability to write maintainable automation in a language such as Go, Python, or shell.
* A practical approach to reliability. You know when to automate, when to simplify, and when not to add a new system.
* Strong written communication. Most of our work happens asynchronously through Slack, Notion, and code reviews.
* The ability to make sound decisions when requirements are incomplete.
* Empathy for product engineers and customers.
* Comfort explaining technical work clearly, including to people who are not infrastructure engineers.

### **Useful additional experience**

* MySQL and Redis operations at scale
* Vault and Kubernetes secrets management
* VictoriaMetrics, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or Vector
* Argo CD, KEDA, cert-manager, or external-dns
* Runtime security tools such as Falco
* High-volume queues and asynchronous workloads
* SLO design, capacity planning, and cloud cost management
* Remote incident response and on-call operations

  
**Benefits**

The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

* A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.
* The total budget for this role is between USD$134,450.00 - USD $167,258.30 depending on the cost of living in your location. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For US employees, the gross compensation could be anywhere between USD$123,888.97 - USD$154,120.18.
* We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a grant value of up to $76,026.50, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.
* Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional USD$268,000.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.
* For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).
* 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.
* Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.
* Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.

description:

The **Associate Cloud Engineer** is responsible for supporting Azure and AWS environments, with a focus on pre-production connectivity, installation readiness, and first-line troubleshooting for Managed Services customers.

This role will act as the frontline contact with Cloud Products during pre-sales, pre-implementation and post-sales activities, working closely with application, security, and platform teams to keep environments reliable and production-ready. The role develops technical skills through training and senior-engineer guidance, with complex issues escalated to the appropriate teams. This role may require participation in an on-call rotation following training, with senior escalation support.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Act as the first point of contact for Managed Services connectivity, troubleshooting, production issues across assigned environments and escalating high complexity challenges as appropriate.
* Support Azure and AWS installation readiness by gathering project requirements, access details, customer dependencies and outstanding actions before implementation.
* Coordinate with Cloud Products and project teams to clarify customer requirements, confirm agreed service scope and track technical actions through pre-sales, pre-implementation and post-sales handoffs.
* Support pre-production networking and connectivity checks, including DNS, firewall rules, VPN connections and load balancers, using approved procedures and senior-engineer guidance.
* Support integrations between Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) and client-facing dependencies, including storage, databases, messaging, DNS resolution, firewall rules, private endpoints, and service connectivity.
* Support secure environments through approved access, configuration and change-management procedures.
* Coordinate installation change requests for Change Advisory Board (CAB) review including, but not limited to, gathering the business need, scope, risk, implementation, validation and rollback details. Confirm CAB review and required change(s) with the change owner, track approvals before work proceeds and confirm completion afterward.
* Support approved deployment and installation activities, including readiness checks and follow-up on missing requirements or approvals, under senior-engineer guidance.
* Use observability tools, including Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch and Elastic/Kibana, to review alerts, logs and application health for assigned systems.
* Collaborate with application and cloud teams to investigate issues spanning Smile CDR, related Smile Digital Health applications and dependent services (database, messaging, network). Follow approved runbooks and escalate unresolved issues.
* Provide first-response support for cloud and application incidents including, but not limited to, gathering detailed troubleshooting logs, timestamps, request identifiers, customer impact and steps taken, following data-handling policies, and communicating progress through resolution or accepted escalation.

### **Requirements:**

* 1-3+ years of experience in technical support, cloud operations or systems administration. Hands-on projects, coursework or internships may be considered in level of experience.
* Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or similar and/or equivalent working experience.
* Strong continuous learning mindset for technical knowledge specifically Azure, AWS and Smile applications.
* Fundamental knowledge of operating systems, networking, storage and access controls.
* Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hands-on experience troubleshooting connectivity issues.
* Demonstrated experience understanding and executing runbooks, collecting diagnostic evidence with ability to identify when to escalate complex issues.
* Exposure to Azure or AWS services and troubleshooting network-layer dependencies (DNS, firewall, private endpoints), including but not limited to, lab and/or academic project experience.
* Demonstrated ability to be both self-driven and partner effectively across technical and non-technical cross-functional teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to convey technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience gathering technical requirements, following change-management procedures and maintaining accurate project and support records.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles, with practical exposure to Terraform preferred.
* Basic understanding of Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tooling, preferred.
* Experience reviewing logs and alerts using monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch or Elastic/Kibana, preferred.
* Demonstrated scripting skills in Bash, Python or PowerShell, preferred.
* Associate Azure or AWS certification or in progress, preferred.

**Some of the benefits we offer:**

* Remote Work Environment
* Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days
* Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits
* RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution
* Life and Disability
* Employee Assistance Program
* FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning
* Super HAPI Fun Club

We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile.

The Senior Analytics Engineer will contribute to producing innovative, impactful analytics products while ensuring data is maintained as an asset with high quality standards.

This is a hybrid role with two main areas of focus:

* **Analytics engineering:** building and maintaining tested, documented data models, the semantic layer, and data quality checks.
* **BI and reporting delivery:** working with product and business teams to define what they need, then building the dashboards and reports that meet those needs.

**Here are some ways you'll make an impact:**

### ***Data modeling and quality***

* Design, build and maintain **dbt models** that are tested, documented and reusable across reports and products.
* Own and extend our semantic layer so each metric is defined once and used consistently in every report and BI tool.
* Build data tests, freshness checks and monitoring, and fix data quality issues at the source.
* Improve the performance and cost of transformation workflows in our cloud data warehouse.
* Work with data engineering to bring streaming data into the models for near-real-time reporting.
* Apply tenant-level access controls and data governance standards so each customer sees only their own data.
* Maintain data dictionaries and model documentation.

### ***Reporting and enablement***

* Work with product, customer-facing and business teams to turn reporting requests into clear requirements, and recommend the right type of reporting and data source for each use case.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for internal teams and customers.
* Train users and write guides so teams can answer their own questions, and troubleshoot reporting tools when issues come up.
* Mentor junior team members and review their work.
* Work with leadership to set team standards, goals and priorities

**An Ideal Candidate Has:**

* 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development or data engineering, including building data models used in production.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, information systems or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Advanced SQL, and experience building data models in dbt or a similar framework using version control, code review and CI/CD.
* Strong grasp of dimensional modeling and experience with a cloud data warehouse.
* Experience building dashboards and reports in at least one major BI tool, such as **Tableau or Amazon QuickSight**.
* Ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and explain technical tradeoffs, data sources and analytical options in plain language.
* Ability to manage your own priorities across data modeling work and incoming reporting requests.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI (GenAI), Large Language Models (LLMs), and their applications in analytics.
* Experience leveraging tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Claude for data analysis and business insights.
* Knowledge of Prompt Engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Ability to build AI-powered analytical solutions and intelligent assistants.
* Experience using AI to automate data analysis, reporting, and insight generation.
* Understanding of AI agents and agentic workflows.
* AI agent integration with reporting platform like Quicksight / tableau.

**Bonus Points if you have:**

* Experience in clinical trials, life sciences or another regulated industry, including familiarity with GxP or 21 CFR Part 11 data integrity expectations.
* Experience with Snowflake, dbt Cloud, and MetricFlow or another semantic layer.
* Experience with streaming data, such as Kafka.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS data and row-level security.
* Python for data work and automation.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools, or preparing data and metrics for natural-language or LLM-based analytics.

**What’s in it for you?**

* **Do well.** We offer a competitive compensation package, medical and dental insurance, and office space in the heart of the city.
* **Do good.** We insist that health technology is the highest calling for software development. We pride ourselves on working on something bigger than ourselves; helping advance cures and therapies.
* **Make the leap.** Join our high-output culture to create innovative, modern, and purposeful software solutions.

Florence supports workplace diversity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, physical disability, or any other protected class.

*Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud.* *Florence Healthcare will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. In addition, Florence Healthcare will not ask for your personal banking information until you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. All communications with Florence Healthcare employees will only be sent from @florencehc.com email addresses.*

**What You'll Bring to The Team:**
We are looking for a curious, experienced, and passionate analytics professional to assist with providing cutting edge solutions. The Senior Analytics Engineer will contribute to producing innovative, impactful analytics products while ensuring data is maintained as an asset with high quality standards.
  
  
This is a hybrid role with two main areas of focus:
  
  

* Analytics engineering: building and maintaining tested, documented data models, the semantic layer, and data quality checks.
* BI and reporting delivery: working with product and business teams to define what they need, then building the dashboards and reports that meet those needs.

**Here are some ways you'll make an impact:**

* Build data tests, freshness checks and monitoring, and fix data quality issues at the source.
* Improve the performance and cost of transformation workflows in our cloud data warehouse.
* Work with data engineering to bring streaming data into the models for near-real-time reporting.
* Apply tenant-level access controls and data governance standards so each customer sees only their own data.

*Reporting and enablement*

* Work with product, customer-facing and business teams to turn reporting requests into clear requirements, and recommend the right type of reporting and data source for each use case.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for internal teams and customers.

* Experience with streaming data, such as Kafka.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com, @patientpop.com, or @kareo.com) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.
  
  
**About The Role**
Tebra helps private practices bring modernized care to patients everywhere. To run our own business well, every team needs numbers it can trust.
  
  
We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help build Tebra's new internal analytics platform. You'll turn data from Salesforce, NetSuite, Stripe, our product, and other systems into one shared, tested set of business data and metrics that Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments all use. You'll lead projects end to end, set the standards others build on, and partner with business leaders to define the metrics that matter most.
  
  
**Your Area of Focus**

* Data Modeling & Shared Datasets: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-wide business data that teams across Finance, Customer Success, Growth, and Payments build on. Apply dimensional modeling and layered design (staging, intermediate, and marts) so business logic lives in one place and isn't rebuilt by each team.
* Metric Definition & Semantic Layer: Partner with metric owners in Finance and the business to define each key metric once, with a named owner and documented logic. Publish governed metrics in a semantic layer that Tableau, AI assistants, and other tools query, and reconcile them to current reporting and the general ledger before teams switch over.
* Self-Service Enablement: Build easy-to-use datasets that let non-technical teammates and analysts answer their own questions without writing complex joins.
* Platform Migration: Lead projects end to end on the new internal analytics platform, from source data to dashboards. Move each team's reporting over one domain at a time, with clear cutover and rollback plans, and onboard the analysts who contribute to new conventions, review processes, and tools.
* Data Quality & Testing: Build automated tests and pull-request checks so data issues are caught before they reach reports. Monitor scheduled jobs, fix failures, and recover runs as part of shared production support.
* Performance & Efficiency: Tune SQL, models, and pipeline schedules so data refreshes on time and dashboards load in seconds. Monitor compute usage and cost, and choose how each model is built and refreshed to keep both in check.
* Forecasting & Machine Learning: Partner with analysts and data scientists to prepare clean, documented datasets for forecasting and machine learning models, such as retention and revenue projections.
* Code Review & Mentorship: Review code from analysts and engineers across teams, and coach them on modeling, SQL, and testing standards.
* Governance & Documentation: Follow data-sharing and privacy rules that keep protected health information (PHI) and personal data out of internal analytics. Maintain model documentation, lineage, and metric definitions via dbt, GitHub, Confluence, and Jira.

**Your Professional Qualifications**

* Experience: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role, with 2+ years hands-on in dbt in production.
* SQL Fluency: Expert SQL, including window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning for queries and pipelines on large datasets.
* Data Modeling: Deep proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball), including shared datasets that serve many teams.
* Tech Stack: Proven experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, and with dbt.
* Business Partnership: Experience defining business metrics with Finance or business stakeholders, and reconciling data to financial systems.
* Software Mindset: Experience with GitHub for version control and code review, automated builds (GitHub Actions or similar), and Jira and Confluence for work tracking and documentation.
* Communication: Strong communication with people who aren't data specialists, and ability to execute under minimal supervision.
* Growth Mindset: Motivated to learn new technologies and develop new skills.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, economics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Semantic Layer: Experience with a semantic layer, such as Snowflake semantic views or the dbt Semantic Layer, preferred.
* Domain Knowledge: Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or Stripe data, and with subscription revenue, retention, or payments metrics, preferred.
* Forecasting & ML: Experience preparing data for forecasting or machine learning models preferred.
* Healthcare: Healthcare or HIPAA experience preferred.
* Additional Tools: Familiarity with Tableau, Terraform, or Okta a plus.
* Certifications: dbt Analytics Engineering or SnowPro certifications preferred.

HOUSTON

title: Software Engineer II - Data Engineering
description:
*7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.*

**Job Summary**
---------------

Build, test, and support reliable data pipelines, datasets, and data products with guidance from senior engineers. This role helps turn business and technical requirements into working data solutions for reporting, analytics, AI/ML, and business operations. The Data Engineer II is expected to follow team standards, learn approved tools and patterns, support production work, and use approved AI tools to work faster while reviewing the output carefully.

  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

**1. Data Engineering**
-----------------------

* Build, test, deploy, and support batch and streaming data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, SQL, Python/PySpark, dbt, Airflow, or similar tools.

* Help build reliable data products for reporting, analytics, AI/ML, and business operations.

* Work with senior engineers to implement Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers and follow medallion architecture patterns.

* Build and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and consumption jobs for internal systems and external data sources.

* Improve pipeline performance, storage use, and compute cost with guidance from senior engineers.

* Document solutions, job schedules, dependencies, and support steps so others can understand and maintain the work.

**2. Quality and Support**
--------------------------

* Add automated tests, data-quality checks, monitoring, alerts, and clear error handling.

* Help make sure data is fresh, accurate, and available when business users and downstream systems need it.

* Troubleshoot production issues, find the cause, and implement lasting fixes with guidance when needed.

* Support service levels, job failures, incident response, and routine production maintenance.

* Use source control, code review, CI/CD, and release practices to move changes safely into production.

**3. Security and Governance**
------------------------------

* Follow access, encryption, privacy, retention, metadata, lineage, and stewardship requirements.

* Handle data securely and follow approved patterns for sensitive data.

* Work with Security, Privacy, Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams when standards are unclear.

* Capture basic metadata and lineage details so data products can be understood, trusted, and reused.

**4. AI-Assisted Development**
------------------------------

* Learn and use approved AI tools, including Windsurf, Devin, and Databricks Genie where appropriate, to help with coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and analysis.

* Use AI tools to draft code patterns, explain errors, create test ideas, and speed up routine engineering work.

* Review and test AI-generated work before using it and ask a senior engineer for help when the output is unclear.

* Follow team standards for security, privacy, code review, and responsible AI use.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 3+ years in data engineering, software engineering, data integration, or a similar technical role.

* Working experience with SQL and Python and exposure to cloud data tools.

* Experience building or supporting data pipelines, ETL/ELT jobs, datasets, or data products.

* Basic understanding of data quality, testing, monitoring, source control, and production support practices.

* Experience or training in AI-assisted development tools, with the ability to review and test AI-generated work.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**
----------------------------

* Experience with Databricks, Spark, dbt, Airflow, Azure, or AWS.

* Exposure to medallion architecture, semantic layers, Dataiku, data catalogs, or data observability tools.

* Experience supporting analytics, reporting, AI/ML, or operational data use cases.

The Company may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in this state. This range may be modified in the future. No amount is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable under the terms and conditions of the applicable policies and plans. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, long-term incentive compensation, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.*

You are curious about the world, are constantly learning, driven to lead (formally or informally), and have a strong work ethic. You're interested in solving impactful problems in science, medicine, and other projects that have a societal good. You can work independently or with a team, prioritize your projects, and be effective without micromanagement.

You'll care about writing. Our team is remote and written communication is essential. In addition to caring about a well-crafted email and a succinct conference abstract, you understand that good writing is good design and engineering.

**Job Description**
===================

Element 84 is seeking a highly experienced and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud & HPC) with a strong background in architecting reliable, scalable cloud systems and a proven record of building and deploying containerized applications and utilizing infrastructure as code in complex deployments to support our innovative projects.

In this role, you'll be instrumental in leading the design, implementation, and operation of cloud-native solutions for complex operational systems, collaborating closely with technical teams and customers.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-grade software within cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on infrastructure as code principles. Hands-on experience running and supporting high performance computing (HPC) workflows on cloud platforms is essential for this role. While direct experience with geospatial applications isn't required, a curiosity and aptitude for working in this domain will be beneficial.

**What You'll Be Working On**
-----------------------------

* Leading the design and implementation of robust, scalable, and secure cloud-native solutions on AWS.
* Collaborating with security experts to translate organizational security requirements into secure and compliant cloud implementations.
* Developing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, HashiCorp Packer) to manage and provision infrastructure across numerous Azure and AWS accounts, ensuring consistency and efficiency.
* Constructing, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD automation pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to facilitate rapid and reliable software deployments.
* Building application containers and deploying them on cloud-native platforms, including HPC-specific container technologies where applicable.
* Estimating and optimizing the cost of workflows running on cloud platforms.
* Managing cloud data storage buckets that support operational workflows.
* Supporting high performance computing (HPC) workflows on cloud platforms.
* Crafting automation scripts in Python, Bash, JavaScript, and other relevant languages to streamline operational workflows.
* Contributing to the development and maintenance of infrastructure supporting Generative AI applications on domain-specific datasets.
* Automating the creation and management of front-end and back-end applications, pipelines, security tooling, etc.
* Defining and advocating for best practices and standards for DevOps success across Element 84 and our customer organizations.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in software development, with 3+ years specifically focused on Cloud Technologies.
* Strong, hands-on experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and/or HashiCorp Packer is a must, including writing, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex configurations for cloud environments.
* Hands-on experience building application containers (e.g., Docker) and deploying them on cloud-native platforms.
* Experience calculating cost estimates for workflows running on cloud platforms.
* Experience constructing and/or maintaining CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and/or GitLab CI.
* Experience with cloud data bucket management (e.g., Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage).
* Experience constructing, running, and supporting HPC workflows on cloud platforms
* Experience with HPC-specific container technologies (e.g., Singularity/Apptainer, Enroot).
* Strong experience developing in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Bash, JavaScript).
* Demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and managing infrastructure and services on a major cloud platform.
* Ability to clearly document and communicate intricate architectural concepts at various levels, including delivering presentations, creating visual representations of architectures, and writing white papers.
* Demonstrated experience in negotiating trade-offs between critical factors such as security, performance, maintainability, and cost.
* Proven ability to multitask and effectively prioritize work across competing demands and multiple customers.
* Extensive experience working within an Agile Development software team.
* Solid experience with Linux environments.
* Deep understanding of cloud architecture patterns and tradeoffs (e.g., serverless vs. provisioned, managed services vs. self-hosting).
* Expertise with build and deployment automation tools.
* Proficiency with infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, AWS Config, Kibana, Splunk, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, etc.)
* Experience with data storage and data engineering tools and technologies (e.g., ElasticSearch, SQL, NoSQL, DynamoDB, Redshift, Athena, Glue, etc.).
* Experience with networking tools and technologies and troubleshooting issues (CloudFront, Route53, Load Balancers, API Gateway, VPCs, NACLs, etc.).

title: GCP Cloud Engineer
description:
**About Us**  
RCH Solutions is a rapidly growing global provider of computational science expertise within Life Sciences and Healthcare. At RCH, our team rallies around a culture crafted for learning and achieving. We’re relentless in our pursuit for innovation and demanding of ourselves to deliver a ground-breaking computing experience for our clients, so that they can deliver life-saving science to humanity.  
  
**Core Values**  
At RCH, our Core Values are more than just words—they represent the threads that weave together the fabric of our culture. Used as a guide when interviewing new team members; as a barometer when evaluating our performance as individuals and teams, and even when deciding which customers to work with, RCH’s Values embody the behaviors upon which we measure our success and create a framework for our growth as people and professionals.  
  
Our Core Values:

* Embrace Excellence: We strive for best-in-class delivery of innovation and service.
* Be Accountable: Integrity, ownership and accountability are non-negotiables.
* Adventure Together: We are committed to fostering a culture that embraces continuous improvement.
* Succeed as a Team: We believe harnessing the power of a team drives outcomes not achievable by individuals.
* Boundaries and Balance: Work-life balance is a core facet of our culture.

If you share in our core values, then we encourage you to continue reading this posting as you may have found a great home for your career.  
  
**Job Description**  
RCH Solutions is seeking a Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate cloud-native services on Google Cloud Platform in support of research and bioinformatics workloads. The right candidate will develop microservices and web applications that put scientific computing directly in the hands of researchers and will build and maintain the workflow orchestration that runs bioinformatics pipelines at scale. You will function as a team member integrating cloud services, scientific applications, and upstream and downstream data systems into a coherent platform. Our ideal candidate is an experienced and talented engineer who is equally comfortable writing production code and reasoning about infrastructure, and who will be instrumental in transforming how computing services are leveraged to support our client's science.  
  
This role will involve driving architecture, roadmaps, and execution of projects that deliver GCP-based platform services to scientific end users. You will develop and implement engineering best practices for customers and RCH applications teams; engaging in the fast-moving realm of Life Sciences, prioritizing innovation. The cloud landscape and the bioinformatics tooling ecosystem are both continuously evolving, with new services and pipeline frameworks released constantly. You know how to distinguish hype from reality and are comfortable making recommendations that best suit our clients’ needs.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and deploy microservices and APIs on Google Cloud Platform to support scientific and bioinformatics workloads
* Develop and maintain web applications that give researchers self-service access to data, pipelines, and compute
* Build, operate, and tune workflow orchestration for bioinformatics pipelines, including scheduling, error handling, and runtime and cost optimization
* Integrate cloud services, scientific applications, and internal and third-party data systems through well-documented, maintainable interfaces
* Ensure that all systems are compliant with company security standards and applicable regulatory requirements
* Troubleshoot operational issues as they arise on supported platforms, and escalate to other IT units as necessary

**Essential Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of professional experience in cloud engineering or software engineering, including production workloads on Google Cloud Platform
* Experience designing and deploying microservices, including containerization and REST or gRPC API development
* Experience with a workflow orchestration framework for scientific or data pipelines, such as Nextflow, Cromwell, Snakemake, or Airflow
* Demonstrated systems integration experience connecting cloud services, applications, and external data sources
* Web application development experience, either full stack or strong backend skills paired with working front-end proficiency
* Proficiency in Python and comfort working in a Linux environment
* Excellent communication skills, including preparation of written documentation for IT colleagues and scientific end users
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Bioinformatics, or equivalent work experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience supporting bioinformatics or computational biology workloads, such as genomics and NGS pipelines, structural biology, or cheminformatics
* Familiarity with GCP services including GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage
* Experience with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform
* Proficient in building Docker images
* Experience with CI/CD for building and deploying containerized services
* R, or other programming languages common in scientific computing
* Has good knowledge of deploying or supporting GxP systems
* Git, BitBucket, or other version control tools

  
**Additional information**  
Great talent should benefit from a great work environment. If you join our team, you’ll have access to:

* A competitive salary and bonus package based on experience.
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
* Company-provided Life and Long-Term Disability Insurance.
* Company-sponsored 401(k) Plan.
* Team-focused culture and unlimited opportunity for advancement.

  
***\*\*This is an onsite position and the candidate will be required to be onsite in our client facility in Collegeville, PA at least 3 days per week.***  
  
***\*\*Role is only open to applicants not needing sponsorship now or in the future, no third parties please.***

title: Senior Database Administrator, Data Platform
description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

Owns the pipelines, data layers and databases that move source data into Microsoft Fabric and make it ready for reporting.

Data moves from source systems such as Stratus, COINS and Autodesk through Fabric pipelines into bronze (raw), silver (cleaned and conformed) and gold (business-ready) layers, and from gold into Power BI. Your primary focus is the data side: landing data in bronze, cleansing it in silver and delivering the gold tables the Senior Power BI Developer reports on, plus the SQL Server and Fabric databases behind them. This is a senior individual contributor role: you own your area end to end, make independent design decisions and mentor others. We build on Microsoft Fabric today and expect to adopt new tools as the platform grows, so experience across modern data platforms counts.

**Position Details**
--------------------

* Ingest data from SQL Server, ERP, SaaS apps, APIs, and files into bronze using Fabric pipelines.**•** Build full and incremental loads, including change data capture where sources support it.
* Cleanse and conform data in silver and build gold fact and dimension tables for reporting.
* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation to source and alerting at each layer.
* Orchestrate, schedule, and monitor pipelines, and own their reliability and failure recovery.
* Administer SQL Server and Fabric warehouse databases: configuration, patching, indexing, statistics.
* Tune query and pipeline performance using execution plans, Query Store and Fabric capacity metrics.
* Manage access, encryption and auditing, and test backup, restore and disaster recovery.
* Deploy database and pipeline changes through Git and deployment pipelines across Dev, Test and Prod.
* Lead the migration of legacy SQL Server jobs, SSIS packages and spreadsheet feeds into Fabric.
* Evaluate new data platform tools and AI capabilities, and recommend what the team should adopt.
* Set modeling and pipeline standards, maintain lineage and documentation, and mentor engineers.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience.
* Five or more years working with SQL Server, including at least three years building data pipelines and ETL into a data warehouse or lakehouse.
* Professional certification in the specialism is common and is never a substitute for scope.
* 5+ years administering production SQL Server: security, indexing, backup, restore and performance tuning.
* 5+ years of advanced T-SQL, including stored procedures, query tuning and execution plans.
* 3+ years building ETL/ELT pipelines into a warehouse or lakehouse, with incremental loads and monitoring.
* 2+ years on a cloud data platform such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks or Snowflake.
* Experience with medallion architecture and dimensional modeling, including slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience implementing data quality, validation and reconciliation checks.
* Working knowledge of Power BI semantic models and how reporting tools consume gold-layer data.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Python or PySpark for data engineering; orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow or dbt.
* Azure SQL Database or Managed Instance, and Always On availability groups.
* REST API ingestion and integration platforms such as Workato; migrating SSIS packages to modern pipelines.
* Data governance and lineage tools such as Microsoft Purview.
* AI-assisted development (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and preparing data for AI and machine learning.
* Construction ERP and project data from systems such as COINS, Stratus or Autodesk Construction Cloud.

**Pay**
-------

Final pay is determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data. For **California**, this range is **$118,119-$144,368** plus annual incentive, benefits, and retirement programs as outlined above.

**Benefits**

As a 100% employee-owned company, we offer a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family:

* 401(k) plan with **50% company match (no cap)** and immediate 100% vesting
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance **(100% paid for employee)**
* Annual bonus program based upon performance, achievement, and company profitability
* Term life, AD&D insurance, and voluntary life insurance
* Disability income protection insurance
* Pre-tax flexible spending plans (health and dependent care)
* **Paid parental leave**
* Paid holidays, vacation, and personal time
* Training/professional development opportunities and company-paid memberships for professional associations and licenses
* Wellness benefits

As one of the nation’s largest MEP companies, Southland Industries is built on the foundation of great people.
