title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
The Senior Data Engineer plays a critical role in the successful execution of Allied’s Data Strategy. This role will be focused on data acquisition, curation, and transformation of data into a useable asset. They will work cross-functionally to develop and deploy optimized data models and modern data architecture in support of strategic data and business initiatives. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for data domain knowledge, SQL, data design, and data processes across the enterprise. This individual will collaborate with teams across the organization to design and build end to end data flows for optimal business intelligence, advanced analytics, and data monetization efforts. Lastly, this role will contribute to core design of data architecture, data models, schemas, and inform future state Data Management and Data Strategy roadmaps.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Creates detailed documentation of data warehouse, data stores, and end-to-end data flows
* Troubleshoots and corrects data and data processing errors in existing solutions
* Works with other technical teams as well as with internal and external users to develop technical designs
* Develops and continually refines the BI-focused data architecture
* Works closely with the Data Intelligence department to understand the data and reporting requirements from internal and external customers and the steps to take on the back-end data side to achieve the expected results
* Conducts gap analysis on source system databases against Allied’s enterprise data warehouse in support of Business Intelligence efforts
* Develops and maintains data sets and standardizes data collection and processing methodologies
* Provides technical advice and weighs in on technical decisions that impact cross-functional teams
* Attends and contributes to architecture meetings to determine project scope, time frame, and cost estimates
* Works on plan and technical architecture to extract, integrate, and/or push data to or from third-party providers
* Provides enterprise data solutions for Allied, including ETL maintenance, warehouse data models, periodic upgrades, security, governance, and performance optimization
* Understands the data warehouse and data mart models as well as being familiar with the business information contained in each
* Locates and defines new process improvement opportunities or alternative technologies that will enhance speed to business value delivery with our data
* Collaborates with developers and subject matter experts to establish the technical vision and analyze trade-offs between usability and performance needs
Mentors other ETL Developers and Data Engineers  

  

**Qualifications (Education, Experience, Certifications & KSA)**

* Bachelor’s Degree required, or equivalent education/work experience
* 5+ years of experience with data warehousing, databases (MS SQL Server, Snowflake), and dimensional modeling
* 5+ years of experience in end-to-end data analysis and development
* 3-5 years of experience in AWS cloud services (AWS Glue, Lambda, S3, etc.)
* 3-5 years of experience with Snowflake (Snowpipe, Snowpark, Streamlit, Streams/Tasks) (preferred)
* Extensive Experience with SQL required
* Experience with R or Python (preferred)
* Experience with Git and CI/CD (preferred)
* Strong attention to detail
* Familiarity with Object-Oriented Analysis, Project Management, Business Analysis Methodology, and the SDLC
* Ability to collaborate effectively and work as part of a team
* Customer-oriented, with a desire to resolve problems to the customer's satisfaction while maintaining focus on productivity, efficiency, and quality
* Effective communicator to clients, management, and project partners
* Experience with cloud-based technologies and services (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS) (preferred)
* Experience with Master Data Management (preferred)
* Strong analytical and product management skills required, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into application and operational requirements.

We offer our employees a robust compensation package! Our comprehensive benefits include: medical, dental and vision insurance coverage; 100% company-paid life and disability coverage, 401k options with company match, three weeks PTO by the end of the first year and much more. Allied proudly promotes from within as part of a strong commitment to providing career growth opportunities for employees of all levels. Our diverse business portfolio allows employees broad career options with the advantage of staying with the same organization.
  
  
All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: SLDS Data Engineer
description:
Dear Candidate

Please find the below requirement

**SLDS Data Engineer**

Rate : ALAP

Location: Denver, Colorado 80203

Fulltime- Direct Client

Rate $70 to $80 as per the exp

**Candidate must be within 100 miles**

**Work Arrangement: Remote / Telecommuting**

**(Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates)**

Preferred Skills & Experience

* Prior experience working with public sector, longitudinal education, and workforce data systems (e.g., CDE, CDHE, CDLE, CDEC, National Student Clearinghouse).
* Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, and deterministic/probabilistic identity matching across disparate public records
* Familiarity with federal and state student/workforce privacy regulations, including FERPA, COPPA, and cell suppression standards
* Experience authoring and executing structured test plans in Azure Test Plans
* Work Arrangement: Remote / Telecommuting (Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates)

The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line-of-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists.

In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS / COdata) an OIT Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor.

The OIT Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge-transfer progression (shadowing, co-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer.

1. Scope of Responsibilities

* Data Ingestion & Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model.
* Transformation & Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect.
* Record Linkage & Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross-agency reconciliations.
* Production Pipeline Operations & Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects.
* Data Quality & Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes).
* Performance Optimization & Platform Stewardship: Optimize query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance for cost and latency; identify and tune heavily used models and performance hot spots in Snowflake.
* Quality Assurance, Code Review & Promotion: Adhere to the unified release process across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans; author and execute test cases, conduct peer code reviews, and maintain release change logs.

2. Activities Performed

A. Ingestion & Pipeline Development (OIT-Led Feeds)

* CDHE Courses Data Ingestion:

o Ingest and validate annual postsecondary course-level data files from CDHE per data sharing agreements.

o Build ETL mapping processes from CDHE course files into the SLDS common data model based on design specifications provided by 3rd party implementation partner.

o Pair with 3 party implementation team during ETL construction, validation, and promotion.

* Postsecondary SES & Disability Data Ingestion (Conditional):

o Ingest and validate demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability classification codes from postsecondary sources.

o Apply mandated privacy protections, cell suppression rules, and permissible-use governance requirements.

* PSAT/SAT Assessment Data Ingestion (Conditional):

o Ingest, validate, and map section/composite assessment scores and grade levels from the College Board or CDE.

o Execute identity matching to connect assessment records to existing longitudinal student profiles.

B. Knowledge Transfer & Operational Transition (Jan–April 2027)

* Shadowing & Co-running (Jan–Feb 2027):

o Shadow 3rd party implementation partner engineers on day-to-day operations of existing data feeds (e.g., NSC, K-3, CDEC, and Phase 1 feeds).

o Co-run live feed cycles, handle data loading, execute record matching, and troubleshoot exceptions alongside 3rd party implementation partner.

* Readiness Gate Execution (Target: March 2027):

o Run two consecutive feed cycles completely unaided to achieve formal operational hand-over sign-off.

* Full Production Operations (March 2027 Onward):

o Execute recurring feed schedules, rebuild downstream objects, reconcile row counts against source files, and triage failed jobs.

o Address ad-hoc data inquiries and export requests from OIT leadership and partner agencies.

C. Data Stabilization & Analytics Layer Upkeep

* Stabilization Backlog Support: Resolve identified data reliability defects, run variations, and de-duplication issues transitioned from the Phase 1 stabilization backlog.
* Analytics Layer Hardening & Maintenance (April 2027 Onward):

o Apply object modeling standards, naming conventions, and layout-change detection into the RAW layer.

o Perform ongoing reconciliation of analytics layer outputs across non-production and production environments.

o Implement metric and calculation enhancements prioritizing downstream use cases (program participation, completion, equitable access, and wage outcomes).

o Conduct query profiling and performance tuning on dashboard back-end models.

D. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Testing

* Testing & Release Management: Author manual and automated test cases in Azure Test Plans; record execution evidence and resolve defect bugs before promoting code.
* Cross-Role Support:

o Partner with the Data Architect to review and adapt physical and logical data models and pipeline designs.

o Support the Data Scientist / Visualization Designer by integrating new data sources to power Tableau dashboard refreshes and preparing source tables for de-identified Institution of Higher Education (IHE) outcome files.

o Coordinate with Operations Engineers on Snowflake compute management, warehouse auto-shutdown, user role permissions, and CI/CD promotion pipelines.

3. Deliverables Created

Technical Code & Pipeline Artifacts

1. Production ETL/ELT Pipelines: Fully developed, scheduled Informatica workflows and Snowflake SQL/transformation pipelines for CDHE Courses and existing operational feeds.

2. Cleansing & Validation Modules: Automated L1, L2, and L3 quality-check rules and Informatica layout-change detection routines in the RAW layer.

3. Identity Matching & Linkage Routines: Documented internal matching scripts linking new partner agency student/workforce records into longitudinal IDs.

4. Analytics Layer Transformation Objects: Production views, tables, and metric models in Snowflake aligned with longitudinal reporting use cases .

5. De-Identified Data Extraction Scripts: Data extraction scripts that generate de-identified, suppressed outcome files for participating

description:
Early Career Data Engineer

*Are you ready to combine your passion for design with a meaningful and multifaceted career in the cycling industry? At Specialized, our teammates are encouraged to explore roles across a variety of functions throughout their careers. We value curiosity, a desire to try new things, and an eagerness to learn about all aspects of the business. Join us in making the world a better place through the power of bicycles and build your dream career at the same time!*

As a Specialized Early Career Data Engineer, you won’t be watching from the sidelines. You’ll step into meaningful work, bring a fresh perspective, and help shape **the future of Specialized and how we show up for riders around the world.**

Bring your curiosity. Bring your ideas. Bring the courage to challenge what’s been done before. You’ll work alongside people who are constantly pushing what’s possible, learn from experienced leaders, and have the opportunity to leave your mark on a brand built around riders.

If you’re ready to learn fast, think differently, and **help write the next chapter of Specialized**, come ride with us.

The Junior Data Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing trusted data products, data pipelines, and AI-ready data assets that power reporting, analytics, operational decision-making, and emerging AI capabilities across the organization.

Working within a modern cloud-based data platform, this role helps improve data accessibility, quality, reliability, and scalability while enabling self-service analytics and AI innovation. The Junior Data Engineer partners closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver curated, business-ready datasets that accelerate decision-making and maximize the value of enterprise data.

This position provides critical delivery capacity for the Data & Analytics team while creating a sustainable pipeline of future engineering talent. The role allows senior engineers and architects to focus on platform modernization, governance, AI enablement, and strategic initiatives while ensuring day-to-day engineering execution is delivered effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Data Engineering & Data Product Development**
-----------------------------------------------

* Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines, integrations, and data products.
* Develop ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, and deliver data from enterprise systems.
* Support the development of trusted, reusable datasets for analytics, reporting, operational processes, and AI initiatives.
* Assist with data warehouse, lakehouse, and semantic layer development.
* Contribute to scalable cloud-based data platform solutions.

**Data Quality, Reliability & Observability**
---------------------------------------------

* Monitor pipeline performance, data quality, and platform health.
* Implement data validation, reconciliation, and automated quality controls.
* Support data observability and proactive issue detection.
* Troubleshoot production issues and participate in root-cause analysis.
* Help establish and maintain data reliability standards and service levels.

**Analytics & Self-Service Enablement**
---------------------------------------

* Deliver curated datasets that enable self-service reporting and analytics.
* Partner with business and analytics teams to understand and translate data requirements.
* Support semantic models and business-friendly data structures.
* Improve data accessibility, documentation, and usability across the organization.
* Reduce manual reporting effort through automation and standardized data assets.

**AI & Data Foundation Support**
--------------------------------

* Prepare and curate data for AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics use cases.
* Support the development of AI-ready datasets, metadata, and lineage documentation.
* Collaborate with governance and analytics teams to ensure data is trusted, documented, and fit for AI applications.
* Support responsible AI initiatives through strong data quality and governance practices.
* Assist with integrating new AI-related data sources and capabilities into the enterprise platform.

**Continuous Improvement & Delivery Excellence**
------------------------------------------------

* Participate in Agile planning, sprint execution, and team ceremonies.
* Follow modern engineering practices including source control, testing, and CI/CD.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency.
* Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, datasets, and integrations.
* Continuously develop technical skills across cloud, analytics, and AI technologies.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 1+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or similar technical roles.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts.
* Experience with Python or another modern programming language.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data integration principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with modern orchestration and transformation tools.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, and testing frameworks.
* Understanding of data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and semantic models.
* Exposure to machine learning, AI, or Generative AI concepts.
* Experience working in Agile product teams.
* Knowledge of data governance and metadata management practices.

**Success Measures**
====================

Within the first 12 months, the Junior Data Engineer will:

* Successfully build and support production data pipelines and integrations.
* Improve data quality, reliability, and observability across key business domains.
* Deliver trusted datasets that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
* Reduce manual data processing through automation and engineering best practices.
* Increase team delivery capacity by owning operational and repeatable engineering activities.
* Demonstrate proficiency with enterprise data platforms and engineering standards.
* Contribute to the organization's AI readiness by improving the quality and accessibility of enterprise data.

**Tell Me More**

**Benefits include:**

* Compensation: $76,000 to $104,000 annually
* Medical, Dental, & vision insurance available
* Company sponsored life insurance
* Competitive vacation package\*
* 401(k) with match
* Paid company holidays
* Employee discounts on all product
* Deep partner retail discounts

*Here at Specialized we believe that bikes have the power to change lives. Our culture is one of passion, striving to break barriers and have a positive impact on the world.*

*We want to increase representation of all races, genders, and body types in the cycling industry and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce where all people thrive. We encourage everyone – especially those from marginalized groups – to apply to our job postings and help us earn the position as the rider’s brand of choice. We are always looking for creative, innovative, and passionate people who are eager to contribute to our mission of pedaling the planet forward. Regardless of your qualifications, if you are ready to make a difference, please apply and let us know how you can make an impact at Specialized!*

*See what we are up to on* *LinkedIn**,* *Instagram**, and most importantly, our #**DogsofSpecialized**.*

title: Data Integration & Pipeline Engineer
description:
LRE (Leeward Renewable Energy) is forging an American energy future with integrity, innovation, and positive impact. Born in Texas in 2003, we own and operate over 30 utility-scale wind, solar, and energy storage projects in local communities across the United States, totaling 4 gigawatts (GW) of generating capacity.

LRE continues to help meet increased U.S. energy demand through our robust pipeline of new projects every year. Domestic jobs and manufacturing are fundamental to our full-lifecycle approach to projects, along with a long-term ownership model and a company culture dedicated to our community partners and protecting the natural environment.

Job Summary:  
The Data Integration & Pipeline Engineer (P3) builds and maintains reliable, scalable data pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and operational systems. This role ensures data flows efficiently across platforms while embedding technical controls for quality, performance, and observability.

Key Responsibilities:  

* Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data
* Integrate APIs, third-party data, and operational systems
* Design and optimize curated (bronze/silver/gold) data layers
* Automate data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration
* Implement monitoring, logging, and observability frameworks
* Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance of pipelines
* Troubleshoot data failures and performance bottlenecks
* Embed validation checks and quality controls within pipelines
* Support MDM integrations and data synchronization processes
* Collaborate with Governance & Quality Engineer to implement steward-defined rules

Qualifications:  
  
Required:  

* 5+ years in data engineering
* Strong SQL and programming skills (Python, Scala, etc.)
* Experience building pipelines in cloud data platforms
* Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices for data
* Understanding of data modeling concepts and data warehouse/lakehouse design

Preferred:  

* Experience implementing data quality frameworks, validation rules, and pipeline testing
* Familiarity with metadata management and data catalog platforms (Collibra, Alation, Purview)
* Experience supporting analytics and BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker
* Experience working in agile data teams with strong collaboration between engineering, governance, and analytics

  
Please Note: This is an in-office role, requiring on-site presence in our office a minimum of three days per week with hybrid flexibility of working remotely two days per week, subject to manager and policy approval. #LI-Hybrid

title: DevOps Engineer I
description:
Overview:

Supports the organization’s Development Operations (DevOps) strategy to ensure quality software deployments and help maintain the health, availability, security, reliability, and performance of critical business systems.

The DevOps Engineer I is an early-career role for someone with hands-on exposure to operating systems, cloud infrastructure, deployment tools, and automation who wants to grow that into deep DevOps expertise. Working alongside senior DevOps engineers, the DevOps Engineer I deploys software, maintains and troubleshoots systems, and helps improve system performance, taking on more complex work as skills and experience grow.

This role suits a proactive, curious person who enjoys learning new tools, asks good questions, and takes ownership of their work.

Responsibilities:

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for .NET web services and APIs, from build and test through deployment of the services.
* Troubleshoot build, packaging (.NET CLI, MSBuild, and NuGet), configuration, and deployment failures with developers.
* Write and update Terraform for AWS and on-premises resources, following team modules and merge-request reviews, and use Ansible and Octopus Deploy to automate configuration and releases.
* Develop scripts and automation tools that remove repetitive manual work.
* Prepare and run releases through Octopus Deploy and GitLab CI, following change-control and approval steps, and coordinate maintenance windows with application owners and stakeholders.
* Administer system and application monitoring, logging, and alerting; respond to incidents and take part in a shared on-call rotation for production support.
* Work with developers to keep development, test, and production environments stable and ready for releases, and with cross-functional teams to turn requirements into technical solutions.
* Help support, troubleshoot, and containerize Windows and Linux services with Docker and deploy them to Amazon ECS.
* Use MS SQL queries and tools to troubleshoot application issues and validate applications after deployment.
* Administer Windows servers and web services for application hosting: sites, app pools, bindings, and certificates.
* Troubleshoot routine network hardware and software issues to restore services, and escalate complex or unusual malfunctions to senior engineers.
* Troubleshoot IP routing, certificate, Active Directory, VPN access, and DNS issues, with guidance from senior engineers on complex cases.
* Apply security patches following the team's patch management process and remediate vulnerabilities identified by the Security team.
* Follow PCI DSS, PCI CP, and SOX practices for secrets, access, and change records.
* Document system configurations, processes, and runbooks in Confluence and Jira.
* Manage assigned tasks and small projects, delivering services and deployments that meet stakeholder requirements, with support from senior team members.

  
Qualifications:

* Exposure to supporting .NET (C#) applications.
* Experience with Ansible or another configuration management tool.
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, or Microsoft 365 Copilot to assist with coding, or building AI skills or agents to automate tasks and workflows.
* Exposure to virtualization platforms such as Nutanix, VMware vSphere, or Hyper-V, and to storage technologies.
* Experience configuring or troubleshooting network settings and proxy servers on Windows and Linux.
* Experience writing SQL queries against relational databases to troubleshoot issues or gather data.
* Exposure to Amazon EKS or Kubernetes.
* Experience with Octopus Deploy.
* Experience in a highly regulated or highly secure environment (PCI DSS, PCI CP, or SOX).
* Experience with Jira and Confluence, or SharePoint.
* Exposure to HSM and PGP/RSA key management.
* Experience creating network or system diagrams with tools such as Visio or Lucidchart.
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or actively working toward one.
* Hands-on experience with a Git-based CI tool (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins), including Git and merge-request workflows, from work, coursework, or personal projects.
* Working knowledge of Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool, from work or lab projects.
* Experience administering Windows Server and virtual machines, including IIS, and basic Linux skills.
* Scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Basic knowledge of relational databases and SQL queries.
* Familiarity with core AWS services (EC2, ECS, VPC, IAM, and S3) and with Docker.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, proxies, load balancing, and TLS, plus basic knowledge of Active Directory and certificates.
* Solid troubleshooting skills and a methodical approach to solving problems.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including technical documentation.
* A proactive, curious attitude and eagerness to learn new tools and take on new challenges.

**Requirements:**

* B.S. or M.S. degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience in a relevant IT field such as DevOps, systems administration, or software development. Internships, co-op roles, and substantial lab or home-lab projects count.

**Physical Demands:**

* Office Environment: This position primarily operates in a professional office environment and requires the ability to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation. Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer, including extensive use of a keyboard, mouse, and telephone. Frequent viewing of computer monitors and electronic devices requiring close visual attention. Regular verbal communication and active listening during in-person, virtual, and telephone meetings. Ability to occasionally stand, walk, bend, reach, and move throughout office and meeting spaces. Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull materials weighing up to 15 pounds, such as laptops, presentation materials, luggage, or office supplies. Ability to travel periodically by automobile and commercial airline, which may include navigating airports, train stations, hotels, and customer or company locations. Ability to transport and manage personal luggage, computer equipment, and work-related materials during business travel. Ability to work in a variety of environments, including offices, conference facilities, hotels, airports, and manufacturing or operational locations, as applicable. May require occasional early morning, evening, or overnight travel based on business needs. CPI Card Group is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the position.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

CPI Card Group® is a payment technology company and leading provider of credit, debit and prepaid solutions delivered physically, digitally and on-demand. CPI helps our customers foster connections and build their brands through innovative and reliable solutions, including financial payment cards, personalization and fulfillment, and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) instant issuance. Learn more at www.cpicardgroup.com.

Competitive pay rates and an inclusive, empowering and rewarding culture.

title: DevOps Full Stack Engineer - Remote - Nationwide
description:

Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare
  
  
At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.
  
  
Join the Vituity Team.At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.
  
  
**Vituity Locations:** Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot customer-managed automation and orchestration tools and platforms.
* Build and maintain full-stack applications, including responsive user interfaces and scalable application programming interfaces.

title: Associate Dev Ops Engineer
description:
**Employment Type:** Salaried  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

This position is primally responsible for building, maintaining, and scaling our DevOps infrastructure, ensuring reliability, performance, and security across development pipelines and production environments in AWS Cloud.

**Major Duties and Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------------

Assist in the setup and administration of AWS environments (Dev, QA, UAT, PROD) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or CloudFormation under senior guidance. Monitor resource usage and support basic cost optimization efforts.

Maintain and troubleshoot existing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions. Assist in the deployments, and support build and release processes for development teams.

title: AWS Cloud DevOps Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

You will build and own the cloud and server infrastructure behind our internal and public-facing applications. You automate how we deploy, patch, monitor and recover our systems, and work with developers and other IT professionals to keep services secure and available.

The ideal candidate is hands-on with AWS and infrastructure as code, writes clear documentation, and prefers repeatable automation to manual work.

Our stack: AWS (S3, Route 53, ECS, ECR, CloudFront, ALB, EC2, WAF, VPC, RDS), OpenTofu, Ansible with Semaphore UI, New Relic, Snyk and an AWS secrets and param store. Applications include Angular front ends, NestJS and Go back ends, WordPress with custom PHP plugins.

No application programming requirements but you will work closely with out Software Engineers on CI/CD pipelines and New Relic and IAC config PR’s.

**Location and Interviews**

This is a hybrid role based in our Salt Lake City office, with 2 days in the office each week. With the exception of an initial HR phone screen, all interviews will be conducted in person at our Salt Lake City office, with no video interviews for subsequent rounds. Relocation assistance is not available; candidates must already be located in the Salt Lake metro area or be willing to relocate at their own expense before starting.

Key Responsibilities

* Build and maintain AWS infrastructure, including networking, load balancing, containers, databases, storage and DNS.

* Manage infrastructure as code with OpenTofu. Automate server configuration and patching with Ansible and Semaphore UI.

* Maintain and patch Linux servers in AWS and on-premises.

* Own our CI/CD platform and deployments to ECS.

* Design, automate and test disaster recovery: backups, failover and restores. Run quarterly tests and report measured recovery time and data loss against targets.

* Manage IAM, secrets, certificates, WAF and network security controls.

* Own host and infrastructure monitoring in New Relic, and route alerts to the right people.

* Host applications that pass review, including business-built applications that move into production.

* Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so any team member can resolve common issues.

* Produce evidence for ISO 27001 controls on infrastructure, access, backup and change management.

* Answer infrastructure requests and escalate when needed.

* Tell developers and business users plainly, and respectfully, when a request is unsafe or should be done differently.

* Support infrastructure during business hours. Possible on-call rotation could come in the future but would be a limited requirement.

Required Qualifications

* Clear written and spoken communication. You document your work, and you can push back respectfully on risky changes while staying someone people want to work with.

* 3 or more years in DevOps, cloud or systems engineering.

* Hands-on AWS: ECS, ALB, CloudFront, Route 53, S3, VPC, RDS and IAM.

* Infrastructure as code with OpenTofu or Terraform.

* Configuration management with Ansible or similar.

* Linux server administration.

* Scripting in Bash and Python or Go.

* CI/CD pipelines and Docker containers.

* Monitoring and alerting experience.

* You have designed and tested backup and disaster recovery for production systems.

* You have designed AWS networking and IAM with security in mind.

* You have supported audit evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 or similar.

* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Nice to Have**

None of these are required.

* AWS Solutions Architect or similar certification.

* Security+ or similar.

* Semaphore UI or New Relic experience.

* WordPress hosting experience.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Overview**  
We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and carry out a layered monitoring and alerting strategy for containerized applications on AWS Fargate. Your goal is to catch real problems that affect users, while keeping alert noise near zero. Every alert must lead to action.  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Set up and maintain monitoring across synthetic tests, real-user monitoring (RUM), application performance monitoring (APM) and tracing, error tracking, and service-level objectives (SLOs).
* Set up and maintain CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and dashboards for ECS/Fargate, RDS, OpenSearch, and Application Load Balancers (ALB).
* Enforce a consistent tagging scheme across AWS resources, monitors, and SLOs, and keep data collection limited to what’s needed.
* Deploy and configure monitoring agents (including sidecar containers) in Fargate task definitions. This includes health checks for RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL), OpenSearch, and self-managed databases on EC2/ECS.
* Connect AWS accounts to monitoring tools using least-privilege, read-only IAM roles.
* Write and maintain the infrastructure code for this work in AWS CloudFormation/CDK.
* Keep alerting clean. Tune, demote, or remove any alert that doesn’t lead to action, and use persistence and multi-location thresholds to prevent false alarms.
* Build application dashboards and create standard alert message templates.
* Work with application teams to add tracing to their services and to define SLOs.
* Take part in incident response and post-incident reviews during business hours, using metrics, traces, and logs to find root causes.

**Required qualifications**

* 5+ years in SRE, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure engineering.
* At least 2 years building production monitoring with a full observability platform, such as Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Elastic Observability.
* Hands-on experience with AWS ECS/Fargate, RDS, OpenSearch, ALB, and IAM.
* Hands-on experience with CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and dashboards.
* Skilled with AWS CloudFormation and/or CDK.
* Practical experience with SLOs, error budgets, and designing alerts based on user-facing symptoms rather than underlying causes.
* Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, plus OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, from an operations standpoint.
* Scripting skills in Python or a similar language.
* Able to obtain and keep a Public Trust determination.
* Possession of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university according to the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) in related field.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with Datadog (synthetic tests, RUM, APM, monitors, SLOs).
* Experience with Sumo Logic: writing queries, building dashboards, and setting up alerts.
* Experience with CloudWatch Logs, including Logs Insights queries and metric filters.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry or adding tracing to services in more than one language (Node, Python, Java, .NET, Go).
* Experience in federal or other regulated environments.
* AWS certification (SysOps Administrator, DevOps Engineer, or Solutions Architect).

  
**Salary:** $120,000-$160,000 based on experience.  
  
**Work Location:** Hybrid (1 day in office, 4 days remote per week) in Rockville, MD 20850

title: Azure Quality Assurance/DevOps
description:
We are hiring a QA/DevOps Engineer to own the quality, reliability and delivery pipeline of our GenAI and agentic AI products on Microsoft Azure. You will build the automation, evaluation frameworks and infrastructure that let us ship LLM powered applications (RAG pipelines, multi step agents and the APIs and UIs around them) quickly and with confidence.  
This role sits at the intersection of software testing, cloud operations and AI evaluation. Non deterministic outputs, prompt and model changes, and agent behavior across multiple steps require testing approaches that go beyond traditional unit and integration tests. You will help define them.  
This position is located in our Plano, Texas office with work performed at client site in Plano, Texas; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable. You will be required to be at client site 3 days/week.  
What You'll Do  
Quality engineering for GenAI and agents  
  
. Design and maintain automated test suites for Python/FastAPI services (unit, integration, contract, load) and React front ends (component and end to end).  
. Build evaluation pipelines for RAG and agentic workflows: retrieval quality, groundedness, answer relevance, hallucination rates, tool call accuracy and multi step LangGraph agent trajectories.  
. Create and curate golden datasets, regression sets and adversarial test cases (prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII leakage, unsafe output) and gate releases on the results.  
. Use LangSmith for tracing, datasets, experiments and online/offline evaluation to catch regressions when prompts, models or retrieval configs change.  
. Define quality metrics and thresholds with engineers and product owners, and report them in a form the team can act on.  
  
DevOps and Azure infrastructure  
  
. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) with automated quality, security and evaluation gates.  
. Provision and manage Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM) for services such as Azure Container Apps/AKS, App Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Key Vault, Storage and networking.  
. Containerize applications with Docker and manage environments, secrets, configuration and promotion across dev, test and production.  
. Implement monitoring, alerting and cost tracking (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics) including token usage, latency and error budgets for LLM calls.  
. Support incident response, root cause analysis and post incident improvements for AI services in production.  
  
Collaboration  
  
. Work closely with AI engineers, backend and front end developers, and security and compliance teams to embed quality and reliability into design, not just release.  
. Document test strategies, runbooks and evaluation methodology, and share best practices for testing non deterministic systems.  
  
What You'll Bring:  
Required Qualifications  
  
. 4+ years in QA automation, DevOps, SDET or site reliability engineering, with at least 1 year working on or alongside ML/AI enabled applications.  
. Strong Python skills, including pytest and test automation for REST APIs; working knowledge of FastAPI.  
. Hands on experience with Azure services and cloud deployment (containers, networking basics, identity/RBAC, Key Vault, monitoring).  
. Proven experience building CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.  
. Experience with infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or equivalent) and Docker; Kubernetes experience is a plus.  
. Experience testing React applications (Playwright, Cypress, Jest or React Testing Library).  
. Understanding of how LLM applications work: prompts, embeddings, vector search, retrieval and agent tool use, and why they need different testing than deterministic software.  
. Solid grasp of test strategy, API and performance testing, and quality metrics.  
. Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable working across engineering, product and security teams.  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
. Hands on experience with LangChain and LangGraph, including testing graph based and multi agent workflows.  
. Experience with LangSmith (tracing, datasets, evaluators, experiments) or comparable LLM observability tools.  
. Experience evaluating RAG systems with frameworks such as Ragas, DeepEval or custom LLM as judge approaches, and knowing their limits.  
. Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search.  
. Knowledge of AI safety and security testing: prompt injection, data exfiltration, content filtering and responsible AI practices.  
. Experience with load testing (Locust, k6 or Azure Load Testing) and with FinOps practices for token and compute spend.  
. Azure certifications such as AZ 400 (DevOps Engineer Expert), AZ 104 or AI 102.  
. Background in a regulated or enterprise environment with compliance requirements.

title: SRE & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**COMPANY DESCRIPTION**

Rancher Government Solutions (RGS) is specifically designed to address the unique security and operational needs of the U.S. Government and military as it relates to application modernization, containers, and Kubernetes.

Rancher is a complete open-source software stack for teams adopting containers. It addresses the operations and security challenges of managing multiple Kubernetes clusters at scale, while providing DevOps teams with integrated tools for running containerized workloads.

This role encompasses end-to-end operational charter across enterprise and federal zones, including AWS, AWS GovCloud, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Azure / AzureGov. Key scope includes operational ownership of core infrastructure, container orchestration platforms, server baseline enforcement, datacenter facilities management, infrastructure automation, hardware procurement, and operations innovation.

* Build scalable, repeatable Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and configuration management automation utilizing Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps deployment pipelines.

* Lead cross-functional IT Operations architecture governance, partnering with teams on unified cross-cloud platform pipelines.

* Pioneer AI-driven infrastructure strategies, next-generation automation, and intelligent operational tooling to continuously optimize system performance and reliability.
* Foster a culture of technical innovation, operational excellence, proactive error budget management, continuous metrics monitoring, and automated health checks across engineering teams.
* Promote knowledge sharing, internal SME guidance, and cross-team alignment on best practices for Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), GitOps, and multi-cloud architecture.

description:

* Analyze cloud spend and billing data; identify cost-optimization opportunities.

* Clear written and verbal communicator.

* Associate-level cloud certification (AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer).
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Git-based workflows.
* Exposure to backup/DR tooling, SFTP/managed file transfer, and directory services / Active Directory integration.
* Experience with cost management and tagging governance at scale.
* Scripting for automation (Python or shell).

title: Product Analytics Engineer
description:
**Location**
------------

Remote in the USA

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Remote

**Department**
--------------

Strategy & Operations

  

**We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse**
=================================================

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

Every month, millions of eligibility checks, claims, remittances, and claim statuses flow between healthcare providers and payers through our clearinghouse. Our Network Operations team is responsible for the health, growth, and operational efficiency of this system.

As a Product Analytics Engineer your job is to analyze the transactions flowing through our rails in order to improve eligibility check success rates, reduce claim rejections, and optimize our payer routes.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Define business metrics to determine the “network health” of our clearinghouse
* Instrument dashboards, reports, and alerts for both the network operations and engineering teams to take action on in order to continuously improve our payer routing and API logic
* Work with product, engineering, and design to “productize” these metrics within the Stedi application for end-customer consumption
* Ensure customer invoices, application reporting, internal reporting, and vendor invoices match with no manual reconciliation. When numbers differ, find the cause in the data pipeline and fix it there.
* Build internal tools, scripts, and runbooks to help Stedi manage the network and make decisions quickly
* Manage a well-defined backlog of issues in Linear

**Who you are**
---------------

* **You have exceptional analytics and documentation skills:** You’ve made a career in working with data to improve products and overall business operations. You know the tools, best practices, and playbooks necessary to stand up a high-performing and organized analytics function at the company.
* **You think like an architect.** You anticipate bugs before they surface and design data models, pipelines, and schemas that hold up as volume grows. You’ve owned production pipelines end to end and have built ETL systems at scale.
* **You know the tech stack.** You consider yourself an expert in the modern data stack (DBT, Redshift), and consider yourself an expert in SQL, data visualization, and structuring complex database schemas. You are excited about using new AI technologies to enhance your productivity and output.
* **You create and execute your own work:** You are relentlessly curious, and want to become an expert in the product and the overall operation so you can create and prove your own hypotheses. You are not satisfied in a role where someone hands you requirements.
* **You do what it takes to get the job done.** You are resourceful, self-motivating, self-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours.
* **You move quickly**. We move quickly as an organization. This requires an ability to match our pace and not get lost by responding with urgency (both externally to payers and internally to stakeholders), communicating what you are working on, and proactively asking for help or feedback when you need it.
* **You are a “bottom feeder”.** You thrive on the details. No task is too small in order to find success, generate revenue, and improve our costs.

**We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team.** Please note:

* All official communication about roles at Stedi will **only come from an @****stedi.com** **email address**, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.
* If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to **contact us directly at** **careers@stedi.com****.**

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

*At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.*

title: Security Platform Engineer I – Splunk, Analytics & Automation
description:
**At Zotec Partners, our People make it happen.**  
  
Transforming the healthcare industry isn’t easy. But when you build a team like the one we have, that goal can become a reality. Our accomplishments can’t happen without our extraordinary people – the men and women across the country who make up our diverse Zotec family and help make this company a best place to work.  
  
Over 25 years ago, we started Zotec with a clear vision, to partner with physicians to simplify the business of healthcare. Today we are more than 900 employees strong and we continue to use our incredible talent and energy to bring that vision to life. We are a team of **Innovators, Collaborators and Doers.**  
  
We’re seeking a **Security Platform Engineer I** to join us.  
  
This is an entry-level role for a recent graduate who wants to learn enterprise Splunk and security data engineering from the ground up, with close mentorship and review, during a major platform migration.  
  
Zotec runs a distributed Splunk Enterprise environment (including Enterprise Security and ITSI) alongside a small Splunk Cloud instance. We are growing our Splunk Cloud Victoria footprint to roughly 2 TB/day, with Splunk taking over hosted upgrades and patching. Our InfoSec enterprise data lake is part of the same platform.  
After the migration, about half of this work shifts from running Splunk to cross-tool security analytics,integrations, and automation.  
  
You will work from defined tasks with review of every change, and you will escalate anything outside a runbook.  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* **Platform**
  + Run daily health checks (ingestion, forwarder status, skipped searches, license use) and document findings.
  + Onboard straightforward data sources using existing add-ons, under review.
  + Build dashboards, reports, and saved searches from defined requirements.
  + Inventory apps, inputs, and content for the Splunk Cloud migration and help test content after cutover.
* **Analytics and Automation**
  + Write small Python scripts and API pulls that feed team metrics, with code review.
  + Validate report data against its source and flag mismatches.
  + Onboard AI tool logs from a defined pattern.
* **Team**
  + Answer basic search and data questions from the SOC and analysts.
  + Write and update runbooks as you learn.
  + Join the on-call rotation after about six months, with a senior engineer as backup.
* **AI Platform Data**
  + Support onboarding and maintenance of logs from the AI tools Zotec uses (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Bedrock, and OpenTelemetry feeds) and from AI security tooling.
  + Help automate the data behind monthly AI usage reporting and allowed-model and shadow-AI views.

**What you’ll bring to Zotec:**

* **Required Qualifications**
  + Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  + Basic scripting in Python (preferred) or PowerShell.
  + Linux command line and basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, ports, TLS).
  + Basic SQL or another query language.
  + Careful attention to detail and clear written communication.
  + Responsible handling of sensitive data, including PHI.
* **Preferred Qualifications**
  + Splunk Core Certified User (free Splunk training counts) or a home lab with Splunk or another SIEM.
  + Internship, co-op, or lab work in IT, security, or data.
  + Familiarity with Git, REST APIs, or JSON.
  + CompTIA Security+.

At Zotec, our purpose is to make healthcare work better for everyone. We value trust, excellence, and care in how we work with our clients and each other. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, contribute ideas, and learn from experienced colleagues who want you to succeed. If that sounds like the kind of team you’d like to join, we’d like to talk with you.  
  
Learn more about our organization, by visiting us at www.zotecpartners.com

title: Data Platform Engineer (Palantir Foundry & Databricks)
description:
Construction Partners Inc., a publicly traded highway infrastructure company, is currently seeking a Data Platform Engineer to join the team in Dothan, AL. Remote work will be considered for the right candidate.

**Who You Are**

A skilled data and application engineer who will serve as a core member of CPI’s data platform team. This position is responsible for consolidating data from CPI’s operational and financial systems into a centralized lakehouse and for developing operational applications on Palantir Foundry that support plant, field, equipment, and financial decision-making across the organization. The role spans the full lifecycle of that work: integrating source systems, modeling and governing data, and delivering production applications, including solutions that replace or extend third-party software and provide real-time visibility into plants, jobs, trucking, and equipment. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with sound software development practices and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. This engineer will work alongside CPI’s existing Foundry team and external consulting partners and will serve as the internal owner of the platform’s design and institutional knowledge. Prior Foundry experience is preferred.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that bring data from ERP and accounting, estimating, field production, plant operations, equipment, and telematics systems into Databricks, connecting through relational databases, REST APIs, and SFTP or flat-file feeds.
* Develop batch and incremental pipelines in Python, PySpark, and SQL using a layered lakehouse approach that cleans, standardizes, and combines data into documented, reusable datasets.
* Help define a common data model across operating companies, including how jobs, equipment, plants, employees, vendors, and customers are keyed and matched when each company and system names them differently.
* Build reconciliation checks so that platform figures tie out to the ERP and other systems of record.
* Handle the realities of source data, including schema changes, late or duplicate records, inconsistent keys, and API limits or failures.
* Support data onboarding for newly acquired companies: profile their source systems, map them to the common model, and bring them onto the platform using a repeatable approach.
* Connect Foundry to the Databricks lakehouse and other sources, and configure authentication, permissions, and sync schedules.
* Design and extend Ontology object types, links, properties, and actions that reflect how the business operates, reusing the existing model rather than duplicating it.
* Build operational applications and automated workflows using Workshop, Pipeline Builder, Code Repositories, and TypeScript or Python functions, moving to OSDK and custom front-end development where low-code tools reach their limits.
* Contribute to geospatial and time-series capabilities such as geofencing, cycle-time analytics, and equipment utilization.
* Develop AIP and LLM-assisted workflows that apply AI to operational problems, in line with CPI’s AI and data governance policies.
* Take ownership of existing Foundry solutions, document how they work, and mature them into maintainable, supported products.
* Monitor pipeline and sync health, set up alerting, and troubleshoot failed feeds, pipeline issues, and application defects.
* Apply least-privilege access controls, markings, and data lineage, coordinating access design with IT Security.
* Follow and help strengthen the team’s practices for version control, code review, testing, documentation, and releases.
* Partner with external consultants as a hands-on contributor and ensure what they deliver is understood, documented, and supportable internally.
* Work directly with business leaders and end users to map workflows, identify pain points, and turn ambiguous needs into technical designs and delivery plans.
* Lead rollout and adoption with business owners and use feedback and operational results to keep improving the platform.

**Minimum Requirements**

  

* 2-4 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or data integration, building and supporting systems used in production.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, or Palantir Foundry, and meaningful exposure to at least one other enterprise grade platform.
* Strong SQL, including complex joins and window functions, and the ability to work quickly in unfamiliar schemas on platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
* Strong Python for data work, including Pandas or PySpark, API integration, and automation scripting.
* Experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, rate limits, and error handling, and working with JSON, CSV, and file-based feeds.
* Solid understanding of data modeling, including relational and dimensional design, keys, and how data flows and transforms across systems.
* Software engineering fundamentals, including Git, testing, code review, and maintainable, documented code.
* Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar platforms quickly and apply them in production.
* Ability to work directly with business users and leaders, explain tradeoffs in plain terms, and take ownership from discovery through everyday use.

**Preferred Experience**

* Palantir Foundry, including pipelines, Ontology, Workshop, and OSDK, or Foundry certifications.  
  Databricks certifications, or experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows.
* TypeScript, along with React or another front-end framework.
* Palantir AIP or other LLM-backed workflows.
* Geospatial or telematics data, such as GPS, geofences, and engine hours.
* ERP and accounting data, especially construction ERPs, job costing, equipment, and materials data.
* Integrating data across mergers and acquisitions or multi-entity organizations.
* Azure cloud services.
* Experience in construction, heavy civil, materials, or other field-operations industries. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

At Construction Partners, we don’t just build roads – we build leaders. We provide opportunities for our employees to grow and develop meaningful careers at all levels. In addition, we offer a wide variety of benefits to support our employees’ well-being, including:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching
* Paid vacation and holidays
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (Construction Partners, Inc.: ROAD)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Professional Development Opportunities

Construction Partners, Inc. is dedicated to the achievement of equality of opportunity for all its employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, age, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected group status under federal, state or local law. Construction Partners, Inc. is an E-Verify Participant.

CPI complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please let us know.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer -  Marketing
description:
About Point

**✨ Real Impact, Real People:**
 Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

**✨ Funding:**
 With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we’re scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

**✨ Game-changing Product:**
 We're building a category defining company in home equity. We’ve earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

**✨ Great Place to Work:**
 Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

**✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:**
Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week.

**Local or 100% Remote**

**About the role**

Point helps homeowners unlock the equity in their homes without taking on a monthly payment, and we find those homeowners through a multi-channel marketing program that keeps growing: millions of pieces of direct mail a month, paid search and social, affiliates, CTV and a fast-growing broker channel. The data behind all of it lives in Snowflake and dbt, and today the marketing analysts build their own pipelines and dashboards on top of it. You will be the first analytics engineer dedicated to marketing. You own the models, the definitions and the activation feeds the team runs on, so every dashboard, experiment and audience reads the same numbers. You sit on the central data team and work day to day with the marketing analysts, with data scientists working on incrementality and media mix modeling, and with the product and engineering teams whose changes decide what gets captured. The work is visible: dashboards that load, attribution that reconciles, an audience and suppression table that replaces spreadsheets, and a semantic layer our AI analyst tooling can trust.

**Your responsibilities**

* Own the dbt models behind marketing reporting and activation: channel, campaign and source definitions, lead and funnel tables, attribution inputs. Layered, tested, with freshness checks.
* Build and maintain a governed semantic layer for marketing (channel, campaign and funnel definitions) so Sigma dashboards and AI-assisted analysis return the same answer to the same question.
* Move heavy transformations out of Sigma workbooks into dbt so the dashboards marketing leadership relies on load fast, then right-size the warehouse behind them.
* Keep activation pipelines healthy (Hightouch syncs, Google Ads and other Conversion API uploads, DSP feeds) and onboard new channels and partners through a repeatable pattern rather than bespoke work.
* Build the warehouse foundations for measurement: experiment assignment and universal control tables, holdout flags, and the feeds our media mix modeling vendor and incrementality analyses depend on.
* Build and maintain the audience and suppression table in Snowflake, with eligibility, model scores and suppression flags per property, feeding direct mail, email and the Audience and Campaign Manager so a suppression entered once applies everywhere.
* Partner with product and engineering before launches that change what the data captures (a new channel like broker, a new flow like Bridge) and define how they land in the models so reporting is right from day one.
* Take engineering work off the marketing analysts: review their PRs, hold the standard that new dashboards read from dbt models, and turn recurring requests into reusable data products.
* Monitor data quality on the marketing marts and close reliability issues so they stay closed: channel mismatches, missing affiliate payouts, unattributed spend.

**About you**

* 5+ years building data models for a business team as an analytics engineer, data engineer or engineering-minded analyst.
* Strong SQL and production dbt experience: layered models, tests, documentation, performance tuning.
* Hands-on with marketing data: ad platform exports (Google, Meta or similar), CRM and marketing automation sources, campaign and channel taxonomies, attribution logic.
* Semantic data modeling. You can turn a messy business question into a durable definition and defend it with the people who use it.
* Comfortable owning a pipeline end to end, including syncs to and from marketing platforms, with monitoring and alerting you set up yourself.
* Clear communicator who works well embedded with a non-engineering team, and who will choose a reusable model over a quick hack and explain why.
* Able to prioritize a queue of requests from several stakeholders and say plainly what will ship and when.
* Git-based workflow and code review as a habit, not a chore.

**Nice to have**

* Snowflake, AWS and Sigma (or another BI tool where you have refactored slow dashboards onto modeled tables).
* Medallion-style layering in dbt.
* Reverse ETL and activation tooling (Hightouch or similar) and Conversion API integrations.
* Data foundations for experimentation: assignment tables, holdouts, incrementality or media mix modeling data prep.
* AI-assisted engineering workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) in daily use, and interest in building the data layer an AI analyst can query.
* Consumer fintech, lending or direct mail marketing background.
* Python for pipeline glue.

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region | Location | Market Salary):

* Tier 1 | San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle | $132,600 - $163,800
* Tier 2 | Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara & Washington DC | $117,300 - $144,900
* Tier 3 | All other US metro areas | $108,800 - $134,400

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point’s states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

Our benefits

* **Generous health benefits:**
  We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (Health Care FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA).
* **Unlimited paid time off:**
   Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays.
* **Flexible remote and onsite work:**
   Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ.
* **Fully paid parental leave:**
   Point will supplement state Paid Family Leave (PFL) so employees receive 100% of their regular base pay, plus two additional weeks of fully paid leave after state PFL ends. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay.
* **Equity:**
   We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives
